title: 3D-Artist / 3D-Visualisierer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Von beleuchteten Spiegeln über Spiegelschränke und Küchenrückwände bis hin zu Glasduschen und Möbeln nach Maß – die Ares GmbH ist eine moderne Manufaktur mit E-Commerce-DNA. Wir fertigen und vertreiben individuell konfigurierbare Produkte für anspruchsvolle Kunden in ganz Deutschland.

Seit unserer Gründung 2013 beliefern wir jährlich über 100.000 zufriedene Kunden mit maßgefertigten Artikeln. An unserem Produktionsstandort in Lünen arbeiten rund 130 Mitarbeiter unter dem Qualitätsversprechen Made in Germany. Aktuell haben wir einen zweiten Standort mit über 20.000 m² in Lünen eröffnet – inklusive Fitnessraum und Sauna für unser Team.

Die Financial Times und Statista haben die Ares GmbH in den Jahren 2020 und 2021 zu einem der 1.000 am schnellsten wachsenden Unternehmen Europas gekürt.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung fotorealistischer 3D-Visualisierungen und Renderings unserer Produkte für Online-Shops, Kataloge, B2B-Partner und Social-Media-Kanäle
  • Modellierung und Texturierung von Spiegeln, Glasduschen, Möbeln und Wohnaccessoires
  • Gestaltung von Produkt- und Lifestyle-Szenen für Marketing und Vertrieb
  • Einsatz von KI-gestützten Tools zur Bilderstellung, Szenengenerierung und Nachbearbeitung (z. B. Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, ComfyUI)
  • Aufbau und Pflege einer konsistenten 3D-Asset-Bibliothek (Materialien, Texturen, Szenen-Templates)
  • Erstellung und Optimierung von Produktbildern durch die Kombination klassischer 3D-Workflows mit KI-Bildgenerierung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Mediendesign-Team, der E-Commerce-Abteilung und externen Partnern

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich 3D-Design, Mediendesign, Produktdesign oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrung in der Erstellung fotorealistischer 3D-Renderings, idealerweise im Bereich Möbel, Interieur oder Produktvisualisierung
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Blender und/oder 3ds Max
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in KI-Bildgenerierung – Sie wissen, wie man Prompts schreibt, Workflows aufbaut und KI-Output gezielt für Produktvisualisierungen einsetzt
  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Render-Engines (z. B. Cycles, V-Ray, Corona)
  • Kenntnisse in Adobe Photoshop zur Nachbearbeitung und Compositing
  • Gespür für Licht, Materialien, Wohntrends und Ästhetik
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit Blick fürs Detail
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem jungen, dynamisch wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung mit Bonusregelung

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem Unternehmen, das Eigeninitiative belohnt

title: 100 %: Staatlich geprüfte Kosmetikerin in Vollzeit
descriptionHtml:
Ein Haus, in dem Handwerk Zeit hat

Inanna Wellness ist ein privates Haus für Ästhetik und Wohlbefinden in der Charlottenstraße in Berlin-Mitte. Wir arbeiten leise und präzise, mit feinem Handwerk und sorgfältig gewählten Methoden, im Rhythmus unserer Gäste.

Wer hier arbeitet, gestaltet diese Haltung mit: den Menschen vor der Methode, Genauigkeit statt Intensität, Rhythmus statt Beschleunigung.

Diese Haltung wurde mehrfach ausgezeichnet:

  • World Spa Award 2024 und 2025, Best Day Spa Deutschland
  • Gloria Award für Ambiente 2025, 1. Platz
  • Spa Star Award 2025, Publikumspreis
  • Top10 Berlin 2026, Platz 1 in den Kategorien Beauty und Massage
  • CIDESCO-zertifiziert, als einziges Haus in Berlin

Diese Anerkennungen sind nicht das Ziel. Sie sind das Ergebnis einer Arbeitsweise, an der Sie mitwirken können.

Aufgaben

Ihre Arbeit bei Inanna Wellness

Sie begleiten unsere Gäste auf dem Weg zu sichtbarer Verfeinerung von Haut und Haar. Ihre Arbeit verbindet feines Handwerk, das über Generationen weitergegeben wurde, mit sorgfältig gewählten, wissenschaftlich fundierten Methoden der modernen Ästhetik. Technologie verstärkt, was Hände beginnen. Hände geben dem Ergebnis Eleganz.

Sie arbeiten in einem kleinen Team von fünf Menschen, unter der fachlichen Leitung von Chantal Däumig, Meisterin des Hauses.

Bei uns hat jede Behandlung ihre Zeit, in der Regel eine volle Stunde. Wir arbeiten mit wenigen Gästen und der Sorgfalt, die jede Begegnung verdient, nicht mit vielen Terminen am Tag. Was zählt, ist die Genauigkeit der Arbeit und die Aufmerksamkeit für den Menschen vor Ihnen.

Ihre Arbeit hinterlässt mehr als ein sichtbares Ergebnis. Sie gibt den Menschen, die zu uns kommen, Zeit für sich und das Gefühl, in Ruhe gesehen zu werden.

Ihre Schwerpunkte:

  • Sie analysieren Haut und Kopfhaut präzise und geben daraus eine klare, persönliche Empfehlung (Canfield VISIA®, HairMetrix®).
  • Sie gestalten handgeführte Gesichtsrituale (Biologique Recherche®) und beherrschen traditionelle Liftingtechniken (Kobido®, Sculptural Face Lifting™).
  • Sie setzen nicht-invasive Technologie dort ein, wo sie die Arbeit der Hände ergänzt: Ultraschall (LDM® Triple), Radiofrequenz (INDIBA® Elite NS) und LED-Phototherapie (Dermalux® Tri-Wave MD).
  • Sie führen fortgeschrittene Hautbehandlungen mit Genauigkeit und Sorgfalt durch, darunter Microneedling (Candela Exceed™) und chemische Peelings (VI Peel®).
  • Sie übernehmen die dauerhafte Haarentfernung mit Laser (Alma Soprano Titanium®) und Nadelepilation (Apilus®).
  • Mit sanfter Körperarbeit und manueller Lymphdrainage sorgen Sie für Entspannung und Wohlbefinden (Dr. Vodder®, Esalen®).
  • Sie begleiten Menschen in besonderen Lebensphasen mit Würde und Achtsamkeit (MamiSpa®, OncoSpa®).

Ihr Einstieg:

Damit Sie gut ankommen, gestalten wir Ihren Start mit Sorgfalt: ein strukturiertes Onboarding, persönliche Mentorinnen und regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche begleiten Sie. Die ersten sechs Monate verstehen wir als gemeinsame Zeit, in der beide Seiten sicher werden.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen

Sie sind staatlich geprüfte Kosmetikerin, ob am Anfang Ihres Weges oder mit Erfahrung aus dem Spa-, Klinik- oder Hotelumfeld. Präzision, Ästhetik und Achtsamkeit prägen Ihre Arbeit.

NiSV-Zertifikate bringen Sie mit oder erwerben sie zeitnah mit unserer Unterstützung.

Deutsch beherrschen Sie muttersprachlich oder auf vergleichbarem Niveau, Englisch sicher. Weitere Sprachen sind willkommen.

Diskretion ist für Sie selbstverständlich. Sie arbeiten gern in einem kleinen Kreis, begegnen Menschen mit Ruhe und Aufmerksamkeit und entwickeln sich gern weiter.

Benefits

Was Sie bei uns erwartet

Inanna Wellness ist mehr als ein Arbeitsplatz. Entwicklung, Anerkennung und Fürsorge bilden hier eine Kultur, die Sie wachsen lässt.

  • Ein transparentes Bonusmodell mit drei Bausteinen: ein monatlicher Bonus, der Ihren Beitrag widerspiegelt; eine vierteljährliche Prämie für gute Ideen, Zusammenhalt und Gästeerlebnis; und eine Loyalitätsprämie nach fünf Jahren
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss
  • Fünf Wochen Urlaub im Jahr
  • Geregelte, planbare Arbeitszeiten im Boutique-Rhythmus, mit einem festen Ruhetag in der Woche
  • Regelmäßige Masterclasses und rund zwei Wochen Weiterbildung im Jahr, unter anderem mit Biologique Recherche®, Esalen® und Kobido®
  • Klare Entwicklungswege, von fachlicher Spezialisierung über Verantwortung im Team bis zur Meisterin des Hauses
  • Fürsorge im Alltag: Dienstkleidung gestellt und gereinigt, Mahlzeiten und Getränke während der Arbeitszeit, BVG-Firmenticket, Corporate Benefits sowie Gesundheits- und Präventionsangebote
  • Ein Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Berlin-Mittes, in Räumen, die mit Sorgfalt gestaltet sind

Ihre Zukunft beginnt hier

Würde · Wissen · Wirkung.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Präzision, Tiefe und Aufmerksamkeit verbinden und an einer Kultur der Schönheit und des Wohlbefindens mitwirken möchten.

Der Weg zu uns nimmt sich bewusst Zeit, denn eine gute Entscheidung braucht sie, auf beiden Seiten. Er beginnt mit zwei validierten Stärkenanalysen, die wir für Sie übernehmen. Es folgt ein vergüteter Tag in unserem Haus, an dem Sie unsere Arbeitsweise erleben und das Team kennenlernen, und ein ausführliches persönliches Gespräch mit unserem Geschäftsführer. Über ein Angebot entscheidet das Team gemeinsam.

Wenn Sie heute in einem Anstellungsverhältnis stehen, behandeln wir Ihre Bewerbung selbstverständlich vertraulich.

Wenn Sie diese Haltung teilen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment.


Accountabilities:

As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the team

Join our high-energy team in London and help us bring smarter payment solutions to growing businesses across the UK and Europe. Today, we support over 4 million businesses in 30+ countries — and we're just getting started. As an Account Executive, you'll be part of a collaborative, fast-paced team driving growth and helping business owners with £50k+ in revenue access the tools they need to succeed.

  • Deliver value-driven product pitches and demos that help convert curiosity into commitment

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Du berichtest an den Team Lead Sales – Steuerkanzleien in Berlin. Unser Prozess: Erstgespräch, Interview mit dem Hiring-Team, Case Study, Gespräch mit deinen künftigen AE-Kolleg:innen, Abschlussgespräch mit dem Head of Sales – alles remote, Feedback nach jeder Runde innerhalb von 48 Stunden.

Standort Remote Deutschland: Du arbeitest aus dem Homeoffice in einer Region mit vielen Steuerkanzleien. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das ganze deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du steuerst mehrstufige Deals mit mehreren Entscheider:innen bis zur Unterschrift – inklusive Einwand-Handling und Verhandlung.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

title: Account Executive ,UK
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

We offer a highly competitive compensation package with On-Target Earnings (OTE) of €80,000 onwards designed to reward high performance and results. This includes a strong base salary complemented by an uncapped commission structure, meaning there is no limit to what you can earn — your success directly drives your income. Top performers have the opportunity to significantly exceed OTE, supported by a transparent, performance-driven bonus plan that truly rewards achievement.

Building on this performance-driven culture, not every candidate ticks every box — and that’s why we value individuals with a growth mindset who bring potential, initiative, and a willingness to learn.

What you will do

  • Build and develop your own client portfolio by identifying and acquiring new business opportunities within your assigned market.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients to foster long-term partnerships.

  • Proactively qualify new leads through daily outbound calls, follow-ups, and consistent pipeline management.

  • Spend several hours per day on the phone engaging with potential and existing clients, guiding them through the sales process.

  • Work closely with the technology team to provide feedback on platform functionality and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Collaborate with both buyers and suppliers to address any issues, inquiries, or challenges that may arise during the trading process.

  • Monitor your performance against monthly targets and KPIs, taking ownership of revenue growth within your portfolio.

  • Stay informed about market trends, product demand, and industry dynamics to make informed trading decisions.

Who you are

  • You have prior experience in Business Development, Sales, Key Account Management, or Account Management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • You are a native English speaker.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

  • A basic understanding of national and international trade and supply chain management is a plus.

Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.

Who we are looking for

Everyone at Higgsfield is an A-player. We're looking for teammates who bring:

  • High energy, strong commercial instincts, and flawless execution.

  • Ownership and accountability to drive deals end-to-end.

  • The ability to build trusted relationships with partners, agencies, and enterprise clients.

  • Resilience in high-pressure situations and an always-on mindset.

  • A balance of sharp analytical skills and natural people intuition.

  • Hunger to win and the grit to scale a B2B SaaS business globally.

About the role

This is the Enterprise Account Executive role for advertising in the UK and Ireland. Higgsfield is opening enterprise sales in Europe, and you will own advertising revenue in the UK and Ireland across brands, agencies and ad platforms. This is a new-business role: you find the accounts, run the deals and close them yourself. You are based in London and work with our US-based Enterprise team and directly with company leadership.

What you will work on

  • New enterprise customers: source, run and close multimillion deals with large advertisers, digital-first brands and agency groups.

  • Brands: sign direct contracts with marketing and performance teams.

  • Agencies: sell enterprise packages to creative, production and media agencies.

  • Platforms: build partnerships and integrations with ad and marketing platforms.

  • Complex deals: work with marketing, performance, creative, procurement, legal and security teams on the customer side, through sales cycles of 6–12 months.

  • Pilots to annual contracts: agree a paid pilot with clear success criteria and convert it into a yearly commitment.

  • Voice of the customer: tell product and leadership what customers ask for, what blocks deals and what competitors offer.

Your must haves

(You don't need to meet every single requirement to be a strong candidate. If you're excellent in a few of these areas and eager to grow, we'd still love to hear from you.)

  • Enterprise AE experience: 4+ years as a B2B Enterprise Account Executive in a closing role, managing the full sales cycle. You have carried a multimillion annual new-business quota and met or exceeded it in most years.

  • Deals of $1M+ ARR: you have personally closed deals of $1M+ ARR in the last three years and can describe them in detail: who signed, how long the deal took, and what procurement and legal required.

  • Complex sales: experience with 6–12 month sales cycles and several decision-makers in one deal at the same time, including C-level and VP-level buyers. You have negotiated enterprise contracts yourself and taken them through procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • Outbound pipeline and forecasting: you build most of your pipeline through your own outbound and do not rely on inbound leads. You forecast accurately, keep the CRM up to date and have used MEDDPICC or a similar method.

  • Advertising background: you have sold to brand marketers or agencies while working at an ad platform, an adtech or martech vendor, a creative technology company or an agency group. You understand how brands, agencies, ad platforms and measurement providers work together, and who controls which budget.

  • Agency knowledge: you understand agency economics and how holding groups buy at group, network and production-unit level.

  • Commercial skills: you can put together an offer with seats, usage commitments and a pilot, and explain the price to a CFO.

  • Partnerships: you can run a platform integration deal together with a Solutions Engineer.

  • Product knowledge: you run your own demos in Higgsfield and use AI tools in your daily work.

  • London network: the right to work in the UK and existing relationships with decision-makers at UK advertisers and agency groups.

Nice to haves

  • Experience selling generative AI, creative automation or video technology.

  • Background in performance marketing: creative testing, attribution, and the Meta, Google and TikTok ad platforms.

  • At least one partnership or integration deal closed with a platform.

  • Experience as an early sales hire at a fast-growing company.

The deal

  • Competitive base salary.

  • Equity participation through the company's stock option program.

  • Based in London. This is a local hire, and you meet customers in person.

  • Our GTM team works six days a week, and the same applies in London.

  • Part of your working day overlaps with US time zones, as you work with our US Enterprise team and company leadership.

  • Full-time position.

  • Opportunity to become the cornerstone of Higgsfield's advertising business in the UK and Ireland.

title: Account Management Lead - Editions France
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Editions, our network of delivery-only kitchens, is a key differentiator in France commercial ambition. The Account Management Lead – Editions France role is created as part of a wider reorganisation of the Editions business as part of our regional strategy. The role reports to Paris regional leadership and is designed to combine strategic partner leadership, P&L ownership and organisation building across the Editions network.

The Role

As Account Management Lead – Editions France, you will lead the Editions commercial team for France constituted of Senior Account Managers, Account Managers and Sales Managers. You will be the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, accountable for its coordination and its execution on the ground, growing the performance and profitability of our sites while driving occupancy and the differentiation Editions brings to the French market.

You will own a portion of the Editions P&L. That means holding the commercial scorecard for new kitchens, making financial decisions with a clear view of both partner and Deliveroo profitability, and steering your team's portfolio towards sustainable growth rather than volume alone.

You will be accountable for the development plan for your team, their success and learning curve at Deliveroo; setting the right KPIs and OKRs to monitor the business. Your role will be commercially focused, however Editions is as much a project management discipline as a commercial one: you will work hand in hand with Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction, Kitchen Layout, Site Operations, Marketing and the International Editions team to bring kitchens live and keep them performing.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Editions Strategy & Growth

    • Act as the guardian of the Editions strategy for France, ensuring its coordination across teams and its disciplined execution site by site

    • Lead your team's portfolio strategy, growing the performance and profitability of each Editions site in line with agreed targets

    • Develop the business so that it fits within, and contributes to, the wider regional strategy, bringing the specificity of the French network to regional and international forums

    • Build and deliver joint business plans with restaurant partners, identifying growth and profitability opportunities, defining mutual goals and finding compelling ways to solve them (menu optimisation, virtual brands, pricing, packaging, catchment expansion)

    • Coordinate with the Media team to identify and negotiate revenue opportunities to generate additional value from Editions sites

  • Occupancy & Commercial Performance

    • Own the occupancy trajectory of the French network, partnering closely with Local teams to positively drive occupancy and secure signed contracts within agreed timelines

    • Own and enforce the Editions commercial scorecard for new kitchens, profitability checks against P&L guidelines, launch package, site specificities, ensuring the process is applied consistently across the team

    • Steer the lead generation and pipeline process, mapping high-potential restaurants and cuisine gaps by site, and mobilising other commercial stakeholders to qualify interest

    • Lead commercial negotiations with business owners and C-suite operators, supporting proposals with a robust P&L rationale

  • P&L Ownership & Governance

    • Own a portion of the Editions P&L, accountable for revenue, profitability and the financial health of your perimeter

    • Set, own and deliver performance targets across occupancy, partner health, site profitability and Deliveroo output metrics

    • Run a clear operating rhythm on reporting, velocity, sign-to-live, occupancy and sales reviews, and use it to make decisions, not just to describe results

  • Kitchen Launches & Cross-functional Execution

  • Work with Site Managers, Food Safety, Compliance, Site Construction and Kitchen Layout teams to secure the successful build and launch of new kitchens

  • Coordinate with Global team on kitchen implementation, and with Marketing and Operations on launch packages, so that every opening lands on time and performs from week one

  • Manage and oversee project execution end to end, including B2B communication and cross-business-unit workshops

  • Propose process optimisation and automation: Deliveroo moves fast, and you will improve the processes that let Editions scale

  • Senior Stakeholder Management

    • Act as the senior point of contact and face of Deliveroo Editions for top restaurant partners, building trusted, long-term relationships and representing Deliveroo at partner events

    • Establish a strong operating rhythm with partners, including quarterly business reviews and monthly performance check-ins

    • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing strategic insights on Deliveroo, competitors and broader industry trends

  • Team Leadership: Support and coach your Account Managers and Sales Managers to build and execute strong commercial and operational plans, and to raise the standard of account management across the Editions network

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 7+ years working in commercially focused roles

  • Experience managing medium-sized commercial or account management teams

  • Highly analytical, with proven P&L ownership or strong financial decision-making experience

  • Solid project management skills, with a track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects on time

  • Mix of both strategy and execution experience

  • Comfortable handling negotiations with business owners or C-suite operators

  • Effective collaborator, able to influence internal stakeholders across functions and geographies, including global teams

  • Relationship-building and communication skills whether face-to-face, through phone or email

  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a rapidly changing environment; proactive and creative problem solver

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for food and operations

  • You will be in the field often, which will require travel (depending on the needs)

  • Previous general management experience, or experience running your own business would be desirable

  • Fluent in French and English is required

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Account Manager Influencer Marketing (m/w/d) TikTok, YouTube & Instagram
descriptionHtml:
Bei Ykone suchen wir keine klassischen Account Manager.

Wir suchen Menschen mit Ideen. Mit Innovationsgeist. Mit Ambition. Mit echtem Verständnis für Social Culture.

Menschen, die nicht nur Kampagnen umsetzen, sondern die neue Standards durch aufmerksamkeitsstarke und erfolgreiche Aktivierungen setzen.

TikTok verändert Aufmerksamkeit. Gen Z verändert Markenkommunikation. Und genau deshalb suchen wir Persönlichkeiten, die diese Welt nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten wollen.

Wer wir sind:

Ykone gehört zu den weltweit führenden Influencer Marketing Agenturen mit Standorten in Paris, Mailand, London, Dubai und weiteren internationalen Märkten.

Seit über 13 Jahren entwickeln wir Kampagnen, Strategien und kulturell relevante Ideen für globale Marken aus Beauty, Fashion, Luxury und Lifestyle.

Wir arbeiten mit internationalen Kunden, für die wir immer das nächste Level erreichen wollen. Dafür suchen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen für große nationale und internationale Brands. Aber noch wichtiger: Du entwickelst Ideen, die Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen. Die kulturell relevant sind. Die Menschen teilen wollen und die Marken langfristig wachsen lassen. Du verstehst TikTok nicht als Plattform, sondern als Sprache.

Du kennst Creator nicht nur aus Listen. Du kennst ihre Communities, ihre Dynamiken, ihren Content und ihre Relevanz.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Strategische und operative Leitung von Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen
  • Entwicklung innovativer Social-First-Ideen mit Fokus auf TikTok und YouTube
  • Beratung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kunden auf strategischer Ebene
  • Identifikation von Trends, Creatorn und kulturellen Bewegungen, bevor sie Mainstream werden
  • Aufbau und Pflege starker Beziehungen zu Creatorn, Managements und Plattformpartnern
  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Influencer Marketing Managern und Junior Talents
  • Steuerung komplexer Kampagnen mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Analyse von KPIs, Learnings und Performance-Daten zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung
  • Proaktive Entwicklung neuer Ideen, Konzepte und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten für unsere Kunden

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Influencer Marketing
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis der Gen-Z- und Social-Media-Kultur
  • Leidenschaft für TikTok, YouTube und digitale Trends
  • Ein starkes Netzwerk zu Creatorn, Talents und Managements
  • Kreatives Denken und den Anspruch, neue Ideen zu entwickeln statt bestehende zu kopieren
  • Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Liebe zum Detail
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Ownership und starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten
  • Die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig auf hohem Niveau zu steuern
  • Analytisches Verständnis für KPIs, Performance und Kampagnenoptimierung
  • Leadership-Mentalität: Du inspirierst Menschen, übernimmst Verantwortung und gehst voran

Skills kann man lernen. Mindset nicht. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die ambitioniert sind, Verantwortung übernehmen, neugierig bleiben, Dinge hinterfragen, Lösungen finden, Energie ins Team bringen und für ihre Kunden die Extrameile gehen wollen.

Benefits

Was dich erwartet:

  • Internationale Kunden und spannende globale Projekte
  • Viel kreativer Freiraum und echte Verantwortung
  • Ein ambitioniertes Team mit hohen Standards
  • Direkte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten fachlich und persönlich
  • Moderne Arbeitsgeräte (MacBook & iPhone)
  • Home-Office-Möglichkeiten
  • Zugang zu Egym / Wellpass
  • Team-Events, Workshops und internationale Perspektiven
  • Ein Umfeld, das Performance, Kreativität und Persönlichkeit wertschätzt

title: Accounting Manager
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Accounting Manager based in France.

We are seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to take ownership of full-cycle accounting operations for U.S.-based businesses. In this hands-on role, you will oversee financial processes, ensure accurate reporting, and maintain strong internal controls. You will manage everything from daily transactions and reconciliations to monthly and year-end financial closes. Working closely with business leaders, you will provide reliable financial insights to support budgeting, forecasting, and strategic decisions. This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with strong financial judgment who thrives in an autonomous role and enjoys improving accounting processes in a growing business environment.


Accountabilities

As Accounting Manager, you will oversee the complete accounting function, ensuring financial accuracy, operational efficiency, and compliance with relevant accounting standards. You will work closely with leadership and accounting support teams to maintain reliable financial records and improve financial processes.

  • Manage the full accounting cycle, including account reconciliations, month-end closing, and year-end closing.

  • Prepare and deliver accurate monthly financial statements, including profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.

  • Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, expense management, and vendor payments.

  • Identify billing discrepancies, unusual transactions, and potential financial errors to protect business resources.

  • Integrate external tools and applications with accounting systems such as QuickBooks Online to streamline workflows.

  • Prepare accurate and organized financial records for annual reviews and external CPA firms.

  • Support leadership with budgeting, financial forecasting, and cash flow planning.

  • Develop and strengthen internal controls, accounting policies, and procedures as the business grows.

  • Supervise and support bookkeepers or accounting staff, providing guidance and constructive feedback.

  • Use digital collaboration and accounting tools, including QuickBooks Online, Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Bill.com, Gusto, Ramp, and ClickUp.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is an experienced accounting professional with a strong understanding of U.S. accounting practices, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to independently manage financial operations. You should be comfortable working in a remote environment, communicating financial information clearly, and taking ownership of accounting processes.

  • At least 5 years of accounting experience working with U.S.-based companies, including full-cycle accounting responsibilities.

  • Strong knowledge of U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

  • Advanced experience with QuickBooks Online or a comparable accounting platform, including integrating third-party applications.

  • CPA certification or a local accounting qualification, such as Contador Público, is an advantage.

  • Previous experience collaborating with external CPA firms or supporting multiple clients is a plus.

  • Experience supervising, mentoring, or guiding accounting professionals, even without a formal management title.

  • Strong financial judgment and the ability to navigate fast-paced business environments.

  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-financial stakeholders.

  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to provide clear updates to remote teams.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

  • Must be based in Latin America (LATAM) or Europe.

    • Benefits:

  • Competitive salary in USD, paid consistently on a monthly basis and determined by experience.

  • 10 paid vacation days per year.

  • All U.S. national holidays observed.

  • 100% remote working arrangement, with the flexibility to work from anywhere in LATAM or Europe.

  • Opportunity to work directly with business leaders and contribute to important financial decisions.

  • Collaborative, supportive, and high-trust working environment.

  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.

WaschMal ist ein moderner Dienstleister für professionelle Wäschereilösungen und Textilmanagement. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre Berufsbekleidung und betrieblichen Textilien effizient, hygienisch und wirtschaftlich zu verwalten.

descriptionHtml:
At Machine Learning Reply, we help organizations turn cutting-edge AI technologies into real-world applications and scalable digital products.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for an AI Application Engineer who enjoys building AI-powered solutions and intelligent product features using modern machine learning and generative AI technologies.

While our GenAI Engineers focus on model development and AI architectures, AI Application Engineers focus on building user-facing AI applications and turning AI capabilities into scalable products.

In this role, you will work at the intersection of AI engineering, backend development, product development and cloud deployment, building production-ready AI systems that create real business value.

Tasks

As an AI Application Engineer, you design and build AI-powered applications and product features for enterprise clients.

Your projects may include:

  • Designing and developing AI applications, such as enterprise assistants, AI copilots, semantic search platforms and intelligent automation systems

  • Building LLM-powered applications using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and modern AI frameworks

  • Developing end-to-end AI products, integrating LLM APIs, enterprise data sources and backend services

  • Designing scalable AI microservices and APIs to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms

  • Implementing vector search, embeddings pipelines and knowledge retrieval systems

  • Rapidly prototyping AI product features and proof-of-concepts and evolving them into production systems

  • Collaborating closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers and enterprise customers to develop impactful AI solutions

  • Deploying AI systems to cloud platforms and production environments using modern DevOps practices

  • Ensuring reliable, scalable and observable AI services through CI/CD pipelines, monitoring and containerized deployments

Benefits

  • Work in an open and collaborative environment within the global Reply network and build next-generation AI applications and intelligent digital products

  • Collaboration with interdisciplinary teams including AI engineers, software developers and data scientists across industries such as Banking, Insurance, Automotive and Retail

  • A very active social program including paid training, conferences, communities of practice, hackathons and Reply XChange

  • Monetary Benefits include: Mobility package, Gym subsidy & WellPass, Insurance & Pension Scheme, Corporate Savings Plan, KiTa and Childcare Allowance

  • Flexible work arrangement between home office, EU-wide workation options, on site office-work in our downtown Munich office with access to Stammstrecke, and client on site visits


Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a comparable technical field

descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

The AI Engineering team at 9fin is building the next generation of AI capabilities that will power our products for years to come. We're looking for an Engineering Lead to lead the GenAI Platform team, building the shared foundations that enable product teams to develop and operate AI-powered products and agents.

Reporting to the Head of AI, you'll own the team's development, technical direction and delivery. You'll shape the platform strategy and roadmap, working with product and engineering teams to understand their needs and decide where shared capabilities will have the greatest impact.

You'll combine people leadership with strong engineering judgement, staying close to architecture and code while giving engineers the support and autonomy to do their best work.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

  • Lead and grow the team through hiring, coaching, feedback and clear expectations for performance and development.

  • Set the GenAI platform's direction and priorities, evaluate technical approaches and adapt the roadmap as product needs and evidence evolve.

  • Own the delivery and operation of reliable, secure and scalable platform capabilities, balancing quality, performance, cost and speed of development.

  • Make the GenAI platform easy for other engineers to adopt and extend through effective APIs, tooling, documentation and clear ownership.

  • Partner with AI and evaluation specialists to establish how platform changes are tested, measured and released.

  • Work with product, engineering and security colleagues to resolve dependencies, communicate trade-offs and turn emerging needs into sustainable capabilities.

What Makes This Role Different

You'll join an evolving GenAI platform with substantial scope to shape its next stage. You'll help decide what the platform should provide, which approaches to adopt and how the team should grow as 9fin's AI ambitions develop.

Your impact will reach across product teams. By building shared capabilities that engineers trust and choose to use, you'll help teams deliver AI products more quickly and operate them with confidence.

You'll own both people leadership and technical direction, developing the team while remaining closely involved in the engineering decisions that determine the platform's success.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

People Management

  • Have experience directly managing software engineers, including hiring, performance management and career development.

  • Can build a team with clear priorities, give useful feedback and support engineers to take ownership of their work.

Platform Engineering

  • Have built shared platforms or developer tools that other engineering teams adopted, and understand what makes those teams successful.

  • Can translate product needs into reusable capabilities and balance immediate delivery with longer-term platform development.

Production LLMs & Agentic AI

  • Have built or operated complex LLM-powered applications or agent systems in production.

  • Understand the challenges of non-deterministic systems, including evaluation, quality regressions, tool use, reliability, security and cost.

Backend, Cloud & Operations

  • Have a strong backend or infrastructure engineering background, with ownership of distributed production systems in the cloud.

  • Understand how to operate services reliably, including monitoring, incident response, performance and cost management.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Have the technical depth to review designs and code, assess alternatives and help engineers work through difficult problems.

  • Communicate trade-offs clearly, build effective partnerships across teams and use evidence to make decisions in ambiguous situations.

Bonus Points

Experience with any of the following would be highly advantageous:

  • Event-driven architectures or long-running asynchronous workloads

  • Secure execution environments and access controls

  • AI evaluation, experimentation or observability

  • Platforms handling sensitive data in finance or other high-trust environments

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity?

We’re looking for Senior+ AI Infrastructure Engineers to build the systems that train and serve Fin's next generation of AI products.

Fin is an AI company that builds from the GPU all the way up to a user agent that resolves millions of customer service queries a month. 

You’ll join a small, highly technical team working at the cutting edge of modern AI infrastructure. The AI Infra team built the training pipelines and runs the inference for custom models like Fin Apex, which outperforms frontier models in customer service tasks, and is the foundation of the AI Group's full stack approach to AI.

We’re particularly interested in engineers who have:

  • A track record of working on model training or model inference at scale, or on low‑level GPU coding (e.g. CUDA, Triton). Experience with one is great, multiple is even better.

What will I be doing?

As a Senior AI Infrastructure Engineer focused on model training and inference, you will:

  • Implement and scale training pipelines for large transformer and LLM models, from data ingestion and preprocessing through distributed training and evaluation.
  • Build and optimize inference services that deliver low‑latency, high‑reliability experiences for our customers, including autoscaling, routing, and fallbacks.
  • Work on GPU‑level performance: tuning kernels, improving utilization, and identifying bottlenecks across our training and inference stack.
  • Collaborate closely with ML scientists to implement cutting edge training and inference methods and bring them to production.
  • Play an active role in hiring, mentoring, and developing other engineers on the team.
  • Raise the bar for technical standards, reliability, and operational excellence across Fin's AI platform.

Profile we’re looking for:

These are indicative, not hard requirements

We’re looking to hire Senior+ AI Infrastructure Engineers. You’re likely a great fit if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of shipping high‑quality products or platforms.
  • You hold a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or you have equivalent experience with very strong fundamentals).
  • You have hands‑on experience with one or more of the following:
    • Model training (especially transformers and LLMs).
    • Model inference at scale (again, especially transformers and LLMs).
    • Low‑level GPU work, such as writing CUDA or Triton kernels.
  • Comfortable working in production environments at meaningful scale (traffic, data, or organizational).
  • You communicate clearly, can explain complex technical topics to different audiences, and enjoy close collaboration with both engineers and non‑engineers.
  • You take pride in strong technical fundamentals, love learning, and are willing to invest in your own development.
  • Have deep knowledge of at least one programming language (for example Python, Ruby, Java, Go, etc.). Specific language experience is less important than your ability to write clean, reliable code and learn new stacks quickly.

Bonus skills & attributes

None of these are required, but they’re nice to have:

  • Experience at AI native companies that train and/or run inference for their own models (e.g. modern AI labs or AI‑native product companies).
  • Experience running training or inference workloads on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with AWS or other major cloud providers.
  • Production experience with Python in ML or infrastructure contexts.
  • Demonstrated passion for technology through personal projects, open source, meetups, or publishing content about your work and learnings

#LI-Hybrid

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

title: AI Modelling and Simulation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Opportunity

Lumai is moving from optical-compute research into production AI systems, and the architecture and compiler decisions that shape the product are being made now, ahead of the silicon that will confirm them. This hire builds the modelling capability those decisions rest on.

The Role

You will own the performance and power modelling framework that predicts how Lumai's photonic AI hardware performs against real inference workloads, giving the architecture and compiler teams one shared source of truth for latency, throughput and power across device configurations. You will model the compute engines, interconnect, memory and bridge interfaces; keep the model honest by characterising operator-level workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results; and turn what the model says into decisions teams act on.

What is genuinely hard about this is balancing speed, fidelity and usability. The model has to capture concurrency, event-driven behaviour and compute-block latency in enough detail to support real architecture decisions, and still compare configurations in minutes rather than overnight. The gap between what the model predicts and what the hardware does has to be measured rather than assumed, and closing it is the part that never stops.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build and maintain a Python-based framework that models hardware and software latency, hardware concurrency and event-driven relationships.

  • Model compute engines, interconnect and synchronisation fabric, memory and bridge interfaces, and accelerator blocks across device configurations.

  • Characterise convolution, depthwise convolution, pooling, attention and other operator workloads against hardware, RTL or emulation results.

  • Build compiler-agnostic interfaces that ingest compiled models and MLIR from multiple internal compiler flows.

  • Analyse simulation traces with the architecture and compiler teams to improve layer-to-hardware mappings and resolve performance discrepancies.

  • Run industry benchmarks and representative models - UL Procyon, Geekbench AI, Stable Diffusion and contemporary LLMs - to produce decision-ready KPIs.

  • Develop block-level power models and validate worst-case power scenarios with the micro-architecture, verification and physical-design teams.

  • Own the CI/CD pipelines and simulation flows that keep results reliable and reproducible as usage scales.

  • Translate modelling findings into architecture and compiler decisions, setting technical direction and developing engineers or interns as the team grows.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Proven experience building or substantially extending a hardware/software performance modelling or simulation framework for AI/ML accelerators, ideally in Python.

  • Strong understanding of hardware concurrency, event-driven modelling and AI inference accelerator micro-architecture: compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect and dataflow.

  • Hands-on experience characterising AI operators and correlating model predictions with real hardware or hardware-accurate reference data.

  • Familiarity with compiler internals and intermediate representations such as MLIR, including tooling that consumes compiler output to drive simulation.

  • Strong software engineering and technical leadership practice: framework design, CI/CD ownership, and direction or review of junior engineers' or interns' work.

Strong preference for

  • Direct experience with NPU, GPU or other edge or client AI inference accelerator architectures.

  • Experience across multiple compiler toolchains, reconciling architecture-level and production compiler behaviour.

  • Exposure to power modelling, RTL, emulation, FPGA prototyping, photonic compute or another non-traditional compute architecture.

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

Position Summary

The Associate Director, Transportation for the UK & EU is accountable for the performance, cost, and future-readiness of our regional transportation network. This role owns the day-to-day service levels our retail partners and consumers expect, while continuously reviewing and challenging the cost base, and — critically — developing the strategy that ensures our 3PL and carrier capacity can absorb the rapid growth ahead.

Sitting in London and reporting to the US-based Associate Director of Transportation, you will be the regional leader who bridges global strategy with local execution. You will partner closely with our 3PL providers, internal commercial and supply chain teams, and the US transportation function to deliver a network that is reliable, cost-efficient, scalable, and aligned to e.l.f.'s values.

Responsibilities:

Service Level Management

· Own end-to-end transportation service performance across the UK and EU, including on-time delivery, order fulfillment accuracy, and transit-time reliability for retail, wholesale, and e-commerce channels.

· Define, track, and publish transportation KPIs and SLAs; lead monthly and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with 3PL and carrier partners to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

· Serve as the primary escalation point for transportation service failures; root-cause issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.

· Ensure transportation execution meets the requirements of key retail partners (e.g., compliance with retailer routing guides, delivery windows, and ASN/labeling standards).

Cost Review & Optimization

· Own the regional transportation budget and freight spend; forecast, monitor, and explain variances monthly, identifying trends and driving corrective action.

· Conduct regular cost-to-serve analysis across lanes, modes, and channels; identify and implement opportunities to reduce cost per unit without compromising service.

· Lead carrier rate negotiations, spot-market management, and freight procurement in coordination with the US Director of Transportation and procurement team.

· Evaluate mode and lane optimization, consolidation, and network design changes to deliver year-over-year cost savings.

3PL Capacity & Growth Strategy

· Develop and maintain a forward-looking transportation capacity strategy that aligns with e.l.f.'s aggressive international growth plans, modeling 1-, 3-, and 5-year volume scenarios against 3PL and carrier capability.

· Assess the scalability of existing 3PL partners — across warehousing throughput, outbound capacity, peak-season flex, and geographic coverage — and recommend capacity additions, alternate partners, or network changes ahead of need.

· Lead or support RFPs, partner selection, onboarding, and contract governance for new or expanded 3PL and carrier relationships across the UK and EU.

· Build peak-season and surge-readiness plans in partnership with 3PLs, ensuring capacity, labor, and equipment commitments are secured well in advance of demand spikes (e.g., holiday, promotional events, new-retailer launches).

· Identify and mitigate supply chain risks — carrier concentration, single-lane dependency, customs/border exposure — with documented contingency plans.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Compliance

· Partner with the US Associate Director of Transportation to ensure regional execution aligns with global transportation strategy, systems, and standards (e.g., TMS, visibility platforms, carrier scorecards).

· Collaborate with Supply Planning, Demand Planning and Commercial Operations to align transportation capacity with forecasted demand and product launch timelines.

· Ensure full compliance with UK and EU transportation, customs, and trade regulations, and partner with customs brokers to maintain efficient and compliant cross-border movement.

· Champion e.l.f.'s sustainability commitments in transportation decisions, including modal shift, emissions reduction, and carrier sustainability standards.

Requirements:

· Lead the transportation strategy working with the other operations team professionals, building capability and a culture of continuous improvement.

· Act as the regional transportation subject-matter expert and represent the function in cross-functional initiatives and leadership reviews.

· Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

· 5+ years of progressive experience in transportation, logistics, or 3PL management, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.

· Demonstrated experience managing 3PL relationships and carrier networks at scale, including SLA governance, QBRs, and performance management.

· Strong financial acumen — proven ownership of a transportation or freight budget, cost-to-serve analysis, and rate negotiation.

· Deep working knowledge of UK and EU transportation markets, carrier landscapes, customs/trade compliance, and retail routing-guide requirements.

· Experience planning capacity or network strategy to support significant volume growth.

title: Associate
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team:

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres, biotechs and MedTech companies to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges.

 

About the role:

This is an exciting, new role, for an individual motivated to deepen their knowledge of AI transformation in life sciences. As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our pharmaceutical clients. We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI solutions are optimised for real-world operations.

#LI-PRIO

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions.

  • Working side-by-side with life sciences stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

 

Who we're looking for:

  • You have some experience working on AI implementation/data intensive projects in a commercial setting

  • You've worked in a Life Sciences company, or with Life Sciences clients

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, keen to take initiative and own finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and energised by the possibilities for innovation in life sciences!

 

Our interview process:

  1. Talent Team Screen (40 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

  4. Interview with Business Unit Director (30 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
