title: Automations Lead
descriptionHtml:
You use AI and automation to make Pivotal's work faster and better, so that the team can do more without growing as fast.

  • Salary: £86,750–£155,500 per year, depending on seniority. We may be able to pay more for exceptional candidates.

  • Location: London, at our office at LISA

  • Hours: Full time

  • Visa: We can sponsor a Skilled Worker visa, but approval isn't guaranteed.

Why work at Pivotal

Pivotal finds people who can work on the biggest risks from advanced AI and gets them working on them. Since 2024, 135 fellows have taken part in our fellowships, and alumni now work at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI and GovAI. We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and we plan to reach at least 16 in 2027. Read more about us at pivotal-research.org, and about what it is like to work here.

What you will own

You’ll make the rest of the team faster & better by building & running the AI tools and automations behind our applications, fellow management, operations, etc. The goal is that Pivotal can run more and better programs without its team growing at the same rate. The AI safety field must grow a lot, and this will help Pivotal scale to support this growth.

We expect you to spend about 30% of your time making our existing tools better and more reliable. The rest goes to new tools. You talk to team members about what costs them the most time, tools they wish existed, and ship solutions quickly. Every tool has to meet our quality bar, protect personal data, and follow data protection law and our internal rules for AI use.

You might also be a central figure in a planned program on ‘AI for AI Safety’.

  • Internal tools. Build and maintain automations and AI agents for applications, fellow management, operations and reporting.

  • Application screening tools. Maintain the AI graders, check them for bias and errors, and design the human review steps around them.

  • Data. Keep applicant, fellow and alumni data clean and connected, so that we can measure outcomes.

  • Safe handling of data. Make sure our tools protect personal data and follow data protection law. You’ll have access to legal advice for this.

  • AI use across the team. Help staff, and fellows, use AI tools well.

Who does well in this role

  • Strong software engineering skills, and experience building tools with large language models and AI agents.

  • You talk to users, find the work that matters most, and ship quickly.

  • You care about reliability, security and data protection.

  • You can explain technical trade-offs in plain language.

  • You care about reducing catastrophic risks from AI.

We don’t expect anyone to be strong in all of this. If the role excites you, please apply, even if you match only part of what we describe here.

How we hire

We review applications as they come in, so applying early helps. The process has these stages:

  • Written application. A short form and your CV. It takes about 30 minutes.

  • Automated video interview. About 10 minutes. You record short answers to a few questions, at a time that suits you.

  • Work task. About 2 hours, based on real work in this role. We pay you for this time. You may use AI tools, as you would in the job. Tell us which ones you used and how.

  • Personal interview. About 45 minutes. We discuss your work task and how you would approach the role. With your consent, we record it so that more of the team can review it.

  • Work trial and references. Up to three paid days working with us at our office in London. We also speak to two referees, after asking you.

If you need an adjustment at any stage, such as extra time, tell us and we will arrange it. If you have questions, email ----- £86,750 – £155,500

title: Backend Engineer (Go)
descriptionHtml:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership
    We take responsibility end to end, from identifying problems to delivering outcomes and learning from results.

What will you be doing?

  • Building and scaling a distributed system using Go, DynamoDB, SQS, Redshift and Lambdas

  • Building a snappy full-stack app using cutting-edge tech (including Next on Vercel, gRPC)

  • Working on the next version of the Prelude API, which we strive to be industry-leading in terms of usability, performance and functionality

  • Ensuring that our services are scalable, extensible, reliable, and performant

  • Helping deploy and scale our fraud prevention model to hundreds of large customers

  • Developing and maintaining internal tools to improve developer efficiency

  • Interacting with clients on a daily basis to assist them and build features around their needs

What are we looking for?

  • Experience designing and engineering large-scale systems

  • Strong coding skills in Go - any experience with Rust, TypeScript or similar is a huge plus

  • A preference for simplicity vs complexity, with intuition for what will scale effectively

  • A product led mindset, keen to code for the output and the impact

  • Fluent/professional English given our international team

What can we offer you?

  • The opportunity to build something from 0-1, and make an impact every day

Interview process

Du bist nah am Kunden. Was du in Gesprächen mit Hausverwaltern hörst, fließt direkt in Produkt, Pitch und Preise ein.

Based in Munich, at the heart of Germany's defence industrial ecosystem (Rheinmetall, Hensoldt, KNDS, ESG, MTU), you will support and drive Alta Ares' early-stage commercial development with German primes and institutional contacts.

You will map the ecosystem, build first-contact relationships, and support the Account Manager Germany in converting opportunities into pipeline. Germany's Zeitenwende is real, budgets are moving fast, and the demand for AI and C-UAS capabilities is accelerating. You will be on the ground at the right moment.

  • Serve as the operational bridge between Munich and Alta Ares HQ in Paris

title: Business Partner - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About Continuity

At Continuity, we’re building AI-native solutions that are redefining how insurers assess, monitor, and act on risk in the €1T+ commercial insurance industry.

In today’s world, insurers are expected to make complex, high-stakes decisions, often with outdated tools and fragmented data. We're rewriting that reality. Our platform combines specialized AI, structured data, and underwriting expertise to empower insurers with the clarity, speed, and confidence they need to take smarter risks, faster.

As the trusted partner of leading commercial P&C insurers, Continuity enables underwriting teams to:

  • Instantly detect and qualify risks

  • Keep portfolios up to date in real-time

  • Automate and accelerate decision-making from quote to bind

Our SaaS platform turns complex and scattered data into a clear, actionable interface, allowing underwriters to focus on what matters most: client relationships, portfolio profitability, and precision at scale.

Backed by a €10M Series A round in 2024, we are now scaling internationally and doubling down on innovation. With more than 50% of our team dedicated to R&D, we’re exploring the frontiers of AI in insurance, from intelligent agents to adaptive underwriting workflows, to fundamentally transform how insurance operates.

Joining Continuity means joining a high-impact, fast-growing team where your work shapes the future of risk intelligence. We’re not just building better tools, we’re helping the industry operate with a new level of intelligence.

What do we promote?

Our strong commitments include to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute. Our cultural drivers {empathy, impact, innovation, and collaboration} guide us as we work together to create meaningful change. This is why we focus on the skills and potential you bring, rather than just your academic background or past experiences.

We believe that talent is shaped by diverse life journeys, and we’re excited to see how yours can contribute to our team while uncovering new perspectives and opportunities for growth together!

Role overview:

Germany is not a test. It's a commitment.

Our pipeline is live. Our first clients are onboard. The commercial momentum is real and we are now looking for the person who will turn that momentum into lasting, measurable client success.

This is not a support role. This is a builder position. You will work in close partnership with our Head of BD DACH, owning everything that happens from the first client handshake through to long-term value delivery. You will be the operational backbone of our DACH expansion, the person who makes sure that what we promise, we deliver.

If you thrive at the intersection of client trust, structured execution, and commercial impact, this role was designed for you.

Location: Germany or France (flexible) Regular travel required across Europe and France

Start by listening, then make it happen

One of our core beliefs at Continuity is that the best outcomes start with the deepest understanding. In this role, that means genuinely listening to what our clients need, not just what they say, and translating it into action that creates real value.

You will engage directly with senior decision-makers at leading insurers: CUOs, COOs, Heads of Underwriting. You will run workshops, challenge assumptions, and earn the kind of trust that turns a first contract into a long-term partnership. Your ability to hold the narrative in front of a room, and to listen carefully before you do, will define your impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Client Delivery & Deployment: Own the full client journey from needs assessment to operational go-live. You lead setup, coordinate with underwriters, facilitate workshops, and manage the client-facing narrative at every stage, with the rigour of a consultant and the energy of a builder.

  • POV Process Management: Drive Proof of Value processes for prospects not yet signed. You structure the deliverables, challenge the risk alerts, and make sure every POV builds a compelling, data-backed business case.

  • Paris / DACH Communication Bridge: You are the connective tissue between our German clients and our Paris delivery and product teams. Information flows clearly and nothing falls through the cracks - because you made sure of it.

  • Legal & Admin Coordination: Handle the contractual volume that comes with opening a new market - NDAs, DPAs, GDPR - with rigor and efficiency.

  • Commercial Expansion: Work alongside the Head of BD DACH to identify upsell and expansion opportunities within existing accounts. Every successful deployment is a potential success story, and you know how to build one.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Collaborate with our technical team on platform configuration and bring client insights back into the product roadmap. You are the voice of the DACH market internally.

  • Value Analysis: Turn platform data into high-impact business recommendations that demonstrate ROI, deepen relationships, and make clients want to expand.

Make a measurable impact, from day one

We don't hire for potential and then put people in a corner. We hire people who are wired to execute, to deliver, and to raise the bar.

At 3 months, you will have full platform fluency, ownership of existing DACH accounts, and be fully embedded in our Paris workflows. At 6–9 months, you will be running deployments autonomously, driving a structured POV process, and identifying the first expansion opportunities in your accounts.

We care about results. We also care about how you get there, with rigour, ownership, and the kind of positive energy that makes hard things look manageable.

What you bring:

  • 3 to 7 years of experience from a high-performance environment: Strategy, Ops, M&A, Consulting, or equivalent. We care about the standard you've held yourself to, not the logo on your CV.

  • Strong quantitative skills: Excel and data analytics proficiency are non-negotiable. A data-crunch case study is part of our selection process - come prepared.

  • Native or near-native German and fluent English are essential. French is a bonus.

  • A Trusted Advisor posture: equally comfortable running a client workshop, analysing a dataset, and challenging a C-level assumption in the same afternoon.

  • Startup appetite: you don't need a playbook to get started. You write your own.

  • Output orientation: you take ownership, move fast, and close the loop, every time.

  • Insurance experience is a bonus but not required. A structured 3-month onboarding will get you fluent in our industry, our platform, and our clients.

We are one team, even across borders

At Continuity, "We Are One Team" is not a value we put on a slide and forget. It is the operating principle that makes everything else possible.

In this role, you will be the living proof of that principle across two geographies. You will bridge cultures, languages, and working styles, between Paris and Frankfurt/Munich, between product and client, between what was promised and what gets delivered. The ability to connect people, share context, and keep everyone moving in the same direction is not a soft skill here. It is a core competency.

You will not be alone. You will have the full support of our Head of BD DACH, our Paris delivery teams, and our leadership, all of whom are invested in making the DACH market work.

Build the future, with us

Germany is the beginning of something larger. As the DACH market scales, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your impact within the Revenue organisation.

We are not looking for someone to hold the fort. We are looking for someone who sees what this market could become and has the drive, the rigour, and the entrepreneurial instinct to help us get there.

Interview process

  • Introduction video call with (45')

  • Meet your future leader (60')

  • Prepare & present a Business Case ; meet cross team members (150')

  • Meet cross team members & executive leaders (90')

What we offer

  • Flexibility: With our Work Where You Like policy, you may be eligible to work from anywhere within France and soon from Europe!

  • Work life balance: We're here to support you in finding balance, no matter your personal circumstances.

  • Learning & Development: We’re committed to providing you with the resources, opportunities, and support you need to develop your skills and achieve your full potential.

  • Career growth: We provide clear development paths, skill-building opportunities, and support for internal mobility through open conversations & career coaching.

  • Health & Wellness: We offer comprehensive health insurance (maximum coverage with Alan Blue), dedicated relaxing events & resources like Moka.Care to support your physical, mental, and emotional health.

  • Life @Continuity: We create moments to come together, celebrate achievements, and strengthen our collective spirit.

  • Transportation & hotel costs: We provide partial reimbursement for public transport season tickets for office and hybrid employees, and cover transportation and accommodation costs for fully remote team members when needed.

  • Meals: We provide a restaurant card (Swile : 12€ per working day).

  • Home office setup: We provide all the necessary equipment to ensure you have the best setup for remote work.

  • Time-off: 25 days of holidays + RTT days.

  • Inclusion: All roles are open to candidates with disabilities. We adapt work conditions and the recruitment process as needed to ensure equal opportunities, just let us know how we can support you!

  • Automatiser des processus de bout en bout.

  • Intégrer un modèle dans un outil que les équipes utilisent déjà.

  • Construire les connecteurs dont le cas d’usage a besoin, par exemple un serveur MCP pour un outil métier.

  • Concevoir l’expérience utilisateur de l’IA : quand une personne valide, comment afficher les sources et l’incertitude.

  • Définir avec l’AI Product Manager les évaluations propres au cas d’usage et les suivre en production.

  • Assumer ce que vous livrez après la mise en production : monitoring, incidents, adoption.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit des applications avec un front end, un back end et des API, même si votre expertise est plus marquée d’un côté.

  2. Du code testé, relu et documenté, en Python, TypeScript ou dans un langage similaire.

  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

  4. Des besoins d’utilisateurs transformés en une première version, puis améliorée à partir de leurs retours.

  5. Le monitoring, les incidents et l’adoption font, pour vous, partie du métier.

  6. Une aisance à expliquer vos choix techniques à des personnes non techniques.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Une expérience de construction d’agents ou d’assistants au-dessus d’un LLM : appel d’outils, orchestration.

  • Une expérience de conception de parcours avec validation humaine (human-in-the-loop) ou d’interfaces d’IA.

  • Une expérience d’intégration à des logiciels métier, comme un ERP ou un CRM.

  • Une expérience au contact des clients.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Entre le produit, l’interface et le modèle, le Product Engineer occupe le point où l’IA rencontre ses utilisateurs. Leurs réactions s’observent directement, et chaque version livrée tient compte de ce que les usages ont révélé.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets : conception d’agents, évaluation par cas d’usage, expérience utilisateur de l’IA, avec l’appui des AI Engineers et de la communauté Product Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Product Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme le chapter AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.

  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).

  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.

  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.

  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.

  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 75 000€ à 85 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 8 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Chief Financial Officer
descriptionHtml:
Fastned is on a mission to accelerate the transition to electric mobility. Since 2012, we have been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations across Europe powered entirely by solar and wind energy. With 500+ colleagues, we now operate over 450+ stations across nine countries, with an ambitious goal of reaching 1,000 stations by 2030. We are not building infrastructure for its own sake. Every station we open is a tangible step in the transition away from fossil fuels.

We are a listed company on Euronext Amsterdam, with a community of over 10,000 retail investors and a growing base of institutional funding partners. In 2025, we reported €122.4 million in charging revenue: a 47% year-on-year increase, exceeding €100 million in annual revenue for the first time. Fastned is at a pivotal point: growing fast, approaching profitability, and expanding across Europe. As our CFO, you will lead a talented and growing team of 40+ finance professionals to drive and shape Fastned's continued success.

Your Role

We are looking for a CFO to join the Management Board, alongside our CEO, COO and CCO, who will drive Fastned on its path to profitability while enabling further growth.

This role is for a financial leader who thrives in scale-up environments and feels comfortable navigating the complexity of an international matrix organisation. You know how to build a finance function that is both structured and able to move fast, effectively resolving scaling-bottlenecks along the way. You maintain strong financial discipline while enabling the continued investment needed to expand the charging network that supports our long-term vision.

In this role, you oversee the full Finance domain, developing people and teams to the next phase. You act as a key financial voice within the Executive Team and Management Board.

Your responsibilities will include:

Strategic Planning & Partnering: Partner with the Executive Board to set long-term financial goals, evaluate investment opportunities, oversee mergers and acquisitions and direct your teams to deliver the analyses and frameworks that underpin these decisions.

Manage our capital structure by optimising the company's capital, debt, and equity structure to maximise shareholder value.

Leading the Finance Domain: lead and inspire a talented Finance team of 43 professionals, bringing clear direction, fostering growth in culture that balances a bold mission with financial rigour. With your operational finance expertise, you will empower domain leads to do their best work. For each of your domains this entails the following:

  • Accounting & Reporting team: enabling finance transformation to ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, ensuring full compliance with applicable regulatory standards and accounting frameworks.

  • Funding & Investor Relations team: develop a compelling, forward-looking equity story that reflects both current performance and long-term potential. You will serve as the primary spokesperson for Fastned's financial health, leading earnings calls and maintaining strong relationships with analysts, shareholders, and investors.

  • Business & Financial Control team: partner with Country- and Functional Directors to evaluate the business cases for new markets, charging stations, joint ventures, and other expansion initiatives, balancing rigorous financial discipline and cost efficiency with growth decisions.

  • Risk & Audit team: build structures that protect against financial fraud and operational risk. Represent the Management Board in Audit Committee meetings and actively drive the implementation and maintenance of internal controls.

  • Tax team: meet tax compliance and the maintenance of a tax control framework across all countries, covering corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and VAT.

  • Serve as the executive owner of Fastned's sustainability strategy, ensuring it is credible, auditable, and aligned with both regulatory requirements, the company's long-term mission.

Management Board Member: Serve as a full member of the Management Board, carrying statutory responsibility for Fastned's financial governance, risk management, sustainability reporting, and knowing when to accelerate growth and when to apply disciplined challenges.

Who we are looking for

  • A financial leader (RA, CPA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent) with proven experience in senior operational finance leadership in scale-up or high-growth environments.

  • A genuine people leader who inspires, challenges, and grows the people around them.

  • Experience in building and professionalising a scalable finance function, including systems, processes, and team capability including leveraging AI and digital technologies company-wide.

  • Bring a healthy appetite for risk combined with rigorous financial discipline: knowing when to accelerate and when to challenge, driving the business towards profitability while enabling sustainable growth.

  • Good understanding of fundingand capital markets including bonds, equity, project finance, or institutional investment with the ability to tell a compelling and credible financial story to investors.

  • Ability to articulate a long-term financial vision and translate it into clear near-term actions.

  • Affinity with Fastned's mission: a genuine belief in the energy transition.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place.

Next to a wide range of attractive secondary benefits, your CFO comps & ben package includes:

  • Annual base compensation between EUR 180.000 and EUR 280.000 (including 8% holiday allowance).

  • You will participate in Fastned’s attractive stock option programmes designed to give you a meaningful opportunity to participate in the long-term value you help create as a member of Fastned’s Management Board.

  • Company-wide Performance Bonus: You are eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 15% of your annual base salary.

  • 29 holidays. Additionally, you will have 2 ‘Mission Days’ that you can use to contribute to Fastned’s mission or to support a cause that is important to you.

  • Fully electric company car.

Interested in making an impact?

We would love to have a conversation with you and hear why you’re excited about joining Fastned’s mission in this impactful role. Our talent acquisition team will get back to all applicants in due time to share details about timing & structure of the upcoming recruitment process.

Fastned stands for equity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, gender identities, sexual orientations, religions, neurodiversity, disabilities, parental status or any other protected characteristic that makes you unique.

You’ll also partner with the Foundation’s Investment Committee and its technical and strategic advisors, keeping their focus on the right questions, their recommendations aligned with the Foundation’s strategic priorities, and decisions moving efficiently from evaluation to funding.

Job responsibilities

Here’s what you’ll likely be focused on for the first 6 months:

  • Building a strong working partnership with the CEO, aligning on priorities, ways of working and clearly defining the scope of your delegated authority.
  • Establishing a trusted partnership with each member of the Executive Leadership Team, learning their priorities, pressures and ways of working.
  • Developing a deep, cross-functional understanding of the Foundation’s work and how each function connects to the CEO’s priorities.
  • Translating the CEO’s priorities into a concise, clear set of strategic outcomes that leaders understand and can use to guide the decisions they own, with a current view of what’s changing and which decisions are approaching.
  • Defining with the CEO what truly requires their attention, and ensuring issues reach them decision-ready, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Getting up to speed with the Investment Committee and its advisors, and helping keep their focus on the right questions so decisions move efficiently from evaluation to funding.

As the Chief of Staff to Mozilla Foundation’s CEO, you will…

  • Serve as the CEO’s thought partner in developing, pressure-testing and refining strategic priorities, synthesizing executive insight and external developments to anticipate what will need to be known or decided in the next 30, 60 and 90 days.
  • Direct the CEO’s time toward strategy, external relationships, development, Board leadership and the Foundation’s highest-consequence decisions.
  • Filter rather than forward, so significant shifts in strategy, material risks, major budget decisions and Board-level matters reach the CEO early, with context, options and a recommendation.
  • Maintain a current view of the CEO’s top priorities, identify where work is drifting from strategic intent, and surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention before they become emergencies.
  • Enable the Executive Leadership Team to operate as one team around the CEO’s priorities, so the right issues reach the ELT at the right level and decisions and commitments are followed through.
  • Partner with ELT members on cross-functional issues that need CEO-level alignment but not the CEO’s direct involvement.
  • Represent the CEO’s position in internal discussions and make decisions on the CEO’s behalf within delegated authority, bringing anything beyond it back to the CEO promptly.
  • Ensure the CEO enters every Board meeting, funder and partner conversation, speech and public engagement fully prepared, with concise briefings, organizational context and answers to likely questions.
  • Identify external opportunities that warrant the CEO’s attention, and ensure commitments the CEO makes externally translate into clear internal follow-through.
  • Steward alignment between the Investment Committee’s work and the Foundation’s strategy: keep its technical and strategic advisors focused on the right questions, surface gaps, risks or competing views, and bring forward matters that need the CEO’s judgment.

What this role is not

This is a role of influence. It exists to ensure the CEO can lead effectively through the Executive Leadership Team.

  • The Chief of Staff does not manage the Executive Leadership Team or run the Foundation’s operations. Each executive leader owns execution and decisions within their area.
  • This role does not make decisions beyond the authority the CEO has delegated. Anything outside that authority returns to the CEO.
  • This role does not have any direct reports and also doesn’t manage the CEO’s calendar, scheduling or administrative support.

Your Professional Profile

  • Significant, verifiable experience as a strategic partner at CEO or executive-team level, with a track record of leading high-stakes work and turning ambiguity into structure and action.
  • Experience working across multiple legal entities is a plus, including navigating differences, building influence, and coordinating work across entities where relevant. 
  • A proven record of driving complex, cross-functional priorities from idea to execution by defining outcomes, ownership, milestones and decision points.
  • Exceptional judgment and discretion, including handling confidential information and navigating complex executive dynamics with integrity.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority, build trust across functions and at the most senior levels, and give direct feedback with care.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication, with experience distilling complex information into decision-ready briefs, recommendations, presentations and executive communications.
  • Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills: you frame the right question, gather the right information, test assumptions and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Disciplined prioritization, with the agility to move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues without losing the thread.
  • Direct experience supporting Board governance, fundraising or other high-stakes external relationships at an executive level.
  • A track record of doing high-impact work out of the spotlight, measuring your success by the CEO’s and the team’s, and acting in the best interests of the CEO and the organization.
  • A demonstrated commitment to Mozilla Foundation’s mission and to building an open, accessible and trustworthy internet.
  • The ability to work across time zones and occasionally outside standard working hours for Board meetings, major events or urgent organizational needs.
  • Comfortable traveling for Board meetings, leadership gatherings and major events.

We Are Excited To See Any Additional Experience With:

  • Senior roles in nonprofit, philanthropic, technology or public-interest organizations.
  • Supporting or advising investment, grantmaking or funding committees.

How We Work

A few things that are true about how we work at Mozilla Foundation. Here's a summary along with our expectation of how these should show up in this role:

  • Move toward the hard thing: you surface conflicts in priorities, resources or attention early, and give the CEO and executives direct, actionable input, including what they may not want to hear. You disagree constructively in the room, not afterward, and you don’t wait for someone else to raise it.
  • Stay curious and current: you stay close to what executives are seeing and what’s happening in our fields and communities, and turn it into the context the CEO needs. You pressure-test assumptions, including your own.
  • Work in the open: you document decisions and the reasoning behind them, so executives and teams can follow how and why priorities are set. You favor shared channels over side conversations wherever appropriate.
  • Focus and finish: you keep the CEO’s agenda focused on what matters most, make deliberate choices about what does and doesn’t need the CEO, and make sure decisions and commitments are seen through.
  • Flex with purpose: you move between long-term priorities and time-sensitive issues as context shifts, and adapt how you work with each executive. Flexibility isn’t about being agreeable; it’s staying responsive while holding to the mission and the CEO’s priorities.
  • Lead with care: you hold a high bar for the work while treating people as whole humans. You extend good faith to fellow executives, respect that each owns their area, and talk directly to the person who can solve the problem.

Salary and Benefits Information

Mozilla Foundation is dedicated to fair and equitable compensation for our staff. We aim to pay a competitive and market-based salary based on the responsibilities and requirements of the role. We do not ask for, or take into account, salary histories in our offer process.

The starting salary ranges for this role are listed below. 

  • Germany: €206,448.00 – €232,253.22
  • UK: £181,764.00 – £204,483.81
  • Canada: $356,400.00 – $400,948.65
  • US: $264,000.00 – $296,999.00

We also offer the following benefits:

  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Extended Sick Leave
  • Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Retirement Plan contributions
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days annual leave + sick days and your birthday
  • Company Holidays + EOY Shutdown
  • Wellness budget
  • Professional Development budget
  • Top up program for Pregnancy and Parental leaves

Benefits are subject to change at any time at the discretion of Mozilla Foundation.

Mozilla Foundation Hiring Practices

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, and persons of all sexual orientations and gender identities and expressions.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Compliance Data & IA Specialist - Alternance
descriptionHtml:
🦊 À propos de Green-Got

Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous construisons l’infrastructure financière du monde qui vient, au service de la transition écologique.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l’ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Nous proposons un compte de paiement associé à une carte, ainsi qu’une gamme de placements financiers pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition (assurance-vie, produits structurés, PER, Private Equity).

La Compliance est au cœur de ce modèle. C’est le socle de notre crédibilité, vis-à-vis de nos membres, du régulateur et de la mission que nous portons.

Lieu : Paris (75) · Présence au bureau : minimum 4 jours par semaine · Contrat : Alternance de 24 mois · Niveau : Master 1 · Poste à pourvoir : janvier ou février 2027

Chez Green-Got, la Compliance est un pilier stratégique et un levier de croissance durable. Nous voulons la faire évoluer vite, avec les bons outils, les bonnes personnes et une vraie culture de la donnée.

Nous recherchons un profil hybride, capable de concilier la rigueur du traitement opérationnel et la puissance de la data. Ce poste s’adresse à une personne curieuse et engagée, qui veut appliquer ses compétences techniques à des sujets de conformité qui comptent vraiment.

Au-delà des acquis académiques, c’est la posture qui fera la différence : autonomie, initiative sincère et envie d’avancer dans un environnement qui bouge vite.

Tu es méthodique sur le fond et réactif dans l’exécution. Les deux à la fois.

Une mission au service de notre raison d’être

Chez Green-Got, la transition écologique n’est pas un sujet annexe. C’est notre mission principale : permettre à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance, et orienter nos placements vers les entreprises qui font avancer la transition. La Compliance est ce qui rend cette mission crédible et durable. En rejoignant l’équipe, tu rejoins une entreprise dont le cœur de métier est là.

Tes missions

Tes missions

Au sein d’une équipe Compliance à taille humaine (nous sommes 5 aujourd’hui), tu es en interface directe avec les équipes Customer Care, Produit, Tech, Data, nos partenaires et nos membres.

Nos missions vont évoluer avec notre offre et avec une année 2027 qui s’annonce très dynamique. Le descriptif de ce poste bougera donc certainement, mais l’objectif restera le même : rester conforme à nos obligations tout en faisant avancer l’entreprise.

Opérations et gestion des dossiers Compliance (60 %)

  • Garant de l’entrée en relation : tu analyses la cohérence des dossiers KYC et prépares les décisions de validation ou de refus des membres.

  • Contrôle et vigilance des flux : tu suis les transactions, qualifies les alertes et proposes les mesures conservatoires à prendre.

  • Déclarations de soupçon (TRACFIN) : tu participes à la préparation et à la transmission des déclarations, sous la supervision de l’équipe.

  • Relation avec les membres et les partenaires : tu réponds aux questions de conformité avec un discours clair, pédagogique et ferme.

IA appliquée, réglementation et formation (40 %)

  • Réglementation IA (AI Act) : tu maîtrises les obligations du règlement européen sur l’intelligence artificielle et tu es responsable de leur mise en place au sein de la Compliance (et tout Green-Got). Cela inclut l’inventaire de nos usages IA, leur classification par niveau de risque, la documentation et les contrôles associés.

  • Contribution au cerveau de Green-Got : tu participes à la construction et à l’alimentation de la base de connaissance partagée de l’entreprise, pour que les équipes et les outils IA s’appuient sur les mêmes informations, procédures et règles.

  • Applications internes : tu repères les process de la Compliance qui gagneraient à être outillés, puis tu participes à la conception de ces applications avec l’équipe Data & IA.

  • Skills Library : tu formalises les méthodes de travail de l’équipe (analyse de dossiers, rédaction de rapports, contrôles) sous forme de compétences réutilisables par les équipes et les agents IA, et tu les tiens à jour à chaque évolution de notre offre.

  • Assistants et agents IA : tu participes à leur paramétrage et à leur amélioration, et tu mesures leur fiabilité avant toute mise en production.

  • Formation de l’équipe : tu es le relais IA de la Compliance. Tu accompagnes tes collègues sur les outils et les bons usages, tu partages tes méthodes et tu aides chacun à monter en compétences, à son rythme.

  • Veille et expérimentation : tu explores les nouveaux usages de l’IA dans un cadre maîtrisé et tu partages tes conclusions avec l’équipe.

  • Maîtrise de nos outils internes : Notion est au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Tu le maîtrises et tu contribues à le faire évoluer pour l’équipe.

Ta montée en compétences

Les premiers mois sont consacrés à une immersion forte dans la production, pour bien comprendre nos process avant de les automatiser. Nous te donnons un cadre clair pour gagner en autonomie :

  • Mois 1 : comprendre Green-Got, notre application et les fondamentaux de la Compliance.

  • Mois 2 : maîtriser les outils et les sujets opérationnels.

  • Mois 3 : être autonome sur les cas simples, continuer d’apprendre sur les cas complexes.

  • Mois 4 : être pleinement autonome sur l’opérationnel et monter en puissance sur les projets Data & IA et sur la réglementation IA.

Vos compétences

Ton profil

Nous recherchons un esprit agile et curieux, prêt à grandir avec nous. Quelqu’un qui a une véritable passion pour la data, la tech et les enjeux réglementaires, et qui veut voir l’impact concret de son travail sur une infrastructure financière que nous construisons avec conviction.

Tu as une vraie envie de travailler, d’avancer et d’évoluer. Tu es prêt à un rythme soutenu, car la charge de travail peut être importante.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes rusés, responsables, nous recherchons constamment le progrès, nous allons vite et le collectif passe avant l’individu.

  • Esprit analytique et algorithmique : tu allies une solide culture data (SQL, manipulation de bases de données, intérêt pour les LLM et le prompt engineering) à un esprit d’analyse affûté pour décortiquer les dossiers complexes, qualifier les alertes et détecter les comportements à risque.

  • Curiosité sincère pour la conformité et la réglementation IA: tu n’es peut-être pas juriste, mais comprendre les mécanismes KYC, LCB-FT, IA Act et RGPD t’intéresse vraiment.

title: Compliance Director
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Compliance Officer / MLRO Switzerland & Liechtenstein
descriptionHtml:
Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

 

  • A competitive salary and benefits package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Opportunity to work remotely

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

title: Consultant(e) Intégration Paie
descriptionHtml:
Alassio recrute son ou sa Consultant(e) Intégration Paie !

En un coup d'œil

  • Contrat : CDI

  • Lieu : Paris ou Aix-en-Provence ; hybride, avec des déplacements ponctuels chez nos cabinets partenaires

  • Équipe : Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA)

  • Expérience : 3 ans minimum en paie

  

Missions

 

🏗️ Alassio, en quelques mots

Le marché de la paie en cabinet d'expertise comptable est dominé depuis des décennies par des solutions historiques. Chez Alassio, notre ambition est de rénover le métier au bénéfice des gestionnaires de paie, avec un logiciel moderne, évolutif et pensé pour les réalités du terrain.

Lancé en juillet 2025 et déployé en clientèle depuis mars 2026, Alassio a levé 2,6 M€ en pre-seed auprès de Partech et de business angels de référence. Nous accélérons pour accompagner de nouveaux cabinets partout en France, tout en maintenant une exigence forte sur la qualité du produit et de l'accompagnement.

 

🎯 Pourquoi ce poste, maintenant

Changer de logiciel de paie est un projet lourd pour un cabinet. La réussite de chaque migration est décisive : c'est elle qui fait d'un cabinet signé un cabinet convaincu, puis un ambassadeur. Pour accompagner l'arrivée de nouveaux cabinets, nous renforçons l'équipe Déploiement & Accompagnement (DnA), qui assure un suivi actif de chacun de nos cabinets partenaires.

Ce poste est le premier recrutement de l’équipe DnA. Le playbook de migration, les supports de formation et les indicateurs de suivi se construisent avec les cabinets que tu accompagnes, et c’est toi qui les feras évoluer. Concrètement, cela veut dire de l’autonomie et de l’influence réelles dès les premiers mois.

 

🚀 Ton rôle

Tu accompagnes nos cabinets partenaires dans leur migration vers Alassio, de la formation à la mise en production, et tu incarnes la qualité de service d'Alassio auprès des équipes de gestionnaires de paie sur le terrain.

C'est un poste à la fois de pilotage et de terrain : en lien avec les équipes Sales et Product, tu mènes le projet de migration du cabinet, tu assures la formation initiale de ses gestionnaires de paie et tu animes les points de suivi tout au long de la phase pilote et des premiers mois de production.

 

🧩 Les étapes d'un déploiement

  1. Cadrage : kick-off structuré avec le cabinet, ateliers de recueil des besoins (conventions, spécificités des dossiers, reprise d'historique), planning partagé

  2. Pilote : formation initiale des gestionnaires de paie, migration d'un premier échantillon de dossiers, paies en parallèle et contrôle des écarts

  3. Déploiement : bascule progressive de dossiers supplémentaires selon le planning défini en amont, mise en production

  4. Suivi actif : accompagnement renforcé après le démarrage, puis passage de relais à l'équipe Support

 

🧭 Tes missions

  • Piloter le déploiement d'un portefeuille de 5 à 10 cabinets selon leur taille

  • Être l'interlocuteur de référence du responsable social du cabinet et de ses gestionnaires de paie ; animer les points d'étape et un bilan régulier avec chaque cabinet

  • Former les équipes : formation initiale des gestionnaires de paie, sessions de prise en main, approfondissements

  • Suivre la migration : reprise des données et des historiques, paramétrage des dossiers avec l'Ingénieur(e) Paramétrage Paie, paies en parallèle et contrôle des écarts

  • Coordonner les équipes internes mobilisées sur le cabinet : Sales, paramétrage, support, produit

  • Construire et faire évoluer le playbook de migration : étapes, checklists, supports de formation, indicateurs de suivi

  • Faire remonter au Product les besoins et les irritants observés sur le terrain

 

📊 Indicateurs de réussite

  • Satisfaction des cabinets de ton portefeuille

  • Respect du planning de déploiement

  • Rapidité de résolution des demandes, en lien avec les autres équipes d'Alassio

  • Adoption d'Alassio par les gestionnaires de paie du cabinet

 

🤝 Ton environnement

  • Rattachement : Alexandre (Responsable Déploiement & Accompagnement), au sein de l'équipe DnA

  • Tu travailles en lien étroit avec l'équipe Sales et l'équipe Métier

  • Outils : Alassio, Notion, Qualiobee

 

🗓️ Tes 6 premiers mois

  • À 1 mois : tu maîtrises l'outil et le playbook de migration, et tu co-pilotes un premier déploiement en binôme

  • À 3 mois : tu pilotes en autonomie tes premiers cabinets et tu contribues à l'amélioration du processus d'onboarding des cabinets

  • À 6 mois : tu gères un portefeuille complet de 5 à 10 cabinets, dont tu mènes entièrement le déploiement sur Alassio

  

Profil recherché

 

🌱 Expérience

Indispensable :

  • Formation en paie (BTS, licence pro, master ou titre professionnel Gestionnaire de paie) ou Bac+3 en RH

  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en paie, en cabinet d'expertise comptable ou chez un éditeur

  • Pratique d'un logiciel de paie du marché

  • Une expérience de migration de logiciel de paie ou de projet de déploiement

  • De l'aisance dans l'animation de formations

  • Sens de l'organisation et de la gestion de projet ; excellent relationnel, y compris avec des décisionnaires

  • Mobilité pour des déplacements ponctuels chez nos cabinets partenaires

Un plus :

  • Expérience de consultant(e) chez un éditeur de paie

  • Bonne connaissance de la DSN et des environnements multi-conventions

  • Expérience de conception de supports de formation

 

💎 Qualités

  • Une posture de conseil, adaptable au contexte de chaque cabinet

  • La pédagogie, la rigueur et le sens du suivi

  • Le calme et la fiabilité dans les moments sensibles d'une mise en production et lors des pics d'activité (clôtures de paie, mois de janvier)

  • Le goût de construire : tu es à l’aise dans une équipe resserrée, où les process s’écrivent en même temps qu’on les utilise

  

Processus de sélection

title: Creative Strategy Director
descriptionHtml:
DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This position is based in London. We combine data, technology, creative content, and paid media to crack brands’ business problems and drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions, from advertising campaigns to augmented reality and chatbots. Our clients include eBay, INEOS, Mammut, Easyjet, PepsiCo, Loreal and Logitech.

Creative Strategy Directors at DEPT® are at the heart of growth invention, bringing together brilliant strategic craft, creative thinking, cultural understanding, and a broader perspective on business and technology. We’re looking for someone who has mastered the fundamentals of strategy but isn’t interested in playing by the old rules. Someone shaped by the world's most renowned creative agencies, with the experience and instinct to challenge convention, connect disciplines, and help define what modern marketing looks like.

We believe great strategy is less about following frameworks and more about asking the right questions, finding unexpected connections, and creating the conditions for brilliant work. The playing field is bigger than advertising. It spans culture, commerce, creativity, media, technology, communities, and the ambitions of our clients. We need someone who sees opportunity in all of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Define the real challenge: Get under the skin of our clients' businesses, their audiences, and the world around them. Connect the dots across culture, commerce, company, competition, capability, community, and creative ambition to uncover the opportunities others might miss.
  • Find the tension: Turn complexity into clarity. Find the sharpest insights, the most interesting tensions, and the questions that unlock new possibilities for brands and businesses.
  • Craft the springboard: Develop strategic briefs, provocations, narratives, and thought-starters that inspire creative teams, give ideas direction, and make brilliant work possible.
  • Invent growth: Look beyond the brief and beyond the boundaries of traditional marketing. Identify new opportunities for clients, connect disciplines, and help shape bigger, more ambitious growth challenges.
  • Think horizontally: Move comfortably across brand, creative, social, digital, media, technology, and experience. You don't need to be an expert in everything, but you know how to connect the dots and bring the right people together.
  • Embrace what's next: Explore how emerging technologies, AI, and the evolving roles of humans and agents are reshaping customer journeys, business operations, and the opportunities for our clients.
  • Move at pace: Be comfortable with ambiguity, trust your instincts, and get hands-on. You know when to dig deeper, when to challenge the obvious, and when to get a good idea out into the world.
  • Elevate the floor: Bring your experience, point of view, and curiosity to the wider team. Challenge the thinking, inspire the people around you, and help make the work (and the people around you) better.

That's the core of it. Beyond that, we're looking for someone who cares deeply about the craft of strategy, the power of creativity, and the potential of people and businesses. Someone with a point of view, a healthy disregard for convention, and the energy to help build something new.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strategic craft: 10+ years of experience, ideally gained in leading creative agencies. You have strong foundations in brand and creative strategy, and the work to show for it.
  • Creative instinct: You know what makes an idea interesting, unexpected, and powerful. You can spot the potential in a thought and help turn it into work people care about.
  • A broader horizon: You're as interested in what happens beyond advertising as you are in advertising itself. Social, digital, media, technology, business, culture: it's all part of the picture.
  • Connected thinking: You don't think in silos. You connect the dots between audience, brand, business, culture, competition, capability, and creativity to find opportunities for growth.
  • Cultural fluency: You have a deep understanding of British (advertising) culture and an instinct for what's shifting in the world around us. You're curious about people, platforms, movements, and the things shaping what comes next.
  • An appetite for what's next: You’re interested in how AI, new technologies, and changing behaviours are creating new opportunities for brands and businesses. You're willing to explore, experiment, and challenge your own thinking.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit: You're not waiting for the perfect brief or the next big assignment. You spot opportunities, make things happen, and bring energy to building something new.
  • A point of view: You have your own perspective on strategy, creativity, and the industry. You're confident enough to challenge convention, open enough to change your mind, and curious enough to keep learning.
  • Hands-on leadership: You lead through the work. You're as comfortable getting stuck into a brief, shaping a thought, or working alongside a creative team as you are guiding a room or presenting a bigger vision.
  • Team player: You know the best work comes from bringing people together. You collaborate generously, challenge constructively, and leave egos at the door. You're interested in bigger challenges, not bigger titles.

WE OFFER

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
  • 24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
  • DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
  • Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
  • Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.
  • A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
  • Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
  • You can discover even more employee benefits here.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Telecommunications, Media and Technology team, part of our wider Retail and Consumer unit, is dedicated to guiding our clients on a path to growth in market sectors that have disproportionately been impacted by AI in recent years.

Combatting customer ARPU erosion, safeguarding media from commoditisation, ensuring customer-facing AI capabilities are impactful and safe for use. The challenges are vast. AI is now not just a means for optimisation, but a core competitive differentiator in an increasingly competitive landscape.

About the role

As a Customer Director, you’ll play an influential role in growing our most impactful accounts and shape our go-to-market strategy in order to achieve our ambitious growth targets.

You will act as a strategic partner to our Telecommunications, Media and Technology clients, helping them reinvent their operations and end-user engagement through AI-powered decision-making.You will build enduring relationships with senior stakeholders, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

This is an opportunity to help build a distinctive practice inside a company with world-class technical depth and the ambition to set the standard for AI in the TMT sector.

The ideal candidate will be T-shaped: broad enough to advise across AI for a range of TMT firms, with deep experience in at least one sector. We are particularly interested in candidates who have delivered AI in the Telecommunication sector.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the TMT sector

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major TMT clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

  • Generating high-value growth for Faculty by shaping compelling commercial pitches and demos that showcase our technical depth and ability to solve sector-specific challenges

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated propositions and points of view through thought leadership, media engagement, and industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

  • Managing a practice within a practice - leading cross-functional teams of delivery experts, PhD-calibre engineers and data scientists to further consolidate Faculty’s reputation for pioneering technical and delivery excellence.

Who we're looking for:

  • You’ve managed C-level, complex stakeholder relationships in the TMT industry, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence

  • You’re commercially driven - energised by hitting growth targets with a proven track record of shaping opportunities, winning work, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI concepts with clarity to technical and non-technical audiences

  • You are comfortable working alongside deeply technical teams and possess the curiosity to master and discuss artificial intelligence applications.

  • You exhibit a leadership mindset that balances executive-level strategy with a hands-on approach to unblocking teams, challenging work constructively, and maintaining high quality

  • Some experience in consulting preferred

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (60 minutes)

  3. Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes)

  4. Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.
