title: Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice
descriptionHtml:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Back Market is on a mission to make refurbished tech the new norm. To achieve this, we use data to better understand our customers, improve their experience, and make smarter product and business decisions.

Within the Data Division, the Customer Experience Analytics team supports teams working across the customer journey, CRM, and Services. We help the business understand customer behaviors, identify opportunities to improve the experience, and measure the impact of new initiatives.

As a Customer Journey & App Analytics Apprentice, you will primarily support the Customer Journey and App Analytics scope. You will work closely with Product, Tech, UX, and Business teams to analyze customer behavior, support experimentation, and turn data into actionable insights.

This apprenticeship is a great opportunity for a curious, structured, and business-oriented student who wants to develop strong skills in product analytics, experimentation, customer journey analysis, and mobile app analytics.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Support the analysis of customer journeys across Back Market’s website and mobile applications, from discovery and purchase to delivery, return, and after-sales service

  • Contribute to the preparation, analysis, and monitoring of Customer Journey experiments, including A/B tests and other experimentation initiatives

  • Help formulate analytical hypotheses, define success metrics, analyze experiment results, and identify actionable recommendations

  • Investigate customer behavior across different touchpoints, segments, markets, and devices

  • Build and maintain recurring dashboards, reports, and analyses for key stakeholders

  • Contribute to the improvement of event tracking plans and analytics documentation

  • Present findings and recommendations in a clear and accessible way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree, or equivalent, in data analytics, data science, business analytics, economics, engineering, marketing analytics, or another quantitative field

  • You have a strong interest in customer behavior, product analytics, experimentation, and digital products

  • You have solid SQL skills and are comfortable writing, reviewing, and improving analytical queries

  • You have an analytical mindset and enjoy investigating the reasons behind changes in customer behavior or business performance

  • You communicate clearly in written and spoken English

  • You are curious, rigorous, organized, and willing to ask questions

  • You enjoy working in a fast-paced, international, and collaborative environment

Bonus point if :

  • You have experience with analytics tools such as Amplitude, GA4, Mixpanel, or similar platforms

  • You have already worked on A/B testing, experimentation, or product performance analysis

  • You are familiar with mobile app analytics, event taxonomies, or tracking plans

ABOUT THE APPRENTICESHIPℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: Ideally for 12 months (24 months to be discussed).

  • Location: Bordeaux, France

  • Contract: You must already be enrolled in a work-study program in a French school (contrat d'alternance / d'apprentissage)

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit/Tech interview with the direct manager

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Campus Talent Acquisition Specialist

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

descriptionHtml:

title: Customer Service Team Leader
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

We run camera-based parking for landowners and operators, from hotels and colleges to shopping centres, across England, Scotland and Wales. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Customer Service Team Leader to lead our support team: six people across two desks, handling around 1,500 tickets a week. One desk helps the landowners and asset managers we work with; the other helps the drivers who park at their sites. Many tickets mean investigating across our systems, escalating to TechOps and following up until the problem is fixed.

This is a people-leadership role first. You’ll set the standard, coach the team to hit it, and use the numbers to see what’s working and what isn’t. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, the backing of our COO, and Client Success, TechOps and Product teams to work with on them. And you’ll lead from the front, getting stuck into tickets with the team when it’s busy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of six, with regular one-to-ones and clear standards for quality and output.

  • Set targets for the team, hold people accountable to them, and help everyone get there.

  • Keep response times, resolution and the backlog on track across both desks.

  • Get stuck in on tickets when the queue is busy, and handle the trickier escalations yourself.

  • Use the team’s numbers to spot what drivers and clients keep contacting us about, and work with other teams to fix the cause.

  • Plan the rota, including Saturday cover, around leave and busy periods.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll need:

  • Experience leading a customer service or support team (phone, email, chat or ticket-based) against KPIs.

  • A track record of improving how a team performs.

  • Experience setting clear targets, holding people to them and coaching them to get there.

  • Comfort with numbers: reading a report or dashboard, asking the right questions of it, and turning the answers into improvements.

  • Happy getting into the detail of a problem, across systems and teams, to find out what actually went wrong.

  • Curiosity about how tools, automation and AI could make the team’s work easier.

  • Clear, calm writing, even when a customer isn’t, and confidence on the phone with an unhappy client.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Zendesk or a similar helpdesk tool.

  • Experience in parking, mobility, utilities or another high-volume consumer service.

  • Experience setting up weekend cover.

Don’t be put off if you haven’t built helpdesk reports yourself. What matters is that you’ve set targets, held a team to them, and used the numbers to make things better. We’ll help you with the tools.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home.

  • Room to grow with the business, with training and development support.

  • 20 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Company pension scheme.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office right next to East Croydon Station, with a fully stocked kitchen offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks (and two office dogs!).

  • Laptop and tech provided.

  • Employee Assistance Programme, BrightHR Exchange discounts and regular company events.

The details

Location: Croydon, next to East Croydon Station. Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 from home.

Reports to: Daivik Patel, Chief Operating Officer.

Team: 6 support agents across two desks (Client Service and Driver Support).

title: Customer Success Account Manager, Digital - French
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Renewals are the core of a SaaS company's revenue. You own renewal targets for Samsara's Digital Mid-Market segment: setting customers up for success while maximising financial results. On every deal that means minimising attrition, locking in the best terms, spotting growth opportunities, feeding insights back to the business and closing 36-month renewals.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You enjoy working at high velocity:
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 60+ renewals per quarter from end-to-end and exceed sales targets
  • Follow a structured scenario-based forecasting methodology
  • Engage with customers to identify and mitigate renewal risk and drive platform adoption at scale
  • Work cross-functionally with sales teams to solve problems and ensure a successful, smooth renewal
  • Contribute to an exceptional team environment that motivates the team to perform at its best
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years of full-cycle closing sales experience, ideally with mid-sized businesses in a high-transaction environment.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • Empathy for customers and teammates, and strong organisation.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Data Center Architect
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Davis is looking for an architect who has already run data center feasibility studies on their own, and who can answer the question a client asks in front of a site: how many megawatts can this land absorb. We expect three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen end to end.


About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

The data center market is structuring fast, operators and landowners are hunting for sites, and the question they ask is one of capacity: how many megawatts of IT load does this land carry, under what scheme, and on what conditions. We answer in days where the market takes weeks. You will be the person who answers for that number.

You will run a portfolio of test fits and data center feasibility studies, with occasional work on large logistics and industry. Under the supervision of a lead architect, you take these projects from first capacity through to schematic design, and you present them to the client.

The core of the role

  • Establish a site's capacity in IT megawatts, working from the local zoning rules and operating constraints, and set out the assumptions behind it.

  • Qualify the applicable land-use category and the environmental-classification regime for industrial facilities, and derive from them the permitted height, the setbacks and the siting conditions.

  • Draw the data halls at their real grid, fully laid out, with their aisles, their air-handling units and their structural grid.

  • Compose the industrial site plan: service yards, a perimeter heavy-vehicle road, loading docks, retention basins, planted buffers, access and parking.

  • Arbitrate between schemes, one level, two levels or more, while respecting the slab-to-slab height and the zoning height cap.

  • Name the questions to put to the operator: cooling system, density per rack, electrical redundancy, hall dimensions, height.

  • Carry your number in front of the client, and defend it under challenge.

  • Place the project on its critical path: grid connection, environmental permitting, ecological surveys, preventive archaeology.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize data center best practice, translating the sizing cascade, the grids and the thresholds into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, saying what is right, what is wrong, and on what grounds.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: we count projects as much as years. Three to five years on the data center product, with two or three projects seen across their full cycle. One of them should be a project you carried yourself, from capacity through to permit or schematic design. A background in large logistics or industrial buildings is a valid base, provided you add that data center experience to it.

  • Software: mastery of Rhino and Revit is essential, and AutoCAD is expected.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

  • Speed and synthesis: our clients decide fast, on a number. You need to produce a credible, well-drawn scenario in hours, cut to the essential on ambiguous cases, and know what level of detail serves the decision at each phase.

Domain skills

  • Product knowledge, the sizing cascade of a data center, hall, power, cooling, telecom and logistics, the slab-to-slab height and what it imposes, the rack-and-aisle grid, electrical redundancy, the order of magnitude of a PUE.

  • Applied regulatory fluency, the land-use sub-category and the 2023 ruling that reclassified data centers, the environmental-classification headings and the threshold that triggers a full environmental permit, height and setback rules, no-net-land-take targets and designation as a project of major national interest, rooftop renewable-energy requirements.

  • Buildable capacity, linking a rule to its quantified effect on a volume, and a volume to an installable power.

  • Industrial site planning, heavy-vehicle access, turning circles, fire safety, water management, insertion and edges.

  • Graphic production, plans, sections and diagrams that make a capacity argument legible to an investor.

  • Ownership of the subject, presenting, arguing and defending a number in front of a client who contests it. We are looking for someone who has owned the subject end to end, assumptions, number and client presentation.

Complementary skills

  • Rigor and a sense of synthesis, especially on ambiguous cases.

  • Structuring information, organizing what you produce so that others, human or machine, can use it.

  • An ability to work across the product, tech and real estate teams.

  • A command of technical English, the vocabulary of the sector being largely English-speaking.

Why Join Davis?

  • Take part in a genuine transformation of the real estate profession, and co-build the next generation of feasibility standards alongside a high-caliber technical team.

  • You will set Davis's data center method, and it will serve every project that follows.

  • See your work in every deliverable, and correct the tool when it gets things wrong.

  • Join a young company, where the methods and the tools are still being built, and where your expertise shapes the way we work.

Package

  • Fixed-term or permanent depending on the case, to discuss together

  • Offices in the center of Paris 2e

  • Private health insurance covered

  • Meal vouchers

  • Gym membership covered

  • 50% of commuting costs reimbursed

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:


Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

Platform & Data

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We're looking for an exceptional engineer. A true A-player who wants to take ownership, build world-class technology, and play a key role in shaping the future of Heidi Systems.

About Heidi Systems

Submetering in Germany still runs mostly on paper. Meters get read by hand, data sits in PDFs, and tenants see their consumption once a year.

Heidi Systems changes that end to end. We install meters and gateways in buildings, collect the data and build the platform property managers use to monitor consumption and run the yearly utility billing.

We have paying customers, a growing pipeline and an angel round with unicorn founders and directors from Google and OpenAI. Now we need an engineer who can carry a big part of the technical foundation together with the founders.

The role

You'll be one of the technical leads at Heidi and work directly with the founders. You make the architecture decisions, build them yourself and run them in production.

As the team grows, you'll help hire and mentor the next engineers.

What you'll own

  • Backend services in Go and TypeScript, including the API our SvelteKit frontend talks to

  • Microservices: deciding where to split services and building them, mostly in Go

  • Data pipelines: ingestion, validation and processing of meter, gateway and building data. These numbers end up on invoices, so they have to be right.

  • Databases and storage: PostgreSQL, Supabase and S3. Schema design, performance, backups, replication.

  • IoT and connectivity: MQTT, message brokers, wireless gateways and the bugs that only show up with real hardware in a basement

  • Infrastructure and deployments: Hetzner servers, Docker, Caddy, GitHub Actions, GHCR

  • Monitoring and incidents: logging, alerting and a clear process for when something breaks

  • Engineering standards: code review, testing and how we ship

What you bring

  • A track record of building backends that run in production, and that you owned yourself

  • Experience writing production backends in Go and TypeScript

  • Experience with Supabase, or with PostgreSQL and S3

  • Experience designing and running microservices, ideally in Go

  • Hands-on with Docker and deploying to Linux servers

  • You've set up monitoring, logging and alerting before

  • You debug production issues yourself and can explain afterwards what went wrong

  • You've made architecture decisions on a real product and can walk us through the trade-offs

  • Fluent English

Bonus points

  • Real-time systems, especially MQTT and message brokers

  • Building CI/CD pipelines and DevOps setups

  • AI data pipelines

  • High-volume time-series data

  • Bare-metal or VPS infrastructure, ideally Hetzner

  • Experience in energy, PropTech or infrastructure tech

  • Previous role as founding engineer, tech lead, staff or principal engineer

  • Hiring and building engineering teams

Our stack

  • Languages: Go, TypeScript

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, S3

  • Infrastructure: Hetzner, Docker, Caddy

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GHCR

  • Connectivity: MQTT, IoT data streams, APIs

  • Config: YAML, TOML

We care more about how you make engineering decisions than whether you know every tool on this list.

Why Heidi

  • You work directly with the founders. Most decisions take one call.

  • You own core systems from day one and set many of the standards the team builds on.

  • The problems are real: software, hardware and energy data in buildings across Germany.

  • A renovated Altbau office in Berlin Mitte at Monbijoupark, everyone at one table.

  • Room to grow into a lead role as the engineering team gets bigger.

Location

Berlin, on-site. You live in Berlin or are willing to move. Full-time, start as soon as possible.

How to apply

What you've built matters more to us than your CV. Send us:

  • A short intro and your CV or LinkedIn profile

  • Your GitHub profile or other examples of your technical work

  • One complex system you designed, built or ran in production. Tell us what made it hard, which architecture decisions you made, what went wrong and how you fixed it.

title: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Natalie unter oder +49 157 92465807.

You will work closely with finance, legal, treasury, capital markets, and external advisers to ensure the Group's structure, intercompany arrangements, and tax positions are efficient, compliant, and defensible.

This is an opportunity to build a tax function from the ground up within a fast-growing, Brookfield-backed AI infrastructure platform, working on high-impact, high-visibility initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Group's tax strategy, ensuring the corporate structure and operating model are tax-efficient, commercially sound, and aligned with Radiant's growth.

  • Lead tax structuring and due diligence on new deployments from initial underwriting, structuring through to execution across co-location and development opportunities.

  • Advise on entity structuring as the Group enters new jurisdictions, including holding and operating company structures, permanent establishment risk, tax registrations, and available incentives.

  • Structure intercompany financing for new data-centre builds alongside treasury and capital markets, including interest deductibility, withholding tax, and repatriation considerations.

  • Own the Group's transfer pricing framework, including intercompany policies for GPU and hardware supply, compute and infrastructure services, management services, and intra-group financing, supported by documentation, benchmarking, and intercompany agreements.

  • Oversee direct and indirect tax compliance across the UK, US, and EU, including corporate income tax, VAT/sales tax on cross-border hardware supply, withholding taxes, and in-country compliance stemming from statutory reporting.

  • Own tax accounting and reporting under IFRS (IAS 12), including current and deferred tax provisions.

  • Establish tax policies, processes, and controls, including a tax risk and governance framework, and assess the Group's exposure to evolving international tax rules.

  • Manage relationships with external tax advisers and tax authorities, and partner with the wider finance team on ad hoc projects as the business scales.

Qualifications:

  • Qualified accountant with 8–12 years of experience in corporate and international tax, transfer pricing, transaction support or a related field, gained in a leading advisory firm and/or a multinational group.

  • Hands-on experience advising on cross-border transactions, such as acquisitions, new market entry, or financing structures.

  • Solid understanding of UK corporate tax, with working knowledge of EU and US tax regimes.

  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on contributor in a cross functional team, managing advisor relationships.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

  • High levels of ownership, integrity, and accountability.

  • A proactive, hands-on approach with a willingness to build processes and take on new challenges as the business scales.

  • Team-oriented with a demonstrated commitment to shared success above any personal accomplishment or recognition.

  • Intellectual curiosity and enthusiasm for the AI infrastructure ecosystem, analytical skills and creative problem-solving ability.

Desirable:

  • Experience in infrastructure, data centres, energy, or technology sectors.

  • Transfer pricing experience, including designing intercompany models in line with OECD guidelines.

  • Experience with tax accounting and reporting (IAS 12 and/or ASC 740).

  • Experience with capital-intensive businesses, including capital allowances, asset financing, or infrastructure investment structures.

  • Familiarity with tax technology and ERP systems.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Tax-efficient, well-diligenced structures for each new data-centre acquisition and market entry.

  • A clear, defensible transfer pricing model operating consistently across the Group.

  • Timely, accurate tax compliance and reporting in every jurisdiction.

  • Well-documented tax policies and controls, and a Group structure ready for audit scrutiny.

  • Become a trusted advisor to the wider team.

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Gympass subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave

title: Duales Studium 2027: Elektrotechnik (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Dein Job für sauberere Luft. Starte dein duales Studium bei Emission Partner.

Technik aus dem Saterland. Wirkung weit darüber hinaus.

In der Gemeinde Saterland entwickeln und produzieren wir Technologien, die Schadstoffemissionen reduzieren. Unsere Katalysatoren und Systeme kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Abgase zuverlässig gereinigt und Emissionsgrenzwerte eingehalten werden müssen.

Moderne Abgasnachbehandlung ist dabei längst mehr als Mechanik und Katalysatortechnik. Elektronik, Automatisierung und intelligente Steuerungstechnik sorgen dafür, dass Anlagen zuverlässig arbeiten, Prozesse überwacht und Emissionen gezielt reduziert werden können.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

In deinem dualen Studium verbindest du das theoretische Wissen aus dem Elektrotechnikstudium direkt mit der Praxis bei uns. Du planst elektrische Systeme, beschäftigst dich mit Automatisierung und Programmierung und arbeitest an technischen Lösungen für unsere Anlagen.

Du möchtest nach dem Abitur nicht zwischen Studium und Praxis wählen, sondern beides miteinander verbinden und schon während deines Studiums an echten technischen Projekten arbeiten? Dann starte dein duales Studium bei Emission Partner.

Zum 01.08.2027 suchen wir dich für ein duales Studium Elektrotechnik (m/w/d) an unserem Standort in Strücklingen.

Was du bei uns bewirkst

Du bringst unsere Technik unter Strom und intelligente Lösungen in unsere Anlagen.

Während deines dualen Studiums lernst du, wie Elektrotechnik und Automatisierung in unseren Anlagen und Systemen eingesetzt werden.

Du beschäftigst dich mit der Planung elektrischer Anlagen, entwickelst Steuerungslösungen, programmierst Anlagensteuerungen und erstellst Visualisierungen. Dabei arbeitest du nicht nur theoretisch an Aufgabenstellungen, sondern kannst deine Lösungen in realen Projekten begleiten.

Besonders spannend: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren technischen Bereichen zusammen und bekommst Einblicke in den gesamten Prozess von der Planung und Entwicklung über die Programmierung bis zur Montage und Inbetriebnahme.

So arbeitest du bereits während deines Studiums an Technologien mit, die dafür entwickelt werden, Schadstoffemissionen zu reduzieren.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Du wirkst bei der Planung neuer elektrischer Anlagen sowie beim Umbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung bestehender Anlagen mit.
  • Du lernst, Anlagensteuerungen zu programmieren und technische Abläufe zu automatisieren.
  • Du erstellst Visualisierungen für unsere Anlagen und unterstützt dabei, Bedienung und Prozessüberwachung weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du arbeitest an der Automatisierungs- und Elektrotechnik unserer Sonderanlagen zur Abgasnachbehandlung mit.
  • Du erstellst und bearbeitest Schalt- und Stromlaufpläne, Kabellisten und technische Dokumentationen.
  • Du unterstützt bei der Elektroinstallation und begleitest Projekte von der Rohmontage bis zur fertigen Anlage.
  • Du lernst, elektrische Bauteile und Systeme auszulegen, zu prüfen und aufeinander abzustimmen.
  • Du begleitest technische Projekte und arbeitest mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen zusammen.
  • Du kannst das Wissen aus deinen Studienphasen unmittelbar in echte technische Aufgabenstellungen bei uns einbringen.
  • Mit zunehmender Erfahrung übernimmst du eigene Projekte und mehr Verantwortung.


Das bringst du mit

Uns ist wichtiger, dass du technisch neugierig bist und komplexe Zusammenhänge verstehen möchtest, als dass du schon alles kannst.

  • Du verfügst zum Studienstart über die erforderliche Hochschulzugangsberechtigung.
  • Mathematik, Physik und Technik interessieren dich und du möchtest wissen, wie technische Systeme funktionieren.
  • Du begeisterst dich für Elektrotechnik, Automatisierung und Programmierung.
  • Du denkst logisch und findest gerne Lösungen für technische Probleme.
  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, strukturiert und zuverlässig.
  • Du möchtest theoretisches Wissen nicht nur lernen, sondern direkt praktisch anwenden.
  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team und möchtest gemeinsam mit anderen technische Lösungen entwickeln.
  • Du bist bereit, mit zunehmender Erfahrung Verantwortung für eigene Aufgaben und Projekte zu übernehmen.


Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Entscheidend ist für uns, dass du technisches Interesse, Lernbereitschaft und Lust darauf mitbringst, Studium und Praxis miteinander zu verbinden.

Dein duales Studium bei uns

Dein duales Studium verbindet deine Praxisphasen bei uns in Strücklingen mit den Studienphasen an der PHWT in Vechta.

So lernst du die wissenschaftlichen und technischen Grundlagen der Elektrotechnik an der Hochschule und kannst dein Wissen anschließend direkt bei uns in der Praxis einsetzen.

Während andere zunächst hauptsächlich Theorie kennenlernen, bekommst du bei uns früh Einblicke in reale Entwicklungs- und Anlagenprojekte. Mit jedem Semester wächst dabei nicht nur dein Wissen, sondern auch die Verantwortung, die du bei uns übernehmen kannst.

Die Studiendauer beträgt 3,5 Jahre inklusive Bachelorarbeit.

Das bieten wir dir

Dein duales Studium soll dir nicht nur einen Abschluss ermöglichen. Du sollst dich bei Emission Partner fachlich entwickeln, praktische Erfahrung sammeln und dir eine langfristige Perspektive aufbauen können.

30 Tage Urlaub
Zeit für Erholung, Freunde, Familie und Freizeit.

600 € Gesundheitsbudget
Über unsere arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung.

E-Bike-Leasing
Für deinen Arbeitsweg oder deine Freizeit.

Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Damit du schon früh anfangen kannst, für später vorzusorgen.

Individuelle Weiterbildung
Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Team & Firmenevents
Kurze Wege, Zusammenarbeit und gemeinsame Veranstaltungen gehören bei uns dazu.

Studium trifft echte Ingenieurpraxis
Was du im Studium lernst, kannst du bei uns direkt in technischen Projekten anwenden.

Eigene Projekte & Verantwortung
Mit deinem Wissen und deiner Erfahrung wächst auch die Verantwortung, die du bei uns übernehmen kannst.

Arbeiten mit Sinn
Du arbeitest an elektrischen und automatisierten Lösungen für Technologien, die dafür entwickelt werden, Schadstoffemissionen zu reduzieren.

Perspektive nach deinem Studium
Unser Ziel ist es, dual Studierende langfristig für Emission Partner zu gewinnen und gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.

Klingt nach deinem Studium?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Kein kompliziertes Anschreiben. Kein Bewerbungsmarathon.

Bewirb dich einfach online und erzähl uns kurz, wer du bist, was dich an Elektrotechnik begeistert und warum du dein duales Studium bei uns starten möchtest.

Jetzt bewerben und Emission Partner werden.

Dein Job für sauberere Luft.

title: E-commerce Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

E-commerce Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the E-commerce Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. 

Our Values 

Be Ambitious to succeed Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work Be always learning and listening to understand Be Results-focused to exceed expectations Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations

All applicants shall be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodivergence, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by local laws. 

INSIDE IDEAS GROUP has set ambitious environmental goals around sustainability, with science-based emissions reduction targets. Collectively, we work towards our mission, embedding sustainability into every department and through every stage of the project lifecycle. 

Our values shape everything we do: 

Be Ambitious to succeed   

Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what’s possible   

Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work   

Be always learning and listening to understand

Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations

We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

title: Electric Propulsion Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Role
Someone has to prove that our AURA RF gridded ion thruster does its job. As Electric Propulsion Engineer, you run the test programme that turns designs into verified, flight-ready hardware, using NewOrbit’s own vacuum facilities.

You start with testing: you build the rigs, run the campaigns, find what fails and give the evidence that drives the next design. As the programme matures, your role grows into design ownership, calculating, designing and building the thruster yourself, and testing your own designs. Your results decide what flies.

Responsibilities

Test and verify

  • Plan and own the propulsion test campaigns that support NEO-1 and our customer thruster deliveries.

  • Operate the vacuum system, RF generators, high-voltage supplies, gas feed and thrust balance during electric propulsion tests.

  • Run plasma diagnostics and data acquisition, then analyse the results.

  • Keep clear records of every test configuration and result, giving traceable evidence for system verification and qualification.

Build

  • Design and implement test rigs and equipment for propulsion testing.

  • Assemble and maintain test hardware, electronics and vacuum facilities.

Design

  • Feed findings back to the design team quickly so each iteration improves on the last.

  • Work with mechanical, electrical and control engineers to integrate and test each new iteration of the ion propulsion system.

  • Over time, take ownership of thruster design and performance calculations, from concept to flight configuration, and turn test results into design changes, then re-test.

Requirements

Essential

  • Practical electric propulsion testing experience, ideally with RF generators, high-voltage power supplies and thrust balances.

  • Experience with vacuum systems (pumps, gauges, valves), power supplies, fluid management (high-pressure gas tanks, mass flow controllers) and data acquisition systems.

  • Working knowledge of RF gridded ion thrusters, including RF plasma generation, ion optics and neutralisation, and of plasma physics, diagnostics and ionisation processes.

  • A rigorous approach to test planning, data quality and documentation.

  • Willingness to design, build and test your own hardware, and to work extended hours on-site.

Nice to have

  • Experience with plasma diagnostics such as Langmuir probes or retarding potential analysers.

  • Experience taking a thruster from design through qualification to flight hardware, or with test rig design or hardware verification for flight programmes.

  • Scripting for data analysis and test automation (Python or MATLAB).

  • Experience running thrusters on more than one propellant, such as xenon, krypton or air.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms.

In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. Your work will enable silicon bring-up, hardware validation, remote access, observability, and platform automation for our validation platforms and production systems.

You will work across hardware and software domains, collaborating closely with silicon, hardware, validation, firmware, and system teams to ensure our in-house accelerator silicon can be brought up, debugged, validated, and accessed efficiently.

This is a hands-on role combining embedded development, hardware integration, laboratory debugging, and technical leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

· Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards.

· Evaluate, select, and integrate MCUs, management controllers, sensors, and supporting hardware components.

· Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation.

· Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks.

· Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams.

· Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements.

· Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity.

· Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities.

· Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other laboratory equipment.

· Support manufacturing test, firmware provisioning, and lifecycle management processes.

· Drive technical execution across multiple projects while contributing to architecture, risk reduction, and long-term platform strategy.

· Generate design documentation, validation procedures, and engineering guidelines.

Minimum Qualifications:

· Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field.

· 5+ years of experience developing embedded firmware and software.

· Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ development.

· Solid understanding of digital hardware design and board-level electronics.

· Experience reading and reviewing schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and hardware interface specifications.

· Familiarity with I2C/SMBus, SPI, UART, GPIO, JTAG, and other common embedded interfaces.

· Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related laboratory equipment.

· Experience with Linux-based development environments.

· Strong problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualificacions:

· Experience with OpenBMC, embedded Linux, Zephyr, FreeRTOS, or similar platforms.

· Experience developing board management controllers, service processors, or platform management solutions.

· Experience supporting silicon bring-up, board bring-up, or hardware validation programs.

· Familiarity with data center, server, networking, accelerator, or HPC hardware.

· Understanding of power sequencing, PMBus, telemetry, monitoring, and voltage margining concepts.

· Familiarity with PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and other high-speed platform interfaces.

· Experience developing automation tools using Python or similar scripting languages.

· Exposure to manufacturing test, production provisioning, and deployment workflows.

· Knowledge of secure boot, firmware update mechanisms, and remote-management architectures.

Soft skills:

· A systems-level mindset spanning both hardware and software.

· Strong technical curiosity and a hands-on approach to engineering challenges.

· The ability to work effectively across multiple technical disciplines.

· Sound engineering judgment and a pragmatic approach to problem solving.

· Ownership and accountability for delivering robust platform management solutions that enable successful silicon bring-up and platform validation.

What We Offer?

· A chance to work at one of the most transformative AI and silicon engineering companies in Europe with cutting-edge technology and industry leaders

· We offer a remuneration package that values your experience

· We believe in investing in our employees and providing them with opportunities for growth and career development

· Join an innovative team and experience company growth

· Travel within Europe, with occasional travel to Asia, to work with our teams and partners

We are looking for outstanding people willing to join our mission to change the silicon industry and help build a better world. If you identify with Openchip, please contact us.

At Openchip, we believe a diverse and inclusive team is the key to groundbreaking ideas. We foster a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential—regardless of race, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

title: Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

As an Engineering Manager at HousingAnywhere, you will play a critical role in leading the evolution of our platform with your vision. You will join the Product Engineering team, leading one of our product teams that owns a key part of the renter journey, from finding and applying to booking, moving in and staying. You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience.
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team's standards high while the way of working changes.

  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.

  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.

title: Engineering Manager, Storage
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a founding people-leadership role. There is no team to inherit and no legacy to maintain — you build the team as well as the stack, and you are accountable for both from day one. Early on you will be deliberately hands-on, because there is no one else to solve the hardest problems — but hiring your first engineers, coaching them, and setting their growth paths starts immediately, not later.

You will be the founding EM for storage on our Sovereign AI cloud.

Block, filesystem, and object storage for training runs, sandboxed workloads, and general compute: you decide what we build, what we buy, and how it adds up to storage our customers can bet a business on. Some layers we deploy and harden from best-in-class vendors. The ones that matter most we write ourselves in Go — S3-compatible object storage, tiering, backup and recovery, caching layers that put cold data on cheap spinning disks.

As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You will own capacity planning across datacenters and the architecture that keeps data durable when disks, networks, and entire sites fail. Storage is a strategic bet for this org: the team you build and the calls you make will define how a gigawatt of European compute stores its data.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the storage stack — block, file, object — for training, sandbox, and general compute workloads.

  • Make the build-vs-buy calls: deploy and harden vendor platforms where they win; design and write our own services in Go where they don't.

  • Own the data plane: allocation, duplication, tiering, backup and recovery, S3-compatible APIs.

  • Plan capacity across datacenters and across failure domains — petabytes, not terabytes.

  • Build the team from zero: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own performance and growth paths, and set the standard for ownership.

  • Partner with Product Managers to shape the storage roadmap and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have built storage systems — object, block, or distributed filesystems — not just operated them. You know what happens when a disk dies mid-write and when a rebalance collides with a backup window.

  • Deep distributed-systems fundamentals: durability, consistency, replication, erasure coding, failure domains.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Systems engineers coming from C++ or Rust who are ready to write Go daily should still talk to us.

  • You are comfortable with hardware reality: HDD, SSD, and NVMe tiers, and the economics of each.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Filialleiter / Stellvertretender Filialleiter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mitfahren kann jeder. Du willst vorne fahren?
Dann übernimm bei uns eine Filiale. Du führst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Leuten und kümmerst dich um über 3.000 Artikel. Dazu kommen jede Menge Kunden, die mit dem richtigen Rad nach Hause rollen wollen. Ob du leitest oder erstmal stellvertrittst, finden wir zusammen raus.

Über uns

Wir sind Little John Bikes. Bei uns dreht sich alles ums Rad, vom Stadtflitzer bis zum E-Bike. Wir sind bodenständig, reden Klartext und lachen gern. Und unsere Branche nimmt gerade richtig Fahrt auf.

Was du von uns bekommst

  • Geld, das sich lohnt: hohes Grundgehalt plus Ertragsprovision für deine Leistung und die deiner Crew.
  • Unbefristeter Vertrag. Punkt.
  • 30 Tage Urlaub, ab 55 sogar 32.
  • Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Jedes Jahr.
  • Arbeitszeitkonto: Im Sommer gibst du Gas, im Winter nimmst du dir die Zeit zurück. Über das Jahr passt's.
  • Einarbeitung in einer Patenfiliale. Keiner schmeißt dich ins kalte Wasser.
  • Dein Weg zum Meister: Du bist Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle? Wir fördern dich bis zum Zweiradmechanikermeister.
  • Weiterbildung und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung, damit du als Führungskraft wächst.
  • Echte Perspektive: von der Stellvertretung zur Filialleitung. Und darüber hinaus.
  • 30 % Rabatt für dich, das ganze Jahr.
  • Dienstrad-Leasing. Wär ja auch komisch, wenn nicht.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Empfehlungsprämie: Du holst gute Leute in die Crew, wir sagen Danke.
  • Produkte, die Spaß machen: E-Bikes und hochwertige Räder in einer Branche mit Zukunft.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Leitung oder Stellvertretung? Das klären wir im Gespräch. Du leitest schon eine Filiale? Top. Du warst bisher Stellvertretung oder erfahrener Verkäufer und willst den nächsten Schritt machen? Auch top. Entweder übernimmst du direkt die Leitung, oder du startest als Stellvertretung und wächst rein.

  • Du führst und motivierst deine Crew aus bis zu 8 Mitarbeitenden. Als Filialleitung trägst du die Verantwortung. Als Stellvertretung unterstützt du und springst ein.
  • Du planst die Abläufe, von der Sortimentspflege bis zum Einsatzplan.
  • Du hältst über 3.000 Artikel in Schuss.
  • Du stehst selbst auf der Fläche, berätst Kunden und machst den Deal klar.
  • Du hast die Zahlen im Blick und bringst deine Filiale nach vorn.
  • Du bist da, wenn's mal hakt. Für deine Crew und für die Kunden.

Was du mitbringst

Must-haves

  • Erfahrung im Einzelhandel.
  • Führungserfahrung als Filialleitung oder Stellvertretung. Oder richtig Lust auf deinen ersten Schritt in die Führung.
  • Du behältst den Überblick. Auch im Juli, wenn der Laden brummt.
  • Du redest gern mit Menschen und bringst den Abschluss sicher nach Hause.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und steckst andere mit deiner Energie an.
  • Empathie und eine gesunde Portion Humor. Muss ja.
  • Flexibilität in der Saison.

Nice-to-haves

  • Handelserfahrung aus Fahrrad, Auto, Möbel, Mode oder Schuhe.
  • Fahrradwissen. Hilft, ist aber kein Muss.
  • Werkstatt-Background als Zweiradmechatroniker-Geselle. Einige unserer Filialleiter haben genau so angefangen und machen bei uns ihren Meister.

Klingt nach deinem Ding?

Dann schnapp dir den Lenker und bewirb dich. Kein Anschreiben, kein Bewerbungs-Blabla. Dein Lebenslauf reicht.

Diese Stelle passt auch, wenn du dich als Filialleiter, stellvertretender Filialleiter, Storemanager, stellvertretender Storemanager, Leiter einer Fahrrad- oder Autofiliale, Verkaufsleiter im Fahrradbereich oder als Zweiradmechatroniker mit Führungsambitionen (m/w/d) siehst.
