title: Finance Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe's software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About the Role

This is not a reporting role. It's ownership of the financial engine for a portfolio of growing software businesses.

You'll be accountable end-to-end for the accounting integrity of your portfolio: closing the books accurately, building and leading a team of local finance experts to meet French statutory and regulatory requirements, and making sure every number that reaches Everfield's leadership is right and on time. But the job doesn't stop at accuracy. You'll sit next to Business Unit Leaders as their financial conscience and commercial sparring partner - coaching them on the numbers, challenging their growth plans, and pushing them to allocate resources where they'll actually compound.

Everfield deliberately gives this role more scope than a typical FP&A or controller seat carries at this career stage. You'll run the accounting, build and lead the regional finance team, and shape how each business thinks about growth - the full stack, across multiple companies.

What You'll Do

Own the numbers

• Be accountable for the accuracy and timeliness of monthly reporting (management P&L, KPIs, operating metrics) for each business in your portfolio - not just its preparation.

• Build and manage a team of local financial experts to meet French statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

• Guide each business's finance and accounting team through migration onto Everfield's NetSuite instance.

• Own the accuracy and timeliness of the underlying accounting work behind every number you report.

• Build and defend annual budgets and rolling forecasts, incorporating strategic initiatives and long-term expectations.

• Prepare Quarterly Update Review (QUR) packs for Everfield's CEO, CFO, and COO.

Drive the growth agenda

• Coach Business Unit Leaders on financial acumen - make sure they understand and consistently apply the Everfield ratios, not just report against them.

• Challenge and support Business Unit Leaders in applying Everfield's prescribed revenue system to their business.

• Help each business spot operating efficiencies, report headcount accurately, and manage overhead with intent.

• Partner with Business Unit Leaders on charting expense management and aligning resources toward growth, not just cost control.

• Play an active role in integration of newly acquired businesses - systems, data, and reporting design, alongside the Integration Director and Head of BI.

• Partner with your Strategic Business Partner (SBP) counterpart on the day-to-day relationship with each business in your region.

Who We're Looking For

• An ambitious problem-solver who wants this role to be a stepping stone – experience on the path towards a CFO or Controller of a larger group of companies, or of a larger standalone business.

• Strong technical grounding in accounting practices and controls - you can run a clean close and hold a third-party provider to a standard, not just review their output.

• Commercial instinct to match: you can sit across from a Business Unit Leader and challenge their growth plan, not just report on whether they hit it.

• A completed university education plus a professional finance qualification (CA/ACA/CIMA or equivalent).

• 5+ years in Business Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering.

• Ability to lead and build a team of regional finance specialists.

• Comfort operating in a decentralised, multi-entity, PE-backed environment - you'll manage stakeholders across businesses at very different stages of maturity.

• Fluent in English and French; effective communicator at every level of an organisation, from bookkeeper to CEO.

• Ideally, a background in fast-growing technology or SaaS companies.

• Willingness to travel occasionally.

What We Offer

• Attractive salary package with performance-based bonus.

• Remote flexibility.

• A collaborative team culture based on respect, ownership, and trust.

• Access to international experts within the Everfield ecosystem - accelerate your personal and professional growth.

• Regular team events and company celebrations.

Interview Process

Here's what to expect and who you'll meet during the recruitment process:

• First interview with Talent Acquisition Manager (0.5 h)

• Second interview with Hiring Manager (1.0 h)

• Third interview with Group Finance representatives (1.0 h)

We are an equal opportunity employer and ensure that no applicant is subject to less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, gender identity, marital status, race, colour, nationality, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, responsibilities for dependants, physical or mental disability. Any hiring decision is made based on skills, qualifications and experiences.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Financial Crime Compliance, Senior Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Please only apply using an English CV.

We're hiring for a passionate FinCrime problem solver to join the Financial Crime Compliance team in Paris and help protect the future of real-time payments.

As a Senior Analyst, you will use your expertise in AML and complex onboarding to solve complex challenges in one of the world’s fastest-growing fintech environments. The Financial Crime Compliance team is the engine ensuring we grow safely.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Lead deep-dive investigations into high-risk corporate entities and complex ownership structures (UBOs).

  • SARs/STRs Management: Identify suspicious patterns and draft high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (Déclarations de Soupçon) for submission to TRACFIN.

  • Regulatory Advisory: Act as a subject matter expert on French AML/CFT laws (Monetary and Financial Code) and help the MLRO translate these into scalable operational processes.

  • Transaction Monitoring: Analyze real-time alerts and historical data to identify emerging financial crime trends.

  • Process Optimization: Don't just follow the manual—help write it. You’ll identify gaps in our automated screening and monitoring tools and propose data-driven solutions.

  • Audit & Liaison: Support the MLRO during regulatory onsite inspections or internal audits, providing clear rationales for risk-based decisions.

About you

title: Forward-Deployed CRM Architect
descriptionHtml:
RevOps is changing fast, and so is the way GTM processes get built and maintained inside the CRM. This role puts you on the front edge of it: forward-deployed in our clients' RevOps teams, building and running their GTM systems in a genuinely AI-first environment.

GTMBase is an AI-first GTM engineering and RevOps agency. We help post-PMF B2B companies (€8M to €50M ARR, 5+ reps) whose go-to-market is over-performing their systems. Reps do manually what should be automated, sales and marketing data doesn't connect, and leadership can't trust the reporting.

We combine strategic GTM thinking with hands-on technical build, and we fix the foundation before running campaigns.

We deliver across Four Pillars:

  1. Data Foundation: list building and enrichment so reps win with better data (Clay, Apollo, custom scrapers, AI research)
  2. RevOps & CRM: building the right GTM process inside the client's CRM, including architecture, lifecycle, pipelines, routing, and reporting (HubSpot, Salesforce)
  3. Agentic Workflows: building agentic GTM workflows with Anthropic Managed Agents and Hermes, getting the org ready for Agentic GTM
  4. GTM Strategy & Plays: recommending and executing the highest-impact campaigns

We've done this for clients including Groupon, Blinkist, Booksy, and Sendify. We work in small pods, with a Strategist, a CRM Architect, and a GTM Engineer.

How We Operate

We run the company on Claude Code. It's our operating system: client context, playbooks, automations, and delivery all live in it, and AI is the default way we work rather than a bolt-on. You'll work this way too, and get very good at it.

Why This Role Matters

You're the person who turns our GTM strategy into a CRM that actually works. Most clients run their entire revenue motion on HubSpot or Salesforce, and the quality of that system runs through this role: how clean the data is, how well leads route, whether leadership can trust the reporting.

Here, "Architect" means architecting inside the CRM: the object model, pipelines, workflows, and automations. The GTM and revenue strategy is set with you in your pod, not by you alone, and you build it with real craft.

You're forward-deployed: you embed with clients' RevOps and sales teams and build inside their live CRM.

The Role

You'll build and maintain GTM process and automation inside our clients' CRMs, mostly HubSpot. Working from the direction set in your pod, you turn requirements into a clean, well-built system the sales team can rely on.

One week you're building a client's lead lifecycle and routing. The next you're debugging a broken automation, untangling duplicate deals, or shipping a dashboard a CRO asked for. You move across several client instances at once without dropping threads.

You're a builder with an admin's discipline. You know the object model, not just the UI. You sweat the details others miss, you test before you ship, and you document what you build so the rest of the pod can run it. When something breaks, you find the root cause and fix it properly.

How This Differs From a GTM Engineer

Your pod is you (CRM Architect), a Strategist who sets direction and hands you requirements, and a GTM Engineer. You and the GTM Engineer are both builders, but you own different layers:

  • You (CRM Architect, Pillar 2): the GTM process inside the CRM. HubSpot/Salesforce architecture, lifecycle, routing, deal logic, automation, reporting, data integrity. You live in HubSpot, Salesforce, Operations Hub, and n8n.
  • GTM Engineer (Pillar 1): the data layer. Enrichment, scraping, signal detection, list building, custom research agents. They live in Clay, Apify, custom scrapers, and data APIs.

Think of it as the data into the CRM (GTM Engineer) versus the system it lands in and the process the sales team runs on (you). You don't need to be a Clay or Apify expert. You just need a solid working understanding of what a GTM Engineer does, enough to spec what you need, integrate their output cleanly, and know what's possible.

What You'll Do

  • Architect and build in client HubSpot instances: information architecture (objects, associations, lifecycle stages, pipeline structure), workflows, deal logic, lead scoring, routing, properties, and permissions
  • Build and debug automations across the GTM stack: HubSpot workflows, n8n, APIs, and webhooks. When an automation breaks, you find the root cause rather than just toggling features
  • Guard data integrity: deduplication, field validation, association hygiene, and import discipline so reporting and forecasting can be trusted
  • Build the reporting leadership relies on: pipeline coverage and velocity, stage-by-stage conversion, and full-funnel dashboards. You know where HubSpot's platform and paywall limits force a different approach
  • Design integrations and data flows between HubSpot and the rest of the stack (Clay, Aircall, telephony, billing, enrichment pipelines)
  • Turn requirements into working builds: take a brief like a 15-minute lead-response SLA and ship the routing system that delivers it
  • Keep multiple client instances healthy at once, with fast turnaround and nothing falling through the cracks
  • Work client-facing: you can talk through a data question with a technical lead and walk a frustrated AE through a new flow in the same afternoon
  • Codify what works into our library of reusable plays and patterns, so every client build sharpens the whole team

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Deep HubSpot expertise: hands-on across Sales, Marketing, Service, and Operations Hubs. You know HubSpot well enough to know what is and isn't possible at the platform level, and to choose native functionality over a workaround when it's the right call.
  • Strong CRM and RevOps fundamentals: lead lifecycle and qualification, routing and assignment, pipeline and deal-stage setup, the data model, and the governance that keeps it clean.
  • An admin's discipline: precise, reliable, and detail-obsessed. You test before you ship, you keep data clean, and you don't let things fall through the cracks.
  • A builder's instinct: you build workflows and integrations, debug them when they break, and aren't intimidated by APIs, webhooks, or a tool you haven't used yet.
  • AI-first, and we mean it literally: AI is your default operating mode, not a novelty. Your first move on a problem is to reach for an agent, a prompt, or a workflow before a manual process. If you're not already using AI tools daily, this isn't the right fit. (If your CRM fundamentals are deep but your GTM-tooling experience like Clay or Claude Code is light, that part is learnable and we'll back you on it. The fundamentals and the AI-first instinct are not.)
  • Forward-deployed temperament: comfortable building across multiple clients in parallel, client-facing, proactive, and able to move fast without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Full-time availability with reliable overlap to CET hours.

Nice-to-have

  • Salesforce: admin or build experience, especially HubSpot to Salesforce sync and migrations (relevant to Groupon and enterprise work)
  • A working understanding of the GTM Engineer's toolkit: Clay, Apify, enrichment providers (ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit), scraping. Enough to collaborate, spec, and integrate. Your pod's GTM Engineer owns the deep builds.
  • n8n orchestration and custom API integrations
  • Scripting (Python, SQL, or JavaScript) for data manipulation and custom connectors
  • German: a good chunk of our client base is DACH
  • HubSpot certifications: a plus, never a gate. Demonstrated depth matters more.

What You'll Get

  • Real client build work from day one, with no busy work and no hand-holding
  • A front-row seat in a genuinely AI-first environment: Claude Code as the operating system, Clay, and the full modern GTM stack
  • Direct collaboration with one of the most experienced RevOps leaders in Europe
  • Exposure to a wide range of B2B companies, stacks, and GTM problems
  • A seat at the table in a growing practice, not a cog in a machine

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt.

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Bei uns erwartet dich ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung auf Augenhöhe - ohne Hierarchien.

Für unseren Bereich Forward Deployed Engineering suchen wir dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht empfiehlt, sondern baut, deployt und in Produktion verantwortet.

Was dich erwartet

Forward Deployed heißt bei uns: Du bist Beobachter, Architekt und Entwickler in einer Person. Dieselbe Person, die das Problem beim Kunden versteht, schreibt den Code, der es löst - und bleibt, bis es produktiv läuft.

  • End-to-End-Ownership: Du verantwortest Deployments von der Discovery über technisches Scoping, Architektur und Build bis zum Produktions-Rollout in der Infrastruktur des Kunden - eingebettet in dessen Engineering- und Fachteams.
  • Full-Stack, wörtlich gemeint: Du arbeitest über alle Schichten - Model-Serving (vLLM, eigene GPU-Cluster), Agent-Gateways und Runtimes, RAG-/GraphRAG-Pipelines, spezialisierte Agenten, Integration in ERP, CRM, DMS und Legacy-Systeme.
  • Auf erprobtem Fundament: Du deployst und erweiterst unsere Produkt-Stacks (mAIstack, VoiceAI, Amicable) beim Kunden, statt jedes Projekt bei null zu beginnen – mit LLMs wie GPT, Gemini, Claude oder Nemotron, Agent-Frameworks und agentischen Harnesses. Vector-Datenbanken und RAG sind dabei Handwerkszeug; als Senior sorgst du dafür, dass die Systeme im Betrieb messbar und beherrschbar bleiben – über Dataset-basierte Evaluations, Logging/Tracing und Observability.
  • Der Rückfluss ist Teil des Jobs: Was sich im Feld als wiederkehrendes Muster erweist, kodifizierst du mit deinem Team in unseren Produkten, Skills und Playbooks. Dein Projektwissen bleibt nicht beim Kunden liegen - es macht das nächste Deployment schneller.
  • Kunde auf Augenhöhe: Du entwickelst in Workshops ein gemeinsames Bild von Problem, Chancen und Lösung, triffst Trade-off-Entscheidungen zwischen Scope, Tempo und Qualität - und sprichst auch an, was der Kunde nicht hören will, wenn es das Ergebnis schützt.
  • Sichtbarkeit: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen in Whitepaper, Talks und unsere AI-Produkte ein - mit Unterstützung unserer technischen Redaktion.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Du hast LLM-Systeme in Produktion gebracht - nicht nur prototypisiert: RAG-Implementierungen, Vector Databases, Agent-Frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK o. ä.), Evals und MLOps.
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende, gewachsene Enterprise-Architekturen - inklusive der unbequemen Teile (Auth, Legacy, Compliance).
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Inference-Infrastruktur (vLLM, GPU-Serving), Kubernetes und On-Prem-/Private-Cloud-Deployments.
  • Die Kompetenz, AI-Konzepte Fachbereichen und C-Level anschaulich zu vermitteln - und die Standfestigkeit, Ownership für Entscheidungen zu übernehmen.
  • Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.
  • Bereitschaft, phasenweise beim Kunden vor Ort zu arbeiten (projektabhängig, remote-embedded als Regelfall), plus Workshops und Konferenzen 1–2× im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands.

Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nach Erfahrung und Kompetenz vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.

  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.

title: Forward Deployed Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
As the Forward Deployed Engineering Manager, you will lead the team that puts Auterion's robotic systems to work with customers in the field. We build complete systems: vehicles, sensors, onboard compute, radio links, autonomy software, and ground control. Your job is to understand how all of it fits together and to make it work in real missions.

You will lead your team through the entire customer engagement, from discovery and integration to field trials and handover. You are not a hardware specialist. You are a systems engineer who can trace a problem across every layer of the system, lead people well, and earn the trust of demanding customers.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead and grow a cross-functional team of Forward Deployed Engineers covering systems integration and software. Hire, coach, and develop your engineers. Build a culture of ownership and proactive problem-solving.
  • Accountability: Keep the bar high for yourself and your team. Work directly with stakeholders across the company. You will have a close relationship with the CTO, CEO, VP of Engineering, and the engineering directors.
  • Field Deployment Oversight: Own technical delivery of customer deployments in demanding, non-standard environments. This covers system configuration, connectivity, mission readiness, and operation under environmental constraints.
  • System Integration: Act as the technical lead for high-stakes customer integrations. Ensure the full system works end to end: vehicle, payloads, onboard compute, communication links, autonomy software, and ground control.
  • Field Troubleshooting: Diagnose failures across hardware, firmware, software, and communications. Use logs, telemetry, and structured debugging to find root causes fast.
  • Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary technical contact for defense and enterprise customers. Translate operational requirements into deployment plans that account for system performance, link quality, power, and mission constraints. Run technical meetings, demos, and field days.
  • Feedback Loop & Release Coordination: Work closely with Product and R&D to feed field results and real-world edge cases back into the product. Coordinate with R&D on platform releases so customer deployments stay current and stable.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Systems Engineering: 7+ years in technical roles in robotics, drones, autonomous vehicles, or comparable complex embedded systems. You understand the full system end to end and how a change in one subsystem affects the others.

title: General Legal Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role: First in-house counsel, with full ownership

As General Counsel & Head of Legal Ops, you own the legal function at Andercore: contracts, claims, employment, compliance and tax structuring. You report to the CEO and work with every leadership team member.

We don't want a large legal department. We want a legal setup that moves at the speed of the business. Today, legal runs through external counsel and individual effort. We need an owner who builds the frameworks, templates and playbooks to scale across Germany and Europe.

This is not a back-office role. You sit at the centre of cross-border supply chains, supplier negotiations, customer claims and operational risk. You hold the Syndikusrechtsanwalt designation. You make the function AI-native: language models do the first pass, external counsel handle complex judgment calls, you decide.

What you will do: Build the legal function

01 Commercial contracting

  • Draft, negotiate and close high-value contracts across sales, procurement, logistics and partnerships.

  • Advise Sales, Procurement and Finance on pricing and payment terms.

02 Templates and playbooks

  • Build contract templates, fallback rules and negotiation guidelines that shorten deal cycles.

  • Turn legal risk into clear decisions.

03 Claims and disputes

  • Resolve supplier disputes and customer claims pragmatically and commercially.

  • Quantify the risk in euros.

04 Employment law

  • Support People on hiring, contracts, terminations and restructurings under German law.

  • Draft HR guidelines and internal policies.

05 Compliance, governance, tax

  • Track EU and German regulation on trade, logistics, payments and data.

  • Run governance for our German entities and structure cross-border tax questions.

title: Global Programme Director - Finance Technology
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

As part of WPPs Elevate28 strategy, we are accelerating a major Finance Technology transformation to simplify, modernise and standardise the platforms, data and processes that underpin Global Finance. This portfolio is critical to statutory reporting, management reporting, forecasting, planning, control, performance management, compliance, and executive decision-making. 

The Global Programme Director - Finance Technology will shape, govern and drive WPP’s global Finance Technology transformation portfolio. This senior enterprise leadership role turns a complex, multi-year agenda into a coherent roadmap that simplifies the finance technology estate, strengthens control and resilience, and enables faster, more trusted business insight. 

The role spans Finance ERP standardisation, consolidation platform replacement, enterprise performance management, revenue forecasting, analytics, finance data foundations and operating model change. It will work across Group Finance, Enterprise Technology, agencies, markets, regions and delivery partners to align priorities, secure decisions, manage trade-offs and ensure investment delivers measurable enterprise value. 

This is a director-level role requiring strategic judgement, executive influence, commercial discipline and the ability to create clarity, momentum and delivery confidence across a high-profile transformation portfolio. 

What you'll be doing:

  • Shape and sequence the global Finance ERP roadmap, moving WPP towards fewer platforms, common templates, harmonised controls and reduced process variation
  • Lead the transition from legacy consolidation tooling to a resilient enterprise performance management capability across consolidation, planning, forecasting, reporting and analytics
  • Strengthen delivery confidence, investment discipline and benefits realisation across a high-value portfolio with significant executive visibility and business risk
  • Define the global Finance Technology portfolio vision, investment narrative and multi-year roadmap across Finance ERP, consolidation, enterprise performance management, forecasting, analytics and finance data
  • Translate finance transformation priorities into a clear, sequenced and deliverable portfolio that balances strategic value, delivery capacity, affordability, risk and business disruption
  • Establish strong portfolio governance, investment controls, stage gates, assurance and executive reporting to support timely, evidence-based decisions
  • Lead and orchestrate a portfolio of finance transformation programmes, ensuring clear sponsorship, ownership, outcomes, funding, delivery accountability and benefits realisation
  • Manage portfolio risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, delivery confidence and executive escalations across Finance, Enterprise Technology, data, architecture, security, controls, suppliers, markets and agencies
  • Build trusted relationships with senior Finance, Enterprise Technology, agency, market and regional leaders to align priorities, resolve trade-offs and maintain enterprise momentum
  • Shape business cases, funding recommendations and portfolio choices using clear analysis of cost, benefit, risk, sequencing, control impact and business value
  • Manage system integrators, software vendors and delivery partners against commitments, outcomes, commercial levers and performance expectations
  • Lead and coach programme directors, delivery leads, PMOs and matrixed teams to raise delivery standards, strengthen transparency and build a culture of accountability. 

What you'll need:

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale finance technology, ERP, enterprise performance management or corporate systems transformation in a global organisation. 
  • Proven track record of leading multi-year transformation portfolios with significant budgets, multiple delivery partners, complex governance and senior executive sponsorship. 
  • Strong understanding of finance operating models and core finance capabilities, including ERP, consolidation, planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, analytics, controls and finance data. 
  • Director-level leadership presence, with the credibility to influence C-suite leaders, Finance executives, technology leaders, agencies, markets and external partners. 
  • Strong capability in portfolio governance, investment management, business case development, budget ownership, benefits realisation, assurance, RAID and dependency management. 
  • Commercially confident, with experience managing vendors, system integrators and delivery partners against commitments, outcomes and performance measures. 
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex finance, technology and delivery issues into clear executive insight, decisions and recommendations. 
  • Ability to create clarity in ambiguity, resolve competing priorities and lead matrixed teams across geographies, functions and business units. 
  • Strong understanding of change, adoption, business readiness, service transition, process ownership and operating model embedding. 
  • Resilient, commercially minded and outcome-focused, with high integrity, strong judgement and the confidence to challenge constructively when value, control or delivery confidence is at risk. 

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Graduate AI and Secure Technologies Engineer (2026 start)
descriptionHtml:
Cambridge, UK
UK travel and occasional international travel

Introduction

We’re looking for graduates who are excited by the opportunity to make emerging technologies secure, trustworthy and resilient. You’ll work on real-world engineering challenges across cyber security, artificial intelligence, embedded systems and connected technologies, supporting projects in areas including defence and security, industrial systems and critical national infrastructure.

You’ll need to be curious, willing to learn and comfortable exploring unfamiliar technical problems. In return, we’ll provide the support, mentoring and hands-on experience you need to develop into a confident, well-rounded security engineer working on innovative deep technology.

We’re much more interested in the engineer you can become than the one you are now. We’ll give you the time, support and opportunities to build your security engineering skills and develop the confidence to contribute to challenging client projects. Curiosity, a careful and structured approach to problem solving, and enthusiasm for technology are more important than having experience in every area of cyber security.

Overview

Cambridge Consultants develops deep technology across sensing, communications, embedded systems, artificial intelligence and complex systems. Our Trusted AI and Secure Technologies team helps clients understand, design and demonstrate security and trustworthiness in emerging and connected technologies.

You’ll work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside engineers and specialists in electronics, firmware, software, RF, AI and data science, and systems engineering. Projects can span the full engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concepts and requirements through to implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

Our work includes cyber security, secure-by-design engineering, embedded and connected systems, industrial and critical infrastructure, defence and national security, edge AI, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

Your responsibilities

You’ll work on real client assignments with support and guidance from experienced engineers. You’ll have opportunities to contribute across different stages of the engineering lifecycle and work alongside specialists from across Cambridge Consultants.

You may contribute to projects at different stages of the engineering lifecycle, from early-stage concept development and requirements through to architecture, implementation, verification, deployment and in-service support.

You’ll also have opportunities to interact directly with clients, including requirements discussions, technical workshops, progress updates and delivery, with support from experienced engineers where appropriate.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contributing to threat modelling, attack-surface analysis and security risk assessments.
  • Helping to identify security requirements and develop secure-by-design system architectures.
  • Supporting vulnerability assessments and security testing, including helping to scope testing activities and track remediation.
  • Investigating vulnerabilities and helping teams understand and address security risks.
  • Contributing to security cases, assurance activities and technical documentation.
  • Analysing systems, software and technical designs to identify potential security weaknesses.
  • Developing prototypes, analysis tools or other technical solutions to investigate security problems.
  • Working with multidisciplinary teams to understand the interaction between security, functionality, safety and system performance.
  • Communicating technical findings clearly to engineers, project teams and customers.
Domains and project types

You could work across a range of applications and technologies, including:

  • Critical national infrastructure: energy, transport, communications and utilities.
  • Industrial systems: ICS, SCADA, OT and industrial IoT.
  • Defence and national security: secure systems and technologies supporting demanding operational environments.
  • Emerging technologies: AI assurance, sensing, secure connectivity and post-quantum cryptography.

What you can bring

The below is essential
  • An excellent degree or PhD in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Electronic/Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 months industrial experience, for example through a placement year or relevant postgraduate experience.
  • A good understanding of fundamental engineering, computing or security principles.
  • Practical experience through university, industrial placement, work experience, research or personal projects in at least one or more relevant areas, such as:
    • cyber/security engineering
    • software or application development
    • embedded systems
    • computer or network systems
    • electronics or hardware security
    • AI or data science
    • systems engineering
  • The ability to understand and analyse technical systems and identify risks or weaknesses.
  • Some familiarity with security concepts such as authentication, authorisation, cryptography, key management, secure boot, network security and secure development.
  • The ability to read and understand code in languages such as C, C++, Python or Java.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and developing new technical skills.
  • A careful and structured approach to problem solving.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with others.
The below is advantageous, but isn’t essential
  • Familiarity with threat-modelling approaches such as STRIDE or MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Knowledge of secure development practices and frameworks such as OWASP or CWE.
  • Experience with embedded platforms, MCUs, RTOS, TPMs or TrustZone.
  • Familiarity with industrial protocols and standards such as Modbus, DNP3, OPC UA or IEC 62443.
  • Experience using tools such as Burp Suite, Wireshark or firmware-analysis tools.
  • An understanding of cloud security.
  • Experience considering security alongside safety or other system-level requirements.
  • Security research, university projects, technical projects or open-source contributions.
  • Industry certifications or formal security training.

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check level security clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria.

Along with your CV, please describe why you are attracted to this position, what you feel you offer Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of. We are especially interested to hear about any projects you have done, for a hobby, for work or for university.

title: Graduate Quantitative Researcher 2028 – Expression of Interest
descriptionHtml:
Register your interest below. This is an expression of interest, not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process.

Looking to start full-time in 2027? Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open. Apply here.

If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.

Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your onboarding 

You’ll participate in Global Optiver Academy, a structured onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams. As part of your onboarding, you'll gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business. 

Your responsibilities 

Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:

  • Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.
  • Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.
  • Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.
  • Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.
  • Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. In return, we'll give you the freedom to pursue your ideas and implement them right into our production systems. 

In terms of skills and qualifications, we're looking for:

  • An academic degree in Engineering, Physics, Maths, Econometrics, Computer science or equivalent, with outstanding academic achievements
  • Programming experience in any language (preferably Python, but C, C++, Basic, JAVA, etc. are also a plus)
  • Ability to apply concepts of probability, calculus and linear algebra
  • Competitive attitude and eagerness to constantly improve
  • Ability to learn quickly
  • Excellent verbal and written English language skills

WHAT YOU’LL GET

You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Motivated by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high-performing environment alongside talent colleagues, working collaboratively to tackle the toughest problems in the financial markets.

In addition, you’ll receive:

  • A performance-based bonus structure, enabling all of our employees to benefit from our global profit pool
  • The opportunity to work alongside best-in-class professionals from over 50 countries
  • 25 paid vacation days in your first year, increasing to 30 from your second year onwards
  • Training opportunities, discounts on health benefits, and fully paid first-class commuting expenses
  • Extensive office perks, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, world-class barista coffee, bi-weekly chair massages, Friday afternoon drinks, a bicycle to explore Amsterdam and much more
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities, including access to conferences and tech events
  • Competitive relocation packages and visa sponsorship where necessary for expats

HOW TO REGISTER

Are you interested in furthering your career on one of the most dynamic and exciting trading floors in Europe?

Complete the short form below with your details and upload your CV in English. Registering your interest is not a job application, and it does not start an assessment process. We'll contact you when we have opportunities that match your profile.

Kindly note that we do not require any assistance from third-parties including agencies in the recruitment of this role. If you have any questions feel free to contact our Recruitment team via our recruitment inquiry form.

descriptionHtml:
Verwaltungsdigitalisierung. Digitale Souveränität. Ökosysteme.

Über die govdigital

Die govdigital eG ist die Genossenschaft der IT-Dienstleister der öffentlichen Hand. Ihre Mitglieder sind ausschließlich öffentliche IT-Dienstleister von Bund, Ländern und Kommunen. Zweck der Genossenschaft ist es, die Digitalisierung der Verwaltung in Deutschland durch ebenenübergreifende Kooperation entscheidend voranzubringen – durch die Bündelung von Kompetenzen und Bedarfen ihrer Mitglieder, durch gemeinsame Beschaffungen sowie durch den Aufbau und Betrieb gemeinsamer digitaler Plattformen. Schwerpunktthemen sind Cloud, Cybersicherheit und Künstliche Intelligenz.

Als inhousefähige Gesellschaft der öffentlichen Hand nimmt govdigital eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle bei der Verwaltungsdigitalisierung in Deutschland ein und agiert an der Schnittstelle von Bund, Ländern, Kommunen, öffentlichen IT-Dienstleistern und Digitalwirtschaft. Die Genossenschaft wächst dynamisch – in Mitgliederzahl, Leistungsportfolio und strategischer Bedeutung.

Mit einem Jahresumsatz von über 80 Millionen Euro, rund 40 Mitarbeitenden und der Verantwortung für zahlreiche komplexe IT-Projekte stellt die govdigital hohe Anforderungen an ihr Führungsteam. Weitere Informationen zur govdigital eG finden Sie unter www.govdigital.de.

Die Position

Zum Ausbau des Führungsteams und zur Verstärkung des Vorstands suchen wir eine zweite hauptamtliche Vorständin bzw. einen zweiten hauptamtlichen Vorstand. Sie leiten die Genossenschaft gemeinsam mit dem hauptamtlichen Vorstandsvorsitzenden sowie zwei nebenamtlichen Vorstandsmitgliedern und gestalten die weitere Entwicklung der govdigital in einer Phase wachsender Verantwortung maßgeblich mit.

  • die gemeinsame strategische und operative Leitung der Genossenschaft im Vorstandsteam; die Verteilung der Ressorts erfolgt im Vorstand einvernehmlich entsprechend den Kompetenzprofilen,

  • die vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit den Mitgliedern, dem Aufsichtsrat und der Generalversammlung,

  • die Vertretung der Genossenschaft gegenüber Partnern in Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Politik und Öffentlichkeit,

  • die Steuerung strategischer Projekte und Kooperationen sowie die Sicherstellung von Wirtschaftlichkeit, Recht- und Ordnungsmäßigkeit und Compliance.

  • abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium der Wirtschafts-, Verwaltungs- oder Rechtswissenschaften, der Informatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung,

  • langjährige Berufs- und Führungserfahrung in der Verwaltungsdigitalisierung – innerhalb oder außerhalb des öffentlichen Dienstes, verbunden mit sehr guten Kenntnissen des öffentlichen Sektors in Deutschland,

  • nachgewiesene Erfahrungen in der Markt- und Geschäftsentwicklung,

  • belastbare Netzwerke in Verwaltung, öffentlicher IT und Digitalwirtschaft auf Bundes-, Landes- und/oder kommunaler Ebene sowie Vertrautheit mit den Strukturen der föderalen IT-Kooperation,

  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Gremien,

  • ausgeprägte strategische, kommunikative und integrative Fähigkeiten sowie Freude daran, unterschiedliche Interessen zu gemeinsamen Lösungen zusammenzuführen,

  • den Willen und die Bereitschaft, die Verwaltungsdigitalisierung in Deutschland durch die Weiterentwicklung und optimale Ausgestaltung der Kooperation der öffentlichen ITDienstleister voranzubringen.

Rahmenbedingungen

Data is becoming increasingly central to how we build the product, understand our users and make decisions. We are looking for a Head of Data to own the function end to end and build the foundations required for the next stage of BeReal's growth.

 

Role

You will lead a team of Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers and Data Analysts, reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. BeReal deliberately operates with small, strong teams, and we are looking for someone who can define the direction while still going deep technically: reviewing architecture and data models, investigating quality issues, challenging pipelines, writing queries and building when necessary.

You should be the kind of leader who could design a modern data platform from scratch, scale it as the company grows, and make sure the people using it can trust what comes out of it.

 

What you'll own

  • Build and evolve the data platform. Own BeReal's data architecture end to end: ingestion, storage, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability and access. Build a platform that is simple, scalable, reliable and cost-efficient as both traffic and the number of data consumers grow.

  • Make data trustworthy. Raise the standard of data quality across the company through clear sources of truth, ownership, testing, monitoring, lineage and consistent metric definitions. Identify inconsistencies proactively and build systems that prevent them from recurring.

  • Data modeling and foundations. Define how our core entities, events and business concepts are represented across the warehouse. Build models that are reliable, understandable and maintainable as the product evolves.

  • Decisions, not dashboards. Turn large, complex user-level datasets into clear insights and recommendations that Product, Growth and leadership can act on. Help teams distinguish meaningful signals from noise and focus on the questions that matter.

  • Product analytics and experimentation. Own the methodology around instrumentation, Amplitude usage, event tracking, metric design and A/B testing. Ensure experiments are designed and interpreted rigorously and that product decisions are grounded in reliable data.

  • Make data self-service. Give Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership the tools and models they need to answer most questions independently, without creating a dependency on the Data team for every request.

  • AI-powered data access. Build or integrate practical ways for employees to interact with company data through AI (agents, bots, natural-language analytics and automated workflows) while maintaining strong standards around accuracy, permissions and governance.

  • Stakeholder management and prioritisation. Serve as the primary data partner to C-level executives and teams across Product, Growth and Engineering. Understand their needs, challenge requests when necessary, arbitrate between competing priorities and translate them into a coherent, high-impact data roadmap.

  • Technical leadership. Set strong engineering and analytics standards across the function. Review architecture, pipelines, models and queries, challenge technical choices and remain close enough to the work to intervene directly when needed.

  • Build the team. Lead, mentor and hire across Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering and Data Analytics. Establish clear ownership, develop the people in the team and raise the technical and analytical bar.

     

Our Data Stack

  • Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Spanner.

  • Orchestration & transformation: Airflow, dbt.

  • Product analytics: Amplitude.

  • Visualisation & analytics: Hex, Tableau, internal tools.

This is our current stack, not a constraint. You will have significant latitude to simplify, rationalise and evolve it when there is a strong reason to do so.

 

Profile

  • 8+ years in data, with deep roots in Data or Analytics Engineering, or data architecture.

  • A hands-on builder: you’ve designed, built and run modern data platforms, ideally from scratch, and know how architecture evolves with scale.

  • Strong across the stack (warehousing, ingestion, orchestration, transformation, modeling, observability), with strong SQL and enough depth to challenge production pipelines and models.

  • Deep data quality expertise: testing, monitoring, lineage, ownership and source-of-truth design.

  • Experience with high-volume, user-level data and with building self-service analytics for non-data teams.

  • Solid in experimentation and A/B testing. Mobile experience is a plus.

  • Hands-on with AI in data workflows (LLMs, agents, natural-language analytics), and a clear view of where it really adds value.

  • Strong stakeholder management and business judgment: you turn vague needs from Product, Growth, Engineering and leadership into clear metrics and a roadmap.

  • You’ve led data people or are ready to own a multidisciplinary team. This can be your first Head of Data role.

  • You ship fast, favour ownership and pragmatism over process, and explain complex topics clearly to anyone, founders included.

  • English is our working language. French is a plus.

 

Experience with Data Science or production Machine Learning is valuable but not a prerequisite for the role.

 

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience.

  • Swile lunch vouchers.

  • Gymlib, 100% covered by Voodoo.

  • Premium SideCare healthcare coverage for you and your family, 100% covered by Voodoo.

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office.

title: Head of Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Supply Chain to take ownership of how Lumai sources, manages and receives the components that go into our systems. As we move from prototypes to multi-node system deployments and towards our next-generation product, the volume and complexity of what we buy is growing quickly. You will take this work on from our engineering team, allowing them to focus on design and development. In the near term, you will be responsible for sourcing and delivering the components for a major system deployment, working closely with engineering to keep it on schedule and within budget. Alongside this, you will build the supplier relationships, parts management and processes that Lumai will need as it moves towards production.

This is an early role in a growing operations function. You will report into operations leadership, and there is a clear opportunity for the role to grow into a more strategic position as Lumai scales.

What You Will Do

Sourcing and delivery

  • Take ownership of the sourcing of the bill of materials for current system builds, working with engineering to confirm requirements and what is still to be sourced

  • Identify long-lead and single-source items, and put mitigation plans in place

  • Obtain quotes, place and expedite purchase orders, and track deliveries against project plans

  • Work within Lumai's procurement and finance processes

  • Track materials spend against project budgets

Supplier development

  • Identify, assess and qualify suppliers across electronics, PCBs, mechanical parts, contract manufacturing and assembly, and optical components

  • Develop sourcing strategy for future products – single versus dual sourcing, and supplier risk

  • Negotiate pricing, NDAs and supply agreements, working with legal

  • Secure capacity and allocation for constrained parts ahead of volume

  • Build cost models that inform product costing and cost reduction

  • Support new product introduction as designs move from prototype to production

Parts, BoM and lifecycle management

  • Establish Lumai's parts and BoM management process – part numbering, approved manufacturer and supplier lists, and revision and change control – with engineering

  • Introduce a preferred parts list and influence component selection early in design to reduce supply and obsolescence risk

  • Monitor product change and end-of-life notices, and manage the response – last-time buys, qualifying alternates, and flagging redesign needs

  • Maintain a view of supply risk across the BoM

Logistics, stores and quality

  • Manage inbound and outbound logistics, import and customs, and support export control requirements on outbound shipments

  • Set up goods-in, incoming inspection, stores and inventory control appropriate to Lumai's stage

  • Select and run lightweight tools for parts, BoM and inventory management that will scale with the company

  • Define supplier quality expectations, track supplier performance, and manage non-conformances and returns

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

  • At least three years' experience in supply chain, procurement or operations within a hardware company – such as electronics, semiconductors or data centre systems

  • Hands-on experience sourcing components, from quotation through to delivery

  • Practical experience of BoM management, part lifecycle and component obsolescence

  • Experience setting up or improving supply chain processes and tools

  • Confident negotiating with suppliers and building long-term supplier relationships

  • Comfortable doing transactional work day to day while building strategy and process for the longer term

  • Able to work closely with engineers and understand technical specifications

Desirable

  • Experience taking hardware from prototype to production, including working with contract manufacturers

  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment

  • Knowledge of optical, photonic or optoelectronic components

  • Familiarity with import, customs and export control processes

  • Experience with ERP, PLM or inventory management systems

About Lumai

Lumai is the optical compute company building the next generation of AI infrastructure. Spun out of optics research at the University of Oxford in 2021, we compute with light instead of electrons. Our 3D optical technology carries out the matrix multiplications at the heart of AI inside beams of light travelling through free space, which lets it go beyond the limits of both silicon GPUs and integrated photonics.

In April 2026 we launched the world's first optical computing system to run billion-parameter large language models in real time. Our first optical computing server is now available for evaluation by hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises and research institutions.

Our work won the Falling Walls Award for Science Breakthrough of the Year 2025 and 'Best Overall Technology' at the OCP Future Technologies Symposium. We are headquartered in Oxford.

Why Lumai

You'll work on a new kind of computer. Optical computing for AI has been promised for decades. We have a working system running real models, and the hard part left is taking it to volume.

Your work ships. We are moving from first product to volume production, so what you build this year goes into the servers our customers run.

You'll work across disciplines. Optical engineers, machine learning researchers, and hardware and software engineers solve problems together. You will learn things that don't appear on your job description.

The work matters beyond Lumai. AI's appetite for energy is one of the defining constraints of the next decade. Our mission is sustainable intelligence at global scale: AI that is faster, cheaper to run and far less power-hungry.

You'll join early. You'll have a real say in how we build the product, the team and the way we work.

Equal Opportunity

Lumai is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need an adjustment at any stage of the hiring process, let us know and we will do our best to support you.

title: HR Manager Onderwijs
descriptionHtml:
Deze HR functie combineert inhoudelijk advies met coördinatie en verantwoordelijkheid. Als HR adviseur Onderwijs bij Lyceo krijg je de ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken én een bredere rol binnen het team te pakken. Je ondersteunt leidinggevenden, begeleidt verzuimtrajecten, verbetert HR processen en coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris. Een veelzijdige volgende stap voor een ervaren HR professional die inhoudelijk sterk is en al ervaring heeft met het begeleiden, coördineren of aansturen van collega's.

Taken

Als HR adviseur Onderwijs ondersteun je leidinggevenden bij personele vraagstukken, begeleid je verzuimtrajecten en denk je mee over beleid en organisatieontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd zorg je voor overzicht en samenhang binnen het team HR en Salaris. Je coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team en bent verantwoordelijk voor recruitment, waarbij je ook de recruiter begeleidt en aanstuurt.

Je blijft nadrukkelijk zelf actief in de dagelijkse HR praktijk. De ene dag begeleid je een leidinggevende bij een complex verzuimdossier, de andere dag stem je prioriteiten binnen het team af, bespreek je de voortgang van recruitment of werk je aan nieuw HR beleid. Zo verbind je HR beleid, processen en de dagelijkse praktijk met elkaar. Je kent de dynamiek van de organisatie, weet wat er op de verschillende vestigingen speelt en zorgt ervoor dat het team effectief inspeelt op wat de organisatie nodig heeft.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • adviseren van leidinggevenden en management over HR en organisatievraagstukken;
  • begeleiden van verzuimtrajecten, waaronder complexe en langdurige dossiers;
  • ontwikkelen, implementeren en evalueren van HR-beleid en optimaliseren en borgen van HR-processen;
  • coördineren van de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris, inclusief recruitment, en het begeleiden en aansturen van collega's binnen het team;
  • goed gevoel voor relevante wet en regelgeving rond arbeidsrecht, verzuim en beloning, en het vermogen om tijdig juridische of fiscale aandachtspunten te signaleren.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je bent een stevige HR professional die zelfstandig werkt, overzicht houdt en gemakkelijk schakelt tussen verschillende gesprekspartners. Je voelt je prettig in een rol waarin je adviseert, zaken voor elkaar krijgt en collega's begeleidt. Daarbij combineer je een proactieve, praktische en resultaatgerichte instelling met een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • hbo werk- en denkniveau en een afgeronde HR-gerelateerde opleiding;
  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als HR adviseur;
  • voldoende kennis van arbeidsrecht, de Wet verbetering poortwachter en fiscaliteit rond beloningssystematiek;
  • ervaring met verzuimtrajecten;
  • affiniteit met het ontwikkelen van beleid en het verbeteren van processen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, op tien minuten lopen van Leiden Centraal. Dankzij deze centrale ligging is het kantoor uitstekend bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer. Vanuit Leiden werk je nauw samen met leidinggevenden, management en jouw directe HR-collega’s. De functie biedt daarmee een centrale uitvalsbasis voor jouw werk binnen de organisatie.

Benefits

Als gedreven HR adviseur kun jij rekenen op:

Veel ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen bij een organisatie met korte lijnen, waar goede ideeën snel besproken én uitgevoerd kunnen worden. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerken, kennis delen en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Ook krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week
  • 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen;

  • toegang tot de Lyceo Academie;

  • leuke activiteiten via personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is marktleider in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met huiswerkbegeleiding, examentrainingen, bijspijkertrajecten en andere onderwijsprogramma’s. Samen met scholen zorgt Lyceo ervoor dat iedere leerling de kans krijgt om het beste uit zichzelf te halen.

Achter deze maatschappelijke missie staat een informele, ambitieuze en snel ontwikkelende organisatie. Korte lijnen, eigenaarschap en initiatief staan centraal. Goede ideeën krijgen de ruimte en beslissingen worden snel genomen. Je werkt binnen een hecht HR-team van twee HR adviseurs, twee HR officers en een Recruiter.

title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

Vieles davon ist öffentlich sichtbar: unsere Cases, unsere Creatives, unsere Tools. Schau dir das an und sag uns, wo du andocken würdest und was dadurch bei uns besser wird.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast dir admkrs angeschaut und kannst in drei Sätzen sagen, warum wir und nicht irgendeine Agentur.
  • Du hast ein Fachgebiet, in dem du richtig gut bist: Performance Marketing, Creative und Design, Video und Motion, Strategie oder Entwicklung.
  • Du zeigst Arbeit statt Buzzwords. Ein Link zu Projekten, Creatives, Code oder Kampagnen sagt uns mehr als jedes Anschreiben.
  • Du lebst in München oder bist gerade dabei, hierher zu ziehen. Wir arbeiten zusammen im Office am Gärtnerplatz, dafür muss dein Lebensmittelpunkt hier sein.

Warum wir?

  • Kurze Wege: Strategie, Design, Video und Performance sitzen an einem Tisch, Feedback kommt in Minuten statt in Tagen.
  • Kreative kennen die Zahlen, Media Buyer die Ideen. Wir entwickeln Arbeit gemeinsam weiter.
  • Eigene Technologie: Unser Entwicklerteam baut Tools, KI-Skills und Schnittstellen für den Alltag. Was fehlt, bauen wir selbst.
  • Ein Office, in das man gern kommt, mitten in München.

Darauf schauen wir

Wir lesen jede Bewerbung, die hier ankommt, und du bekommst in jedem Fall eine Antwort. Entscheidend sind drei Dinge: ein konkreter Grund für admkrs, sichtbare Arbeit und eine Vorstellung davon, welche Rolle du bei uns ausfüllen willst. Eine allgemeine Bewerbung ohne Bezug zu uns hat hier keine Chance. Das ist nicht unfreundlich gemeint, es spart uns beiden Zeit.

Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Im Bewerbungsformular fragen wir, warum admkrs und warum du, in welchem Bereich du dich siehst und wo wir deine Arbeit sehen können. Wenn du dich über ein anderes Portal bewirbst, schreib diese Angaben bitte in deine Nachricht oder deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit für die Antwort, das kann ein paar Tage dauern.
