title: Interim Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
About Ultralytics:

At Ultralytics, we commit to relentless innovation in the AI space and seek team members who resonate with our ambition to produce the world's best YOLO AI models. If you're obsessed with AI, eager to make an impact on the world, and thrive in dynamic, high-intensity environments, we invite you to apply for a position on our team.

🌍 Join the team powering the future of vision AI
Hello, hola, 你好, こんにちは, नमस्ते, hallo, bonjour! Thanks for stopping by — we know your time is valuable, so here's what makes Ultralytics special.

⚡ Who we are
At Ultralytics, we're on a mission to simplify AI for everyone. As the creators of the world's leading open-source Ultralytics YOLO models, we empower millions of developers, researchers, and companies worldwide to build state-of-the-art computer vision applications.

Following our $30M Series A round, we're expanding rapidly across our global hubs in London, Madrid, and Shenzhen. Our Ultralytics Platform brings data, annotation, training, deployment, and monitoring together for vision AI teams.

We move fast. We build boldly. We execute with purpose. And we do it together.

💼 About the role
As Financial Controller, you'll own day-to-day accounting and reporting for a nine-month fixed-term cover. You'll run the monthly finance cycle end to end across our US, UK, and Spain entities, keeping accounting complete, accurate, and on schedule.

You'll join a small finance team, working hands-on from day one and directly with senior leadership. Your work will give the finance lead capacity to focus on the year-end audit and ERP change, while you support audit readiness, fundraising preparation, and the transition to a new system.

This role suits an experienced, qualified accountant who can quickly take ownership, work independently with a limited handover, and bring care and clarity to a growing global business.

🚀 What you'll do
Month-end close and reporting

  • Run the US, UK, and Spain month-end close, including journals, accruals, prepayments, and balance sheet reconciliations.

  • Prepare multi-currency group consolidation and monthly management accounts with clear variance commentary.

  • Complete bank reconciliations and maintain weekly cash positions and forecasts.

  • Provide accurate, timely figures for investor and board reporting.

  • Maintain the close checklist, audit-ready support files, SaaS revenue recognition, and deferred revenue schedules.

  • Reconcile intercompany balances and recharges across entities.


Payroll and daily finance operations

  • Run US payroll through Gusto and UK and Spain payroll through PayFit; reconcile payroll to the general ledger and resolve queries.

  • Process supplier invoices and scheduled payments, following approval limits and dual-authorization controls.

  • Reconcile supplier statements, support customer invoicing and credit control, and follow up overdue invoices.

  • Onboard suppliers, verify bank details, and answer finance questions from new starters and other teams.

  • Coordinate with tax advisors on timely US, UK, and Spain filings, and document finance processes and controls.


Audit, fundraising, and ERP support

  • Prepare audit files, lead schedules, and reconciliations; respond promptly to auditor requests and sample queries.

  • Support statutory accounts and adjustments ahead of year-end audit fieldwork, mainly in Q1 2027.

  • Partner with the Head of Finance on Series B fundraising readiness.

  • Support the QuickBooks-to-AI-native ERP change through data cleansing, migration, chart-of-accounts mapping, UAT, and parallel runs.

  • Document new processes and support the team through go-live.


🧠 Skills and experience
Core requirements

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, or CIMA) with at least three years running month-end close and management accounts.

  • Experience with multi-currency accounting and multi-entity consolidation.

  • Hands-on payroll and accounts payable experience.

  • Experience preparing for and supporting an external audit.

  • Able to start quickly, work independently with limited handover, and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders.

  • Right to work in the UK.


Nice to have

  • ERP implementation or migration experience, including data migration, chart-of-accounts mapping, or UAT.

  • Experience in a fast-growing technology or SaaS company, or in interim and maternity cover roles.

  • Familiarity with QuickBooks, Gusto, or PayFit.

  • Working knowledge of US and Spanish accounting and payroll requirements alongside UK requirements.

  • Interest in our YOLO models, guides, or community.


🌟 Cultural fit
At Ultralytics, we set bold goals and execute with speed, precision, and teamwork. We're driven by hard work, ambition, and resilience — building fast, learning constantly, and delivering measurable impact.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • Take ownership and deliver results with focus and accountability.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

  • Value excellence, grit, and creativity in equal measure.

  • See collaboration as the foundation for meaningful progress.


Our culture is built around our core values:

  • Relentless progress: Constant evolution and improvement.

  • Strive for excellence: Perseverance and attention to detail.

  • Actions, not words: Focus on delivering meaningful results.

  • Act with urgency: Seize fleeting opportunities.

  • Open access to all: Transparent communication and collaboration.


Learn more in our Ultralytics Handbook.

💰 Compensation and benefits
We reward excellence and impact — not just tenure or title.

  • Competitive salary: Reflecting your experience and contribution.

  • On-site collaboration: Work with passionate builders in one of our global hubs.

  • Flexible working hours: We value results over routines.

  • Generous time off: 24 vacation days, your birthday off, plus local holidays.

  • Tech & tools: Work on cutting-edge AI projects that power millions of devices.

  • Gear: Brand-new Apple MacBook Air/Pro, Apple Studio Display, and AirPods Pro 3.

  • Learning & development: Dedicated budget for personal and professional growth.

  • High impact: Your work will help power the future of vision AI.


👉 Check out ultralytics.com/careers for more about our culture, values, and teams.

🌎 Where and how you can work
We believe great work happens where passion meets purpose.

  • This role is on-site at our London hub.

  • Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country of application.


We're an in-office team that values daily collaboration, energy, and connection. Being together helps us move faster, learn from one another, and celebrate wins as they happen.

🚀 Why join us
We're not just building models — we're building the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI. If you're ready to build, move fast, and make an impact — this is your moment.

⚡ Ready to build the ecosystem powering the future of vision AI? Apply now.

What we offer:

Cutting-Edge, Next-Generation AI Computer Vision Technology: Contribute to building cutting-edge computer vision AI models based on the YOLO framework.

Impactful Work: Shape the future of AI-powered solutions that transform industries.

Collaborative Culture: Join a talented and passionate team that values open communication and innovation.

Comprehensive guide to our company's mission, vision, values, and operational practices. This handbook is designed to provide key insights and resources for our (future) team members, collaborators, and community to align with Ultralytics' core principles.

Link: https://handbook.ultralytics.com/

title: Interviewer / Fahrgastzähler (w/m/d) - Minijob
descriptionHtml:
Die ISUP GmbH ist ein in Dresden ansässiges und seit 35 Jahren umfassend im Verkehrssektor tätiges Ingenieurbüro. Im Bereich der empirischen Mobilitätsforschung führen wir deutschlandweit Verkehrserhebungen im Personennahverkehr durch. Diese bieten den Auftraggebern aktuelle Informationen über die tatsächliche Verkehrsnachfrage (zeitliche und räumliche Nutzung) und dienen u. a. als Aufteilungsschlüssel der Fahrgeldeinnahmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir SIE.

Aufgaben

Als Verkehrserheber*in fahren Sie auf ausgewählten Strecken im Dieselnetz Niedersachsen-Südost jeweils ab Dannenberg Ost im Zug mit, zählen die Ein- und Aussteiger sowie die mitfahrenden Fahrgäste und befragen diese nach Fahrschein und Fahrtverlauf (keine Kontrollfunktion). Die hierbei ermittelten Daten werden per Erfassungsgerät aufgenommen und nach Abschluss des Einsatzes per WLAN übertragen.

Die Erfassung der Daten erfolgt mit zur Verfügung gestellten Smartphones. Die Nutzung priv. Erfassungsgeräte ist nach Absprache möglich und wird mit einer Aufwandsentschädigung vergütet.

Die Verkehrserhebung "DINSO 2027" wird unter anderem auf folgenden Strecken durchgeführt:

  • RB 32 Lüneburg - Dannenberg Ost

  • RB 47 Uelzen - Gifhorn - Braunschweig Hbf.

Weitere Informationen finden Sie auch auf unserer Homepage.

Qualifikation

Sie haben:

  • das 18. Lebensjahr vollendet

sind:

  • aufgeschlossen, kommunikativ, pünktlich, zuverlässig und freundlich

und verfügen über:

  • die Möglichkeit auch Einsätze in Randzeiten zu übernehmen

  • sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse (B2 und höher)

  • ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild und höfliche Umgangsformen

  • grundlegende Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Smartphone sowie MS Office (Excel-Tabellen)

  • Zugang zum WLAN und eigene E-Mail-Adresse

  • eigenen PKW (nicht Bedingung, aber von Vorteil)

Ihr Wohnort befindet sich

  • möglichst in Dannenberg oder der näheren Umgebung

Benefits

Ihre Einsätze erfolgen flexibel nach Ihrer Verfügbarkeit (freie Auswahl bezüglich Einsatzzeit und -ort aus einer Vergabeliste). Die Einsätze werden fahrplanabhängig in den Betriebszeiten der jeweiligen Verkehrsunternehmen stattfinden. Die Dauer eines Einsatzes beträgt zwischen ca. 3,0 und ca. 4,0 Stunden. Der Startbahnhof ist in der Regel auch der Endbahnhof.

Pausen und Umstiegszeiten innerhalb eines Einsatzes werden voll bezahlt!

Im Vorfeld erhalten Sie von unseren Mitarbeitern eine kostenfreie Schulung/Einweisung im Untersuchungsgebiet, in welcher Ihnen die Arbeitsaufgaben, die Organisation sowie der Umgang mit der Erhebungs-App und den möglichen Fahrausweisen und Tarifen erklärt werden.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: iOS Engineer - Design System
descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide.

title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy. Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house. La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave.

Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business.

Principali responsabilità:

  • sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365, con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale
  • supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti
  • partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali, contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business
  • seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico, collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale
  • garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni


Requisiti richiesti:

  • conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps
  • competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python, e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne
  • conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati, con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali
  • capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici


Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali:

  • laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente
  • esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365
  • esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
  • familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
  • esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
  • approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
  • capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi


Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on, autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo.

In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso.

title: IT Support Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

 

Your Role

As IT support specialist, you will be the primary point of contact for day-to-day IT support across our Berlin and Darmstadt offices, keeping employees connected, equipped, and secure so they can focus on building fusion technology. You will own the full IT support lifecycle at both sites, from ticket resolution and device management to onboarding and security compliance.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the device lifecycle for Windows and macOS endpoints: imaging, configuration, inventory tracking, and patching.

  • Prioritise and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues across Berlin and Darmstadt, proactively and independently.

  • Execute onboarding and offboarding IT tasks, including accounts, access provisioning, device readiness, and timely revocation, in close coordination with People Operations.

  • Enforce the security baseline by ensuring MFA coverage, completing access reviews, and maintaining patch compliance under IT security policy and GDPR.

  • Keep IT documentation and self-service FAQs current, and identify recurring issues with proposed root-cause fixes.

  • Support improvement projects such as cloud device management migration, DLP implementation, and EDR rollout, and escalate scope or security issues early to the Senior IT Manager.

Who You Are

  • You have solid IT support fundamentals in hardware, software, networking, and endpoint security, with hands-on experience in both Windows and macOS.

  • You are experienced with Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint) and an MDM platform such as Intune.

  • You understand identity and access management and MFA solutions, and you work confidently in ticketing systems such as Jira, Confluence, or Box.

  • You have working knowledge of GDPR as it applies to IT operations in Germany and follow ITIL-aligned practices for incident and request management.

  • You have basic scripting skills (PowerShell or similar) and a root-cause mindset that favours proactive maintenance over firefighting.

  • You take ownership without waiting to be asked, follow up without prompting, and communicate fluently in German and English.

 

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

title: Junior Electrical Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production. You’ll work closely with Embedded Software, Mechanical Engineering, Software and the Production team. As Filics moves from prototypes to series production, your designs need to work reliably at scale, not just in the lab.

What you’ll do

  • Take full ownership of a complex PCB project and get it running in as few revisions as possible

  • Design high-power and high-speed circuits and make sure they work together at system level

  • Design for EMC, manufacturability and testability, and take boards through EMC testing and certification

  • Bring new technical approaches to the team, for example a new converter architecture that enables higher charging power in a smaller package

  • Introduce useful processes from your experience, such as simulation workflows that validate a layout before it goes to production

  • Help with board bring-up and debugging together with Embedded Software, and support Production with clear documentation and training

  • Take over ownership of existing boards so the team shares responsibility

About you

  • Several years designing electronics in an R&D environment at a smaller hardware company driven by innovation (e.g. robotics, e-mobility, aviation, autonomous vehicles, motion control)

  • A proven record of taking PCBs within a larger system from requirements to a validated product

  • Strong skills in schematic design and PCB layout (Altium, KiCad, OrCAD or similar)

  • Hands-on debugging experience with an oscilloscope, logic analyzer, VNA or spectrum analyzer, plus soldering

  • Experience with designs that went through EMC testing or CE certification

  • An innovator’s mindset: you have built something new or significantly improved an existing concept

  • Basic simulation know-how (e.g. LTspice, ANSYS, thermal/EM/tolerance analysis); deeper experience is a strong plus

  • Basic experience with Linux and embedded software

  • You work independently, take ownership and thrive without rigid structures

What Filics offers

  • Real ownership of your designs, from first draft to series production

  • Space to innovate and a wide range of technical challenges, from power electronics to high-speed design

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across disciplines

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

title: Junior Go Backend Developer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

To solve this, the team has built a Real-Time Bidding platform of 20+ Go microservices that orchestrate ad auctions at 1,500 bid requests per second, integrate with external demand partners via OpenRTB, and connect to ML models making 50 billion predictions daily across 600+ features to optimize bid pricing. The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Golang Backend Foundation: You have a Computer Science degree (or related field) and hands-on experience writing Golang. You will use this foundation to contribute directly to our production backend services from day one at adjoe, rather than writing isolated or throwaway code.

  • Proven Project Portfolio: We look for engineers with tangible projects to show, not just coursework. You will leverage the architectural lessons from your past builds—what worked, why you built it, and what you would change—to design and scale our live systems.

  • Modern Infrastructure Stack: You are comfortable working with REST APIs, version control via Git, and CI/CD pipelines. You will use these core tools, along with your familiarity in cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure, to reliably deploy your code into our environments.

  • Iterative Code Ownership: You will work alongside experienced engineers who will rigorously review your pull requests. We need someone who parses technical feedback directly and uses it to continuously refine their system design and coding standards.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Key Account Executive - UK
descriptionHtml:
As Marqeta’s Key Account Executive based in London, you will be passionate about scaling the success of our business in Europe. This exciting role is ideal for individuals seeking to go deep in all aspects of complex business and technical engagements and will span multiple areas of development:

(1) Cultivating and managing relationships with executives seeking to innovate and disrupt B2B & consumer payments;

(2) Working closely with internal stakeholders in Product, Legal, Compliance and Delivery to define solutions that will empower our customers; and

(3) Originating new customer opportunities, responding to inbound opportunities, and shepherding deals from opening through to contract and closing stage.  

The team at Marqeta focuses on the largest and most impactful commercial opportunities in Marqeta’s evolving business. These customers include established brands, fintech innovators and labour / retail marketplaces, all looking for solutions to launch, scale and continuously evolve their financial products and services.  Key to this role is an ability to understand Marqeta's technology and how it brings value to the market, expertly communicate its benefits, and win the trust of the key stakeholders across revenue growth, product and technology teams of our potential partners.

We're looking for a self-motivated, experienced solution seller, who is eager to further deepen their knowledge of embedded finance and possesses the business judgment and sales acumen to vet opportunities and close deals. In this role you will spend the first 3 months learning the ins and outs of Marqeta and our customers and our programme management capabilities, supporting Team Leads on strategic projects, and building a sales pipeline. Additionally, you will need to understand the process of selling a complex platform technology and be able to communicate technical and product benefits to both sophisticated and unsophisticated buyers.

PLEASE NOTE: This is a hybrid role and requires employees to be based within 35 miles of our London office. You will be expected to work on-site two days a week, on Tuesday and Thursday, with the flexibility to work remotely on the other days.

The Talent team will share more details if selected for the "Recruiter" Interview. We'd love for you to join us!

The Impact You'll Have

This role is about generating and closing new opportunities while playing a key role supporting the Sales Director in setting the strategic vision for the business - here are a few key expectations:

  • Closing and launching enterprise customers: Work alongside the team Director in identifying, closing and onboarding new customers. Manage the back end of the process including Salesforce rigour and reporting, financial modeling, and garnering internal approvals. 

  • Qualify leads and prioritize the right opportunities: Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects by identifying their needs and requirements, responding to requests for information and proposals, and vetting them against our current and future product offering.

  • Run a Sales Process end to end: Manage real customer opportunities through a sales process, from initial engagement to scoping to final contract negotiations. At any given time, you will be responsible for partnering with the team to grow and renew existing accounts and working opportunities in various stages of that process in Salesforce.

  • Contracting: Work with our Legal team as required to shepherd opportunities through the contracting process, including negotiation and execution.

  • Know the Tech: Quickly get up to speed on Marqeta's technical and programme management capabilities, the unique features and customer benefits our platform offers and how to speak with confidence, knowledge and credibility about what we bring to our customers and prospects.

  • Sell the partnership vision: Work with internal SMEs to identify and develop solutions for prospects who are trying to understand what makes Marqeta’s platform and service offering so exceptional and differentiated.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in sales and/or strategic business development roles; payments, investment banking and strategic consulting backgrounds preferred but not required. Bachelor’s Degree or comparable experience required.

  • Deep understanding of the payments ecosystem and card issuing is crucial, with bonus points for having worked in a regulated programme manager offering full stack solutions to customers.

  • Strong familiarity and ease with the fintech ecosystem, B2B technology applications and how technology platforms serve customer businesses.

  • Financial Acumen. The payments business and caliber of customer relationships necessitates complex deal structures and financial modelling. We’re looking for an individual who is comfortable and capable of evaluating and modeling customer proposals and resulting contract financial models. 

  • Confidence in serving as the face of Marqeta for prospective customers and partners who may comprise C-suite executives and senior leadership members.

  • Ability to prioritize, manage, and deliver on multiple projects simultaneously; highly motivated and able to work against aggressive schedules.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with the ability to work cross-functionally to deliver on the customer’s needs.

  • Superior communication skills (interpersonal, verbal, email, and presentation) with the ability to successfully orchestrate the sales process by managing the time and resources of the team and specialist partners.

  • Positive attitude, team player, adaptable, resourceful, and self-starter who is able to work independently.

  • Lou Devlin - Linkedin Profile (no agencies please!)

Typical Process

  • Application Submission

  • Recruiter video call

  • Hiring manager video call

  • Virtual “Onsite” consisting of 2 x 45 min calls

  • Presentation Round to team

  • Offer!

Compensation and Benefits

  • Premium Private Medical and Dental coverage

  • Generous time off program with additional “Floating Holiday days”

  • Retirement savings program with company contribution

  • Equity in a publicly-traded company and an Employee Stock Purchase Program

  • Monthly stipend to support our remote work model

  • Annual development stipend to support our people's growth and development

  • Family-forming benefits and up to 20 weeks of Parental Leave

About Marqeta

Marqeta is on a mission to change the way money moves. We’re one of the earliest enablers of embedded finance, a market opportunity sized up in the trillions. Our card issuing platform provides unprecedented flexibility and control for companies to issue cards, authorize transactions, and manage payment operations in real time. Marqeta is powering the most well known brands in the new economy (Block, Cash App, Affirm, Instacart, Doordash, Uber, Walmart, etc). You don’t need to be a Payments expert to join the Marqeta Team, let us help you with that. This is the opportunity of a lifetime to work with innovators around the world and unlock equitable financial access for all.

Marqeta’s Values

– Solve for the Customer: With a deep understanding of our customers' business and empathy for their needs, we deliver products and services that drive their success. Earning and keeping their trust guides everything we do.

title: Lead Product Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the team

Zego’s Data team delivers high-impact projects across the whole business - from AI tools that let anyone query data and publish dashboards in Zego Lens, to the customer insights that shape our growth strategy.

We already have established data science teams in Pricing and Telematics. This is the first data science role in our central Data team, focused on the huge untapped potential across the rest of the business - from experimentation to churn, marketing and fraud. We’re a fast-moving disruptor in insurance, driven by great tech products and data. We adopt new technology quickly - we’re AI-first, so most of our code is now written by AI and reviewed by people.

About the role

As our first Lead Product Data Scientist, you’ll shape how Zego makes its biggest product and commercial decisions. You’ll work directly with senior leaders across Product, Growth and Operations to decide where to focus, which bets to back and how we’ll know they’ve worked.

You’ll start by building the foundations - a trusted experimentation framework and customer models that tell us who to acquire, how to engage them and where to invest. As teams learn to run routine experiments themselves, your focus will shift to guiding product investment and making sure evidence, rather than intuition, drives our roadmap.

This is a senior, hands-on role with real scope to shape a new capability - and the chance to use AI to scale data science across a growing business.

What you will be doing

  • Work with senior leaders to embed data science in strategy and decision making. Create and own a prioritised roadmap for where data science can have the biggest impact.

  • Own Zego’s experimentation framework - design standards, power, guardrail metrics and decision rules. Coach teams to run routine experiments themselves.

  • Partner with Product teams before anything is built, shaping ideas into evidence-based hypotheses and well-designed experiments. Apply causal inference where randomised tests aren’t possible.

  • Build models of customer behaviour across the lifecycle - acquisition, conversion, retention, churn and lifetime value - with teams such as Marketing and Fraud.

  • Use AI to scale data science across Zego, automating experiment analysis and readouts. Build self-serve tools that help teams sharpen their hypotheses.

  • Take the most impactful models into production with our ML Platform team.

  • Set technical direction and mentor analysts and data scientists as the capability grows.

What you’ll need

  • Significant data science experience in a product-led business, with a track record of work that changed product or commercial decisions.

  • Strong executive presence - you influence senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence and explain results clearly to any audience.

  • Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with many online experiments designed and analysed.

  • Experience building customer models such as churn, propensity, LTV or segmentation - and getting them used in real decisions.

  • Strong Python and SQL, with confidence working AI-first (and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong).

  • Experience taking models into production on AWS SageMaker or a similar ML platform.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with experimentation or product analytics platforms such as Statsig or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt and Looker or a similar modern data stack.

  • Experience of marketing measurement such as media mix modelling or incrementality testing.

  • A background in insurance, fintech or another regulated or subscription business.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Lead Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience

 

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

 

Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.

 

We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.

 

If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.

  • At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

  • Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

  • We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

 

Here's what you can expect to be working on

  • Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

  • Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

  • Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

  • Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

  • Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

 

You should apply if:

  • You’re curious about how AI is changing product design and you already use it in your own work. You’re comfortable designing features that use it, without needing deep specialist experience.

  • You’ve got a well-formed point of view on building trust into a product - how you design for transparency and control, how you handle edge cases and errors, and how you make sure users always feel in charge.

  • You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

  • You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

  • You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

 

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

  • You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

  • You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

  • You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

 

A bit about you

  • Complex product experience:: Complex product experience: You’ve designed for complex, data-heavy or technical products, with real examples of how you made them simple and trustworthy for users.

  • Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

  • Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

  • Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

  • Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

  • Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

  • Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

 

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

 

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚴 Cycle to work scheme

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

 

Salary

We're not publishing a fixed band for this one. We'll build the package around your experience and the scope you bring, so please apply and let's have the conversation.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

 

Interview Process

3 stages = An introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview inc. a Design & AI Task with our Head of UX > Final interview with our Co-Founder.

 

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

 

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

How we use AI in the hiring process
Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by people, not AI.

As a Lead Product Manager, you’ll lead one or more cross-functional teams to define and deliver a strategy that helps customers make the most of Monzo. You’ll help build the platform, capabilities and app structure needed to optimise a customer’s in-app experience and engagement.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

  • Lead the charge: build a product vision and strategy for your area, ensuring alignment with Monzo’s goals and an exceptional customer experience.
  • Communicate effectively: you get people inspired by the product vision and you share the right context with the right people at the right time.
  • Collaborate seamlessly: partner with engineering, design, data, research, marketing and other teams across Monzo to create a strategy and deliver.
  • Deliver impact: define, deliver and measure the impact of the customer-focused personalisation and discovery experiences you create.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • You are a seasoned product manager, and have led high-performing teams to ship world-class products at a fast growing company.
  • You have a track record of leading consumer personalisation and discovery efforts (recommendation systems) that drive significant value for customers and the business.
  • You're data-driven and commercial, and have a track record of collaborating with machine learning experts or data scientists to define key metrics, run experiments, and deliver business impact.
  • You can systematically break down and solve complex problems.
  • You have good judgement, and have a track record of making good decisions in complex situations where there’s often no “right answer”.
  • You have the urge and resilience to challenge the status quo and make things better, and are full of creative ideas for how to do so.
  • You can work effectively with a diverse range of people and working styles - spanning engineering, design, data, user research, marketing, legal and compliance - to get stuff done.
  • You’re a great storyteller, who is able to motivate, energise and inspire people towards a common goal.
  • You’re passionate about building value for customers and not just achieving business results, and are excited about our mission at Monzo.
  • You’re intellectually honest about your work's performance, continually striving for improvement.
  • You’re a fast learner, humble and curious, and enjoy learning every day and sharing your knowledge and experience.
  • You’ve mentored other PMs, have the ability to coach others, and can provide clear and constructive feedback to your team and other disciplines.

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £115,000 - £140,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.

✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.

✅ We can sponsor your visa

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) 

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. 

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

Our interview process usually involves 4 main stages:

  • Recruiter Call
  • Initial Call with Hiring Manager
  • Final Loop, consisting of x3 hour long interviews to assess Project Walkthrough, Case Study and Leadership.
  • A final stage with a VP or CPO within the Product team

Our average process takes around 5-6 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

title: Leiter/in der Konstruktionsabteilung / Head of Engineering Design Organisation (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Head of Design Organisation (gn), Leichtflugzeugbau
 
Wann haben Sie zuletzt eine Konformitätserklärung unterschrieben, für die Sie allein geradestehen?
 
Es gibt in der Luftfahrt wenige Positionen, in denen eine einzelne Unterschrift entscheidet, ob ein Fluggerät zugelassen wird. Diese ist eine davon. Wer sie ausfüllt, ist nicht Verwaltungsinstanz eines Regelwerks, sondern die technische Autorität, die dafür sorgt, dass aus einer Idee ein zertifiziertes Flugzeug wird. Und die selbst Hand anlegt, wenn es zwischen beidem hakt.
 
Das Unternehmen
Ein mittelständischer Hersteller von Leichtflugzeugen mit Sitz in Niedersachsen, Deutschland, Weltmarktführer in seiner Kategorie und international aufgestellt. Entwicklung, Zertifizierung und Produktion unter einem Dach. Die Designorganisation arbeitet unter behördlicher Zulassung, und die Stelle, um die es geht, ist Teil dieser Zulassung: Sie unterliegt der Genehmigung der Luftfahrtbehörde und berichtet direkt an die verantwortliche Geschäftsleitung. Das Unternehmen ist jung genug, dass Prozesse noch geformt werden, und etabliert genug, dass diese Prozesse weltweit Fluggeräte in die Luft bringen.
 
Worum es geht
Sie sind die technische Autorität der Entwicklungsorganisation. Sie bauen das Design-Assurance-System auf und halten es lebendig, nicht auf dem Papier, sondern im Alltag der Konstruktion. Sie verantworten, dass Entwicklung und Flugerprobung innerhalb der genehmigten Designberechtigungen und in Übereinstimmung mit den Lufttüchtigkeitsvorschriften stattfinden. Und Sie führen die Bereiche Engineering, Entwicklung und Zertifizierung so, dass Sie die technischen Details kennen, statt sie aus der Ferne zu steuern.
 
Was diese Rolle von vergleichbaren unterscheidet: Prüfen allein reicht hier nicht. Wenn ein Problem zwischen Abteilungen festhängt, greifen Sie ein. Wenn ein Prozess nicht trägt, bauen Sie ihn um. Die Organisation soll geführt werden, als wäre sie Ihr eigenes Unternehmen.


Deine Aufgaben

Regulatorisch

  • Sie etablieren das Design Assurance System und halten es in Betrieb und stellen sicher, dass alle Konstruktionsarbeiten im Einklang mit BCAR A8-21 und den weiteren anwendbaren Lufttüchtigkeitsvorschriften stattfinden.
  • Sie gewährleisten, dass alle Designaktivitäten innerhalb der genehmigten Designberechtigungen bleiben und die Einhaltung der jeweiligen Baumusterzertifizierungsgrundlage nachgewiesen und verifiziert wird.
  • Sie verantworten die Flugerprobung nach behördlichen Vorgaben.
  • Sie unterzeichnen die Konformitätserklärung für jede Typgenehmigung und jede Konstruktionsänderung, nachdem Sie die Einhaltung der Verfahren aus dem Design Organisation Exposition geprüft haben.
 
Organisatorisch
  • Sie leiten Engineering, Entwicklung und Zertifizierung der Designorganisation.
  • Sie koordinieren externe Compliance-Verifizierungsingenieurinnen und -ingenieure und sind technische Schnittstelle zur unabhängigen Leitung der Lufttüchtigkeitsabteilung.
  • Sie stellen Qualifikation und Ausbildung des Ingenieur- und Zertifizierungspersonals sicher.
  • Sie steuern Design-, Zertifizierungs- und Flugtestprogramme mit internen und externen Beteiligten, einschließlich Terminierung und Ressourcen, damit Programme im Zeit- und Budgetrahmen bleiben.
  • Sie treffen die technischen Entscheidungen zu Designfragen und Zertifizierungsstrategien und greifen persönlich ein, wenn Themen zwischen Abteilungen feststecken.
  • Sie verantworten eine vollständige und nachvollziehbare Konstruktionsdokumentation für Zertifizierung, Produktion, Aufrechterhaltung der Lufttüchtigkeit und spätere Untersuchungen.
  • Sie unterstützen Produktion und Kundendienst technisch, auch bei Störungsuntersuchungen, wenn es nötig ist.
  • Sie erkennen Lücken in bestehenden Prozessen und treiben deren Behebung voran.

Dein Profil
  • Umfangreiche Berufserfahrung in einem regulierten industriellen Umfeld; Erfahrung in einem deutschen Unternehmen und auf Führungsebene in der Automobilindustrie sind ausdrücklich erwünscht
  • Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Führung von Ingenieurteams, mit voller Verantwortung für Ergebnisse und regulatorische Konformität
  • Praxiserfahrung in komplexer Systementwicklung, einschließlich der Integration von Elektrotechnik und Avionik
  • Vertrautheit mit regulatorischen Rahmenwerken wie DULV BUT, BCAR Section T, UK CAA, FAA oder CAAC
  • Ein Führungsstil, der auf Nähe zum technischen Detail setzt, mit Durchsetzungsvermögen über Schnittstellen hinweg, von Engineering bis Produktion
  • Die Haltung, offene technische Probleme als Antrieb zu sehen und pragmatische Wege zu finden, statt auf ideale Bedingungen zu warten
  • Abschluss in Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Englisch, Deutsch und Chinesisch in Wort und Schrift, alle drei sind zwingend

Benefits

  • Umfassendes Onboarding und kontinuierliche Weiterbildung

title: Leitung Unternehmensentwicklung (Jurist) und Praxisintegration (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die MVZ Krause Gruppe ist ein ärztlich geführter Verbund ambulanter Praxen in Dortmund und der Region. Für die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Gruppe suchen wir eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die medizinische Versorgungsziele, wirtschaftliche Anforderungen und rechtliche Rahmenbedingungen zusammenführt. Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Ausrichtung der Gruppe und begleiten die Umsetzung der daraus abgeleiteten Maßnahmen. Den Fachabteilungen und Mitarbeitenden stehen Sie als Ansprechperson für rechtliche Fragen des Praxisbetriebs zur Seite. Darüber hinaus begleiten Sie Praxen vonder Übernahme bis zur Integration (PMI) in die bestehenden Versorgungs- und Organisationsstrukturen.

Ihre Aufgaben

· Strategische Unternehmensentwicklung – Sie beraten die Geschäftsführung zu Leistungsangebot, Standorten und Organisation und erarbeiten mit der ärztlichen Leitung und der Finanzleitung Entscheidungsvorlagen für Geschäftsführung und Eigentümer.

· Standortübergreifende Projekte – Sie leiten strategische Projekte, stimmen Ziele, Zuständigkeiten und Termine ab und berichten der Geschäftsführung über Fortschritte und Entscheidungsbedarf.

· Rechtliche Beratung im Praxisbetrieb – Sie beraten Geschäftsführung, Fachabteilungen und Standortleitungen zu KV- und Zulassungsfragen sowie zum ärztlichen Berufsrecht. Arbeitsrechtliche Fragen klären Sie mit der Personalabteilung.

· Vertragsgestaltung und Ausschreibungen – Sie gestalten, prüfen und verhandeln Dienstleistungs-, Liefer- und Kooperationsverträge und begleiten Ausschreibungen bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

· Zusammenarbeit mit externen Rechtsberatern – Sie koordinieren externe Kanzleien, bereiten Rechtsfragen auf und unterstützen die Fachabteilungen bei der Umsetzung der Empfehlungen.

· Kooperationen und Praxisübernahmen – Sie begleiten die wirtschaftliche und rechtliche Prüfung und koordinieren bei Übernahmen mit der Standortleitung die Integration bei laufender Patientenversorgung.

Ihr Profil

· Qualifikation – Sie haben Rechtswissenschaften oder Wirtschaftsrecht (z. B. LL.M.) studiert und abgeschlossen oder verfügen über eine vergleichbare juristisch-betriebswirtschaftliche Qualifikation.

· Unternehmensentwicklung und Projektleitung – Sie haben mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Unternehmensentwicklung oder in der Leitung bereichsübergreifender Projekte und mindestens ein Vorhaben von der Konzeption bis in den Regelbetrieb geführt. Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, insbesondere im MVZ-Umfeld, ist von Vorteil.

· Juristische Beratung und Vertragsgestaltung – Sie beraten verständlich, gestalten, prüfen und verhandeln Dienstleistungs- und Kooperationsverträge und binden bei Bedarf externe Kanzleien ein. Kenntnisse im Vertragsarzt-, Berufs- und Arbeitsrecht sowie Erfahrung mit Ausschreibungen sind wünschenswert.

· Wirtschaftliches Urteilsvermögen – Sie beurteilen Jahresabschlüsse, Ergebnis- und Liquiditätsplanungen und leiten aus wirtschaftlichen Auswirkungen und rechtlichen Risiken Empfehlungen für die Geschäftsführung ab.

· Führung und Kommunikation – Sie führen interdisziplinäre Teams, verhandeln verbindlich und gewinnen ärztliche Leitungen, Standortverantwortliche und Mitarbeitende für Veränderungen.

· Arbeitsweise – Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und sorgfältig. Mit juristischem Blick entwickeln Sie praktikable Lösungen und verantworten deren Umsetzung im Praxisalltag.

title: Leitung Vertriebsinnendienst und Prozesssteuerung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Worms · Vollzeit · unbefristet · Eintritt nach Vereinbarung
Berichtet direkt an: Head of Sales
Führt: Vertriebsinnendienst und Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling

Bei NICO entstehen gute Ergebnisse, wenn Menschen, Prozesse und Informationen zuverlässig zusammenspielen: Kalkulationen müssen stimmen, Angebote sorgfältig vorbereitet, Aufgaben klar verteilt und Entscheidungen durch belastbare Zahlen unterstützt werden.

Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit, die den Überblick behält, Zusammenhänge schnell erfasst und gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Menschen gute Lösungen entwickelt. Sie schaffen so viel Struktur wie nötig und halten Abläufe so einfach wie möglich.

Aufgaben

Ihre Rolle: Sie führen den Vertriebsinnendienst sowie die Stabsstelle Vertriebscontrolling fachlich und disziplinarisch. Dabei verantworten Sie die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Vertriebsprozesse. Klassische Kundenbetreuung steht nicht im Mittelpunkt dieser Position.

Sie koordinieren den Gesamtprozess – von Kalkulation und Angebot über Auftrag, Beschaffung und Lieferung bis zu Rechnung, Auswertung und Nachbereitung. Sie sorgen dafür, dass Zuständigkeiten geklärt sind, Informationen fließen und Entscheidungen auf verlässlichen Daten beruhen.

Ihre Aufgaben:

  • Sie führen Ihr Team klar, wertschätzend und nah am Arbeitsalltag.

  • Sie steuern und verbessern die internen Vertriebsprozesse über alle Prozessschritte hinweg.

  • Sie koordinieren insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf, Buchhaltung und Logistik und beziehen IT sowie weitere beteiligte Bereiche rechtzeitig ein.

  • Sie klären Zuständigkeiten, Übergaben, Freigaben und Vertretungen und verfolgen Vereinbarungen verbindlich nach.

  • Sie erkennen Informationslücken, unnötige Arbeitsschritte und wiederkehrende Fehlerquellen und entwickeln mit den Beteiligten praktikable Lösungen.

  • Sie erstellen und pflegen verständliche Prozessbeschreibungen, Arbeitsanweisungen, Handbücher, Checklisten und Vorlagen.

  • Gemeinsam mit der IT verbessern Sie digitale Ablagen, Ordnerstrukturen, Berechtigungen und die Nutzung vorhandener Systeme.

  • Sie setzen digitale Werkzeuge zur Arbeits- und Projektorganisation ein, um Aufgaben, Termine, Ziele und Verantwortlichkeiten transparent zu machen.

  • Zusammen mit dem Vertriebscontrolling sorgen Sie für aussagekräftige Kennzahlen, nachvollziehbare Auswertungen und eine verlässliche Datengrundlage.

  • Sie prüfen Zahlen auf Plausibilität, erkennen Abweichungen und Zusammenhänge und leiten daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Sie bereiten Informationen für den Head of Sales verständlich auf und geben einen realistischen Überblick über laufende Themen, Entwicklungen und mögliche Engpässe.

  • Auch wenn viel gleichzeitig zusammenkommt, setzen Sie klare Prioritäten und geben Ihrem Team Orientierung.

Qualifikation

Was Sie mitbringen:

Für diese Aufgabe suchen wir keine reine Verwaltungskraft, sondern eine Führungspersönlichkeit mit ausgeprägtem Prozess-, Zahlen- und Datenverständnis.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung, ein betriebswirtschaftliches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Vertriebsinnendienst, in der Vertriebsorganisation, im Vertriebscontrolling oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion

  • Erfahrung in der Führung und Weiterentwicklung von Mitarbeitenden

  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für kaufmännische Gesamtprozesse – von Kalkulation und Angebot bis zu Lieferung, Rechnung und Auswertung

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der bereichsübergreifenden Prozesskoordination

  • Sehr gutes Zahlen- und Datenverständnis sowie die Fähigkeit, Auswertungen kritisch zu prüfen und verständlich einzuordnen

  • Erfahrung in der Dokumentation, Vereinheitlichung und Verbesserung von Abläufen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP- beziehungsweise Warenwirtschaftssystemen und den gängigen Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel

  • Ein gutes Verständnis für Datenqualität sowie nachvollziehbare Ablage- und Informationsstrukturen

  • Offenheit für digitale und KI-gestützte Werkzeuge und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wo diese Abläufe vereinfachen und die Qualität der Arbeit verbessern können

  • Eine verbindliche Kommunikation, ein respektvoller Führungsstil und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenzuführen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind hilfreich

Wie wir zusammenarbeiten möchten

Wir wünschen uns eine Führungskraft, die zuhört, nachfragt und die Erfahrung ihres Teams einbezieht. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Sie Entscheidungen treffen, Prioritäten setzen und vereinbarte Maßnahmen konsequent umsetzen.

Agile Zusammenarbeit bedeutet für uns ganz praktisch: Aufgaben sichtbar machen, Verantwortlichkeiten klären, sich regelmäßig abstimmen und Verbesserungen Schritt für Schritt umsetzen.

Zahlen verstehen wir dabei nicht als Selbstzweck. Sie sollen Entwicklungen sichtbar machen, Ursachen erkennen lassen und bessere Entscheidungen ermöglichen.

Was Sie bei der NICO erwartet

Sie übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit direkter Anbindung an den Head of Sales und spürbarem Einfluss auf die Zusammenarbeit im Unternehmen.

Sie treffen auf erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen, bestehende Strukturen und den gemeinsamen Wunsch, Abläufe transparenter, einfacher und verlässlicher zu gestalten. Dabei sollen Sie nicht vom ersten Tag an fertige Antworten liefern. Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie zunächst verstehen, dann bewerten und anschließend gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten die richtigen Veränderungen umsetzen.

Wir bieten Ihnen eine unbefristete Vollzeitstelle an unserem Standort in Worms, eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung, kurze Abstimmungswege und eine der Verantwortung angemessene Vergütung.

Benefits

Warum Sie bei uns gut aufgehoben sind

  • Ein motiviertes, kollegiales Team mit 10 Personen am Standort Worms, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt

  • Ein Familienunternehmen, das Stabilität, Bodenständigkeit und kurze Entscheidungswege vereint

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel, faire Vergütung und ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten – besonders im Bereich Prozesse

  • Ein abwechslungsreicher Arbeitsalltag in einer spannenden und dynamischen Branche

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Zeiterfassungs-/ Abwesenheitssystem, regelmäßige Teammeetings und Firmenevents

  • monatliche Sachbezüge als Gutschein, die Ihnen nach der Probezeit zusätzliche Vorteile im Alltag bieten

Wir möchten Sie kennenlernen

Uns interessiert nicht nur Ihr Lebenslauf. Erzählen Sie uns auch, wie Sie führen, welche Prozesse Sie bereits verbessert haben und wie Sie Zahlen und Daten für gute Entscheidungen nutzen.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
