title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
descriptionHtml:
WHY this position is important

Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it.

The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot: automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible.

These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.

HOW you will contribute

You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor.

Every topic follows the same path:

  • Evaluation first: in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter.

  • A baseline in production: you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3.

  • Then go further: you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result.

You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results.

Topics for 2027

Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you.

  • Reading invoices and new types of documents with compact vision-language models (VLMs): fine-tuning, supervision from e-invoices, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards.

  • Knowing when the AI is right: calibrated confidence, selective automation and model routing for automated accounting decisions.

  • Evaluating accounting agents: an open benchmark of long-horizon accounting tasks on simulated client files, with verifiable scoring.

  • Learning from accountants' corrections: turning feedback into editable rules, with non-regression guarantees.

  • Bank reconciliation: matching one transaction to several documents, as learned graph optimisation.

  • An AI agent for Autopilot support tickets: from investigation to a pull request. This is an applied topic for profiles who prefer building systems close to production.

  • Data foundations for AI: evaluation datasets, data quality and monitoring, and agents that let teams query and use data on their own.

AI will be part of how you work

You will use coding assistants and AI agents every day: to explore the codebase and data models, write Python and SQL, run experiments, write tests and debug.

We expect you to give agents the right context and to check their output. You own the result, not the agent.

OUR CULTURE

You will join a hands-on engineering culture, where two technical co-founders are still among the most active contributors to the codebase.

You will work with ML and AI engineers, data specialists, software engineers, product managers and accountants. You will have strong mentorship and a lot of ownership: freedom to test ideas, challenge existing approaches and build things from scratch, with an R&D mindset.

The goal is not a demo. It is something the team can trust, reuse and ship.

YOU'RE THE RIGHT CANDIDATE IF YOU

  • Are in the final year of a Master's degree or engineering school in machine learning, computer science, statistics or applied mathematics. Research internships of at least 4 months are also considered.

  • Have strong ML foundations and solid Python, and have already trained, fine-tuned or evaluated models in academic, personal or professional projects.

  • Care about evaluation: clean baselines, reproducible experiments and metrics that reflect the real problem.

  • Are comfortable with real-world data: SQL, analysis, messy and imbalanced datasets.

  • Already use AI ambitiously in your projects and can explain how you verify its output.

  • Communicate clearly and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary team. No accounting knowledge is required, only curiosity.

PRACTICAL INFORMATION

  • Duration: 5 to 6 months (final-year internship).

  • Start date: March or April 2027.

  • Location: Paris office, at least 3 days per week on site, together with your tutor.

  • Supervision: a dedicated tutor from the ML & AI team.

  • Resources: GPUs, API access to frontier models, real data under GDPR-compliant conditions, and our existing evaluation infrastructure.

  • After the internship: an opportunity to join Pennylane full-time on a permanent contract.

HOW TO APPLY

Please send us:

  • Your CV.

  • Links to relevant projects: GitHub repositories, technical reports, notebooks or papers.

  • A few lines on your motivation and the topics that interest you most.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager (Power)
descriptionHtml:

By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.

About the Role

As a Machine Learning Engineering Manager at Kpler, you will lead and grow an engineering team dedicated to bringing production-grade machine learning models to the core of global trade intelligence. Operating at the intersection of people leadership, system architecture, and applied AI, you will guide your team in scaling resilient MLOps pipelines and deploying models that process massive, real-time datasets. Your leadership directly accelerates how our platform translates complex market telemetry into actionable, high-impact signals for global commodity and maritime leaders.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and support a high-performing squad of Machine Learning Engineers, fostering psychological safety, professional growth, and a culture of continuous delivery.

  • Drive the end-to-end technical direction and operational excellence for ML infrastructure, automated training, model evaluation, and low-latency inference pipelines.

  • Partner with Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Data Engineering leads to align roadmaps, scope technical initiatives, and deliver high-impact features predictably.

  • Define and champion engineering best practices across MLOps, system observability, data quality monitoring, and automated testing to ensure high reliability.

  • Provide architectural guidance and participate in technical design reviews, helping the team evaluate trade-offs between speed, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

  • Champion technical hiring and interview calibration to attract, evaluate, and onboard diverse engineering talent.


Experience & Background

What you'll need (Must-haves)

  • Proven experience in technical leadership or engineering people management, guiding small-to-medium squads through complex software delivery cycles.

  • Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience deploying and operating machine learning pipelines in production environments (e.g., Python, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Deep understanding of MLOps lifecycle tools, workflow orchestration, model serving, and cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent).

title: Maintenance Technician
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Maintain, troubleshoot and repair machinery across our magnet factory,keeping equipment safe, accurate and available.

  • Carry out preventive maintenance, inspections and repairs on mechanical, electromechanical and pneumatic systems.

  • Diagnose breakdowns, intermittent faults and undocumented failures. Resolve the root cause and verify safe operation before returning equipment to service.

  • Assemble, install, align, and commission new equipment.

  • Support factory and site acceptance tests, installation checks.

  • Work with multiple teams to distinguish machine faults from setup, material, process or measurement problems.

  • Work with controls and manufacturing engineering to tune equipment, including winding tension, motion, vacuum and thermal profiles, within approved process limits.

  • Identify wear early, flag long-lead items and communicate to the lead technician.

  • Record failure modes, downtime, repairs, parts used and equipment modifications.

  • Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

  • Provide clear handovers on equipment condition, outstanding faults and any operating restrictions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in industrial maintenance, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or mechatronics, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

  • Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

  • The ability to interpret engineering drawings, equipment manuals and electrical or pneumatic schematics, and practical familiarity with mechanisms, pneumatics, drives and sensors.

  • Confidence using workshop tools and measuring equipment to strip, rebuild, align and inspect machine components accurately.

  • A disciplined approach to electrical and machine safety, safe isolation and stored energy, with sound judgement about when specialist support is required.

  • The ability to organise assigned work independently, keep reliable records and adapt as equipment and processes develop.

  • Working English for understanding technical instructions, recording work and communicating with technicians, engineers and suppliers.

Nice to have

  • Experience diagnosing programmable logic controller (PLC) systems beyond the operator screen, including Beckhoff/TwinCAT or comparable controls.

  • Experience with reel-to-reel machinery, tension control, precision motion, or cable and conductor handling.

  • Experience commissioning custom machinery, a new cell or a new production line, including factory or site acceptance testing.

  • Hydraulic, vacuum, cryogenic or high-voltage equipment experience; an electrical qualification such as Elektrofachkraft.

  • Experience with computerised maintenance management systems (CMMS), establishing preventive-maintenance programmes or structured reliability improvement.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

     

This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH)
*This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Manager Business Development mit Schwerpunkt Projektakquise (m/w/d) im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien
descriptionHtml:
Was wir tun
"Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen"

Mit dieser Zielsetzung hat sich VISPIRON ENERGY eine strategische Position im Zukunftsmarkt der erneuerbaren Energien erarbeitet. Das ursprünglich auf Photovoltaikparks spezialisierte Unternehmen legte im Jahr 2017 den Fokus auf die Vernetzung regenerativer Energiesysteme und konzipierte das Ökosystem ENERGY WORLD. Regenerative Energieerzeuger, Verbraucher, Speicher und Hochleistungsladesäulen werden in diesem Ökosystem vernetzt und intelligent bewirtschaftet. Wir decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Hierzu arbeiten die hochspezialisierten Unternehmen VISPIRON ENERGY, VISPIRON EPC und SEtrade als Einheit zusammen und decken die Wertschöpfungskette von der Projektstrukturierung über den Anlagenbau bis hin zur Energievermarktung, zum Kapazitätshandel und zur Betriebsführung ab.

Sind wir ein Match?

Du

  • hast Freude daran, neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu erschließen, Menschen für gemeinsame Projekte zu begeistern und nachhaltiges Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • erkennst Chancen und Potenziale für neue Energieprojekte, bevor andere sie sehen.
  • gehst aktiv auf Flächeneigentümer, Kommunen, Unternehmen und Projektpartner zu und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf.
  • verhandelst souverän und findest Lösungen, die für alle Beteiligten Mehrwert schaffen.
  • arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und behältst auch bei komplexen Verhandlungen den Überblick.
  • verstehst, dass erfolgreiche Projektakquise Vertrieb, Verhandlung und Beziehungsmanagement gleichermaßen bedeutet.
  • möchtest einen direkten Beitrag zur Energiewende leisten und die Grundlage für neue Energieprojekte schaffen.

Wir

  • Wir arbeiten seit 20 Jahren täglich daran, die Abhängigkeit von fossilen Energieträgern zu beenden.
  • Wir wollen eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.
  • Wir glauben an das Potential unserer Mitarbeiter:innen.
  • Wir sind Pioniere und haben neue Technologien entwickelt.
  • Wir sind neugierig, leben eine offene Fehlerkultur und teilen unser Wissen.
  • Wir setzen innovative Geschäftsmodelle nachhaltig um.

Aufgaben

Job Results - Tätigkeiten

  • Generierung und Qualifizierung von Leads zur Sicherung attraktiver Flächen für Charge Farms, Energieparks und Batteriespeicherprojekte.
  • Identifikation und Bewertung neuer Projektpotenziale im Bereich Photovoltaik, Batteriespeicher und Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Aufbau eines belastbaren Netzwerks aus Flächeneigentümern, Kommunen, Unternehmen und Projektpartnern zur langfristigen Sicherung neuer Projektmöglichkeiten.
  • Sicherung attraktiver Projektflächen durch den erfolgreichen Abschluss von Nutzungs- und Gestattungsverträgen.
  • Anbahnung und Abschluss von Kooperationsvereinbarungen zur Sicherung von Projektrechten und zur Erschließung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
  • Entwicklung neuer Konzepte zur Erweiterung der Projektpipeline.
  • Pflege und Ausbau eines belastbaren Netzwerks aus Flächeneigentümern, Projektpartnern und Branchenkontakten.

Qualifikation

Deine Kompetenzen

Background: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium, wünschenswert im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien. Wichtiger aber als dein Ausbildungsweg sind für uns deine Erfahrungen in der Akquise, dein Verhandlungsgeschick und dein unternehmerisches Denken.

Berufserfahrung: Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Projektakquise, Projektentwicklung, Flächensicherung, Immobilienentwicklung, Geschäftsentwicklung oder im Vertrieb komplexer Infrastruktur-, Energie- oder Immobilienprojekte.

Verhandlungsgeschick: Erfahrung in der Verhandlung von Nutzungsverträgen, Gestattungsverträgen, Kooperationsvereinbarungen oder vergleichbaren Vertragswerken.

Marktverständnis: Verständnis der wirtschaftlichen, regulatorischen und technischen Rahmenbedingungen von Photovoltaik-, Batteriespeicher- und Ladeinfrastrukturprojekten sowie der Anforderungen an eine erfolgreiche Projektentwicklung.

Netzwerkaufbau: Freude an der Ansprache neuer Kontakte und Fähigkeit, langfristige Beziehungen zu Flächeneigentümern, Kommunen, Unternehmen und Projektpartnern aufzubauen.

Kommunikation: Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Eigentümern, Partnern, Behörden und weiteren Stakeholdern.

Eigeninitiative & Verantwortungsbewusstsein: Du arbeitest selbstständig, lösungsorientiert und bringst Themen konsequent zum Abschluss.

Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten

  • Wirkung: Du trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass neue Charge Farms, Energieparks und Batteriespeicherprojekte wie unser Energiepark Egling Realität werden – und damit zur Energiewende und zu einer enkeltauglichen Zukunft.
  • Team & Kultur: Sei du selbst und wachse mit uns (Wissenstransfer). Du wirst von einem freundlichen und leistungsstarken Team aus Energieexpertinnen und Experten mit langjähriger Unternehmenszugehörigkeit herzlich empfangen, die ihr tiefes akademisches und praktisches Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Fort-und Weiterbildung: Wir bieten interessante Entwicklungsperspektiven und ermöglichen aufgabenspezifische Fortbildungs- und Schulungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Arbeitsumfeld: Wir pflegen eine offene Arbeitskultur, in der Ideen und Initiativen gefördert werden. Zudem sind die Arbeitszeiten flexibel und basieren auf Vertrauen. Du erhältst ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau und der Entwicklung deiner Projektpipeline.
  • Entlohnung: Alle Mitarbeiter:innen sind gemeinsam am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligt. Weitere Benefits sind Zuschüsse zum Mittagessen in Firmenkantine, JobRad, Carsharing, betriebsinterne Kita, kostenlose Getränke und Obst, vegetarisches Essen und Sportangebote.
  • Standort: Unser Büro befindet sich in München und ist öffentlich gut erreichbar.

Warum brauchen wir dich im Team?

Unsere Projektakquise ist der Ausgangspunkt unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Hier entstehen die Projekte, die später entwickelt, finanziert, gebaut und betrieben werden.

Als Manager Business Development (m/w/d) identifizierst du neue Potenziale, erschließt neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, gewinnst Flächeneigentümer, Unternehmen, Kommunen und Projektpartner für gemeinsame Vorhaben und sicherst die Projektrechte für zukünftige Energieprojekte.

Du baust Netzwerke auf, verhandelst auf Augenhöhe mit unterschiedlichsten Stakeholdern und schaffst die Grundlage für die Energieinfrastruktur von morgen.

Dabei verbindest du unternehmerisches Denken mit Umsetzungsstärke und leistest einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum unserer ENERGY WORLD.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Chancen zu erkennen, Menschen zu begeistern und Projekte von Anfang an auf den Weg zu bringen, wirst du in dieser Rolle maßgeblich zum Erfolg unserer Mission beitragen:

Eine enkeltaugliche Welt hinterlassen.

Cross-functional influence and expertise

title: Manager - OTA Vehicle Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

RV Tech is redefining what a car can be by making continuous iteration and improvement core to the product. Over-the-Air (OTA) Updates are what make that model possible — allowing us to seamlessly and rapidly deliver the latest software to both engineering and customer vehicles. As a result, the OTA system sits on the critical path of RV Tech's entire development chain.

As Manager of OTA Vehicle Engineering Berlin, you will lead and grow the Berlin chapter of RV Tech’s OTA team so that they may develop end to end features within the broader OTA ecosystem and support the Volkswagen Group directly in our joint effort to build a software defined vehicle.

We are looking for a highly motivated leader who can operate credibly from the electrical layer to the business strategy layer, and who thrives in complex, ambiguous, high-stakes environments.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

title: Marketing Lead
descriptionHtml:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt.

Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründertisch. Keine Agentur, kein Team unter dir, keine fertigen Prozesse. Du baust Marke, Community und Funnel von null auf – erst mit den eigenen Händen, dann mit einem Team.

Was dich erwartet: ein Hardware-Produkt plus Abo, Direktvertrieb in DACH und Eltern als Zielgruppe, die das Beste für ihre Kinder wollen und Datenschutz ernst nehmen. Und ein Thema, bei dem KI und Kinder in einem Satz stehen. Da gewinnt, wer Vertrauen aufbauen kann.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du machst aus Onoo eine Marke, die Eltern sofort verstehen: Positionierung, Story, Ton – vom Video bis zum Karton.

  • Du baust unsere UGC-Maschine: Creator finden, briefen, Hooks schreiben, jede Woche 10–20 Ad-Varianten testen, lernen, wiederholen.

  • Du bringst 5.000 Familien auf die Warteliste, bevor es Onoo zu kaufen gibt – und hältst sie bei Laune (Newsletter, Social, „Kinderfrage des Tages“).

  • Du machst aus unseren Beta-Familien Fans: Reviews, Videos, Testimonials, echte Geschichten.

  • Du baust den Funnel von Warteliste bis Abo: Landingpage, Shop, E-Mail-Flows, Empfehlungsprogramm, Abo-Aktivierung, Kündigungs-Prävention.

  • Du schaltest Paid Social (Meta, TikTok) selbst, misst sauber (Tracking, Attribution, CAC, LTV) und entscheidest nach Zahlen.

  • Du bringst uns in die Magazine, Podcasts und Feeds, die Eltern in DACH wirklich lesen und hören.

  • Du machst die Gründer sichtbar (LinkedIn, Instagram) – vor dem Launch unser günstigster Kanal.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Marketing hält, was das Produkt verspricht: keine Kinder als Werbefiguren, Datenschutz vorgelebt, Werbung sauber gekennzeichnet, kein Fake-UGC.

  • Du hast ein Krisen-Playbook in der Schublade, falls Onoo einem Kind mal etwas Falsches sagt.

  • Du baust ab dem Launch das Team und holst Freelancer und Agenturen dazu, wo es sich lohnt.

Melde dich, wenn:

  • Du 5+ Jahre Consumer-Marketing gemacht hast, am liebsten D2C mit Abo oder Hardware.

  • Du schon mal eine Marke von null aufgebaut hast oder beim Aufbau ganz vorne dabei warst.

  • Du UGC nicht nur kennst, sondern eine Creative-Testing-Maschine gebaut hast und uns sagen kannst, welche Hook-Rate dein bestes Creative hatte und warum.

  • Du Lifecycle-Marketing kannst: Klaviyo oder Ähnliches, Flows, Segmente, Churn.

  • Du Zahlen magst: CAC, LTV, Cohorts, Payback und mit unserem Finance-Mitgründer eine Sprache sprichst.

  • Du selbst Ads schaltest, Texte schreibst, Videos schneidest, Decks baust und nicht nur delegierst.

  • Du den DACH-Markt kennst und verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse mitbringst.

  • Du KI-Tools für Content täglich nutzt und weißt, wo ihre Grenze ist.

  • Du Kinder, Eltern und Bildung spannend findest. Nicht nur als Zielgruppe.

  • Du Verantwortung willst, bevor alles fertig ist.

Eher nicht, wenn: du zuletzt vor allem Budgets und Agenturen gesteuert hast und nicht mehr selbst Hand anlegen willst. Oder wenn du nur Performance kannst, aber keine Marke. Oder nur Marke, aber keine Zahlen.

descriptionHtml:

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

Our Values:

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

title: Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist, Post Graduate Trainee
descriptionHtml:
The Medical Affairs Project Associate Specialist (post-grad trainee) will join the International Medical TTR team and report to International Medical Strategy & Operations. The post-grad trainee will support the planning, governance and execution of the international Medical Affairs Strategy for ATTR-CM across Alnylam's international markets, working closely with regional and country Medical teams and cross-functional partners. The role contributes to medical operations and planning deliverables, evidence generation portfolio, scientific engagement and insight programs, field medical excellence initiatives and patient experience work and offers first-hand insight into how a regional Medical Affairs organization is run. The scope is intentionally flexible: the more capability, initiative and curiosity the post-grad trainee brings, the more the remit can expand, in line with results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the International Medical Strategy & Operations team in planning, tracking and reporting on International Medical TTR strategic priorities and operating-model deliverables across international markets
  • Help with the preparation of management materials, such as leadership updates, pre-reads, meeting materials and executive presentations, turning complex information into clear, decision-ready outputs
  • Support medical planning and budget cycles by consolidating regional and country inputs, tracking spend against plan and preparing summaries, in partnership with Finance
  • Contribute to evidence generation portfolio management by maintaining study trackers (e.g., investigator-initiated studies, research collaborations) and partnering with in preparing status, milestone and timeline overviews
  • Support scientific engagement and medical education activities, including the speaker engagement process and congress planning, all scientific and non-promotional in nature
  • Contribute to the TOP 41 Centers of Excellence (CoE) program, supporting the project owner in engagement mapping; this is a potential area where the post-grad trainee may take ownership of project deliverables, depending on experience and interest
  • Support field medical excellence initiatives, such as field medical KPIs and dashboards, the quarterly medical insights process, training roll-out
  • Contribute to patient experience work, including patient advocacy and engagement and patient support programs
  • Gain first-hand insight into the regional medical leadership agenda by supporting cross-functional planning, governance meetings and operational follow-up
  • Depending on experience and interest, support projects on AI-enabled tools, CRM and insights platforms, and other emerging medical priorities

Qualifications

  • Availability for a minimum of 9 months; 12 months is strongly preferred
  • Completed bachelor's degree; a master's degree is a plus
  • Academic background in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, biomedical sciences, public health or another analytical discipline is preferred; interest in Medical Affairs, cardiology or rare diseases is valued
  • Strong logical and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate complexity and structure ambiguous problems
  • Ability to read, interpret and critically summarize scientific and clinical literature
  • Awareness of, or willingness to learn, the compliance principles that govern Medical Affairs
  • Advance PowerPoint and Excel skills; confidence using Microsoft Copilot and AI-enabled productivity tools is highly valued
  • Fast learner, proactive and adaptive, taking ownership of high-quality outputs and handling confidential information with discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus
  • Flexibility to work 2-3 days per week in the Zug office; occasional travel possible (mainly EU)
  • Collaborative, flexible and comfortable working in a fast-moving, cross-functional and international environment

What We Bring

  • The opportunity to join a highly motivated, science-driven team in a leading RNAi therapeutics company 
  • Hands-on exposure to how International Medical Affairs supports the AMVUTTRA ATTR-CM launch, with a focus on science, evidence and patients 
  • The chance to contribute to Alnylam's mission of bringing groundbreaking medicines to patients 
  • Direct one-to-one mentoring, supportive supervision, and regular development feedback 
  • Collaboration with a diverse team of experts across medicine, scientific engagement, evidence generation, patient experience, and analytics 
  • A strong office community, with events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across functions and disciplines 

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Member of Technical Staff – GPU Deployments
descriptionHtml:
Your team

You will work with the engineers who bring Lyceum’s GPU capacity online and keep it running. The team’s aim is a platform that operates without manual intervention: every new cluster should go live through the same automated, repeatable process, and changes should reach production without customers noticing.

Your mission

You will bring new GPU clusters online for Lyceum, from the technical specification of a cluster to the moment it serves its first customer workload. As we add GPU capacity across European data centres, you make sure every new cluster is specified correctly, set up fast, and handed over in a state customers can rely on.

Your focus

Technical specification: Define cluster designs together with our hardware and data-centre partners: server configuration, InfiniBand and Ethernet networking, storage, power and cooling. Review supplier specifications against what our products need.

Cluster bring-up: Own the setup from racked hardware to production: firmware, BIOS, drivers, OS images, subnet manager and network configuration, burn-in and acceptance testing.

Troubleshooting: Diagnose hardware, network and driver issues during deployment and in production, and resolve them with vendors and data-centre staff.

Automation: Turn every deployment into repeatable tooling and runbooks, so the next cluster goes live faster than the last one, and integrate new clusters into our orchestration and fleet management.

Your KPIs

  • Time from hardware delivery to first production workload

  • Share of nodes passing acceptance tests on the first attempt

  • GPU capacity brought online per quarter

  • Deployment-related incidents in the first 30 days after go-live

Your profile

We consider candidates from diverse backgrounds, with a deep love for technical challenges and the desire to take on ownership beyond what's reasonably expected.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in HPC, data-centre or infrastructure engineering

  • Hands-on experience deploying GPU servers or HPC clusters on bare metal

  • Strong Linux fundamentals, from boot process and kernel drivers to system configuration

  • Solid networking knowledge, including InfiniBand or high-speed Ethernet fabrics

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting across hardware, firmware and software

  • Scripting in Python or Bash and experience with automation tooling (Ansible or similar)

Nice to have

  • Experience with NVIDIA HGX systems and their firmware and driver stack

  • Familiarity with subnet managers, BMC/Redfish and PXE-based provisioning

  • Experience working with colocation providers and hardware vendors

Why us?

  • Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

  • Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

  • Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

  • European mission: Build sovereign, GDPR-compliant AI infrastructure for the next generation of deep-tech

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: (Mid-Senior) Project Manager - Workday Optimization & HR Transformation (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

You will join Flix's People & Organization in the Digital Transformation team to lead our HRIS transformation programme to optimize our processes, revamp payroll ecosystem and define the target operating model for a human-led, AI-partnered and agent-operated People function.

As (Senior) Project Manager (m/f/d), you will bring structure to a large, fast-moving transformation across various workstreams. You will turn ambition into a plan, a decision framework and a delivery rhythm that HR, our internal Workday technology team and external partners can all follow.

The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, and will work closely with People Operations, People Partners, Centres of Expertise and Tech teams.

This role is based in Berlin, with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week.

About the Role

  • Lead HRIS transformation, owning the integrated plan, milestones, dependencies and RAID log across the HRIS revamp, payroll transition and operating-model workstreams, and keeping all our functional and tech teams working as one delivery engine
  • Set up project governance and decision frameworks, including master data ownership, DACI/RACI and decision rights, intake and prioritization, escalation paths and steering forums
  • Plan and facilitate process revamp workshops with our process owners, People Partners and CoEs, driving as-is/to-be gap analysis, global-first standardization with justified local variants, and clear process ownership across the hire-to-retire lifecycle
  • Translate business needs into technical requirements, working with our HRIS tech team, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing and UAT, release readiness and documentation
  • Steer a complex global payroll transformation including middleware solutions, integrations, parallel runs, sign-offs and cut-over, and building a repeatable migration playbook
  • Manage stakeholders and drive proactive change management with transparent reporting, risk escalation, adoption metrics and a calm, structured presence when priorities shift

About You

  • 7+ years of experience managing complex, multi-country transformation programmes in HR technology, with a track record of delivering in a global-local environment
  • Proven experience in Workday transformation projects, such as optimization, business process redesign or platform revamps, with enough technical fluency to challenge and align with configuration, security and integration teams. Workday certifications are an advantage
  • Hands-on experience in payroll transformation, such as vendor migrations, country roll-outs, parallel runs and cut-over planning. Experience with global payroll providers is a strong plus
  • Experience shaping target operating models and governance frameworks, including service delivery models, master data governance, DACI/RACI and decision-rights design
  • Strong workshop and process-revamp skills, with the ability to facilitate cross-functional groups, map as-is/to-be processes (e.g. BPMN) and reach decisions without losing momentum
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including influencing senior leaders, translating between business and technical teams, and staying calm and building structure in ambiguity. Familiarity with works council and multi-country compliance requirements is a plus
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Jira and Confluence. Certifications in project management or agile delivery (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum) are a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family.
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit den zuständigen Markt- und Marktfolgeeinheiten zusammen und besprechen Ihre Prüfungsergebnisse konstruktiv. Sie identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale in den Kreditprozessen und bringen Ihr Fachwissen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Revisionsmethoden ein.

Sie haben eine bankkaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein entsprechendes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und bringen fundierte Berufserfahrung im Kreditgeschäft oder in der Bankrevision mit. Sie verfügen über fundierte Kenntnisse des Kredit- und Sicherheitenrechts sowie der relevanten regulatorischen Anforderungen. Eine analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet Sie aus, gepaart mit Urteilsvermögen und Durchsetzungskraft. Sie kommunizieren klar, schriftlich wie mündlich, und agieren in Prüfungsgesprächen souverän und lösungsorientiert.

Ihr Start bei der Ostfriesische Volksbank eG

In den ersten Monaten machen Sie sich mit unseren internen Revisionsprozessen, den relevanten Systemen und unserem Kreditportfolio vertraut. Sie begleiten erste Kreditprüfungen gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kollegen und übernehmen nach der Einarbeitung eigenverantwortlich Revisionsmandate. title: Payroll Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.

 

Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.

 

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

 

About the Role

 

We're hiring a Payroll Specialist to join Sona's payroll bureau, taking hands-on ownership of UK payroll processing for a portfolio of our customers.

Our bureau is growing fast. We're moving from around 15,000 payslips a month to roughly 22,000 by the start of Q4, driven by new customer go-lives in hospitality and care. That means the pace of the role is genuinely high, and we're hiring ahead of that curve rather than catching up after the fact.

Day to day, you'll manage a portfolio of standard and mid-complexity clients across multiple pay frequencies: statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC filings and payroll journal reconciliation. You'll also handle client queries through our support desk, working to fast turnaround times. Your work is checked by a Senior Payroll Specialist before it reaches clients, as part of our standard quality process.

This isn't a conventional bureau role. Sona is a startup and the payroll team is still building its own processes and tools, so there's genuine room to shape how things work and to grow as the bureau scales. You'll be working on a product in a sector most software has ignored, and once you're through probation we support CIPP study through the apprenticeship levy.

 

Responsibilities

 

  • Own end-to-end UK payroll processing for a portfolio of Sona customers across multiple pay frequencies, covering standard and mid-complexity clients

  • Manage payroll queries through our support desk, giving clients fast, proactive updates and resolving within SLA

  • Process statutory payments, court orders, standard holiday pay calculations, Alabaster reviews and NMW checks for your own portfolio

  • Handle workplace pension auto-enrolment, contributions, reconciliations and submissions, flagging any miscalculated contributions for investigation

  • Upload, reconcile and submit payments across BACS, Faster Payments and SEPA, and manage payroll journal uploads and reconciliations

  • Manage HMRC filings (FPS, EPS) and year-end processing for your portfolio, escalating disputed or mis-allocated PAYE cases to your Senior or the Payroll Manager

  • Build strong working relationships with clients, including attending client meetings when needed, and flag product bugs to Engineering as you spot them

  • Spot and flag process gaps or improvements within your own portfolio, and support Payroll Assistants and Senior Payroll Specialists with day-to-day queries

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years hands-on experience processing multiple UK payrolls independently

  • Experience within a bureau or outsourced payroll environment is a bonus

  • Good working knowledge of UK payroll and tax compliance, including tax calculations and filing and payment requirements

  • Confident managing a busy queue of support tickets, with strong organisational skills and clear written and verbal communication

  • Comfortable in Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, concatenation) and Google Suite

  • Methodical and accurate under volume, and quick to flag issues rather than let them become problems

  • Bonus: CIPP or equivalent qualification, exposure to Irish payroll (PAYE, PRSI, USC), or confidence using AI tools in your day-to-day work

 

Benefits

 

  • Salary: £35,000 - £45,000

  • Hybrid working - 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho)

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

title: PreSales Engineer
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la conformité et à la gouvernance de l'IA.

Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles dans la structuration et le pilotage de leurs enjeux de conformité, avec une ambition : rendre des sujets complexes plus simples, accessibles et opérationnels.

Dans un contexte de croissance et de développement à l'international, nous renforçons notre organisation commerciale et recrutons notre PreSales Engineer pour accompagner nos opportunités stratégiques.

Ton rôle chez Dastra

À la croisée du business, de la technologie et du conseil, tu joueras un rôle clé dans nos cycles de vente complexes.

Ta mission : apporter la crédibilité et les preuves techniques qui feront de Dastra la solution de référence pour nos futurs clients.

En véritable partenaire de nos équipes Sales, tu interviendras sur les opportunités stratégiques pour comprendre les enjeux techniques des prospects, démontrer la pertinence de notre plateforme et sécuriser leur décision.

Tes missions

  • Sécuriser les cycles de vente complexes : répondre aux questions d'architecture, d'intégration, de sécurité et de configuration (SSO, API, interconnexions, MCP...) et lever les objections techniques des prospects.

  • Contribuer activement aux appels d'offres (RFP) : participer à l'élaboration des réponses fonctionnelles, à la définition des plans de déploiement et à la préparation des démonstrations, jusqu'aux soutenances auprès des clients.

  • Assurer la continuité entre avant-vente et déploiement : collaborer avec les équipes Sales, Produit, Customer Success et Professional Services pour cadrer les besoins et garantir une transmission technique structurée après signature.

Tu contribueras également à l'amélioration continue de nos pratiques avant-vente, de nos démonstrations et de notre documentation technique.

Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu disposes d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique, idéalement en tant que PreSales Engineer, Sales Engineer ou Solution Consultant, dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu as l'habitude d'accompagner des cycles de vente complexes auprès de grands comptes, avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques exigeants.

  • Tu possèdes une solide compréhension des architectures SaaS, des intégrations, des problématiques de sécurité et des environnements IT.

  • Tu connais les enjeux de Privacy, conformité, GRC ou cybersécurité, et sais les traduire en solutions concrètes pour tes clients.

  • Tu combines expertise technique, sens commercial et excellente communication : tu sais vulgariser des sujets complexes, convaincre et adapter ton discours à tes interlocuteurs.

  • Tu fais preuve d'agilité intellectuelle, de pédagogie, de pragmatisme et de sang-froid, y compris lors de démonstrations en direct.

  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l'anglais (niveau C2) pour évoluer dans un environnement international.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un rôle stratégique : intervenir directement sur les opportunités à fort potentiel et contribuer à la croissance de Dastra.

  • Un environnement stimulant : évoluer à l'intersection du SaaS, de la protection des données, de la cybersécurité et de l'intelligence artificielle.

  • Une fonction en construction : rejoindre une organisation avant-vente en cours de structuration, avec l'opportunité de contribuer à son développement.

title: Prescriptions Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference.

With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK.

This is a full-time, working 40 hours per week.

 

About the Role

As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey.

Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service.

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information.

  • Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays.

  • Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions.

  • Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly.

  • Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need.

  • Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required.

  • Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures.

  • Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed.

  • Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better.

  • Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training.

  • Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required.

  • Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required.

     

What You Will Need

  • At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role.

  • Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner.

  • A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others.

  • Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures.

  • A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service.

     

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension contribution

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

  • The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued

     

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK.

Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support.

Compensation: £29.5K

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI Creator
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 17 million learners and 6,000+ companies, including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

About the role

Research has consistently shown that one-on-one tutoring dramatically outperforms traditional classroom instruction—a finding known as Bloom's 2 Sigma Problem. Despite decades of awareness, no solution has successfully delivered personalized tutoring at scale. Until now.

We're building an AI Creator that turns learning into action—empowering users to instantly build, experiment, and solve real-world problems, transforming knowledge into tangible impact from day one.. You will work on the core AI system that delivers real-time, adaptive learning experiences to learners. If you're excited about building the future of human learning, this role is for you.

About you

At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You're a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve the core AI tutoring system, including prompt architectures, agentic workflows, and real-time adaptive behaviors.
  • Run rigorous experimentation and evaluation, developing custom metrics and frameworks to measure learning effectiveness and improve model reliability.
  • Design and implement scalable, maintainable software, integrating AI capabilities with platform systems, content pipelines, and user experience components.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with educators, content creators, and product teams to translate pedagogical goals into technical solutions.
  • Prototype and productionize novel model interactions, leveraging emerging research and capabilities to advance the tutor's intelligence.
  • Ensure quality, safety, and observability through monitoring, testing, guardrails, and iterative refinement of model behavior.
  • Share knowledge and elevate teammates, contributing to a culture of clarity, simplicity, and continuous learning.

Qualifications

Technical

  • 1+ years building complex LLM-based systems, with strong prompt engineering intuition and experience designing agentic workflows.
  • Ability to design meaningful evaluation methods, including custom metrics and frameworks when off-the-shelf options fall short.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, architectural thinking, and fluency in Python; comfortable working with production infrastructure, cloud environments, and CI/CD.
  • Actively follows AI research and emerging capabilities, applying new ideas creatively to real problems.

Product & Pedagogy

  • Strong empathy for learners and content creators; able to translate pedagogical goals into system behavior and product decisions.
  • Ability to reason holistically across AI behavior, content structure, platform features, and user experience.
  • Familiarity with learning science or a desire to develop expertise.

Character & Collaboration

  • Drawn to difficult, ambiguous problems with no clear blueprint; persistent in exploring and refining solutions.
  • Preference for elegance and simplicity in system design.
  • Communicates clearly across mediums and enjoys mentoring and collaborating in small, high-ownership teams.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible!
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we're awesome!

title: Principal Engineer - Electrical Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

SharkNinja is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively impact people’s lives in homes around the world. Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja, the company has a proven track record of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed SharkNinja to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than 4,100 associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world. 

AI at SharkNinja

At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.

SharkNinja is looking for a highly motivated Principal Electrical Engineer to join our R&D team in London. You’ll be a creative problem solver with a strong grasp of physics and electrical engineering fundamentals, passionate about tackling complex engineering challenges and bringing innovative products to market.

Our R&D team develops new technologies and shapes how our products work—from how a coffee maker brews to how an air fryer cooks, a blender blends, or a yet-to-be-invented kitchen device delivers something entirely new.

You’ll own the electrical and electronic architecture of our products, including power electronics, motor drive and control, heating control, sensing, and embedded hardware and firmware interfaces. Working across the full product lifecycle, from early concept through to mass production, you’ll combine deep technical expertise with hands-on experimentation and cross-functional collaboration.

Due to the hands-on nature of prototype development, this role is based in person at our London office.

What you’ll do

  • Lead electrical engineering development for new products, setting technical direction and acting as the lead engineer through development and delivery.
  • Define and develop electrical and electronic architectures, integrating power electronics, motors, heaters, sensors, power supplies, and embedded systems.
  • Design circuits, develop schematics and PCB layouts, and carry out PCBA bring-up, debugging, and testing.
  • Design and build prototypes to explore new technologies, prove concepts, and resolve complex engineering challenges.
  • Plan and run early-stage R&D experiments to identify the features and parameters that drive product performance.
  • Develop and execute test plans, analyse data, and translate findings into design improvements.
  • Collaborate with mechanical, software, firmware, and wider product development teams to deliver integrated product solutions.
  • Identify and resolve technical risks, balancing performance, reliability, safety, compliance, and manufacturability.
  • Support the transition from concept to mass production, resolving issues and continuously improving product performance.
  • Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

  • A BEng, MEng, MSc, or PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Typically 7–10+ years of experience in product design, electromechanical engineering, or consumer product development. Experience in household appliances or consumer goods is desirable.
  • Strong electrical engineering and physics fundamentals, including analogue and digital circuit design, power electronics, motor control, and the thermal behaviour of electrical systems.
  • Hands-on experience in circuit design, schematic capture, PCB layout, and PCBA bring-up and debugging.
  • Proficiency with oscilloscopes, power analysers, logic analysers, and data acquisition systems, alongside experience with sensors, motors, heaters, power supplies, and PCBAs.
  • Working knowledge of motor drive and control, such as BLDC, universal, or induction motors, alongside heater and power control.
  • Familiarity with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and prototyping platforms such as Arduino or Raspberry Pi.
  • Familiarity with UK/EU household appliance safety, EMC, and compliance requirements, including BS EN/IEC 60335, UKCA/CE marking, and RoHS.
  • An understanding of electronics and electromechanical production processes and design for manufacture.
  • Competence with CAD/EDA tools such as Altium, KiCad, or equivalent. Basic mechanical CAD capability is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a first-principles approach to developing robust, elegant, and innovative solutions.
  • Intellectual curiosity, a proactive approach, and a willingness to take ownership of technical problems through hands-on development and testing.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines, manage competing priorities, and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) status, or progress towards it, is desirable.
   

Our Culture

At SharkNinja, we don’t just raise the bar—we push past it every single day.  Our Outrageously Extraordinary mindset drives us to tackle the impossible, push boundaries, and deliver results that others only dream of. If you thrive on breaking out of your swim lane, you’ll be right at home.

We offer competitive health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, employee stock purchase options, wellness programs, SharkNinja product discounts, and more. We empower your personal and professional growth with high impact Learning Programs featuring bold voices redefining what’s possible. When you join, you’re not just part of a company—you’re part of an outrageously extraordinary community. Together, we won’t just launch products—we’ll disrupt entire markets.  

At SharkNinja, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are vital to our global success. Valuing each unique voice and blending all of our diverse skills strengthens SharkNinja’s innovation every day. With help from our leadership, associates, and our community, we aim to have equity be a key component of the SharkNinja DNA.
