title: Principal Solutions Architect
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Our Commerce & Technology division helps leading global brands design, build and run the commerce platforms behind their growth. We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect to lead solution in business pursuits and account growth, across enterprise commerce. 

You will be the person in the room who understands how the whole commerce estate fits together, from web storefront and mobile app through commerce platform, data and ERP.   You will turn that understanding into a clear case for business value, win the trust of senior client stakeholders, and when it helps, build a working demonstration to show them what good looks like. 
 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Architect Enterprise Commerce: Design end to end commerce solutions across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Shopify, HCL and composable (MACH) solutions, spanning web, mobile apps, data and back office systems.  
  • Lead with value: Frame every solution around commercial outcomes, cost and return, so clients can see clear cases for change rather than a technology shopping list.  
  • Serve as an outward-facing, energetic leader who runs workshops, participates in governance, and collaborates with commercial teams to identify and shape technical growth opportunities. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Client Engagement and Discovery: Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders. Run discovery workshops, ask the questions that uncover what really matters, and cut through complexity to the decisions that count. 
  • Solution Design and Architecture: Produce clear architecture diagrams and solution designs covering storefront, mobile apps, commerce platform, search, content, order management, product information, payments, data and other integrations. Recommend the right platform and approach for each client rather than defaulting to one. 
  • Platform Selection and Replatforming: Guide clients through platform choices and migrations, including the move from monolithic to composable, weighing total cost of ownership, speed to market, risk and operating model. 
  • Data, Integration and Back Office: Get into the detail of how commerce connects to ERP (such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Oracle), order management, warehouse, customer data and analytics, and design integration patterns that hold up at enterprise scale. 
  • Mobile and Omnichannel: Shape mobile app strategy and architecture (native, cross platform and headless) alongside web, store and marketplace channels, so the customer experience is joined up. 
  • Business Case and Value: Build business cases, value models and roadmaps that link technology decisions to revenue, conversion, margin and cost to serve. 
  • Demonstrations and Proofs of Concept: Stand up demo storefronts and prototypes quickly, such as a Shopify store or a composable proof of concept, to show clients what is possible and take risk out of their decisions. 
  • Proposals and Pitches: Own the solution story, architecture, assumptions and effort estimates in proposals, and present them with confidence at pitch. 
  • Handover and Delivery Assurance: Make sure what is sold can be delivered, with a clean handover to delivery teams and continued involvement through mobilisation. 
  • Market and Partner Leadership: Stay across the commerce market, including cloud (AWS, GCP), AI in commerce and agentic commerce. Share that knowledge to strengthen our propositions and our partner relationships. 

What we want from you 

  • Enterprise Commerce Experience: Extensive senior experience in enterprise commerce across retail, consumer brands or B2B, gained in digital agencies, consultancies or large brands. 
  • Breadth Across Platforms: Strong working knowledge of Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Shopify, plus composable and MACH (microservices, API first, cloud native, headless) components such as Commerce tools, Contentful, Algolia, Akeneo or similar. 
  • Presales and New Business: A track record of shaping and winning significant commerce deals, running workshops, writing proposals and presenting to senior audiences. 
  • Commercial Acumen: Understands how clients make money. Speaks confidently about value, cost and return, and can hold a commercial conversation with a Chief Executive or Chief Financial Officer as easily as with a Chief Technology Officer. 
  • Data and ERP Integration: Hands on understanding of how commerce connects with ERP, order management, product information, customer data and analytics, and the integration patterns that make it work. 
  • Mobile Apps: Solid understanding of mobile commerce app architecture and delivery, including native and cross platform approaches and how apps connect to headless commerce services. 
  • Architecture and Communication: Excellent diagramming, written and verbal skills. Able to turn complex estates into simple pictures and clear stories for senior audiences. 
  • Hands On Credibility: Comfortable building a demo store, configuring a platform or proving a concept yourself, rather than relying on slides alone. 
  • Presence: Energetic, confident and credible with clients. Able to cut through noise and lead the room. 

If you know some of this, even better 

  • Certifications across Adobe Commerce, Salesforce B2C Commerce or Shopify, MACH 
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional) and experience running commerce on Cloud solutions.  
  • Order management, product information management and marketplace platforms 
  • B2B commerce, including complex pricing, catalogue and account structures 
  • Agentic commerce concepts and emerging standards (ACP, AP2, A2A) and practical use of AI in commerce 
  • Total cost of ownership and business case modelling 
  • The C4 model and diagrams as code 

What we can offer you

Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.

Permanent only
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

How we use AI in the recruitment process:
 
To ensure more focused and engaging conversations, we leverage AI in our recruitment process exclusively for secure, objective note-taking, never for evaluative judgments. This allows our team to be fully present with you. You are always welcome to request a transcript of these notes or opt out of this feature at any time. Opting out will not impact  the outcome of the interview process" 

At  WPP Enterprise Solutions

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.  

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™  

To find out more, visit enterprisesolutions.wpp.com and follow us on LinkedIn. 

WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

title: Principal Solutions Delivery Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Solutions Delivery Manager to act as a senior implementation leader within our Solution Consulting organization. While our Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects guide customers through day-to-day deployments, the Solutions Director steps in as the strategic anchor for our largest, most complex, and highest-stakes enterprise implementations.

In this role, you will be responsible for three core pillars:

  1. Executive Oversight of Complex Deployments: Taking ownership of implementation success for strategic, global, and highly complex customer deployments (multi-entity, multi-ERP integrations, complex change management).

  2. Team Strategy & Process Scalability: Re-architecting and refining our implementation methodologies, governance frameworks, and delivery playbooks to support hyper-growth.

  3. Leadership Development: Mentoring, coaching, and upskilling a team of talented Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects, cultivating the next generation of professional services leaders at Zip.

If you are an experienced consulting or professional services leader who loves combining big-picture strategy with hands-on technical problem-solving, we want to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Our Most Complex Projects: Serve as the Executive Sponsor and senior implementation authority on strategic, Fortune 500, and highly customized enterprise deployments. Partner directly with C-suite executives and key customer stakeholders to navigate organizational complexity, mitigate deployment risk, and ensure time-to-value.

  • Define Implementation Strategy & Playbooks: Evaluate current delivery methodologies and design scalable, repeatable processes for discovery, solution architecture, workflow design, and testing. Drive standardization across the team without sacrificing flexibility.

  • Drive Leadership Development: Act as a player-coach and mentor to Senior Implementation Managers and Solutions Architects. Provide strategic guidance on project governance, stakeholder management, and technical delivery while fostering a high-performance, collaborative team culture.

  • Cross-Functional Executive Alignment: Partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success leadership. Translate complex implementation learnings and customer feedback into actionable product roadmap inputs and pre-sales scoping improvements.

What We’re Looking For

  • Senior Implementation Experience: 10+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation, professional services, solutions architecture, or management consulting—with at least 4+ years in a senior leadership or director-level capacity at a SaaS or B2B enterprise technology company.

  • Proven Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated success overseeing complex, multi-workstream deployments for large-scale enterprises (e.g., integrations with major ERPs like Workday, NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle; global rollouts; complex compliance and security requirements).

  • Strategic Process Builder: A track record of scaling professional services or implementation teams from startup/mid-market to enterprise maturity by designing robust methodologies, playbooks, and KPIs.

  • Passionate People Leader: Exceptional focus on mentorship and leadership development. You take pride in coaching individual contributors into top-tier strategic advisors and future team managers.

  • Executive Presence: Outstanding communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills. Comfortable challenging assumptions, managing scope creep, and guiding C-level customer stakeholders through transformative change.

  • Domain Expertise: Familiarity with procurement, finance, accounting, accounts payable (AP automation), or supply chain workflows is a strong plus.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Competitive Compensation: Top-tier salary, generous equity packages, and comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.

title: Product Designer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
As a Product Designer, you'll work on the H Platform, where our users create and run agentic AI workflows powered by our models. Nobody has written the playbook for designing these experiences yet. Our next stage is making the platform truly useful for its users and levelling it up, in design as much as in technology, and you'll build the product experiences that deliver real value in organisations.

At H Company, we believe AI should take action in the real world, and our mission is to make agentic AI genuinely useful for large organisations. We're pioneers in computer use: our own vision-language models power agents that see, click and type their way through the software businesses already run, with no integrations or rebuilds, and we own the whole stack, from research and models to the products built on top of them.

What you'll be doing

  • Talking to our users constantly to understand their needs and figure out what will make the platform truly useful for them.

  • Turning those insights into research and explorations, looking at problems from different angles before settling on a direction.

  • Picking the right tool for each task: a Figma design, a prototype, or a small PR when a quick change is the fastest way to ship.

  • Testing what you build with users, measuring its impact (A/B testing, user interviews, users daily use data...) and iterating quickly based on what you learn.

  • Shaping the roadmap together with the whole team, engineers and PMs alike.

Who you'll work with

The role sits in our Product team, which is responsible for product direction, strategy and design. You'll join the product designer who owns design and UX today, and work closely with product, engineering and forward deployed engineers.

What we think it takes

Above all, we want someone who cares deeply about users, has great product taste and can explain it, moves fast while keeping quality high, leaves their ego at the door and welcomes feedback.

Likely a good fit if you

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer at tech companies.

  • Have excellent UX, UI and interaction design skills, and can make complex, technical flows, like building and running AI agent workflows, feel simple and intuitive.

  • Have a portfolio that shows your latest work.

  • Have hands-on experience running user tests and A/B tests.

  • Know when a proven solution is good enough and when a problem deserves something new.

  • Have designed complex data or ML/AI-driven products: you know how to make complex systems understandable and how to design for AI behaviour that isn't always predictable, building trust and keeping users in control.

  • Are comfortable in technical discussions: you can dig into constraints and trade-offs with engineers and ramp up quickly on technical topics to discuss them with our researchers and more technical engineers.

  • Are fluent in Figma.

  • Can work within a design system and contribute to it.

Stronger still if you

  • Have designed platforms: complex B2B web or desktop software used by professionals, whether that's tools to build and run workflows, big data and analytics software, operational dashboards or other data-dense interfaces.

  • Are curious about code and AI in your design workflow. Every design team is still figuring out how AI changes the way we work, and we're no different, so we'd love someone who has started experimenting, whether by prototyping in code, building small tools or bringing AI into their process, and who wants to keep exploring with us.

If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway. We care far more about how you think, your curiosity and your care for users than a perfect match.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute portfolio review, a 60-minute design interview in person at our Paris office, and a closing 30-minute conversation.

The portfolio review and design interview are built around your own work and how you design. Please apply with your CV and a link to your portfolio showing your latest work.

We're a fast-growing team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies and leading enterprise manufacturers as customers. We ship fast, work close to the shopfloor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of.

The Role

As Product Engineer with a frontend focus, you'll build the product features our customers use every day, fully owning the product with a strong focus on usability and intuitive design. title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

  • Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

  • Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap

     

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture

  • Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

  • Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

  • Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

  • Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

  • Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

  • Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

  • Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

  • Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

What we offer

  • Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

  • Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

  • A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

  • Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

title: Product Marketing Lead

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Lead to own how the world understands our products and ecosystem. They will work closely with the product teams to frame product positioning, commercial narratives, and GTM strategies across our agentic platform, AI Materials Foundry and new products as they emerge.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the product marketing function that transforms CuspAI's deep scientific breakthroughs into clear, credible narratives, accelerating our GTM engine and scaling the global impact of our AI Materials Foundry.

Over time, you will scale the function by hiring, coaching, and leading a high-performing product marketing team.

What You Will Do

Platform Launch & Go-to-Market

  • Lead the end-to-end launch of science products, from early-access and design-partner programmes through announcement and general availability.

  • Work with Product, Commercial and Finance on pricing and packaging.

Product Positioning & Messaging Architecture

  • Own the messaging and naming architecture for new products, the AI Materials Foundry, and emerging product capabilities, working with leadership and Brand as the platform expands through regular releases.

  • Collaborate with AI Researchers, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure all performance claims are scientifically defensible and reflect current platform capabilities.

  • Own competitive positioning against general-purpose AI science assistants and specialist materials-discovery platforms, and keep competitive intelligence current for Commercial, Product and the Founders.

Foundry & Partner Ecosystem Marketing

  • Define and articulate the Foundry membership proposition, framing how network effects compound scientific discovery over time.

Sales Enablement & Customer Intelligence

  • Equip Commercial and Partnerships teams with pitch decks, one-pagers, and demo scripts.

  • Build customer case studies and reference stories in multiple formats.

Must Have Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product marketing within deep tech, scientific software, enterprise AI/ML platforms, semiconductors, or advanced industrial sectors.

  • Proven track record of building product positioning, messaging architectures, and GTM frameworks from scratch in high-growth environments.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate highly complex, deep-tech subject matter into clear, rigorous, and compelling commercial narratives without losing scientific accuracy.

  • Hands-on experience managing partner, ecosystem, or multi-sided platform marketing programs.

  • High autonomy and leadership aptitude, with a strong desire to transition from an individual contributor to building and managing a team as the company scales.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Direct experience marketing to buyers within semiconductors, chemicals, clean energy, or advanced manufacturing sectors.

  • Prior experience navigating scale-up dynamics in a fast-growing, post-Series B technology company.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, atomistic simulation tools, or scientific machine learning frameworks.

Additional Considerations

This role is ideally based in our London office (we would also consider Cambridge, Amsterdam or Berlin), with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

title: Production Engineer, Network Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

How We Operate

  • Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

  • Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

  • Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

  • Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

  • Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

The Production Engineering Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

  • Turn every network fault from a mystery into a closed ticket. Link diagnostics across router to router and NIC to router paths, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, because at 10s of GW scale debugging has to be systematic, not artisanal.

  • Build the network repair pipeline that runs itself. Automated fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver lifecycle tracking, and return to service, across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers, because a new site comes online every six months and manual repair doesn't keep up.

  • Build the network monitoring platform for a fleet that never stops growing. Alerting lifecycle and health dashboards for infrastructure spanning multiple hyperscale sites today and 10s of GW next year. It doesn't exist yet. We're building it.

Role Scope

  • Carry the on-call pager for the network fleet and run repair end to end: diagnose the fault, execute the fix or drive the RMA, and return the link to service across DC fabric, edge, and host to network layers.

  • Write Python and Go tooling that replaces manual diagnosis, including link tests, remote command execution across the fleet, and repair visualization that shows what's broken and why, so faults resolve in minutes, not hours.

  • Automate the repair pipeline from fault detection through RMA initiation, ticket integration, transceiver and optics tracking, and return to service, so a failure at any site follows the same path without manual handoffs.

  • Maintain the realtime monitoring and alerting that gives every on-call engineer a true picture of network health across all sites, and keep it accurate as new sites and hardware roll in.

  • Validate new sites and hardware into production by running the qualification tests that confirm a network is healthy before it carries traffic.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

  • You've carried a pager for a production network and can walk into an outage, find the fault, fix it or drive the RMA, and write the postmortem without someone walking you through it.

  • You've written Python or Go scripts that replaced a manual, repetitive network task, from link diagnostics to config pushes to fleet-wide command execution.

  • You understand how a transceiver fault, a misconfigured route, and a power event each show up differently in the data, and you can tell them apart from the signals alone.

  • You've worked hands-on with link diagnostics, optics, and network monitoring protocols such as gNMI, gRPC, NETCONF, and SONiC, and you're comfortable at the CLI on switches and routers across a fleet.

  • You treat toil as a bug. If a repair step means SSHing into ten boxes by hand, you script it once and never do it by hand again.

  • You reach real competence in an unfamiliar part of the stack fast, and you document what you learn so the next on-call engineer doesn't start from zero.

  • Bonus: RMA and repair lifecycle automation. Large-scale datacenter fabric (BGP, ECMP, spine-leaf). Out-of-band network management. Fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor to move faster on scripts and tooling.

Salary & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

  • Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

title: Projektingenieur Mittel-, Hoch- & Höchstspannung für Erneuerbare Energien (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Nachhaltigkeit denken. Zukunft gestalten. Gemeinsam handeln.

Du verfügst über ...

  • alternativ eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

Warum SCHNEPF?

Bei SCHNEPF arbeitest Du nicht nur an technischen Anlagen, sondern an der Energieversorgung von morgen. Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Team aus Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieuren entwickelst Du Lösungen für nachhaltige Energiesysteme, Netzanschlüsse und moderne Umspannwerke.

title: Quantitative Researcher, Optimisation
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Millions of parcels, thousands of couriers, and routing, pricing and scheduling decisions needed in real time and under uncertainty. Relay's last mile is a growing optimisation problem that never sits still.

Relay's in-house solver has carried the business through more than 100x growth, built by a team of Operational Research Scientists who designed the decision architecture the network runs on. You'll join them and take it further.

Optimisation Highlights

  • An in-house solver, built and owned by our own Operational Research team, running live at scale.

  • Routing, pricing and scheduling decisions made in real time and under uncertainty.

  • ML and recommender intelligence integrated into the decision models.

  • A flexible network: pitstops can change, warehouse automation can be reconfigured, and new processes roll out overnight.

The Opportunity

As a Quantitative Researcher at Relay, you'll:

  • Lead optimisation for Relay's last mile, making the best routing, pricing and scheduling decisions for couriers and the wider network.

  • Model and optimise the decisions that define our last-mile delivery network and marketplace.

  • Develop our solvers and algorithms so they perform live, and at scale.

  • Partner with other Scientists to unite ML and recommender systems with Operational Research.

  • Raise the standard for Operational Research at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Bring deep expertise in operational research, whether from a PhD, publications, or years at the frontier in industry.

  • Come from operational research or industrial engineering, or from an advanced quantitative discipline, including trading, that has branched into optimisation.

  • Have built optimisation systems or ML models that run in production, and owned the outcome.

  • Are energised by large, messy problems, and know how to bring structure to them.

  • Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: R&D Mechanic
descriptionHtml:
About us

We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies.

Driven by a mission to create versatile and trustworthy embodied AI for physical labor, we fuse deep engineering mastery in AI and mechatronics with a rapid-execution culture. We are addressing the labor shortage by closing the gap to production-grade deployment. This means building the trusted alternative: robots that are safe, secure, and engineered to automotive standards of scale and durability.

We are well-capitalized and now assembling our team.

Our Locations: Vesoma has two main locations: Munich, Germany and Limassol, Cyprus. This pan-European setup represents our core ambition of building a European technology leader, gives us a great talent base and a strong corporate structure.

Your mission

As an R&D Mechanic, you join the early team and bring our designs to life. You build the prototypes of our humanoid - an industrial-grade machine built for the highest levels of reliability and performance - to the highest standard of precision. You don't just assemble: you improve how every system is built, serviced and tuned.

Key responsibilities

  • Precision Assembly: Lead the build of complex mechatronic systems and handle evolving R&D designs with a first-time-right mindset.

  • Workshop Ownership: Own the assembly area to the highest standards of cleanliness, tool organization and hardware inventory.

  • Quality Control: Lead the inspection of incoming precision parts and verify supplier quality with professional metrology equipment.

  • Fabrication & Fixtures: Modify parts and build custom jigs and fixtures that simplify assembly and servicing of the robot.

  • Design Feedback: Feed assembly and service insights back to the design engineers to improve every iteration.

Your profile

We seek builders ready to move beyond theory to real deployment: professionals who value precision and reliability as much as innovation.

Must have

  • Experience: 3+ years in high-end precision mechanical assembly (e.g. motorsports, aerospace, medical devices, precision gears or high-end robotics).

  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with precision hand tools, gauges and measuring equipment.

  • Drawing Literacy: Able to read and interpret complex 3D assemblies and technical drawings, including GD&T.

  • Quality Control: Experience inspecting parts with precision measuring tools and documenting the results.

  • Mindset: You are precise, organized and document your work carefully. You thrive where speed and precision must coexist, and you know there is no room for "good enough".

Nice to have

  • Manual Machining: Proven ability to operate a lathe and milling machine.

  • CNC & CAM: Experience with 5-axis CNC setup, maintenance and CAM programming.

  • CAD Modeling: Ability to model simple parts and fixtures in CAD.

title: Regional Account Relationship Manager – IFA Distribution (London & South East)
descriptionHtml:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.

A feel for our culture

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.

Does this sound like you?

Flagstone is the UK's leading cash platform with £19bn in AuA and a mandate to reach £50bn by 2028. The IFA and wealth manager channel is one of the most significant growth opportunities in front of the business, with over 1,400 registered IFA firms already on the platform and many more still to bring on board.

The role combines proactive business development with ongoing relationship management. On one side, you'll be deepening engagement with our existing base of registered firms, and turning platform access into active, consistent referral behaviour. On the other, you'll be identifying new IFA firms across London and the South East who aren't on Flagstone yet, introducing the proposition and building the relationship from first meeting through to active referral partner.

What You'll Be Doing

Proactive Partner Engagement & Development

  • Own your territory of IFA firms and wealth managers, taking personal responsibility for the breadth and depth of engagement and the referral activity it generates

  • Spend the majority of your time in the field visiting adviser firms, attending regional industry events, and building face-to-face relationships that create consistent, long-term referral partners

  • Deepen engagement with our existing base of registered firms who aren't yet referring regularly, understanding what's holding them back and taking targeted action to unlock their activity

  • Grow the volume and value of referrals from existing active partners by helping them identify more clients who could benefit from Flagstone

  • Identify IFA firms not yet on Flagstone, introducing the proposition and building the relationship from first meeting through to active referral partner

Proposition Training & Education

  • Deliver clear, confident, and compelling presentations of the Flagstone proposition to IFA firms individually and in group settings

  • Train advisers on the Flagstone referral portal and onboarding process, reducing friction and building confidence so that making a referral feels straightforward

  • Keep partner firms up to date with product developments and platform enhancements

  • Use insight from adviser conversations to feed back proposition gaps, platform friction points, or competitive pressures

Reactive Support & Partner Feedback

  • Act as a knowledgeable and responsive point of contact for your partner firms when they have questions about Flagstone, the referral process, or platform features

  • Resolve queries with pace and accuracy, always closing the loop with the adviser

  • Act as a structured source of intelligence from the IFA market back into Flagstone, capturing and communicating what advisers are telling you about the platform, proposition, and competitive landscape

  • Feed adviser feedback directly into the product development process, flagging friction points, missing features, and enhancements that would most meaningfully increase referral activity

Pipeline & Performance

  • Maintain a clear and current picture of your regional pipeline through tracking firm engagement levels, referral volumes, and conversion activity

  • Report regularly to the Relationships Team Lead on the health of your territory - what is working, where the opportunities are, and where support is needed

What You'll Bring

Field Sales & Relationship Management

  • Experience in a field based sales or relationship management role, with a proven track record of building trusted commercial relationships face to face

  • Genuine comfort being out in the field every day, covering a broad and geographically diverse territory - you need to be energised by travel, variety, and independence

  • The personal presence and communication skills to represent Flagstone confidently in front of independent financial advisers and wealth managers

Financial Services Knowledge

  • You don't need direct cash management experience to succeed in this role, that can be trained. What matters more is a genuine track record of building trusted adviser relationships, whether that's from a platform, wrap, DFM, or a wider intermediary facing background.

  • Familiarity with the regulatory landscape: directly authorised firms, Appointed Representatives, and network members

  • Financial literacy to have credible, confident conversations with advisers about how the Flagstone proposition fits within their clients' wider financial planning

Commercial Drive & Self-Direction

  • A commercially motivated self-starter who takes personal ownership of regional performance and manages their own diary and territory plan

  • Organised and disciplined in how you manage a complex regional portfolio: you plan your visits, track your pipeline, and follow up consistently across a large number of relationships simultaneously

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

  • A range of salary sacrifice options to help you make tax efficient savings on electric cars, nursery schemes, home and tech goods.

  • Around the World scheme - 3 months work from anywhere scheme

  • Mental wellbeing support - Access therapy and mental health sessions through Spill

  • Learning and development - £1,000 personal development budget to help you grow in your role.

  • Private health care - Enjoy all the benefits AXA has to offer, including reduced gym memberships and medical history disregarded

  • Medical cash plan - To help you with the costs of dental and optical expenses

  • Life insurance and Income Protection- four times your annual salary for peace of mind

  • Matched pension contributions up to 5%

  • 25 days holiday - plus bank holidays, well-being days and volunteering days

  • Enhanced Parental Leave - enhanced maternity, paternity and adoption pay.  

All are welcome.

At Flagstone, we’re assembling a diverse team that defies our industry’s norms. Think this role could suit you? We encourage you to apply, no matter your background.

title: Regional Sales Director, Core Enterprise – DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is building its Core Enterprise business in the DACH region, and we are hiring a Regional Sales Director to lead it. This is a build role in a new market: you will create the pipeline machine from the ground up, rather than inherit an established team or playbook.

You will lead a team of six Enterprise Account Executives. The team sells deals of €100K–€300K AOV over four to six month cycles, so the role calls for pace and velocity paired with value-based selling rigour.

This role is remote, and you can be based anywhere in Germany. Munich, Düsseldorf and Cologne are our key hub cities for the region.

In this role, you will

  • Own the performance, development and day-to-day leadership of a team of six Enterprise Account Executives
  • Build a pipeline machine in a new market: define the target accounts, segments and motions that generate repeatable new business across Germany, Austria and Switzerland
  • Create and embed a team playbook covering prospecting, qualification, deal progression and handover, so the team sells consistently and new hires ramp quickly
  • Coach the team through each deal cycle, driving execution and velocity and embedding MEDDIC and Command of the Message
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large DACH enterprises. This isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles (cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping) that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the region's largest accounts
  • Run a structured operating rhythm of pipeline reviews, deal inspection and forecasting
  • Coordinate ADRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineering and partners around your team's priorities, influencing functions you do not directly own
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged and high-performing team, developing AEs into strong Core Enterprise sellers
  • Partner closely with your peer Regional Sales Directors, Samsara's wider leadership and Customer Success to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and into new markets

Minimum requirements for the role

  • Three or more years of proven success leading new business sales at enterprise level, with a track record of revenue delivery and overachievement against target
  • Has built something rather than inherited it, with experience building a market or a new sales function from scratch
  • Full team lifecycle experience: has recruited, ramped and retained a team, and can show where each happened
  • Direct experience selling into enterprise companies at comparable deal sizes and cycle lengths
  • Experience establishing rigour in value-based selling, using methodologies such as MEDDIC or Command of the Message
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate supporting functions to drive pipeline and close business
  • Fluent German and based in Germany

An ideal candidate also has

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company, helping to build or refine the enterprise go-to-market playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style, with a record of developing AEs from good to exceptional
  • Intelligence and genuine coachability: you learn fast, welcome feedback and apply it
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial streak: you create momentum without needing to own every function involved
  • Experience leading and engaging a remote team across multiple cities
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you are expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity: you can set the market strategy and also step into a deal review to show a rep where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: IT Security Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die Braintower Technologies für innovative IT-Security- und Netzwerklösungen, sichere Business-Kommunikation sowie ganzheitliche Managed Services – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Zur Verstärkung unseres dreiköpfigen IT-Security-Teams, das in einer Remote-First-Kultur zusammenarbeitet, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Schutz der IT-Systeme, Netzwerke und Daten unserer Kund:innen vor Cyberangriffen und Sicherheitsrisiken

  • Analyse aktueller Cyberbedrohungen sowie Optimierung von Sicherheitslösungen zur Erkennung bekannter und neuer Angriffsmuster

  • Durchführung von Schwachstellenanalysen mit Tenable (Nessus & Exposure Management) sowie Beratung unserer Kund:innen bei der Bewertung und Behebung von Sicherheitslücken

  • Auswahl, Implementierung und Überwachung von IT-Sicherheitslösungen in den Bereichen SIEM, SOC, EDR und NDR, beispielsweise mit Microsoft Defender und Huntress

  • Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Sicherheitsmaßnahmen rund um Identity & Access Management (IAM), Zertifikatsinfrastrukturen und Cyberabwehr

  • Weiterentwicklung der IT-Sicherheitsarchitektur unserer Kund:innen sowie Dokumentation sicherheitsrelevanter Systeme und Prozesse

  • Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Security-Tickets über Jira (perspektivisch ServiceNow) sowie Einsatz von Tufin SecureTrack im Netzwerk-Sicherheitsmanagement

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT-Security sowie gute Kenntnisse in LAN-/WAN-Netzwerken und Firewall-Lösungen mit, idealerweise mit Fortinet

  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung im Vulnerability Management und im Umgang mit Schwachstellenscannern wie Tenable Nessus, Microsoft Defender oder OpenVAS

  • Du kennst dich mit Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) aus und hast idealerweise bereits mit Microsoft Defender XDR gearbeitet.

  • Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse in der Administration von Windows- und Linux-Servern und bist mit der Netzwerktechnik vertraut

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert, kommunizierst klar und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie den direkten Kundenkontakt

  • Du kannst mit IT-Security-Zertifizierungen wie Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA Security+, CySA+ oder Fortinet-Zertifizierungen zusätzlich punkten

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Orientierung an unseren Servicezeiten (7–17 Uhr) und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

title: Manager, Legal Programs, Privacy & AI (EU/UK)
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is looking for an outstanding Manager, Legal Programs, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) to join our growing Legal team. We’re looking for a curious, proactive privacy and AI governance professional to play a central role in running and scaling the systems our UK and European businesses use to protect personal data and govern AI.

Focusing primarily on our privacy program, with a share of your time on our AI governance program, you will report to our Senior Counsel, Privacy & AI (EU/UK) and partner closely with our EU/UK privacy team, our Data Protection Officer, our global Privacy & AI Legal team, and teams across the business to maintain our privacy commitments, build out responsible AI practices, and help solve complex legal and compliance problems at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and consumer products. This is a remote role open to candidates based in the UK or EU.

You Will:

Privacy Program

  • Help lead the day-to-day operations of our EU/UK privacy program, developing the processes, workflows, and documentation that support compliance with the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, and related laws across the region.

  • Manage the data subject rights process for the region, coordinating access, deletion, and other requests with Patient Support, Engineering, and Legal.

  • Administer our consent management platform and coordinate its rollout across brands and markets with Engineering, Marketing, and Product teams.

  • Help build and maintain core privacy records, including data maps, records of processing activities, DPIA and legitimate interests assessment registers, and records of international data transfers.

  • Coordinate privacy reviews within our vendor risk management process, including questionnaire triage, DPA tracking, and escalation to counsel.

  • Support privacy incident response with intake, tracking, documentation, and deadline management.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation for rights requests, incidents, training, and other accountability processes.

  • Coordinate privacy training and awareness activities for teams in the region.

AI Governance Program

  • Help maintain the UK and EU portion of our inventory of AI systems and use cases, including records that support EU AI Act classification.

  • Coordinate intake of new AI use cases from the region into our global AI governance process.

  • Support AI incident response for the region, in coordination with our global AI incident response process.

Across Both Programs

  • Own implementation responsibility for strategic legal initiatives that require close cross-functional work with Product, Engineering, and Marketing

  • Track program initiatives, owners, and milestones, and prepare metrics and status reporting for regional and global leadership.

  • Keep program procedures and playbooks current in the team’s knowledge base.

  • Coordinate with Legal and Public Policy teams to monitor evolving UK and EU privacy and AI legislation and translate new requirements into practical program updates

You Have:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience - Required

  • 6+ years of experience in privacy operations or legal program management, with a focus on UK or EU data protection - Required

  • Working knowledge of the UK GDPR and EU GDPR, with hands-on experience running data subject request processes and maintaining records of processing activities or DPIA registers

  • Experience administering privacy tools, such as consent management or privacy management platforms

  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and/or emerging AI regulation, including the EU AI Act

  • Experience managing stakeholders and cross-functional teams from project initiation through close

  • Organizational skills with experience managing multiple and sometimes competing priorities

  • Project management, time-management and organizational skills

  • Demonstrated aptitude for problem-solving and delivering operational results

  • Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams and interacting with a diverse range of stakeholders, ranging from front-line engineers to strategic company leadership

  • Comfortable working with colleagues across US and European time zones

  • Healthcare or telehealth experience, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT certification, and working proficiency in French, German, or Spanish are a plus

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

title: People Partner Engineering & Product
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role
We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

You'll support Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams, getting to know their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs. Much of the role is coaching: helping leads handle feedback, performance, growth, and change well, and surfacing people issues early. You'll work as part of the wider People team, with Employee Relations and People Ops alongside you on more complex cases.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys coaching, can context-switch quickly, builds trust easily, and brings clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

You will

  • Partner with Engineering and Product leaders across our international teams to support team health, performance, and talent density.

  • Coach leads and managers through people challenges, including feedback, performance, conflict, growth conversations, and team change.

  • Run proactive 1:1 sessions mainly with leads, and with peeps where needed, surfacing issues early.

  • Contribute to organisational design work, advising on team structures, spans and layers, and capability gaps.

  • Support leaders and teams through change, such as team moves and new ways of working.

  • Support key People programs (performance reviews, engagement, recognition, and lead enablement) for Engineering and Product.

  • Work with Employee Relations and, where required, Legal Counsel on early-stage ER issues, escalating complex cases.

  • Spot patterns across teams and share them with the wider People team to shape new People initiatives.

  • Work with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, and local requirements in each country where needed.

Requirements

  • Experience supporting leaders and teams through people topics such as performance, coaching, growth, and team change.

  • Strong coaching skills, with the confidence to guide managers through difficult conversations.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable with both partnership and hands-on execution when needed.

  • Comfortable working with leaders across different timezones and cultures; experience supporting globally distributed or multi-jurisdiction teams is a strong plus.

  • Experience supporting Engineering or Product teams.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in on the East Coast USA or Europe

Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Finance.

DEINE MISSION

Als Senior Oracle Data Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Datenbanklösungen und gestaltest performante, sichere Anwendungen auf Basis von Oracle-Technologien. Du bringst deine Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL und Oracle Data Integrator ein, koordinierst das Entwicklerteam und sorgst mit sicherem Auftreten dafür, dass Projektleitung und Endkunde jederzeit bestens abgeholt sind.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenbanklösungen auf Basis von Oracle sowie SQL und PL/SQL

  • Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Integrationsprozessen mit Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) sind wünschenswert

  • Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung für Themen und Anforderungen im Projektkontext

  • Aktive Unterstützung und Koordination des Entwicklerteams

  • Zügige Einarbeitung in neue Technologien und Themenstellungen

  • Nutzung von Jira und Confluence zur Planung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung der Entwicklungsarbeiten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie Visual Studio Code

  • Moderation, Kommunikation und adressatengerechte Vermittlung technischer Inhalte

  • Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Oracle-Datenbanken sowie SQL und PL/SQL

  • Grundkenntnisse in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)

  • Erfahrung mit Jira und Confluence

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen, beispielsweise Visual Studio Code

  • Fähigkeit zur Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung

  • Gute Moderations-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten

  • Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte adressatengerecht zu vermitteln

  • Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

    Nice to have:

  • Data-Vault-Datenmodellierung

  • Containerisierung mit Podman

  • Oracle Analytics Server

  • Oracle APEX

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

title: Senior Tools Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Companion Group is a AAA co-development gaming studio with a globally distributed and fully remote setup, renowned for its adeptness in overcoming the most intricate challenges in multiplayer game development. Our reputation precedes us as an excellent choice for clients aspiring to elevate their latest multiplayer titles, enabling scalability in player numbers, maximising player density, and crafting immersive gameplay experiences.
 

Embedded seamlessly within a client's in-house team, we collaborate harmoniously to turn dreams into reality. Our portfolio boasts groundbreaking games developed in collaboration with major studios worldwide. As a fully remote studio with colleagues across the globe, we value and emphasise clear, continuous, and transparent communication as highly as technical skills.
 

As our Senior Tools Engineer, you will play a key role in building a log monitoring and coordination system designed to work with Unreal Engine, process event data, and ultimately provide robust, scalable insights into gameplay sessions. 

If you're comfortable in Linux environments, have backend experience, and are excited about working on foundational tools that interface with game systems, we want to hear from you!



Responsibilities:

  • Lead the development of internal tools that run on Linux-based environments.

  • Help define and standardize development workflows and best practices in Linux for the team.

  • Build and maintain back-end systems that ingest, process, and report on gameplay session data.

  • Collaborate with game teams to integrate tools with Unreal Engine — including reading, managing, and altering log output and server-side controls.

  • Design tooling interfaces that receive commands, push updates, and generate actionable reports.

Required Skills: 

  • Strong proficiency with Linux environments, especially in development and deployment contexts.

  • Experience with C# & C++.

  • Solid understanding of backend engineering principles — including system design, service communication, and data pipelines.

  • Working knowledge of Unreal Engine, particularly in relation to logging, runtime controls, and server communication.

  • Ability to understand complex event graphs and gameplay state data structures.

  • Clear, proactive communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
     

Rewards:

  • Competitive salary ranging from £50,000 to £70,000 Per Annum

  • Embark on a clearly defined career ladder, enabling you to progress in responsibilities and be rewarded accordingly.

  • Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role, collaborating with top game developers from around the world.

  • Join forces with industry leaders who will inspire and guide you on your path to success.
     

Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of online gaming experiences!
