title: SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist
descriptionHtml:
SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist – Technical SEO, Google Ads & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Experience Level: Mid-Level to Senior
Department: Digital Marketing / Growth Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist to develop, execute, and optimize digital marketing strategies that increase organic traffic, improve search rankings, generate qualified leads, and drive measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, paid social advertising, content optimization, marketing analytics, and automation. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently manage campaigns, identify growth opportunities, and turn marketing data into actionable strategies.

You’ll take ownership of organic search performance, paid advertising, website optimization, and lead generation while exploring emerging opportunities in AI-powered search optimization (AEO/GEO).

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and execute SEO strategies to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and search intent analysis.
  • Perform technical SEO audits, addressing indexing, crawling, site architecture, page speed, and mobile performance.
  • Optimize meta titles, descriptions, headings, internal linking, URLs, and structured data.
  • Execute ethical link-building strategies and monitor search algorithm updates.
  • Optimize content for traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences (AEO/GEO).

Paid Advertising & Lead Generation

  • Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads.
  • Manage advertising budgets to improve lead quality, Cost per Lead (CPL), and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).
  • Develop and optimize landing pages, lead capture forms, and conversion funnels.
  • Implement retargeting and remarketing campaigns.
  • Collaborate with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.

Content Marketing & Website Management

  • Develop SEO-driven content strategies aligned with business objectives.
  • Create and optimize website copy, blog articles, and landing pages.
  • Manage website updates through WordPress, Webflow, or similar CMS platforms.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and content creators to improve website performance and user experience.

Analytics, Reporting & Optimization

  • Monitor traffic, keyword rankings, conversions, and campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Build performance dashboards and provide actionable marketing reports.
  • Conduct A/B testing across landing pages, advertisements, and campaigns.
  • Analyze user behavior and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.

Marketing Automation & CRM

  • Manage email marketing campaigns, lead nurturing sequences, and automated workflows.
  • Work with platforms such as HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or ActiveCampaign.
  • Improve lead tracking, marketing attribution, and sales handoffs.
  • Maintain accurate campaign data and performance reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in SEO, digital marketing, or performance marketing.
  • Proven success improving organic rankings, website traffic, and qualified lead generation.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content optimization.
  • Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar tools.
  • Experience managing Google Ads and paid social media campaigns.
  • Familiarity with WordPress, Webflow, or other CMS platforms.
  • Understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), landing pages, and lead generation funnels.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to translate data into actionable improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple campaigns and meet deadlines.
  • Availability during U.S. Business Hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
  • Knowledge of local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and technical website improvements.
  • Experience in B2B marketing, SaaS, professional services, or lead-generation businesses.
  • Experience with Looker Studio and advanced marketing reporting.
  • Certifications in Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or SEO.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of marketing performance and focus on measurable results.
  • You understand how SEO, paid advertising, content, and conversion optimization work together.
  • You can independently develop strategies, execute campaigns, and analyze performance.
  • You’re proactive about identifying growth opportunities and testing improvements.
  • You stay informed about search engine updates and emerging AI-powered marketing trends.
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with remote teams.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing GA4, Google Search Console, and advertising dashboards to evaluate traffic, keyword rankings, and lead generation performance. You’ll investigate SEO opportunities, optimize paid campaigns, update website content, or improve landing page conversions.

You may also configure marketing automation workflows, analyze campaign results, and collaborate with sales or development teams to implement improvements.

In short: You’ll manage SEO, paid advertising, analytics, and marketing automation to generate qualified leads and drive measurable business growth.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Organic Traffic Growth: Increase qualified organic website traffic.
  • Keyword Rankings: Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords.
  • Lead Generation: Increase marketing-qualified leads from organic and paid channels.
  • Conversion Rate: Improve website and landing page conversions.
  • Cost per Lead (CPL): Optimize advertising spend and acquisition efficiency.
  • Return on Ad Spend (ROAS): Improve paid campaign profitability.
  • Technical SEO Health: Maintain indexing, crawling, and website performance.
  • Marketing Attribution: Ensure accurate tracking of leads, conversions, and campaign results.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced SEO Specialist, Digital Marketing Specialist, or Performance Marketing Professional with expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, analytics, and lead generation, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a remote team where you can take ownership of digital marketing initiatives, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable business results.

descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As a Customer Care Specialist at RoomPriceGenie, you’ll play a key role in giving our clients excellent service. You’ll respond to inquiries, solve problems, help customers get the most out of our system and make sure they have a smooth experience. You’ll be part of a collaborative team that works together to keep improving customer satisfaction. If you’re passionate about customer care and enjoy a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, we’d love to hear from you!

We regularly hire Customer Care Specialists, especially for these markets:

  • Germany (DACH)

  • Spain

  • UK & Ireland

  • North America

  • Benelux

  • Australia & New Zealand

This is our talent pool for Customer Care roles. There may not be an open position right now, but by applying here you’ll be the first to hear from us when a role opens up in your market.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer inquiries

    • Give timely and accurate answers to customer questions via email, chat and phone.

    • Handle concerns and issues with professionalism and empathy, so every customer has a positive experience.

  • Solve problems

    • Troubleshoot and resolve customer issues efficiently.

    • Work with other teams to resolve more complex issues.

  • Share product knowledge

    • Build and maintain in-depth knowledge of the RoomPriceGenie system.

    • Explain product features, functionalities and best practices to customers.

    • Guide customers on how to use the system and our self-service resources.

  • Documentation & knowledge management

    • Keep accurate records of customer interactions, requests and complaints.

    • Update the knowledge base and FAQs so customers and internal teams always have up-to-date information.

  • Customer feedback

    • Collect and analyse customer feedback to find areas for improvement.

    • Share actionable insights with the team to help improve our product and services.

  • Cross-functional collaboration

    • Work with teams such as Revenue Management and Technical Support & Integrations to give customers seamless support.

    • Work closely with the product team to share customer feedback and improve the overall customer experience.

Your Profile

  • C2-level proficiency in the main language of your market (e.g. German, Spanish or Dutch) and fluent English, with excellent communication skills

  • Based in or close to the time zone of the market you’d cover

  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

  • Able to work independently and as part of a team

  • Prior customer support experience is a plus

Nice to Have

  • Additional languages

  • Experience in a SaaS or travel tech company

  • Hospitality experience or a passion for helping hotels

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

title: Research Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the role:

 

The Research Manager role is central to Legal 500’s strategic growth, leading the delivery of high-quality, lawyer-led coverage of our global market. Based in our new Leeds office, you will manage a team of Research Analysts, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of editorial projects, and fostering a high-performing, supportive team culture.

 

This is a hands-on leadership position that combines people management, project oversight, and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with our Senior Editors and Chief Research Officer, alongisde commercial colleagues to identify priority markets, manage research cycles, maintain quality standards, and build relationships with partner-level lawyers and business development teams in leading law firms.

 

The role requires excellent organisational skills, a proactive and results-driven mindset, and the ability to manage competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

 

What we're looking for:

 

The ideal candidate will be a proven people manager with strong communication skills, able to motivate and coach a team while delivering complex projects to schedule. You will be comfortable working independently, confident in decision-making, and able to build credibility with senior stakeholders both internally and externally.

 

Essential experience:

  • Proven line management experience, including performance reviews and development planning

  • Track record of delivering project-based work to deadlines

  • Experience in research-led, editorial, or data-informed environments

  • Comfortable operating independently in a deadline-driven context

 

Desirable experience:

  • Background in market research, publishing, insight generation, or similar industries

  • Exposure to professional services, B2B environments, or legal markets (advantageous but not essential)

  • Experience liaising with commercial or client-facing teams

 

From a competency perspective, we’re looking for someone who is:

  • An effective supervisor: sets clear goals, motivates the team, and delivers constructive feedback

  • A strong communicator: able to engage confidently with law firm partners, business development professionals, and internal stakeholders

  • Results-oriented: able to keep projects on track and maintain team focus across competing deadlines

  • Organised and detail-oriented: ensures all research output meets accuracy and consistency standards

  • A relationship builder: credible, approachable, and able to maintain strong professional relationships at all levels

  • Adaptable and resilient: thrives in a fast-moving environment and responds positively to change

  • A culture contributor: fosters an inclusive, respectful, and high-performing team culture

Role information:

  • This role is based in Leeds (central location, close to Leeds station)

  • Hybrid working – 3 days a week in the office, 2 days remote

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will develop the proprioceptive motion control layer to enable our robots to do high contact manipulation predictably, smoothly, and safely under varied and uncertain conditions.

  • Design and implement model- and learning-based estimation and control algorithms, along with the runtime loops that form the backbone for teleoperation and our AI-driven manipulation, from simulation to the real robot system.

  • Debug and diagnose complex system behaviors spanning the interplay of hardware, software, and algorithms.

  • Own robot bring-up, including validation and refinement of our robot model descriptions (URDF, MuJoCo XML, USD, etc.) for simulation and control, characterizing and adjusting for the sim-to-real gap as needed.

  • Work together with both our hardware team and our AI researchers to continuously assess and push the performance of our full stack robot system

What We're Looking For

  • Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

  • Excellent theoretical and practical grasp of model and learning based whole-body control and state estimation

  • Experience with robot simulation environments (MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or similar) and robot description files (URDF, USD, etc.)

  • Proven ability to take complex algorithms from concept through hardware integration to production-ready real-time robot software

  • Strong proficiency in Python, complemented by efficient low-level programming skills in Rust or C/C++

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Hands-on experience with tensor and automatic differentiation frameworks such as JAX, PyTorch, CppAD, Burn, or similar.

  • Experience with whole-body force estimation

  • Experience in developing reinforcement learning based robot control

  • Experience in robot safety, including Control Barrier Functions and/or relevant industry certifications.

  • Experience in contact rich manipulation, preferably including teleoperation and interfacing with large behavior models such as VLAs.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

title: Sales Enablement Lead
descriptionHtml:

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The role

We're hiring our first dedicated Security Engineer to protect our technology and our customers' data. You'll work across the systems behind TabPFN, from cloud infrastructure and software to enterprise deployments.

You'll work with engineers to understand risks, design secure systems and build the tools to protect them. The role spans cloud and product security, incident response, and technical work with customers and auditors.

We're looking for a strong infrastructure engineer who wants to focus on security. Your experience could come from platform engineering, SRE, backend development or a security role.

What you'll do

- Review system designs and code, identify security risks, and help engineers address them throughout development.

- Build security controls and automation for our cloud infrastructure, software and deployment pipelines.

- Improve identity and access management for people and services, including permissions, secrets and access changes.

- Assess vulnerabilities, coordinate penetration tests and work with engineering teams to prioritise and deliver fixes.

- Develop detection and recovery capabilities, investigate incidents and lead the technical response with engineering teams.

- Support customer security reviews and the technical controls for SOC 2 and ISO 27001. Our Operations team coordinates the audit programme.

What we're looking for

- Hands-on experience building and running cloud infrastructure, including GCP or AWS, IAM, CI/CD and containers.

- Experience writing and maintaining infrastructure as code and automation in a team.

- An interest in security that you've put into practice through work, personal projects, CTFs or relevant training.

- Sound judgment about which risks need attention first, and an interest in the breadth of the role, including audits and customer conversations.

- The ability to explain a risk clearly and work with other engineers to address it.

- Practical use of AI tools to improve engineering workflows.

- Based in Berlin or Freiburg, or willing to relocate. We consider remote work within the EU by exception.

What sets you apart

- Experience in cloud or application security, penetration testing, or acting as your team's security contact.

- Work on container and software supply-chain security.

- Experience supporting SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits, or taking responsibility for security at a smaller company.

 

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

We care about how your data is handled - see our Recruiting Data Privacy page

title: Senior Accountant
descriptionHtml:
Senior Accountant

About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're seeking a Senior Accountant to own core financial operations across Radiant's fast-scaling platform and help build the finance function as we grow. Working closely with the Head of Group Reporting, Finance Manager and senior finance management, you'll take full ownership of AR/AP, month-end and year-end close, reconciliations, and entity setup - ensuring accurate financial reporting, strong controls, and timely insights that enable business decisions.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to take real ownership, mentor junior team members, and shape how financial operations scale with rapid growth. You'll have visibility across the full finance function, work across multiple jurisdictions, and play a central role in audit processes and strategic reporting. If you are an experienced accountant who thrives on responsibility and wants to be a trusted leader in a fast-moving business, this is your opportunity.

What You'll Do

  • Own Revenue & AR and Expenses & AP processes end-to-end, establishing robust controls, driving accuracy, resolving complex queries, and ensuring timely collections and payment approvals that maximize vendor relationships

  • Lead month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes, reviewing journals, accruals, and management schedules, and ensure all stakeholders have timely, accurate reporting

  • Oversee revenue billing and reconciliations, managing the complete cycle from billing accuracy to resolution external discrepancies

  • Take ownership of year-end financial statement preparation, including supporting schedules, disclosures, and technical accounting decisions

  • Act as the primary contact for external auditors, coordinating audit deliverables, resolving technical accounting questions, and driving resolution of audit matters

  • Lead the finance and accounting workstream for new global entity setups, navigating multi-jurisdictional complexity and establishing proper financial foundations from day one

  • Mentor and review work from junior team members, building their technical skills, quality control, and understanding of our accounting approach

  • Collaborate across the broader finance team and business stakeholders, building effective relationships and ensuring timely, accurate financial information flows across the organization

  • Drive continuous improvement in financial controls, accounting processes, and reporting procedures, identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and strengthen our financial foundation.

What You'll Bring

  • Fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 4-7 years of accounting experience, gained in public accounting or industry roles, ideally in multi-entity or international environments.

  • Strong Excel capabilities, accounting system knowledge, and ability to pick up new tools and processes quickly.

  • Strong technical accounting and financial reporting skills, you understand accounting standards and controls and can navigate complex transactions.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy, you maintain high standards while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving ability, you investigate issues thoroughly and drive resolution, often taking ownership of solutions.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, you build trust with colleagues, external auditors, and senior management.

  • Natural mentor, you help junior team members develop skills, ask good questions, and take pride in building capability in others.

  • Strong organisation and time management, you juggle multiple work streams, manage competing deadlines, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with multi-entity consolidation and group financial reporting

  • Background with modern accounting platforms (Xero, NetSuite, or equivalent)

  • Exposure to energy, infrastructure, or capital-intensive industries

  • Experience with regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions

What Success Looks Like

Financial operations run smoothly, AR/AP is accurate and timely, month-end close happens predictably without fire-fighting, and senior management trusts the numbers.

Your junior team members are developing stronger skills and ownership, they come to you for guidance, and you're actively building their capability.

External auditors value you as a partner, they know you'll provide clean documentation, resolve queries promptly, and stand behind our accounting positions.

You've become the trusted voice on technical accounting matters, stakeholders across finance and operations come to you to understand complex transactions and financial implications.

You're shaping how the finance function scales, identifying process improvements, building stronger controls, and ensuring our accounting foundation supports rapid growth.

Why Join Radiant

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry and take real ownership of a core function, building strategy and improvement across financial operations, not just executing processes.

  • Build and mentor a growing team, develop junior accountants and shape the culture and capability of the finance function

  • Help shape a category-defining company at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield-backed company with resources, mentorship, and genuine growth opportunities

title: Senior communicatieadviseur interne en corporate communicatie
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan de volgende fase van HeinenoordZicht Groep?

Na een zeer recente fusie van twee bedrijven hebben we onze krachten gebundeld in HeinenoordZicht Groep, een wervelende speler in de assurantiebranche. Eén met ambitie en potentie. Eén die bouwt aan een gezamenlijke cultuur en gedeeld verhaal. Aan een organisatie waar collega's elkaar weten te vinden, waar strategische keuzes helder worden vertaald naar de praktijk en waar communicatie een belangrijke rol speelt in verbinding, verandering en groei.


Hiervoor willen we ons team nu uitbreiden met een senior communicatieadviseur die moeiteloos schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Iemand die ons mede richting geeft, beweging creëert, mensen weet mee te nemen in verandering en de communicatiestrategie vertaalt naar een concrete communicatieaanpak. Iets voor jou?

De functie in het kort:

Enerzijds ligt de nadruk op interne communicatie en het versterken van onze positie als werkgever. Je helpt collega’s begrijpen waar we als organisatie staan, waar we naartoe gaan en wat dit betekent voor hun werk. Je versterkt onze gezamenlijke identiteit en zorgt voor communicatie die helder, relevant en herkenbaar is. Tegelijkertijd bouw je mee aan onze positie op de arbeidsmarkt en aan een sterke candidate en employee experience. Je onderhoudt contacten met interne stakeholders en externe partijen en geeft zo binnen jouw aandachtsgebied mede vorm aan de corporate en directiecommunicatie over onze organisatie, strategie en het werkgeversmerk. Je levert ook bijdragen aan perscommunicatie, woordvoering en events en signaleert reputatierisico’s.

Wat breng je mee?

Je bent een strateeg én een creatieve doener. Je krijgt energie van grote, soms complexe communicatietrajecten. Staat op als eigenaar van het totaal: van eerste goed doordachte idee tot uitvoering en zichtbaar resultaat. Het is daarbij je tweede natuur om niet meteen in middelen te duiken. Je verdiept je altijd eerst in ‘de bedoeling’. Wat willen we bij wie bereiken en wat is daarvoor nodig? Je adviseert over de communicatieaanpak bij projecten, veranderingen en andere organisatieontwikkelingen. De rol van strategisch gesprekspartner voor managers en directie is dan ook ‘100% comfort zone’.


En ook mooi: je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verdere vorm te geven aan je functie. Deze is namelijk nieuw en daarmee nog in beweging.

Waar kom je te werken?

Jouw werkplek vind je in ons splinternieuw en moderne hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, dicht bij het Provinciehuis. Maar thuiswerken is ook helemaal onderdeel van onze cultuur. Samen met een communicatieadviseur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de interne, corporate en arbeidsmarktcommunicatie van HeinenoordZicht Groep. Je rapporteert aan de directeur HR & Communicatie en werkt nauw samen met de collega’s van MarCom, die zich richten op klantcommunicatie.


De sfeer is informeel. Werken in jeans en op sneakers vinden we de normaalste zaak van de wereld. We geven je ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen vanuit je eigen expertise en werken vanuit vertrouwen en samenwerking. Zo maken we samen communicatie die helder, relevant en effectief is.

Wat krijg je hiervoor terug?

  • Een goed salaris: schaal loopt van € 5.000,- tot € 7.623,- bruto op basis van 40 uur per week. We stemmen de hoogte van je salaris af op je kennis en ervaring.

  • Deelname aan de collectieve pensioenregeling bij BeFrank.

  • Maandelijkse netto internetvergoeding van € 20,-.

  • 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks maximaal 5 dagen bij te kopen.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer tot 40 km enkele reis of volledige vergoeding bij reizen met het openbaar vervoer.

  • Aantrekkelijke kortingen op je zorgverzekering en de eigen verzekeringsproducten van HZG.

  • De mogelijkheid om een (elektrische) fiets te leasen tegen fiscaal voordelige voorwaarden.

  • De flexibiliteit om deels vanuit huis te werken, waarbij ook gezorgd wordt voor een fijne en veilige thuiswerkplek.

  • Werken bij een topspeler in de Nederlandse assurantiemarkt die onderdeel is van de stabiele, internationale NN Group.

  • Blijvende aandacht voor jouw ontwikkeling en inzetbaarheid.

Wanneer pas je goed in ons team?

  • Als de liefde voor communicatie onderdeel is van je DNA: Je bent een energieke bruggenbouwer tussen vraag en antwoord, tussen vandaag en morgen. Je houdt van verandering en voortuitgang. Van dynamiek en groei.

  • Als je ‘aan’ gaat van stakeholdermanagement: Je weet precies hoe je hen moet betrekken bij jouw projecten en zorgt voor een soepele communicatie.

  • Als strategie en hands-on creatie twee delen van jouw geheel zijn: Innovatieve ideeën, creatieve concepten, aansprekende online en offline communicatiemiddelen, verbindende content: jij brengt het mee. Met een neusje voor visueel aantrekkelijke beelden en een hart voor het schrijven van heldere en doelgroepgerichte teksten. Als het maar inspireert en verbindt.

  • Als je je organisatietalent ook wilt inzetten: Je hebt geen moeite met het organiseren van evenementen. Van concept tot uitvoering: jij hebt alles onder controle.

  • Als op jouw kilometerteller behoorlijk wat interne communicatie staat: Jij bent de spil van onze interne communicatie. Door jouw inspanningen blijft iedereen binnen de HeinenoordZicht Groep goed geïnformeerd en betrokken. Je draagt zorg voor een levendig en informatief intranet, organiseert inspirerende interne bijeenkomsten en zorgt voor een consistente stroom van boeiende updates en nieuws.

  • Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is onderdeel van je rol. Heb je hier al ervaring mee? Mooi. Zo niet, dan verwachten we dat je je hierin verder ontwikkelt.

Wat willen we sowieso terugzien op je cv?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting.

  • Minimaal vijf jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie.

  • Heb je ervaring met PR, arbeidsmarkt- en/of corporate communicatie? Plusje!

Wie zijn wij?

Twee sterke bedrijven, Heinenoord Holding en Zicht, risico- en verzekeringsadviseurs, samengebracht in één toekomstgerichte organisatie: HeinenoordZicht Groep. Een nieuwe naam, gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw ervaring. De kracht van digitale mogelijkheden combineren we met lokaal ondernemerschap én de professionaliteit van een grote landelijke Nederlandse speler.

En wat is ons DNA?

Wij helpen elkaar en onze klanten vooruit. We geven onafhankelijk en professioneel advies en helpen bij het maken van bewuste keuzes, om slagvaardig te blijven bij financiële risico’s. Dit geldt zowel richting onze klanten, als binnen de organisatie. Dit is wat ons energie geeft en waar ons talent ligt. Dit doen wij vanuit ons vakmanschap, vanuit de wens om persoonlijk, als team én als organisatie te groeien, en vanuit de lokale verbinding. Dat is waarom onze collega’s hier werken, waarom onze klanten bij ons komen én blijven. En wat ons verbindt. We werken er zo iedere dag samen aan, om van HeinenoordZicht Groep steeds verder te laten groeien als GAAF bedrijf: Goed geregeld, Aantrekkelijk voor medewerkers, Aantrekkelijk voor klanten en Financieel gezond.

Solliciteren?

Enthousiast geworden over deze vacature van senior communicatieadviseur bij HeinenoordZicht Groep in Den Bosch? Reageer dan via de solliciteerbutton.

We sluiten deze vacature als we een passende kandidaat hebben gevonden. Voor deze vacature werken wij niet samen met werving- en selectiebureaus.

descriptionHtml:

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact. With 2,000+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 26 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. At our German offices, we are on a rapid growth trajectory, advising leading national and international clients cross-industry on how to unlock the full potential of their data, build scalable data architectures, and implement cutting-edge AI solutions.

As a Senior Consultant (m/f/d) Data & AI Strategy, you will sit at the center of this mission. You won't just deliver static slides; you will bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives, guiding clients from a focused short-term engagement with Mittelstand manufacturers to multi-phase AI transformations with enterprises. In this role, you will take ownership of cross-functional workstreams, drive data-driven decision-making, and actively shape the digital future of our clients.

What you will do:

  • Client advisory & strategy: Work closely with (international) clients to understand their business needs and translate them into data-driven recommendations that support strategic decision-making and business transformation.
  • Data & analysis: Collect, synthesise and iterate data to create actionable insights. You work with a modern, AI-native toolstack - from LLM-powered environments (e.g. Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) and agentic workflow tools (e.g. n8n, Lovable) to coding assistants and automation platforms - and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.   • Project delivery: Take ownership of project workstreams and ensure high-quality, timely delivery in alignment with overall project goals. Work collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams across consulting, data, and tech functions.
  • Data & AI solutions: Support the development of data strategies, AI use cases, and business intelligence solutions, contributing to governance frameworks and implementation roadmaps where relevant.
  • Knowledge sharing & collaboration: Contribute to a strong team culture by sharing knowledge, staying up to date with digital and AI trends, and supporting continuous team development.
  • Business development & thought leadership: Actively contribute to Artefact’s growth in Germany - supporting client proposals, shaping new service offerings, and creating intellectual capital such as frameworks, point-of-views, and benchmarks that strengthen our market position.

Candidate Profile

At our heart, we define ourselves by a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable talents who bring strong motivation and curiosity for new challenges. 

  • Experience: You have at least 2–3 years of experience in management consulting, technology consulting, or in-house corporate strategy roles, with a proven track record of participating in data/AI strategy, cloud transformation, or applied AI/Machine Learning projects.

You are familiar with concepts like Generative AI, LLMs, or predictive analytics and are eager to bridge the gap between business needs and AI deployment. Ideally, you have hands-on experience in AI use case conceptualization or data platform tracking.
  • Business & analytical mindset: You combine strong analytical skills with a business-oriented perspective. You enjoy identifying business problems and translating them into practical AI and data-driven solutions.
  • Technical skills: You are confident working with PowerPoint and Google Slides to produce polished client-ready output. More importantly, you know how to leverage AI tools - from LLM environments to agentic workflows - to run analysis, generate insights, and accelerate delivery. Experience with SQL, BI tools, or programming languages is not a requirement, but comfort with structured data and a hands-on attitude toward new tools is expected.
  • Communication & collaboration: You communicate complex technical topics clearly in both German and English. You enjoy working in interdisciplinary teams and collaborating across different levels and functions (e.g., translating requirements between business stakeholders and data scientists).
  • Personal attributes: You are proactive, structured, and solution-oriented, with a strong client focus and stakeholder understanding. You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy solving complex problems.
  • Languages: Business-fluent German and English are required - you will participate in client workshops, present to senior stakeholders, and write deliverables in both languages. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Work Eligibility: A valid work permit for Germany.

Why ARTEFACT?

  • Impactful client work: Work on challenging projects with leading national and international clients across data, digitalisation, and advanced data strategy.
  • Career growth opportunities: We believe in performance over tenure. Your growth is driven by your impact, not your length of service, with clear opportunities to progress and diverse career prospects.
  • Competitive rewards: A strong compensation package including a performance-based bonus, which is paid out half-yearly.
  • Learning & development: Join a team of passionate Data Consultants who actively support each other. You'll learn through diverse projects, collaboration, and exposure to leading experts in the field - including international work.
  • Flexibility & time off: Hybrid working model, 28 days of annual leave, plus your birthday as well as Christmas & New Year's Eve off.

title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

At Polarsteps, we believe the best products are built by people as diverse as the travelers using our apps! That's why we specifically encourage people underrepresented in the tech industry to apply for a role with us. Because we believe that diversity, be it age, race, sexual orientation, physical ability, ethnicity, or gender identity, makes both the world and the workplace better.

Das bringst Du mit:

title: Senior Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Data die het verschil maakt

Data is pas waardevol als een organisatie erop kan bouwen. Als Senior Data Engineer bij LINKIT zorg jij daarvoor: je ontwerpt platformen die schaalbaar, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn, en je kijkt verder dan de losse pipeline. Klinkt dat als jouw volgende stap?

De uitdaging

Als Senior Data Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in mobiliteit, energie en financiële dienstverlening. Je draagt bij aan platformen die er echt toe doen: data-oplossingen voor internationale treinreizen bij NS, moderne beleggingsplatformen bij Robeco en schaalbare data ecosystemen bij EDSN en Stedin. Je ontwerpt en bouwt schaalbare data pipelines in Cloud omgevingen, ontwikkelt betrouwbare datamodellen die organisatiebreed worden gebruikt en denkt actief mee over architectuur, performance en onderhoudbaarheid. Je werkt nauw samen met analytics- en data science-teams om data ML-ready te maken en verbetert bestaande oplossingen waar dat waarde toevoegt. Als Senior Data Engineer maak je zo het verschil op zowel technisch als strategisch niveau.

Je plek binnen LINKIT

Je werkt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep Explorers (zo noemen wij onze collega’s) die elkaar scherp houdt op vakmanschap en samen bouwt aan oplossingen voor complexe dataomgevingen. Kennis delen is de norm, niet de uitzondering. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in leren, verbinden en vooruitkijken.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.


Wat we vragen

  • 5+ jaar ervaring in data engineering binnen complexe omgevingen.

  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

  • Kennis van of ervaring met distributed data processing frameworks/datalakes/orchestrators zoals Spark, Flink, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Airflow, dbt, etc.

  • Ruime ervaring met production ELT/ETL-pipelines.

  • Ervaring met batch/streaming dataverwerking.

  • Ervaring met CI/CD op cloudplatformen.

  • Ervaring met een cloudplatform zoals Azure, AWS of GCP.

  • Je communiceert goed in het Nederlands en spreekt vloeiend Engels.

  • Pré: ervaring met Databricks, Snowflake, MS Fabric of BigQuery.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €5.700-€7.400 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega's terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra's zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  3. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem contact op met Tabea Hensel via

Over ons

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Senior Data Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

Rethink it with LINKIT.

title: (Senior) Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

title: Senior Design Manager (Mensch) New Business
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten mit Schwerpunkt auf dem persönlichen Austausch im Office und ergänzender Remote Work passt sich dein Job deinem Leben an. Überstunden kannst du flexible ausgleichen.
  • Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
  • Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.
  • Practice makes perfect: Entfalte dich mit unseren vielfältigen Weiterbildungen und nutze unsere internen Karriereprogramme für deine Entwicklung im WPP-Netzwerk.
  • More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
  • Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das bewegst du:

Als Senior Design Manager (Mensch) bist du Teil unseres 6-köpfigen Design-Teams innerhalb der WPP Media Growth-Unit. Gemeinsam mit den Kolleg*innen aus New Business, Marketing, Strategie und Responsible Media übersetzt du strategische Kernbotschaften in visuell bestechende Geschichten und trägst maßgeblich zu erfolgreichen Pitches sowie hochkarätigen Vorstandspräsentationen bei.

  • Pitch- & Vorstands-Design: Du entwickelst und gestaltest wirkungsstarke, erstklassige Präsentationen (Schwerpunkt PowerPoint) für nationale und internationale New-Business-Pitches sowie Entscheidungsvorlagen auf GF- und Vorstandsebene.
  • Motion & Video Content: Du konzipierst und produzierst bewegte Inhalte, Animationen und Video-Assets (z. B. Case-Videos oder dynamische Pitch-Intros) mithilfe von Adobe Premiere und After Effects.
  • KI-Integration & Innovation: Du nutzt moderne generative KI-Tools (z. B. für Bild-, Konzept- und Content-Erstellung) eigeninitiativ im Arbeitsalltag, um kreative Prozesse zu bereichern und Workflows zukunftssicher weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Brand- & Kampagnengestaltung: Du verantwortest die visuelle Umsetzung von Marketingmaterialien und Initiativen – von digitalen Kampagnen bis hin zu Assets für den Bereich Responsible Media.
  • Schnittstelle & Sparring: Innerhalb der Growth-Unit arbeitest du eng auf Augenhöhe mit den Fachbereichen (New Business, Strategie, Marketing) zusammen und berätst Stakeholder stilsicher von der ersten Idee bis zur finalen Master-Folie.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige, fundierte Erfahrung im Präsentations- und Kommunikationsdesign mit – idealerweise gesammelt im Agenturumfeld oder in einem dynamischen, pitch-getriebenen Setup.
  • PowerPoint-Exzellenz: PowerPoint ist dein kreatives Zuhause. Du beherrschst das Tool bis ins Detail und beweist, dass anspruchsvolles Design und PowerPoint Hand in Hand gehen.
  • Adobe Creative Suite: Du bist absolut versiert im Umgang mit der Adobe Creative Cloud – insbesondere mit Photoshop, Illustrator und InDesign sowie Premiere und After Effects im Bewegtbildbereich.
  • KI-Affinität: Du brennst für neue Technologien, experimentierst aktiv mit aktuellen Generative-AI-Tools und verstehst es, diese produktiv und qualitätsbewusst in deine Designprozesse zu integrieren.
  • Fundierte Ausbildung: Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Design / Kommunikationsdesign oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung (z. B. Mediengestaltung).
  • Kommunikations- & Sprachkompetenz: Du bewegst dich stilsicher und verhandlungssicher in deutscher sowie englischer Sprache (in Wort und Schrift).

Darüber hinaus bist du: #kreativ #lösungsorientiert #eigeninitiativ #stressresistent

Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.

Arbeiten bei WPP Media:

Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.
 
WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen. #LI-Promoted (ID:13706)

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. title: Senior Due Diligence Design Engineer - EMEA/APAC
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

Senior Site Due Diligence Design Engineer

About the Team

The Senior Site Due Diligence Design Engineer plays a critical role in CoreWeave's data centre development pipeline by providing the first full technical evaluation of prospective sites. As the first engineering representative in site selection and due diligence, you will bring a broad, multidisciplinary perspective to judge how well each site can support CoreWeave's requirements across all major design disciplines.

You will be the technical bridge between the Site Selection team and the broader Design & Engineering organisation. From first site introduction through lease execution or acquisition, you will lead technical due diligence. That includes evaluating infrastructure capacity, utility availability, building suitability, land use and entitlements, and early design constraints, and working directly with data centre providers, utilities, landlords, and external partners. Once a site is secured, you will hand it off to the assigned Design Manager for full project design. The role calls for strong engineering judgment, the ability to interpret information across disciplines, and the confidence to represent CoreWeave's technical priorities in early strategic conversations.

This role requires frequent travel to prospective data centre locations across the EMEA and APAC regions.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Initial Technical Evaluation: Act as the first technical evaluator for prospective data centre sites across electrical, mechanical, architectural, civil, and IT/LV disciplines, identifying technical risks, constraints, opportunities, and required upgrades.
  • Early-Phase Design Leadership: Lead the design team from initial site concept through lease execution or acquisition, coordinating all design activities in these early phases. Take part in early design and scoping discussions to align everyone on CoreWeave's requirements and technical expectations.
  • Proposal & Document Review: Review provider proposals, capacity offers, utility information, conceptual layouts, and as-built drawings to confirm they align with CoreWeave's design principles. Make sure technical requirements are correctly reflected in early documents such as LOIs, provider proposals, and preliminary agreements.
  • External Engagement: Work directly with landlords, developers, data centre providers, and utilities during early due diligence. Run early technical workshops with providers so they correctly understand CoreWeave's design expectations and project objectives.
  • Power & Utility Assessment: Review site infrastructure, including power availability, redundancy options, upstream utility constraints, delivery timelines, and required upgrades.
  • Mechanical Feasibility: Assess heat rejection options, water availability and quality, mechanical yard capacity, and compatibility with CoreWeave cooling strategies (e.g., chilled water plants, CDUs, TCS loops).
  • Building Suitability: Evaluate structural capacity, floor loading, egress paths, ceiling heights, roof strength, envelope condition, and potential for expansion.
  • Land Use & Entitlements: Evaluate land use, zoning, permitting, and entitlement feasibility at a high level, and identify regulatory constraints or municipal approval risks that could affect schedule, density, or constructability.
  • Conceptual MEP & Risk Assessment: Develop high-level conceptual MEP assessments. Identify and document site-specific blockers and risks, with clear impacts on scope, cost, schedule, density, constructability, and long-term scalability.
  • Assessments & Recommendations: Prepare concise technical due diligence summaries and early go/no-go recommendations covering feasibility findings, required upgrades, regulatory considerations, and alignment with CoreWeave's design and operational requirements.
  • Pipeline Tracking: Build and manage dashboards or similar tools to track technical progress, risks, land-use considerations, and milestones for all active candidate sites.
  • SME Collaboration: Work with internal SMEs and the broader design team. Resolve early-stage questions yourself where possible, and route discipline-specific topics quickly to the right experts.
  • Design Handover: Deliver a structured technical handover to the assigned Design Manager once a lease is executed or a site is acquired, so full project design continues seamlessly.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in data centre engineering, MEP consulting, site selection, due diligence, or early-phase design and development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or Architectural Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Broad technical competency across electrical, mechanical, civil/structural, and architectural fundamentals, with the ability to evaluate multi-discipline issues without full SME support.
  • Strong understanding of utility infrastructure, such as power delivery, substations, feeders, water sources, and permitting, and how it affects site feasibility.
  • Experience reviewing capacity offers, conceptual site plans, utility data, and building documentation from data centre providers or developers.
  • Familiarity with land use, zoning, and entitlement processes, and the ability to identify regulatory risks that may affect feasibility or schedule.
  • Experience with or exposure to data centre design standards, including cooling strategies, power distribution, redundancy concepts, and scalability.
  • Ability to turn complex technical information into clear written assessments and concise go/no-go recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently during early assessments and exercise sound engineering judgment.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with experience engaging landlords, utilities, developers, and real estate teams.
  • Excellent communication, technical writing, and presentation skills, including briefing leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • High comfort operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where rapid technical vetting and decision support are essential.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively to prospective data centre locations across EMEA and APAC.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.
