title: Senior Engineer I, Systems Engineering - Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Senior Engineer I - Controls Engineer

ASM | Simulation & Modeling Hub | Almere, Netherlands

Design, tune and validate control systems for ASM semiconductor process tools, with an emphasis on precision temperature control. Work with experienced controls engineers and equipment and process teams to translate process requirements into control strategies, then verify their performance on physical tools. The role combines dynamic modeling, controller development and hands-on testing, with opportunities to take ownership of control functions.

Responsibilities

  • Translate process and equipment needs into measurable control requirements for temperature accuracy, stability, uniformity, repeatability and response during recipe changes.
  • Design and tune feedback and feedforward control strategies for heating and cooling systems. Address interactions between zones and account for sensor and actuator limits.
  • Plan and run tests on laboratory and production-representative equipment. Analyze sensor and actuator data, use system identification to develop or calibrate dynamic models, and compare predictions with measured responses.
  • Work with software, equipment and process engineers to integrate control logic, troubleshoot performance on the tool, and support commissioning and validation.
  • Document control logic, test procedures, tuning parameters and validation results so other engineers can reproduce tests and maintain the controls.

Required qualifications

  • Degree in controls, electrical, mechanical or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience designing, testing or tuning closed-loop controls on physical equipment. Relevant industry, laboratory or applied research projects are welcome.
  • Working proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink or an equivalent environment for dynamic modeling, data analysis and control design. Familiarity with system identification and instrumentation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot equipment methodically and communicate results to colleagues across engineering disciplines.

Preferred experience

  • Precision temperature control, heat transfer or thermal instrumentation in semiconductor equipment or other precision industrial systems.
  • Experience with multizone or cascade control, model-based control, sensor calibration or equipment commissioning.
  • Experience with Simcenter Amesim or other tools for modeling system dynamics and validating control strategies

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

title: Senior Franchise Producer
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Senior Franchise Producer

Franchise Development // PlayStation Studios™

PlayStation Studios has created some of the most loved worlds, characters, and stories in entertainment. Our opportunity now is to build those IP with greater intention — growing audiences, deepening fandom, and creating more ways for people to engage with PlayStation franchises beyond the release of a game.

We are looking for a Senior Franchise Producer to help turn that ambition into coordinated high-quality work across a varied portfolio of franchise initiatives.

This is a project management and production role with an unusually broad remit. The producer may support or lead work across franchise resources and documentation, location-based experience, linear media, publishing, internal partner and contractor-led projects, and other initiatives that bring franchise strategy to life.

The role sits within a broader production team and contributes to shared sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery. While the team works collectively, this senior producer will independently own a defined set of workstreams from planning through completion.

A major part of the role is partnering with teams across Sony Interactive Entertainment to translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into executable plans, track activity and dependencies, and directly produce selected initiatives where appropriate.

This producer will also work closely with stakeholders within the PlayStation Studios’ development studios, coordinating approvals and reviews throughout production, maintaining trusted relationships, and ensuring that franchise work reflects both studio intent and wider PlayStation priorities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of franchise production workstreams from initial brief and scoping through delivery, review, launch, and closeout.
  • Translate franchise strategies and roadmaps into practical project plans with clear objectives, milestones, owners, dependencies, budgets, risks, and decision points.
  • Track franchise activity across teams, maintain integrated plans and status reporting, and provide clear visibility of progress, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions.
  • Produce selected franchise initiatives directly, coordinating internal contributors, studios, external partners, and vendors to deliver against agreed creative, quality, schedule, and budget expectations.
  • Support a varied range of productions, which may include location-based experiences, publishing projects, franchise resources, documentation, presentations, toolkits, and partner-facing materials.
  • Lead day-to-day project communication, meetings, action tracking, production reviews, approvals, and follow-up across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Partner across PlayStation Studios, Portfolio Strategy, PlayStation Productions, brand, marketing, insights, finance, consumer products, licensing, legal, and Sony Group teams to align plans and unblock delivery.
  • Scope, onboard, brief, and oversee contractors, agencies, and specialist production partners; manage deliverables, capacity, performance, and associated resource needs.
  • Contribute actively to team sprint planning, backlog management, prioritization, estimation, retrospectives, and continuous improvement as part of the wider franchise production team.
  • Create and maintain production standards, templates, trackers, documentation, and repeatable ways of working that improve clarity and consistency across the team.
  • Identify issues early, recommend practical solutions, escalate appropriately, and keep work moving through ambiguity and changing priorities.

What We’re Looking For

  • Substantial production or project management experience in games, entertainment, media, experiential, publishing, consumer products, licensing, or a related creative industry.
  • A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and concurrent deadlines.
  • Strong command of production fundamentals, including scoping, scheduling, budgeting, resource planning, risk management, approval workflows, status reporting, and delivery governance.
  • Experience translating strategic or creative ambition into structured plans, practical next steps, and high-quality deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the judgment and confidence to work with senior leaders, creative teams, specialist functions, and external partners.
  • Clear and concise communication, with the ability to adapt detail for working teams, studio leadership, and executive audiences.
  • A highly collaborative approach, combined with the accountability to own workstreams and drive them through to completion.
  • Experience working in agile or sprint-based teams and contributing to shared planning, backlog, prioritization, and review routines.
  • Experience briefing and managing agencies, contractors, vendors, or other external production resources.
  • Experience in one or more of the following is a plus: location-based entertainment; publishing, including books or comics; franchise or IP documentation; licensing or consumer products; live experiences; or multi-format entertainment production.
  • Knowledge of games and the PlayStation ecosystem is valuable, but relevant experience from adjacent entertainment sectors is equally welcome.

The Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a calm, proactive, and highly organized senior producer who enjoys bringing structure to ambitious creative work. They can move comfortably between long-range roadmaps and the operational detail needed to deliver a specific project.

They are equally effective facilitating a team sprint, building an integrated plan, briefing a contractor, preparing a studio review, or helping cross-functional partners understand how their activity contributes to a wider franchise roadmap.

They build trust through clarity, follow-through, and good judgment. They know when to drive, when to facilitate, and when to escalate. They are motivated by collective success, while being fully accountable for the workstreams placed in their care.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Assigned productions have clear plans, accountable owners, realistic schedules, visible dependencies, and well-managed risks.
  • Franchise strategies and roadmaps are translated into coordinated activity that progresses across PlayStation and Sony teams.
  • Studio stakeholders and cross-functional partners experience a clear, responsive, and trusted production process with timely reviews and approvals.
  • Projects and resources are managed responsibly, with issues surfaced early and delivery kept aligned to creative intent, quality, timing, and budget.
  • The wider production team benefits from strong sprint participation, transparent workload planning, dependable ownership, and improved tools and ways of working.
  • The producer successfully owns multiple workstreams while contributing flexibly to the collective priorities of the Franchise Development team.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Minerva Frontline is STARK's command and control software — the brain that connects operators to autonomous systems across multiple domains in real time. The Frontline team is based across Europe & the UK, working with our hardware teams to build mission-critical C2 capabilities for use in active operational environments.

We move fast, ship real software, and operate under constraints most engineers never encounter — low-bandwidth networks, air-gapped devices, high-stakes decision loops. We are a tight-knit team of zero-ego, mission-driven developers. There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.

If you want to build software which will make a tangible difference to the security of Europe, we want to hear from you.

YOUR MISSION

STARK is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Frontend Systems) to expand our mission management software. We are not looking for someone who just works on Jira tickets. We need a frontend systems thinker who balances rapid delivery with the deep system understanding required to answer: 'What is the right solution for the overall system, and what is the frontend's role in it?'

You will build and evolve the frontend as a robust, high-performance architecture. You have the high-agency to navigate the physical constraints of our hardware, challenge the backend with hard questions, and translate complex data streams into a clear, calm UI for operators under extreme cognitive load. While you actively provide impulses for our overall system evolution, your core focus remains hands-on engineering.

We consistently rely on agentic AI workflows. While these agents accelerate development, they also introduce entirely new classes of technical challenges. Your role is to set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously orchestrate these agents, and collaborate with the team to solve the novel integration and quality problems that arise in this new engineering paradigm.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • System Thinking through the Frontend Lens: You don't need to write path-planning algorithms, but you must understand how they constrain the UI. You engineer highly optimized frontend solutions that handle high-frequency telemetry and asynchronous data streams while strictly minimizing computational load to preserve critical battery life on field devices.
  • Mission-Critical UI & UX: You translate complex data into immediate situational awareness. You understand UX as cognitive load management for operators under stress. You implement interfaces that are deterministic, error-tolerant, and relentlessly focused on providing clarity out of chaos.
  • Strategic Sparring Partner: You align rapid delivery with long-term system health. Instead of just accepting what the backend provides, you proactively challenge APIs and data structures if they threaten frontend performance or the operator's experience.
  • Mastering Agentic Workflows: You don't just prompt; you engineer alongside AI. You set strict architectural guardrails, rigorously validate outputs, and proactively solve the novel integration and quality challenges that arise in this new paradigm.
  • Engineering for Extreme Constraints: Build high-performance, framework-less user interfaces (Vanilla TS, Web Components) that function flawlessly under extreme real-world conditions (low bandwidth, air-gapped networks).
  • Collaborative Excellence: You are a team multiplier. You raise the level of the entire team by sharing knowledge, providing valuable impulses for our system design, and facilitating open, fact-based discussions with zero ego.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • System-Level Frontend Seniority: Deep, practical expertise in Vanilla TypeScript/JavaScript and the native web platform (DOM API, Event Loop, Memory Management). You view the frontend not as a collection of pages, but as a complex, stateful system interacting with the physical world.
  • Constraint-Driven Engineering: The ability to engineer solutions that anticipate and mitigate hardware realities—specifically managing latency, handling data bursts, and optimizing for constrained compute and battery life.
  • AI-Engineering Competence: Practical experience integrating agent-based coding tools into your workflow. You understand how to structure architecture for AI, rigorously validate its output, and solve the novel integration challenges these tools create.
  • Mission-Oriented Execution: You balance the drive for rapid delivery with a critical mindset. You proactively question requirements and always evaluate technical decisions from the operator's perspective on the ground.
  • Strong Team Player & Zero-Ego: You have the maturity to moderate technical decisions, compromise, and always put the mission above your own ego.
  • Mobility: Ability to travel as needed.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Practical experience building comprehensive design systems (ideally using native Web Components).
  • Experience with real-time data streaming architectures (WebSockets, WebRTC) or handling high-frequency telemetry.
  • Experience in geographic mapping, GIS, or complex Canvas/WebGL rendering in the browser.
  • Experience working with unmanned systems, ideally in command-and-control, mission management, or operator-facing software.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Integration Software Engineer to ensure the quality and reliability of software solutions used in real-world sensing and data processing systems.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who is passionate about quality, structured validation, and delivering robust software in complex engineering environments.

As a Software Test Engineer, you will be responsible for defining and executing practical software tests to validate software components (including algorithms, cloud back-end, and user interfaces) that process sensor signals generated by fiber-optic sensing systems. You will work closely with data scientists, signal processing specialists, back-end developers, and software architects to ensure that products meet functional and non-functional requirements.

This role requires a hands-on professional with a proactive mindset, a structured approach to software testing, strong attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex technical systems and translate requirements into effective test strategies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 3 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

title: Senior Internal Forward Deployed AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

OAG is the essential intelligence partner transforming global travel. For nearly a century, we've been the foundation the travel industry builds on, trusted, proven, essential. Today, we're going beyond.

We combine unmatched data quality, quantity and access with breakthrough technology and deep industry expertise to deliver what the industry truly needs: not just more data, but better answers. From real-time operational intelligence to strategic decision-making, we power the entire travel ecosystem, from airlines and airports to technology companies and financial institutions.

We are actively embedding AI throughout our intelligence layer, combining nearly a century of proprietary data with the latest technology to deliver answers that were simply not possible before.

We exist because travel moves the world, and we move travel. By transforming complexity into clarity and questions into answers, we give our partners the intelligence they need to thrive in an evolving world. For more information visit www.oag.com

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Senior Internal Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will work embedded alongside OAG teams to understand how they really work, redesign their processes and deliver dependable AI applications, agents and automation. Reporting to the Director of AI Led Business Transformation, you will partner with business owners and Technology from first discovery through to design, delivery and ongoing operation, challenging whether work is needed at all before automating it. Success looks like measurable improvements to customer outcomes, commercial contribution, operating costs and risk, and reusable capability that colleagues can adopt and sustain without depending on any one builder.

This role can be worked remotely from anywhere in the UK only. Please note that we're unable to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants will need the existing right to work in the UK.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Embed with OAG teams, observing real work and talking directly to users to define the problem, the starting position, the intended outcomes and the acceptance criteria.
  • Challenge existing steps, handoffs and approvals, simplifying or removing unnecessary work before automating it.
  • Design future workflows that use AI where it adds value, comparing conventional software, workflow automation, agents and existing products, and being open about the trade-offs and costs.
  • Build and run dependable AI applications and agents, with the right tool access, memory, evaluation, human oversight and recovery arrangements.
  • Work with Technology on testing, version control, controlled deployment, monitoring and security, and stay involved through rollout and stabilisation, using live evidence to improve reliability.
  • Own designated platform components, initially including n8n and our customer experience “second brain” solution and its memory layer, managing upgrades, running costs, technical debt, support boundaries and tested recovery procedures.
  • Use approved AI tools and agents across your own engineering work, giving them clear context and bounded responsibilities, and independently checking what they produce.
  • Create reusable components, reference implementations and practical guidance, and coach colleagues through shared delivery so that capability transfers and technical ownership stays clear.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Demonstrable delivery and operation of production AI and agentic applications, including responsibility for design decisions, evaluation, release and improvements informed by live use.
  • Experience working directly with business users or customers from discovery and scoping through implementation, rollout and stabilisation. You do not need a forward deployed engineer job title; we are looking for evidence of this way of working.
  • Strong production coding skills in Python, TypeScript or a comparable language, with sound system design, APIs, authentication, SQL and data modelling.
  • Experience integrating business systems and workflow automation, with reliable integrations that handle retries, duplicates and failures safely, and maintaining services through upgrades, failures and changing requirements.
  • Practical capability in cloud services, containers, automated deployment, monitoring, incident diagnosis and backup and recovery, applying proportionate security and change controls.
  • A strong understanding of how agents fail, including uncertainty, prompt injection and access boundaries, and the judgement to recognise when an agent is the wrong answer.
  • Evidence of using AI coding tools and agents in your own delivery, explaining what the agents did, how their work was verified and where human judgement changed the outcome.
  • Customer-first, lean thinking: the ability to turn business problems into clear technical options, and to help colleagues adopt practices that improve how they build and maintain solutions.

IT WOULD BE GREAT IF YOU ALSO HAD

  • Hands-on experience with n8n workflow automation.
  • Experience with memory or retrieval systems and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience with Azure AI services.
  • Direct experience with Rembr (useful, but not required).

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about this role, we’d still love to hear from you.

WE WILL OFFER YOU: 

💡 You will proactively explore and adopt AI tools and automation in your day-to-day work, keeping the customer at the centre of everything you do. You will share learnings with your team and approach new technologies with curiosity and an open mind. At OAG, finding better ways to work and putting customers first is everyone's responsibility. 

🚀 Real responsibility on hard problems, with the autonomy to own decisions and act on them, in an open culture built on trust. 

🏡 Flexible working arrangements that allow remote work or office attendance  

💰 An attractive compensation and benefits package, including private health insurance, a company bonus scheme and enhanced pension scheme  

🏖️ 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, and a day off during your birthday month   

⚡ Octopus EV salary sacrifice scheme  

🌍 Work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 1 month per year  

📚 Annual learning and development budget.  

OAG is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to perform at their best. 

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to have an open conversation about how we can support you.

title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Job Description

🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel.

What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation.

Responsibilities:

Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role)

  • Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps.

  • Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against.

  • Advise on open-source, fair-code and open-core licensing, and on IP questions around AI-generated outputs, machine learning models and training data.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on privacy questions that arise in product design.

  • Support Product and Engineering with customer, community and regulator questions about how our products meet legal requirements.

Support complex technology and commercial deals (c. 20% of the role)

  • Review, draft and negotiate technology-heavy agreements (SaaS and self-hosted), partnership and integration, and AI model and cloud provider contracts.

  • Partner with sales, partnerships and revenue teams on complex enterprise deals with AI or product requirements.

  • Deliver creative, risk-based solutions that protect the business, and feed deal learnings back into product decisions.

Scale legal as a business enabler

  • Solve legal questions in real time with a builder mindset.

  • Improve and maintain scalable legal templates, playbooks and training materials together with the Legal team, so that standard deals and product questions do not need legal involvement, so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without escalation.

  • Collaborate with our Automation and Legal Operations to improve our self-serve legal processes and tooling.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • ⚖️ Qualified lawyer (Europe-based): You are a qualified legal professional with 5+ years' post-qualification experience (PQE), with at least 3 of those years within an in-house SaaS or technology environment with a start up or scale up company.

  • 💬 Fluent English: You can clearly communicate legal nuance in plain terms to global stakeholders.

  • 🤖 Product, AI and digital regulation expert: You have substantial, hands-on experience of acting as a trusted business partner to and advising technology teams on regulatory matters such as the EU AI Act and related digital regulation and a clear track record of getting up to speed on new regulation quickly.

  • 🔓 Open-source and licensing: You have working knowledge of open-source, fair-code or open-core licensing and how it applies to software products.

  • 🌍 Cross-functional collaborator: You have experience supporting engineers, product managers and sales teams, and can demonstrate how you balance legal risk with product and revenue goals.

  • 🛠️ Builder mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy solving problems with and without a playbook, and look for ways to improve how legal works.

  • 🏃 Fast-scaling environment experience: You have worked where priorities shift quickly and your impact is immediate.

  • 📄 Commercial and technology contracts: You have solid working experience with SaaS and self-hosted software license agreements.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧠 Curiosity for tech and automation: You are excited to experiment with legal tech, AI tools and scalable internal systems.

  • 🎓 AI or technology law credentials: for example AIGP, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 💬 Other Languages: You can communicate in German with customers and stakeholders.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won't disappear into a shared drive. It will shape how a category-defining company builds products and does deals. You will be embedded with Product and R&D, with commercial work where your product expertise matters most. You will join a senior Legal team, helping embed AI-first thinking into everything we do, in a fast-growing, remote-first team that values ownership, pragmatism and speed.

Sound like a challenge you are excited to take on? Apply now, and help us build the future of automation. If you meet most but not all of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

title: Senior Manager, Capability Engineering & Customer Training, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About This Role

Databricks is experiencing tremendous growth as enterprise organizations transition from evaluating AI to rapidly deploying production-grade AI systems. This role exists to redefine how we enable our largest customers to move faster, activate their data workforces, and convert platform investments into measurable business outcomes.

As the Senior Manager of Capability Engineering & AI Adoption for EMEA, you will lead two complementary teams: a regional group of Customer Enablement Architects who act as trusted advisors and builder-enablement partners for Databricks’ largest, most complex accounts, and the EMEA Scaled User Programmes team, whose mission is to design and execute broad, high-impact enablement initiatives across the region. Operating at the intersection of technical depth, program strategy, and business outcomes, you will translate advanced product roadmaps into both personalized, just-in-time capability programs and scalable enablement engines that meet customers wherever they are in their modernization and AI adoption journeys.

The Impact You Will Have

  • People Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop an elite regional team of Customer Enablement Architects across EMEA, setting a high standard for technical depth, customer impact, and creative problem-solving.
  • Capability Engineering at Scale: Redesign enterprise enablement workflows, moving away from legacy episodic models to continuous, contextual, and hyper-personalized capability building aligned with customers' modernization curves.
  • AI Adoption & MAU Activation: Partner directly with account teams and field leadership to diagnose capability blockers and drive measurable increases in Monthly Active Users (MAU) across strategic enterprise accounts.
  • Hands-on Builder Innovation: Cultivate a builder culture within the team to design and deploy custom enablement applications, tools, and prototypes (e.g., via Databricks Apps, Genie, or agentic frameworks) when standard curricula fall short.
  • Executive & Stakeholder Alignment: Conduct deep discovery sessions with enterprise technical leaders and C-suite executives, aligning strategic capability roadmaps with the customer's high-level AI transformation goals.

  • Strategic Regional Presence: Undertake regional travel across EMEA to engage directly with strategic enterprise accounts on-site , lead high-stakes executive alignment sessions , and provide hands-on leadership to a geographically dispersed team. 

What We Look For

  • Technical Depth: Deep foundational understanding of lakehouse architecture, data engineering/ETL pipelines, data governance, and generative AI/agentic workflows to earn immediate respect from customer data teams.
  • Hands-on Builder Mindset: A non-negotiable track record of personally designing, building, and deploying working prototypes, automation tools, or technical apps.

  • Leadership and Credibility: Prior experience leading and managing technical or customer-facing engineering teams, with a proven ability to mentor talent, hold a high bar, and build a cohesive team identity.

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. title: Senior Manager, R&D Quality Assurance
descriptionHtml:
Overview:

The Senior Manager, R&D Quality Assurance independently performs the R&D QA Program Lead role for assigned clinical studies, providing Clinical Quality Assurance oversight in accordance with study protocols, company procedures, GCP requirements, and applicable local and international regulations. The role leads and supports quality oversight, audit, and inspection-readiness activities and works cross-functionally to identify, assess, mitigate, and escalate quality and compliance risks. The Senior Manager also provides guidance and oversight to junior R&D QA staff, as applicable, and supports continuous improvement activities within R&D Quality Assurance.

This is a hybrid role that can be based in Cambridge, MA; Philadelphia, PA; or Maidenhead, UK, with three days per week onsite.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Independently perform the R&D QA Program Lead role for assigned clinical studies, providing Clinical Quality Assurance oversight in accordance with study protocols, company procedures, GCP requirements, and applicable local and international regulations, with escalation to the GCP QA Director as appropriate.
  • Provide quality oversight for assigned clinical studies, including identification, assessment, mitigation, and escalation of quality and compliance risks and support for the investigation and resolution of Quality Events and CAPAs.
  • Lead and support GCP audit activities, including investigator site, vendor, study, and process audits, as applicable, and ensure audit observations and associated corrective and preventive actions are appropriately addressed.
  • Lead inspection-readiness activities for assigned clinical studies, including coordination of QA and cross-functional activities, identification and mitigation of potential inspection risks, and preparation for FDA, EMA, PMDA, and other Health Authority inspections.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal Alnylam Expertise Area leads, study teams, vendors, and external partners to support study quality, compliance, and inspection-readiness activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable global GCP regulations, regulatory guidance, and industry practices and support continuous improvement of R&D QA processes, procedures, and tools, as applicable.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, and oversight to assigned junior R&D QA staff, as applicable, to support effective execution of assigned activities and continued development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably life science (technology, biological science, pharmacy, or other health related discipline preferred) or equivalent qualification or clinical research experience. Master’s degree in a science, technology, or industry related discipline, preferred.
  • Seven years’ experience in GCP Quality Assurance, or similar experience working in GCP and clinical trial that support pharmaceutical development.
  • Experience in overseeing late phase clinical trials
  • Experience in leading audits preferred.
  • Experience supporting and leading inspections readiness efforts and direct inspection experience.
  • Extensive experience working with different Quality Assurance functions, knowledge of Auditing, Clinical Supply Chain, Clinical Operations, Monitoring, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Research, Drug Safety, Data Management, Programming and Statistics
  • Strong working knowledge & knowledge of how to interpret GCP regulations as well as industry guidance (e.g., FDA, EMA, and other national agencies).

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Senior Photonics Engineer, Optical Interfaces
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us. 

Job Summary:

We are seeking a Senior Photonics Engineer to develop ultra-low-loss optical interface solutions between dissimilar, exploratory, waveguiding platforms. This role combines device concept development, optical simulation, and hands-on experimental validation to assess and mature new approaches for mode conversion and coupling. The successful candidate will combine creativity in photonic device design with strong engineering judgement, identifying solutions that are both high-performing and practical to deploy. Working closely with internal teams and expert external partners, they will help guide the development of advanced optical interfaces. We welcome applicants from both advanced industrial photonics environments and leading research groups who combine strong physical intuition with practical experimental and engineering judgement.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and assess novel device concepts for ultra-low-loss optical coupling and mode conversion between dissimilar optical platforms.
  • Use simulation and analytical tools to study optical propagation, modal behaviour, overlap, loss mechanisms, and sensitivity to design and fabrication tolerances.
  • Apply tools such as BeamPROP, FDTD, or equivalent methods to evaluate candidate device concepts and guide design decisions.
  • Design and execute experiments to validate device performance, coupling efficiency, mode conversion behaviour, and optical loss.
  • Correlate modelling and experimental results to refine concepts, test assumptions, and build confidence in technical feasibility.
  • Evaluate candidate solutions with consideration for robustness, manufacturability, packaging, and practical implementation constraints.
  • Work closely with expert external partners to review technical options, assess results, and help mature promising device approaches.
  • Collaborate across photonics, systems, and experimental teams to develop practical optical interface solutions for demanding applications
 

Experience/Qualifications:

Required

  • PhD degree in photonics, optics, physics, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Significant experience in photonic device development, guided-wave optics, optical coupling, or integrated optical interface design.
  • Strong understanding of mode conversion, mode control, and optical coupling between dissimilar waveguiding or photonic platforms.
  • Experience with simulation tools such as BeamPROP, FDTD, eigenmode, BPM, or related methods for analysing propagation, modal behaviour, and coupling performance.
  • Proven ability to use simulation to guide device design choices and interpret behaviour in complex optical interfaces.
  • Hands-on experience designing and executing experiments to characterize optical coupling, insertion loss, and device performance.
  • Strong experimental judgement and ability to troubleshoot complex photonic or optical measurements.
  • Ability to assess technical feasibility while keeping practical implementation constraints in view.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with internal teams and external technical partners

Preferred

  • Experience developing low-loss optical interface devices between fibre, waveguide, or integrated photonic platforms.
  • Experience with advanced optical packaging, taper-based transitions, or coupling structures.
  • Experience with optimisation methods or inverse design for photonic structures.
  • Experience taking photonic device concepts from early-stage exploration through experimental proof of concept.
  • Experience balancing innovation, performance, and manufacturability in photonic device development.
  • Experience in advanced industrial photonics environments or high performing applied research groups.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

Sales Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

  • What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

  • Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

  • The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Pricing Analyst, B2B at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

  • Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Can say early whether a quarter will land, and what would tell you it won't.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, EMEA, you'll shape how Airwallex's products are understood and adopted across the region. You'll translate complex financial products into clear, compelling stories for customers, prospects, and internal teams, while connecting product, marketing, sales, and regional priorities.

  • Own product positioning and messaging for Airwallex across EMEA.

  • Develop go-to-market strategies and launch plans that bring product narratives to market.

  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, Brand, Demand Generation, and regional leaders to deliver campaigns and launches.

  • Turn customer insight, market trends, and competitive intelligence into sharper messaging, sales enablement, and marketing programmes.

  • Build feedback loops that help Product and Commercial teams understand what resonates in the market and where we need to improve.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Strong product marketing experience, ideally in fintech, payments, financial services, SaaS, or another complex B2B environment.

  • Experience developing positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategies, and launch plans.

  • A track record of working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Brand, Demand Generation, and regional stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex products clear and compelling.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect customer needs, market context, and business priorities.

Preferred

  • Experience marketing products across multiple EMEA markets.

  • Experience working in a high-growth or scaling company.

  • Familiarity with payments, financial infrastructure, embedded finance, or other regulated products.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

Marketing at Airwallex is a growth function, not a support one. The brief is ambitious: build the brand to match the platform, well-established in some markets and still emerging in others. This team leads across product marketing, brand, demand generation, and regional GTM: understanding what our platform actually does, then building the stories that make it land with real businesses, not just buyers on paper. They work closely with product, sales, and leadership, so the link between marketing activity and business outcome is direct.

If you want to build a global brand through insight, sharp positioning, and creative that earns attention and trust, this is where marketing has real leverage.

Equal opportunity

We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Senior Project Manager Microsoft Dynamics 365

title: Senior R&D Engineer/Projectleider Flight Test and Certification (m/v/x)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende baan in de wereld van de lucht- en ruimtevaart?

En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen.

Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren.

Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden.

Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica;

  • Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring;

  • Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden;

  • De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight test en certificatie;

  • Affiniteit met werken voor Defensie, en liefst kennis van de Defensie organisatie;

  • Bewezen capaciteiten als projectleider voor grote projecten;

  • In staat zijn om klantenwensen te vertalen en een brug te slaan tussen techniek en operationele impact;

  • Positieve instelling, initiatiefrijk, flexibel, resultaatgericht;

  • Communicatief vaardig in het Nederlands en Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau)

Wat bieden wij jou?

Bij NLR krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken én jezelf te ontwikkelen. Je werkt in een innovatieve nationale en internationale hightech omgeving waar nieuwsgierigheid, samenwerking en vakmanschap centraal staan. We geloven dat mensen het beste presteren als ze de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, zich te blijven ontwikkelen en een gezonde balans te vinden tussen werk en privé.

Verder bieden wij jou onder anderen:

  • 45 verlofdagen (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek);

  • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

  • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

  • Een zorgtoelage van €145,- bruto (op basis van een 40-urige werkweek) via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA, als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

  • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

  • Volop kansen om te blijven leren met opleidingen, trainingen, coaching en andere ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • De mogelijkheid om 32-40 uur per week te werken inclusief thuiswerken.

Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

De afdeling Flight Test en Certificatie (ASTC) richt zich op het ondersteunen van de Nederlandse overheid (Defensie, EZK, IenW) en markt waarin thema’s als "bescherming van de samenleving" en “Klimaat neutrale luchtvaart” belangrijke uitgangspunten zijn. We voeren experimenten en vliegproeven uit met onze eigen vliegtuigen, geschaalde vliegtuigen en drones. We ondersteunen vliegproeven met vliegtuigen van klanten. Dit kan zijn voor een onderzoeksprogramma’s of om te bewijzen dat we radicale en nieuwe concepten op een veilige manier effectiever en sneller kunnen certificeren. We zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor modificaties aan onze research vliegtuigen en bewijzen dat deze veilig zijn.

We zijn georganiseerd in twee marktgeoriënteerde teams, Flight Test Support en Certification Support. Veel collega’s zijn in beide teams actief en werken vaak buiten de afdeling in multi-disciplinair verband. Er worden goede mogelijkheden geboden om je eigen ontwikkeling vorm te geven.

Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

Koninklijke NLR is al meer dan 100 jaar een toonaangevende kennisinstelling voor toegepast onderzoek in de lucht- en ruimtevaart. Samen met meer dan 1000 professionals werken we aan innovatieve oplossingen voor een duurzamere, veiligere en efficiëntere lucht- en ruimtevaart. We willen dat iedereen bij NLR de ruimte krijgt om zichzelf te zijn, talenten te ontwikkelen en ideeën in te brengen. Door verschillen te waarderen en van elkaar te leren, creëren we samen een inclusieve werkomgeving.

Wil jij meer weten?

Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

Solliciteren?

Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

title: Senior Robotics Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Inbolt

Deploying an industrial robot still takes months of integration and programming, and the moment a part, a process, or a position changes, it starts over. Inbolt makes it take minutes.

Our generalist vision model gives robots the ability to see, think, and adapt in real time, so any robot can master any process, part, or station. Set up from a CAD model in minutes and compatible with FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau, and Universal Robots, Inbolt runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, Bosch, and more, with 200+ systems live across 100+ factories on three continents.

We're a team based in Paris, Detroit, and Japan, and we're growing fast. Here's the role:

This position is Paris, France based.

Role Overview

Your mission is to own the integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, at 100% industrial-grade quality, from architecture to production on the factory floor.

As Senior Robotics Engineer, you are the technical reference for robot control and robot programming in our product. Our roadmap covers static and dynamic robot control whatever the brand. You will architect and build these capabilities, integrate them end to end into Inbolt Studio, and make sure they run reliably on real robots in demanding production environments.

You will work at the intersection of robotics, 3D perception, and software engineering, in a small fast growing team where your contribution is visible and your decisions shape the product. This is not an R&D position: your work has a daily impact on what runs in production at Inbolt customers.

Want to take your robotics career to the next level by building the future of robot vision guidance in the real world? This role is for you.

Responsibilities

Feature ownership and architecture

  • Own the design and integration of complex robotics features into Inbolt Studio, from architecture to production release

  • Deliver the roadmap on static and dynamic robot control

  • Make the key technical decisions on motion planning, robot control, and real-time constraints, and defend them with data

  • Push the limits of the current codebase and propose better architectures when needed

Industrial-grade quality

  • Guarantee industrial-grade quality: every feature is tested, validated on real robots, robust to edge cases, and safe to run in a factory

  • Set the standards for code quality, testing, and review in the robotics team, and keep the PR process efficient

  • Own the quality of your deliverables: code, engineering reports, and validation results

  • Estimate lead times fairly for Epics, deliver on schedule, and flag early when a plan is drifting

From lab idea to production

  • Turn prototypes into production features, validated in real factory conditions at customer sites

  • Integrate and validate Inbolt’s solution across industrial robot brands and their programming environments

  • Keep a solid view of the state of the art in robotics, and bring what is relevant into the product

Technical leadership and collaboration

  • Act as the technical reference for the application engineering (RAE) and sales teams on complex customer cases, feasibility, and escalations

  • Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and take part in interviews for new hires

  • Work closely with the Lead Robotics engineer, other engineering teams, and deployment teams in Paris, the US, and Japan

Profile

Inbolt values end-to-end ownership, high rigor, and a hands-on curiosity. We move fast while staying precise, with a proactive, autonomous, results-driven mindset and strong collaboration with engineering teams.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of strong professional experience in robotics, in a startup or a large company, with a track record of owning complex features end to end

  • Strong expertise in robotics motion planning: trajectory generation, path planning, collision avoidance, and motion optimization for industrial robot arms

  • Strong expertise in real-time robot control, both static and dynamic (sensor-driven): closed-loop control, low-latency sensor-to-motion pipelines, and deterministic, performance-critical code running on real robots

  • Excellence in software development: strong Python and/or C++, solid engineering practices (testing, code review, version control, CI/CD)

  • Proven record of shipping complex robotics features to production at industrial-grade quality: reliability, test strategy, and validation on real robots

  • Ability to design abstractions that work across robot brands and programming languages

  • Solid foundations in robotics: kinematics, frames and transformations, and integration with industrial or collaborative robot arms

  • Technical leadership: you make architecture decisions, raise the bar in code reviews, and mentor other engineers

  • Appetite for fast development and visible impact: you iterate quickly, ship often, and take ownership of the result

  • Clear communicator, able to explain technical topics to engineers, sales, and customers

  • Fluent in English; French is a big plus given daily interactions with the Paris team

Additional Plus

  • A PhD in robotics or a related field is appreciated, as long as your focus is on shipping: this role is about production impact, not research

  • Experience with 3D vision, point clouds, computer vision, or machine learning applied to perception

  • Experience with industrial robot brands (Universal Robots, ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Comau) and their programming languages

  • Experience with ROS or other robotics frameworks

  • Experience deploying or supporting systems on customer sites in industrial environments

  • Experience as a tech lead or team lead of a robotics team

Position details

  • Role: Senior Robotics Engineer

  • Team: Engineering

  • Location: Paris, France, in our office at 12 rue Vivienne, 75002 Paris

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Employment type: Full-time

  • Collaboration: you will work closely with teams in Paris, the US, and Japan, and your work will directly impact deployments in factories worldwide

Why join Inbolt

  • Real impact, on real factory floors: your work runs in production at Stellantis, Toyota, Ford, GM, and Bosch, across 100+ factories on three continents.

  • Ownership from day one: we value end-to-end ownership, high rigor, and hands-on curiosity, and we move fast while staying precise.

  • An international team: Paris, Detroit, and Japan, working closely with world-class robotics and automation partners.

  • A seat at the start of something big: we're building the default intelligence layer for every industrial robot, on every brand.

Benefits

We're building our benefits location by location, so they fit local needs and practices in each country where we operate.

  • 📍 Prime office locations in Paris and Detroit

  • 🤝 Team-building events & off-sites

  • 🐶 Bring-your-dog-to-work policy

  • 🍽️ Lunch expenses covered

  • ✈️ Customer site visits in real factories

  • and more…

Benefits may vary by location and contract type.

Our hiring process

  • Introduction call (30 min) with our Talent team, to get to know you and answer your questions.

  • Interview with your future manager, including a case study or technical exercise depending on the role.

  • Meet the team: a conversation with the people you will work with every day.

  • Final round with our founders.

  • Reference checks.

The exact steps can vary slightly by role. We keep the process short and transparent, and we'll keep you posted at every step.

Ready to give robots sight?

Inbolt is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background, and a real person reads every application. Even if you don't tick every box, if this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.
