title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
descriptionHtml:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

Role Mandate

A seasoned, hands-on administrator who understands the business problem, scopes and implements complex solutions across Salesforce and connected systems with minimal guidance, and stays accountable for technical quality through delivery and ongoing support.

About the Role

NinjaOne is looking for a Senior Salesforce Administrator to help shape the systems and capabilities that support our growing global revenue organization. As part of Sales Operations, you'll translate complex business needs into practical, scalable solutions across Salesforce and our connected sales technology ecosystem.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgment with business curiosity and a builder's mindset. You'll look beyond the immediate request to understand the underlying problem, challenge unnecessary complexity, and design and build solutions that improve how our teams work. Partnering closely with Salesforce Architects, Admins, our broader Sales Operations teams, and Revenue Stakeholders you'll guide solutions from discovery and design through implementation and adoption. Your impact will extend beyond individual projects: you'll help strengthen the architecture, standards, and technical capabilities that allow NinjaOne to scale without continually adding manual work or one-off solutions.


Location - Berlin, Germany

What You'll be Doing

Translate Business Needs into Scalable Solutions

  • Partner with business and Operations stakeholders to understand workflows, identify root causes, and translate priorities into clearly scoped solutions. Challenge assumptions and clarify requirements before moving into a build.
  • Develop practical recommendations that account for user experience, business impact, dependencies, delivery effort, and long-term maintainability. Explain options and tradeoffs clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Contribute to Salesforce Solution Architecture

  • Help scope, design, and implement technical solutions for approved Salesforce initiatives, including data models, automation, access controls, integration requirements, and the impact on existing workflows.
  • Favor straightforward, maintainable solutions, using native capabilities and low-code tools where appropriate and custom development where justified. Consider scale, performance, security, and support needs before implementation.

Connect Processes, Data, and Systems

  • Design solutions around end-to-end workflows across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and other revenue functions—not isolated requests within a single tool.
  • Partner with Sales Integrations, Data & AI, and other technical owners to define system responsibilities, data flows, dependencies, and exception handling. Ensure Salesforce changes work reliably within the broader technology environment.

Lead Technical Delivery and Raise Quality

  • Remain hands-on through prototyping, configuration, complex automation, and troubleshooting. Work alongside administrators and developers through implementation, peer reviews of technical work, and help resolve design challenges.
  • Partner with the Salesforce Platform Manager to strengthen testing, version control, deployment practices, and release readiness. Create clear design documentation and support handoffs so solutions can be understood, maintained, and improved by the broader team.

Build for the Next Stage of Growth

  • Proactively identify technical debt, fragmented workflows, and recurring issues. Recommend phased improvements that address root causes and support new business, customer, and regional requirements without unnecessary customization.
  • Partner with Data & AI and Operations teams to evaluate practical automation and AI-enabled improvements. Help define the data, access, integration, testing, and human-review requirements needed to move useful ideas into dependable workflows.

Contribute to the Team's Technical Capabilities

  • Provide technical mentorship and constructive design feedback to administrators and developers. Build reusable patterns and shared knowledge that improve delivery quality and reduce reliance on individual experts.
  • Communicate risks, dependencies, and recommendations early. Contribute architectural input to the platform roadmap and follow through on the technical outcomes of the initiatives you support.

About You

  • You bring meaningful Salesforce delivery experience. You have 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience, including ownership of solution design and implementation for complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • You have strong platform fundamentals. You understand Salesforce data architecture, security and sharing, Flow, configuration, and platform constraints. You can assess how design decisions affect reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • You can work across configuration and code. You have the technical depth to evaluate Apex and Lightning components, review implementation approaches, and troubleshoot solutions alongside administrators and developers.
  • You think beyond Salesforce alone. You have experience designing solutions involving connected applications, APIs, and data flows, with a clear understanding of system ownership and downstream impacts.
  • You understand how revenue teams work. You can connect technical decisions to business workflows, user needs, and operational outcomes. You are comfortable turning incomplete or ambiguous requirements into a clear recommendation.
  • You take ownership beyond the design document. You bring disciplined testing, documentation, and delivery practices, communicate tradeoffs directly, and stay engaged until a solution works in practice.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting a high-growth B2B SaaS organization with multiple sales motions, international teams, or evolving customer and partner models.
  • Familiarity with CPQ, routing, sales engagement, and integration platforms such as DealHub, LeanData, Salesloft, or Workato.
  • Experience improving an established Salesforce environment through architectural simplification, automation redesign, integrations, or data migrations.
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications, particularly architecture-focused credentials, and experience applying automation or AI to business workflows.

What Success Looks Like

Business priorities become well-defined solutions with clear design decisions and fewer surprises during implementation. Revenue teams experience simpler workflows and less manual work. Salesforce changes fit reliably into connected systems, and the technical team can maintain and extend what has been built.

Over time, your work should help the organization deliver more consistently, reduce recurring issues and avoidable rework, and support growth without increasing complexity at the same pace.

What You’ll Love  

Grow personally and professionally with one of the fastest growing companies

Enjoy your lunch covered by NinjaOne 3 times/week at the office

Access to our Corporate Benefits Platform (with discounts for brands such as Expedia, FitX, Zalando and many more)

Develop your skills through our renowned training platform

Collaborate with a curious, kind, international and intercultural workforce  

Enjoy your work environment with its location in the heart of Berlin, directly at the Alexanderplatz (close to all transit)

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

title: Senior SecOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:

The role

You run day-to-day security operations for a full-cloud company as a senior engineer in the SecOps team, reporting to the SecOps Manager. You bring technical proposals to the SecOps Manager; the IT & Security lead approves the SecOps roadmap.

You back up the SecOps Manager on technical topics and during incidents.

You are also the link between SecOps and the other teams, mainly R&D, Platform Engineering and IT. You keep them in sync on security priorities, changes and incidents. You train them on secure practices and on the security tooling they use, so they can own security in their own areas.

Most of your time goes into building and running things yourself. You write the Terraform, the detections and the automation.


Responsibilities

  • GCP guardrails and posture as code: definition, organization policies, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, KMS and Secret Manager; run our CSPM (Wiz); take controls from monitoring to enforcement with a rollback plan; deliver controls in Terraform and CI/CD policy checks with Platform Engineering.

  • Detection and incident response: own log pipelines (Cloud Logging, audit logs, Workspace, Okta, CrowdStrike), build detections end to end (log onboarding, SIEM use cases, validation) and manage alert quality, automating triage and enrichment; lead security incidents from triage to root cause and post-mortem, including GCP forensics; maintain playbooks and run tabletop exercises.

  • Vulnerability and attack-surface management: cloud, containers (GKE, Artifact Registry), dependencies and external surface; prioritize findings on exploitability and real exposure; run the technical side of external pentests (scoping, challenging findings, retest) and drive remediation with owning teams and track SLAs.

  • Secure development: threat-model new services with R&D; embed SAST, SCA, secret and container scanning and supply-chain controls in the SDLC; be the security contact for each R&D team.

  • Assurance: produce technical evidence for ISO 27001 audits; answer the technical part of customer security questionnaires and RFPs, including non-standard requests; assess the security of third-party vendors.

  • FinOps: know the cost of the security tooling you deploy, flag cost drifts early and work with Procurement on cost estimates when selecting security vendors.


    • Must-have profile

  • 7+ years in security engineering or SecOps, including 3+ years securing production on a public cloud — GCP strongly preferred, AWS/Azure transferable.

  • Deep GCP security knowledge: IAM model, org policies, VPC-SC, SCC, logging, GKE security.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native security platforms such as Google SecOps (Chronicle), Security Command Center (SCC) and Wiz (or similar CNAPPs).

  • Hands-on incident response experience, including leading incidents and cloud forensics.

title: (Senior) Security Engineer - m/f/d
descriptionHtml:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

We’re hiring a hands-on (Senior) Security Engineer to strengthen the security of Langdock’s product, infrastructure, and internal systems.

Your primary focus will be application and infrastructure security. You’ll work closely with our CTO and engineering teams to identify risks, assess our defenses, and drive practical improvements. You’ll coordinate penetration tests, triage incoming vulnerability reports, and make sure findings turn into lasting fixes. You should be comfortable getting into technical details, challenging assumptions, and helping engineers choose the right controls.

You’ll also own the security of our internal IT environment, including identity, access, and device security. We’re looking for someone who builds reliable, automated processes and can judge whether our protections are effective.

Alongside this technical work, you’ll help explain our security posture to customers and support our compliance efforts. The foundation of this role is making Langdock secure; audits and customer assessments should reflect that work.

What You Will Do

The role's responsibility will span over multiple fields, which are:

Application security

  • Coordinate penetration tests end to end. Define scope with engineering and external testing partners, support testing, assess findings, and follow remediation through to verification.

  • Own vulnerability intake and triage. Monitor our security inbox and responsible disclosure program, assess reported issues, and work with engineering to prioritize and resolve them.

  • Help engineering build securely. Review security-sensitive designs and changes, identify weaknesses in areas such as authentication, authorization, and data isolation, and recommend practical improvements.

Infrastructure security

  • Assess and improve our security posture. Work with engineering to evaluate how our production infrastructure and internal systems are protected, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

  • Strengthen network and access controls. Review network separation, service exposure, privileged access, and permissions so systems and data are accessible only where needed.

  • Verify that controls work in practice. Look beyond configuration checklists to understand how systems could be compromised and whether our protections would prevent or detect it.

Internal security and automation

  • Own identity and device security. Ensure we have effective MFA, appropriate access policies, and properly managed, encrypted, and patched devices.

  • Automate the employee lifecycle. Build dependable processes for account provisioning, access changes, offboarding, and access reviews across Entra ID and our internal tools.

  • Keep recurring work manageable. Use scripts, integrations, and AI tooling to automate security operations and surface issues that need attention.

Customer assurance and compliance

  • Support customer security assessments. Help answer questionnaires and join customer conversations that require a clear, technically credible explanation of our security controls.

  • Contribute to our compliance programs. Support our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II work through effective controls, current evidence, and technical input into audits and risk assessments.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • Hands-on application and infrastructure security experience. You understand how modern SaaS applications and cloud environments are built, where they can fail, and how to protect them.

  • Technical depth and sound judgment. You can investigate a vulnerability, assess its practical impact, discuss remediation with engineers, and distinguish urgent risks from lower-priority findings.

  • Experience taking findings through to resolution. You’ve worked with penetration testers or vulnerability disclosure programs and helped teams turn reports into verified fixes.

  • Confidence with identity and endpoint security. You’re comfortable configuring identity providers, MFA, access policies, and device management, and automating the processes around them.

  • An automation mindset. You build scripts, workflows, and integrations to reduce recurring work, and use AI tooling thoughtfully to increase your effectiveness.

  • Clear communication. You can explain technical risks and controls to engineers, colleagues, and customers. German is a plus, but not a requirement.

  • Pragmatism. You prioritize meaningful risk reduction and choose controls that teams can realistically implement and maintain.

Experience with ISO 27001, SOC 2, and customer security assessments is valuable. Your strongest skill set should be in technical security.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Compensation: €90K – €140K • Offers Equity

descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will be focused on Firefox on Windows, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments and especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Bonus Points for experience with:

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really want to join us!

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. What is The Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search Relevance team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This technical leader is responsible for contributing to the technical direction and vision for our search capabilities, including design and implementation of new search features, enhancements to search functionality, and resolving bugs.   Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading search engine offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.

Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.

title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
locations: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
descriptionHtml:
Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day. 

Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL's portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.  

Position Purpose

The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams in identifying systemic barriers to quality care, designing and implementing practical improvements, and strengthening the institutional capabilities needed to sustain results.

Reporting to the Director, Maternal & Reproductive Health, the Senior Technical Advisor works across RTSL's technical programmes to translate evidence and programme learning into effective service delivery improvements. The role exercises significant independent technical judgment in developing and adapting implementation approaches, guides multidisciplinary teams and partners through complex health system challenges, and contributes expertise and learning to strengthen RTSL's broader approaches to more proactive, reliable, and accountable health care.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. Eligible for candidates based in the US, UK, Nigeria, Ethiopia, Rwanda, India, France and DRC.

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Health Systems and Service Delivery Transformation

  • Apply systems thinking and health systems transformation approaches to identify and address systemic barriers to quality health care, drawing on service delivery assessments and analysis of health system performance.
  • Provide strategic and technical advice to national and subnational governments on health system and service delivery reforms, supporting the translation of national policies and priorities into effective service delivery models and implementation approaches.
  • Provide expert technical guidance to governments and country teams on redesigning clinical care pathways, referral systems, workflows and service delivery models to improve the quality, reliability and continuity of care.
  • Translate findings from maternal death reviews, routine performance data and other sources into prioritised, feasible improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide multidisciplinary collaboration with technical specialists across clinical care, digital health, financing and measurement to develop integrated solutions to complex, priority service delivery challenges.

Change Management and Institutional Strengthening

  • Promote government ownership and sustainability by embedding improved practices, management routines and accountability processes within existing health systems.

Country Implementation and Technical Support

  • Provide senior technical guidance to country programmes and government partners, supporting the design, implementation and adaptation of health system and service delivery improvements, identifying emerging challenges, and recommending course corrections.
  • Work closely with country teams, government counterparts and implementing partners to identify priorities, address operational challenges and support effective programme delivery.

Learning, Evidence and Innovation

  • Guide the application of data, implementation learning, and performance measurement to assess the effectiveness of service delivery changes, identify emerging challenges, and inform course correction.

Experience

Skills & Abilities

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex health systems challenges into clear, actionable recommendations and to influence diverse technical, clinical, government and management stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30%.

Compensation and Benefits

For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits

title: Senior Technology Design Manager - EMEA
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Team

We are looking for a highly skilled, experienced Data Centre Design Manager to lead the design process on behalf of CoreWeave. You will oversee the design of our data centre fit-outs (white space) and make sure every design meets and incorporates CoreWeave's project requirements.

You will focus mainly on managing Architectural, MEP, and LV/IT infrastructure designs within our leased data centre facilities, making sure they meet our performance, efficiency, and scalability standards. You will support the fit-out construction phase so designs are implemented accurately. On each assigned project, you will be the primary point of contact for design matters, working with internal teams and external consultants to deliver consistent, high-quality designs.

This role requires up to 30% travel to data centre sites.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Project Leadership & Oversight: Manage the design and coordination of multiple data centre fit-out projects at once. Oversee professional consultants (architects and engineers) and equipment suppliers during the design process.
  • Single Point of Contact: Serve as the primary point of contact for all design matters on assigned projects. Coordinate closely with data centre providers and their contractors, architecture/engineering (A/E) firms, and internal stakeholders to keep communication and alignment smooth throughout the design process.
  • Internal SME Coordination: Coordinate with internal subject matter experts across electrical, mechanical, and LV/IT disciplines. Make sure project requirements, technical specifications, and solutions are aligned, and bring specialist expertise into the design process as needed.
  • Standards & Compliance: Apply CoreWeave Design & Engineering Guidelines and industry best practices so designs align with company objectives, with an emphasis on value engineering for optimal cost and performance.
  • Basis of Design Deviations: Track and document deviations from the Basis of Design throughout the project lifecycle, coordinating with internal teams and external consultants.
  • Budget & Schedule Coordination: Work with the Technical Project Management team to prepare, review, and monitor project schedules, budgets, and forecasts for design and construction spending.
  • OFCI Equipment Management: Review and evaluate submittals for owner-furnished, contractor-installed (OFCI) equipment, and give recommendations to the Construction Management and Procurement teams.
  • Design Reviews: Take part in page-turn meetings with consultants, giving feedback on designs, sequences of operation, Basis of Design documents, commissioning plans, and testing scripts.
  • Vendor Management: Help with RFPs for A/E consultants, evaluate proposals, and select vendors. Keep consultants aligned with project budgets and schedules, and review and approve consultant invoices.
  • Reporting & Communication: Prepare and deliver detailed project reports for executive leadership and project teams, tracking budgets, schedules, scope, and progress. Provide regular formal and informal updates to internal and external stakeholders, keeping projects aligned with CoreWeave's gating process and handing off smoothly to the Construction Management team.
  • Site Visits: Visit sites during construction to review design implementation, assess construction progress, and confirm adherence to design specifications, quality standards, and project requirements.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Capacity, Network Engineering, Construction, Operations, Supply Chain, and Technical Project Management to stay aligned with business objectives and project deliverables. Act as the liaison between internal teams and external consultants or vendors.
  • Innovation & Design Enhancement: Contribute to internal design team meetings by proposing and exploring new technologies or design concepts that improve project outcomes. Stay current with industry trends and bring innovative solutions into project designs.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Network, Low Voltage/Cabling, or a related field), Architecture, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in data centre engineering or design, with a proven track record of successfully completing data centre design projects.
  • Strong knowledge of data centre white space, including cooling systems, power distribution, network architecture, and LV/IT design.
  • Experience with large-scale, high-density data centres and cloud infrastructure, including power, cooling, and other critical infrastructure systems.
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects, with strong project management and organisational skills and a record of delivering on time and within budget.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple projects and competing priorities with close attention to detail.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a focus on efficient, cost-effective solutions to complex design challenges.

Preferred Skills:

  • Professional certifications such as Uptime Institute, BICSI, LEED, or similar.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organisation's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation & Benefits

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

title: Senior Web Engineer - Subscriptions
descriptionHtml:

We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.

From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.

As a Senior Web Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.


What You'll Do

  • Build end-to-end features across modern web applications that support Spotify's global subscription business.

  • Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows.

  • Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services.

  • Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL.

  • Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows.

  • Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability.

  • Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Platform Reliability
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role

Platform Infrastructure provides the infrastructure, tooling, processes and services that more than a thousand Elastic engineers depend on. We are about 110 people across ten teams in three groups: Core Infrastructure, Reliability Engineering, and Engineering Productivity & Developer Experience. We run the multi-cloud platform underneath Elastic Cloud Hosted and Serverless, the shared Kubernetes platform other Elastic teams build on, the observability estate that shows Cloud engineers what production is doing, and the release path the whole Elastic Stack ships through.

As an SRE here you take an engineering approach to reliability. You write the Go, Python and Terraform that replaces manual work, you carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, and you work with Cloud engineering to close the gaps you find.

Elastic is expanding its Serverless offerring, and most of what we build sits underneath it. Current work includes packing hundreds of customer projects onto shared clusters, PrivateLink and static IPs, new regions, a single identity layer across the stack, and new government regions. We are also replacing manually managed services with code-managed systems, which lets the platform grow without the on-call load growing with it.

Why join us

  • The scale is large. We run across multiple cloud providers and many regions, and some teams operate 200+ production deployments of our own product.
  • We are customer zero for Elastic Cloud Hosted, Serverless and the observability and security products, so new features land on our systems first and our feedback goes back to the product teams.
  • The engineers who use what you build are a thousand colleagues you can go and talk to.
  • On-call follows the sun, which keeps the burden outside working hours small.
  • We are fully distributed across EMEA, NASA and APJ and the work happens in writing, so you control how you run your day.

What You Will Be Doing

  • You own systems end to end as the DRI on a project, and you break the work down yourself.
  • Own the outcome of projects on your team’s roadmap as the DRI, breaking the work down and pulling in help when you need it.
  • Operate and harden the infrastructure that other Elastic engineers depend on, managed as code with Terraform, Go and Python.
  • Build tools and services that remove manual work.
  • Carry the on-call rotation for what your team runs, drive incidents to resolution and write RCAs that lead to lasting fixes.
  • Improve observability, runbooks and documentation so the on-call load gets lighter over time.
  • Review code and designs, and act as a second set of eyes on production changes to critical infrastructure.
  • Raise risks and ideas without being asked, and mentor engineers with less experience.
  • Give feedback to the Elastic product teams on the features that reach our systems first.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years in SRE, platform engineering or infrastructure engineering, including real time operating what you built.
  • Experience with Terraform at multi-workspace scale.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Go or Python, the languages most of what we build is written in.
  • Extensive experience carrying on-call, resolving incidents under pressure and writing RCAs that hold up under review.

How you work

  • You take an ambiguous project, come back with a plan and own it to the end.
  • You say when an estimate or a sequence is wrong before the team commits to it.
  • You write clearly, because we work across nine time zones and the work happens in tickets and channels.
  • You stay calm when something is broken, communicate while you work and write the follow-up that stops it happening again.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

  • Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
  • Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
  • Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
  • Generous number of vacation days each year
  • Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
  • Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
  • Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Social Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen.

Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt.

Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem agilen Netzwerk aus Editor:innen, Designer:innen und Integrated Producer:innen in Berlin, London, Paris und Madrid steuerst du alles – von dynamischen Vertical Videos (TikTok und Instagram) über Creator-Kooperationen bis hin zur Live-Begleitung von Events vor Ort. Mit echtem kreativen Gestaltungsspielraum und einer offenen, kollegialen Unternehmenskultur bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem mutige Ideen wachsen können.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Social Account Management

    • Du arbeitest direkt mit einem großen Entertainment-Streaming-Kunden zusammen, pitchst eigene Kreativkonzepte und stimmst strategische Ziele gemeinsam ab.

    • Du entwickelst herausragende Social-Aktivierungen für große Film- und Serienstarts sowie für saisonale und kulturelle Highlights.

    • Du adaptierst globale Kampagnen-Assets und Toolkits für den deutschen Markt und passt Botschaften an, sodass diese lokale kulturelle Nuancen treffen.

    • Du verantwortest die Social-First-Begleitung bei Live-Events, Marketing-Shoots und Presseveranstaltungen und briefst und leitest Talente vor Ort souverän an.

    • Du übernimmst das gesamte kreative Copywriting über alle Formate hinweg – von Videoskripten und Interviewfragen bis hin zu In-Asset-Texten und plattformgerechten Captions.

    • Du pflegst plattformübergreifende Redaktionspläne und koordinierst die tägliche Planung und Veröffentlichung freigegebener Inhalte auf allen organischen Kanälen.

  • Social Media Expertise

    • Du behältst Plattform-Updates, neue Nutzungsgewohnheiten und Popkultur-Trends in Echtzeit im Blick, um proaktiv reaktiven, kulturell relevanten Content zu pitchen.

    • Du beobachtest Community-Stimmen sowie Performance-Daten nach dem Launch und übersetzt Analysen in fundierte Kampagnen-Debriefs, Abschlussberichte und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kund:innen.

  • Projektmanagement

    • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Design, Redaktion und Integrated Production zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Assets entlang Briefing, pünktlich und exakt im Einklang mit den Markenrichtlinien der Kund:innen geliefert werden.

    • Du sorgst für reibungslose interne Produktionsabläufe, indem du verlässliche Zeitpläne erstellst und pflegst, Feedbackschleifen mit Kund:innen steuerst und Freigabeprozesse vom Briefing bis zum finalen Sign-off souverän begleitest.

Dein Profil

  • Deutsch auf C2- oder Muttersprachniveau mit einem sicheren Gespür für Copywriting, das auf Social-Media-Kanäle und den jeweiligen Tone of Voice der Marke zugeschnitten ist.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, dem Scripting und der Produktion von Social Content auf nationalem Kampagnenniveau.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit TikTok, Meta, YouTube und X sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Publishing- und Management-Tools wie der Meta Business Suite oder Sprinklr.

  • Erfahrung im Community Management sowie ein intuitives Verständnis für Audience Engagement, Tone of Voice von Marken und plattformtypische Kommunikation.

  • Tiefes Eintauchen in die deutsche Jugendkultur, Entertainment-Trends und Online-Fandoms – verbunden mit dem Talent, spontane Internet-Momente in mitreißenden Content zu verwandeln.

  • Starke, teamorientierte Kommunikation über alle Touchpoints hinweg (vom täglichen Chat bis hin zu formellen Kundencalls und Präsentationen) sowie ein Händchen dafür, langfristiges Vertrauen und partnerschaftliche Beziehungen aufzubauen.

  • Bei Herausforderungen holst du die richtigen Leute an einen Tisch, wägst verschiedene Optionen ab und findest pragmatische Lösungen.

Hinweis: Wir legen mehr Wert auf Fähigkeiten, Fachwissen und persönliche Eigenschaften als auf langjährige Berufserfahrung oder klassische Studienabschlüsse. Wenn du Teil unseres kooperativen Teams werden möchtest, bewirb dich noch heute mit deinem Lebenslauf auf Englisch.

Weitere Infos

Werde Teil von Jellyfish und erlebe ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Weiterentwicklung Priorität hat, deine Erfolge gefeiert werden und du deinen Arbeitsalltag so gestalten kannst, wie es am besten zu dir passt.

💫 Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite bis zu 60 % deiner Zeit remote und gestalte deinen Arbeitstag dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten frei zwischen 8:00 und 18:30 Uhr.

title: Social Content Producer - Inside I35 Contractor
descriptionHtml:
Our vision is to give everyone the belief they can make their move. We aim to make moving simpler, by giving everyone the best place to turn to and return to for access to the tools, expertise, trust, and belief to make it happen.

We’re home to the UK’s largest choice of properties and are the go-to destination for millions of people planning their next move, reading the latest industry news, or just browsing what’s on the market. 

Social Video Content Producer (Contractor - Inside IR35) 

Contract duration: Approximately 2-3 months 
Location: London office - Hybrid working (Wednesday and Thursday in the office, with the remaining days remote) 

About the Role 

Rightmove is looking for an experienced Social Video Content Producer to support the delivery of an exciting programme of search-led video content as part of our Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and social search workstream. 

We're looking for someone who combines creative storytelling with hands-on video production expertise, bringing ideas to life through engaging, social-first content.  

Working closely with our Content and Social teams, you'll help develop, film and edit a suite of YouTube videos across key topics, experimenting with different formats and styles to create content that is useful, engaging and discoverable.  

This is a short-term contract opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of the creative process, from initial concepts and scripting through to directing, filming, editing and final delivery.  

What You'll Be Doing 

Content Development & Planning 

  • Develop engaging video concepts from content briefs and agreed topics. 
  • Support scriptwriting and adapt existing content into compelling video narratives. 
  • Collaborate with our Content and Social teams to explore creative approaches, formats and presentation styles. 
  • Plan and coordinate video shoots, including preparing contributors, locations and production environments for filming. 

Video Filming & Production 

  • Lead the end-to-end filming and production of video content, including self-shooting and editing. 
  • Film a range of social-first formats, including face-to-camera, interview-led and podcast-style content – filming in a variety of locations.  
  • Direct and interview on-camera contributors. 
  • Take on some face-to-camera presenting where appropriate. 
  • Capture high-quality footage that can be adapted across different video formats. 

Editing & Post-Production 

  • Edit and produce engaging, high-quality YouTube videos that are appropriately paced and optimised for digital audiences. 
  • Repurpose longer-form content into YouTube Shorts, adapting edits to suit short-form viewing. 
  • Create supporting thumbnails and video packaging to help maximise engagement and discoverability. 
  • Manage the post-production process, incorporating feedback and delivering polished final assets. 
  • Ensure all content is delivered in the required upload-ready formats, including TRV files. 

Collaboration & Delivery 

  • Work closely with our Content and Social teams to ensure content aligns with Rightmove's brand, tone of voice and objectives. 
  • Participate in regular content reviews and planning discussions to maintain progress against agreed deliverables. 
  • Incorporate creative feedback and ensure content meets relevant brand guidelines and compliance requirements. 
  • Collaborate with external agencies where required to support production and delivery. 

What We're Looking For 

We're looking for a creative, hands-on content producer and videographer who understands what makes great social content and has the technical skills to bring it to life.  

You'll ideally bring: 

  • Proven experience producing, filming and editing video content for social and digital platforms, particularly YouTube. 
  • A good eye for detail when looking through the lens and the ability to create high-quality video content, in a range of social-first formats. 
  • Strong understanding of social-first content, including what makes videos engaging, accessible and discoverable. 
  • Experience creating branded content  
  • Experience creating both longer-form YouTube content and short-form formats such as YouTube Shorts. 
  • Ability to develop creative concepts and scripts from initial briefs. 
  • Confidence directing and interviewing contributors, with some experience presenting on camera. 
  • Strong video editing and post-production skills (including some graphics creation), with proficiency in industry-standard editing software, such as Adobe Premiere 
  • Experience creating engaging video thumbnails and understanding how video packaging influences performance. 
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple pieces of content and deliver to agreed timelines. 
  • A collaborative approach, with the confidence to share ideas, take feedback and work with a range of stakeholders. 

An understanding of search-led content, YouTube SEO or emerging social search trends would be particularly valuable. 

What You'll Deliver 

Over the course of the engagement, you'll be responsible for delivering: 

  • YouTube videos covering agreed business topics. 
  • Supporting YouTube Shorts edits for each core video. 
  • A mix of creative formats, including face-to-camera, interviews and podcast-style content. 
  • Supporting thumbnails and video packaging. 
  • Final edited assets in agreed, upload-ready formats. 

The programme is expected to be completed by the end of Q4, with opportunities to test different creative approaches and styles throughout the project. 

Working Arrangements 

This is a 2–3 month contract engagement, based our Soho, London office. 

We offer a benefit of a hybrid working arrangement, with Wednesday and Thursday as office-based days and the remaining working days remote. The successful individual will be expected to attend the London office and shoot locations to support filming, meetings and collaboration with the wider Content and Social teams. 

You'll be expected to have your own filming and camera equipment, although Rightmove can support with arranging suitable filming locations where needed. 

You'll work closely with our Content team, with additional creative input and oversight from our Social team, participating in regular check-ins and content reviews throughout the project.  

Contract Engagement & Payment Arrangements 

To engage with Rightmove on this contract, the successful candidate will be required to work through one of Rightmove's pre-vetted umbrella companies, which will be responsible for processing payments and payroll administration for the duration of the engagement. Please note the benefits below are only applicable to our directly engaged employees.  

The successful candidate will be required to complete the relevant registration and onboarding process with one of our approved umbrella providers before commencing the engagement. 

Please provide a link to your showreel and/or portfolio in your application. 

Life at Rightmove

Despite our growth, we’ve remained a friendly, supportive place to work, with employee #1 still working here!  We’ve done this by placing the Rightmove Hows at the heart of everything we do. These are the essential values that reflect our culture, and include:

  • We create value…by delivering results and building trust with partners and consumers.
  • We think bigger…by acting with curiosity and setting bold aspirations.
  • We care deeply…by being real, having fun, and valuing diversity.
  • We move together…by being one team - internally collaborative, externally competitive.
  • We make a difference…by focusing on delivering measurable impact.

We believe in careers that open doors and help our team develop by providing an open and inclusive work environment, offering ongoing   training opportunities, and supporting charity fundraising events. And with 89% of Rightmovers saying we’re a great place to work, we’re clearly doing something right!

What we offer

  • Cash plan for dental, optical and physio treatments.
  • Private Medical Insurance, Pension and Life Insurance, Employee Assistance Plan.
  • 27 days holiday plus two (paid) volunteering days a year to give back, and holiday buy schemes.
  • Contributory stakeholder pension.
  • Life assurance at 4x your basic salary to a spouse, family member or other nominated person in your life.
  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Paid leave for maternity, paternity, adoption & fertility.
  • Travel Loans, Bike to Work scheme, Rental Deposit Loan.
  • Charitable contributions through Payroll Giving and donation matching.
  • Access deals and discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, gym memberships, cinema discounts and more.
  • We offer hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days in the office. For our roles, such as Field or Home-based positions, different working arrangements apply - full details will be shared during the recruitment process.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Rightmove will never discriminate based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage / civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity or sexual orientation. 

At Rightmove, we believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce leads to better innovation, productivity, and overall success. We are committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of their background or identity, to develop and promote a diverse culture that reflects the communities we serve.

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Software Engineers at Axle build the core infrastructure for connecting to distributed energy devices, orchestrating them, and allowing them to participate in electricity markets.

This is a generalist Software Engineering role, encompassing product-engineering, devops, and data engineering. We encourage engineers to own as much of the problem-space as they can: you’ll spend time talking to clients, getting feedback from users, and working closely with market operators.

At Axle, we work in a deliberately flat structure. That means fewer layers, faster decisions, and more ownership for everyone.

Software engineering at Axle looks like

  • Forming a deep understanding of the domain & the business, so you have enough context to execute independently at speed

  • Focusing on outcomes, not process, and taking ownership for the end product you ship into the world

  • Managing your own time and those of others to adapt to changing scope and deadlines, delivering 80% of the value in 20% of the time

Tech stack

🐍 We build in Python + React for the frontend

🐋 Everything we build lives in Docker, for minimal cross-platform faff and maximal reproducibility.
🤖 Unlimited Claude Code tokens - we are aggressive users and explorers of AI, and encourage everybody to reconsider their workflows regularly

title: Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Techniek is nooit het eindpunt, het is het startpunt van elke transformatie

Elke organisatie heeft een verhaal over waar ze naartoe wil. De vraag is of de technologie dat verhaal ondersteunt of tegenwerkt. Als Solution Architect bij LINKIT bepaal jij het antwoord: je vertaalt strategische ambities naar architectuur die houdt, schaalt en meebeweegt.

De uitdaging

Als Solution Architect beweeg je je tussen twee werelden: je haalt nieuwe opdrachten binnen én je maakt ze waar. Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in overheid, finance en logistiek.

Aan de ene kant ben je een belangrijke schakel in ons presalesproces. Je schuift aan bij prospects, denkt mee over hun vraagstuk en vertaalt dat naar een overtuigende technische oplossing. Samen met de Account Executive en Business Consultants zorg je voor de technische onderbouwing die de doorslag geeft, van eerste gesprek tot gewonnen opdracht.

Aan de andere kant ga je, eenmaal binnen, zelf aan de slag als architect. Je werkt aan kernapplicaties die het digitale fundament van onze opdrachtgevers versterken, evalueert technische keuzes en borgt integratie binnen complexe applicatielandschappen. Zo versnel je de digitale transformatie van organisaties die geen ruimte hebben voor half werk.

Je verbindt strategie, technologie en uitvoering, en werkt daarbij nauw samen met onze technische squads en experts op het gebied van security, privacy en informatiehuishouding.

Jouw impact in de praktijk:

  • Je borgt technische keuzes.

  • Je stelt transitie- en solutionarchitecturen op en documenteert deze.

  • Je adviseert over integratie en samenhang binnen complexe applicatielandschappen, inclusief lowcode, cloud en legacy.

  • Je evalueert technische keuzes op beheer, onderhoud, toekomstvastheid en impact voor de organisatie.

Als Solution Architect beweeg je moeiteloos tussen strategisch niveau en technische diepgang, en tussen presales en delivery.

Jouw plek bij LINKIT

Je werkt niet in isolatie, maar midden in het speelveld van LINKIT. Je komt regelmatig naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern. Op vrijdag is er om de twee weken de clubdag, waarin we tijd investeren in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden met collega’s uit alle disciplines.


Wat we vragen

  • 7+ jaar ervaring als Low-code Expert of Solution Architect in complexe IT-landschappen.

  • Hbo of wo-niveau en ruime ervaring met lowcode platformen zoals Mendix en OutSystems, integratievraagstukken en moderne cloudplatformen.

  • Ervaring met agile en DevOps werken, en met moderne technieken; je vertaalt strategische kaders naar gerichte oplossingen.

  • Sterke communicatievaardigheden, stakeholdermanagement en ervaring in presales: je beïnvloedt zonder formele autoriteit, neemt verantwoordelijkheid, hebt nieuwsgierigheid naar technologische trends en verbindt commercie en technologie effectief.

Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact.

Wat je krijgt

  • Salaris tussen €4.500-€7.500 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling.

  • Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken.

  • Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding.

  • Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken.

  • Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag).

  • Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga.

Sollicitatieprocedure

We willen je leren kennen, en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet.

  1. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is.

  2. Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten.

  3. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod.

Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via

Over LINKIT

LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als Solution Architect ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past.

title: Solutions Engineer

Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.  

We are looking for experienced, curious, and driven Solutions Engineers to help customers realise the full value of our platform in a fast-growing market.

This role is a critical part of Algolia’s go-to-market organisation, working closely with Sales and Solutions partners to drive revenue, customer adoption, and best practices. You will play a key role in helping prospects and customers evaluate Algolia, understand its technical capabilities, and successfully apply it to their use cases.

In this position, you will own the technical pre-sales relationship across opportunities and accounts. You will partner with Account Executives to demonstrate the product and underlying architecture, address technical and business objections, and deliver thoughtful, consultative solutions that result in a strong technical win and clear product fit.

title: Staff AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Staff Engineer, AI / ML — Self-Serve Toolchain will build the end-to-end system that lets customers adapt UFORCE models on their own private data without exposing that data to us.

This role spans data processing, foundation-model-assisted labeling, human-in-the-loop QA, active learning, training, evaluation, and model promotion. You will turn an in-flight principal-led capability into a repeatable toolchain that non-expert customers can run safely on-site.

What you’ll do

 

  • Own the ML adaptation pipeline from raw customer data to trained, evaluated, deployable models.

  • Build foundation-model-assisted labeling workflows using tools such as SAM-2, Grounding DINO, open-vocabulary models, LLM steering, and human review.

  • Design self-serve operator workflows using yes/no/maybe feedback and natural-language corrections.

  • Create versioned datasets with lineage, data cards, label provenance, class distributions, and known gaps.

  • Build QA methods that catch systematic pseudo-label errors, missing annotations, and long-tail data gaps.

  • Develop active-learning loops that prioritize the highest-value frames for limited operator review.

  • Build reproducible train/eval pipelines with experiment tracking, model packaging, and promotion gates.

  • Design evaluation around held-out anchor sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and automated approve/reject decisions.

  • Package the toolchain for on-prem, air-gapped, regulated, or customer-held environments.

  • Close the field-failure loop by feeding live failures back into the next tune cycle.

  • Lead and grow a small specialist team around curation, auto-labeling, deployment, and onboarding.

What success looks like

 

  • Customers can run a full adaptation cycle without engineer intervention.

  • Customer data stays inside the customer boundary.

  • The system produces trusted datasets with clear provenance and quality signals.

  • Pseudo-label quality is measured and systematic errors are caught early.

  • The promotion gate can approve or reject models based on evidence, not intuition.

  • Evaluation is protected by anchor sets, leakage controls, slice metrics, and baseline comparisons.

  • Field failures become reproducible inputs to the next training cycle.

  • Synthetic data is used only when it proves value against real held-out data.

  • The toolchain becomes a repeatable capability supported by a small, ramped team.

Required Qualifications

 

  • 7+ years building production ML, AI, or computer-vision systems.

  • Strong Python and PyTorch.

  • Experience owning ML data pipelines, training pipelines, or evaluation infrastructure.

  • Deep CV data experience: detection, segmentation, annotation taxonomies, dataset curation, and data quality.

  • Hands-on experience with model-in-the-loop or foundation-model-assisted labeling.

  • Familiarity with tools such as SAM-2, Grounding DINO, FiftyOne, and annotation platforms.

  • Strong understanding of evaluation: held-out sets, leakage prevention, baselines, slice metrics, and promotion gates.

  • Experience with QA sampling, label-noise analysis, missing annotations, IAA, or alternatives when only one operator is available.

  • Experience with active learning or other methods for prioritizing labeling effort.

  • Ability to reason about dataset economics: quality vs. quantity, long-tail coverage, and cost-per-useful-example.

  • Experience with dataset versioning, lineage, experiment tracking, model registries, or data cards.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and systems thinking.

  • Experience leading engineers as a tech lead, staff engineer, or small-team manager.

Nice to have

 

  • Synthetic data, sim2real, or domain randomization experience.

  • EO / IR / LWIR, remote sensing, maritime imagery, or small-object detection experience.

  • Privacy-preserving ML, federated learning, on-prem, or air-gapped deployment experience.

  • Experience building self-serve ML platforms or tools for non-expert users.

  • Experience with lakeFS, DVC, MLflow, Weights & Biases, Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Flyte, Dagster, Airflow, or Argo.

  • LLM application, context engineering, structured output, or LLM evaluation experience.

  • Exposure to radar, AIS, EO/IR fusion, tracking, sensor fusion, robotics, autonomy, UxV, defence tech, C2/C4ISR, or tactical systems.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.
