title: Staff Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a £7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-pound decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Platform team

Platform at hx builds the foundation that enables engineering teams to ship secure, scalable applications at velocity. We're evolving towards an AI-first platform where self-service infrastructure, intelligent automation, and reusable components compound developer productivity and operational excellence. This isn't about maintaining the status quo; we're reimagining how modern software delivery works.

As the Staff Platform Engineer, you will own the technical direction of this evolution. You will define the architecture and engineering standards that others build to, drive coherence across teams, and ensure the platform strategy is aligned to long-term business outcomes. You will shape how AI-first, self-service infrastructure is done at scale, not just by delivering capabilities yourself, but by creating the conditions for engineering teams across the organisation to move faster, more safely, and more autonomously.

Check out our Engineering Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining!

What you'll be doing

  • Establish a coherent 12–18 month technical direction for the platform, with clearly articulated trade-offs, milestones, and alignment across engineering leadership. The roadmap is understood, trusted, and actively referenced by stakeholders.

  • Platform capabilities are adopted broadly across engineering, not because teams are told to use them, but because they are well-designed, well-documented, and genuinely reduce friction. Measurable reduction in Platform as a bottleneck for common provisioning and deployment tasks.

  • Define the architectural patterns and standards that enable autonomous and AI-augmented workflows across the organisation. Other engineers can build AI-native capabilities without requiring Platform's direct involvement in every initiative.

  • Platform defined standards for security, reliability, and operational excellence are embedded into how all teams build not enforced through gatekeeping, but adopted because they are the path of least resistance. Measurable reduction in misconfiguration, security exceptions, and operational incidents across the estate.

  • Senior engineers are visibly stronger for having worked alongside you. The team develops better instincts for architecture, trade-offs, and platform thinking. You are sought out as a technical authority.

What you'll need to have done

  • Defined the architecture, standards, and patterns for the platform domain over a multi-quarter horizon. Makes high-judgement calls on foundational trade-offs such as build vs buy, depth vs breadth, short-term pragmatism vs long-term coherence and brings the organisation along on those decisions.aa

  • Navigating disagreement across senior engineers, architects, and stakeholders to reach durable technical decisions. Comfortable holding a position under pressure, updating it when presented with better evidence, and ensuring decisions stick once made.a

  • Accountability for outcomes that span multiple teams and that they do not personally deliver. Designs systems, standards, and enablement approaches that multiply the effectiveness of the engineers araound them, rather than being the primary hands-on contributor to every initiative.

  • Defined how AI and automation are embedded into the platform at an architectural level not just experimenting with tools, but establishing patterns that make AI-augmented workflows the default for engineering teams across the organisation.

  • Understanding of the adoption dynamics, internal customer needs, and the systemic barriers to self-service. Shapes the platform roadmap based on feedback, usage data, and a clear-eyed view of where friction exists and ensures the platform earns its adoption rather than mandating it.

  • Identified architectural, security, and operational risks before they become incidents. Influences how the broader engineering organisation thinks about reliability, security posture, and cost efficiency not just within Platform's direct remit.

  • Connecting platform decisions to business outcomes clearly and credibly. Can represent the platform strategy to senior leadership, translate engineering constraints into business language, and use commercial context to sharpen technical priorities.aa

  • Actively developing senior engineers through technical challenge, honest feedback, and deliberate exposure to harder problems. Recognised as someone who raises the capability of the team, not just the quality of the code. Models the engineering culture the organisation is trying to build.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer executing predefined tasks over taking ownership of ambiguous problems that require exploration, experimentation, and iteration to solve

  • You view platform engineering as building infrastructure in isolation rather than treating it as a product with internal customers whose adoption and satisfaction drive success

  • You're uncomfortable with rapid change and continuous improvement, preferring stability and established patterns over evolving practices based on data and feedback

title: Staff Product Analyst, Trust and Safety
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Product Analyst, Trust and Safety at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Sales Engineer, Strategic Accounts (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

We're looking for a Staff Sales Engineer who's energized by solving hard, emerging problems at the intersection of AI, security, and software delivery. You will act as a trusted technical advisor and champion owner, partnering closely with Account Executives, Post Sales, and Product teams to drive measurable business and technical value through:

  • Technical Selling and Deal Shaping

  • AI Governance and Security Thought leadership

  • Technical Champion Ownership and Thought Leadership

  • Customer and Internal Advocacy

  • Competitive and Strategic Selling

This role suits people who like translating deep technical complexity into business clarity, who are comfortable being one of the first to help define a category, and who bring varied backgrounds and ways of thinking to how we solve customer problems.

As a Staff Sales Engineer, you will be reporting to the Solutions Engineering leadership team and operate at the intersection of technical depth, business acumen, and competitive selling discipline.

_______________________________________________________________________


Responsibilities

Technical Selling and Deal Shaping

  • Lead deep technical discovery across Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, and AI/ML teams to understand:

  • AI governance requirements for agentic development (shadow AI, ungoverned MCP tools, agents holding real developer credentials)

  • Software supply chain risk posture

  • Regulatory and compliance drivers (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI Risk Management Framework)

  • Secure development lifecycle requirements

  • Shape technical requirements early in the sales cycle to align customer outcomes with Docker's differentiated value in AI governance, container security, and software supply chain integrity.

  • Design, position, and execute structured PoCs/PoVs focused on:

  • Sandbox, network, and MCP tool policy enforcement

  • Image and artifact integrity (Docker Hardened Images, SLSA Build Level 3 provenance, verifiable SBOMs)

  • Software supply chain visibility

  • Agent and MCP tool governance controls

  • Secure build pipelines

  • Define clear success criteria, evaluation frameworks, and executive-ready value summaries.

  • Influence decision-making through demos, workshops, architecture reviews, and technical executive briefings.

  • Translate complex AI security and governance capabilities into clear business value narratives for CISOs, Heads of Platform Engineering, and AI leaders.

AI Governance and Security Thought Leadership

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor on:

  • Responsible AI development practices

  • Secure AI model lifecycle management

  • Software supply chain integrity (SLSA provenance, SBOMs, verified base images)

  • Container and artifact security

  • DevSecOps best practices

  • Guide customers in implementing governance controls across AI-enabled SDLC workflows.

Provide architectural guidance for:

  • Agentic AI development environments and runtime isolation (sandboxing)

  • Policy-as-code enforcement across agents, tools, and machines

  • MCP tool governance and allow-listing

  • Identity and access governance for AI workloads (IdP-based role and policy assignment)

  • Audit, logging, and SIEM visibility for agent activity

  • Act as a subject matter expert on secure software supply chain and AI security trends in customer-facing engagements.

Technical Champion Ownership and Thought Leadership

  • Build, own, and expand relationships with technical champions across Security, DevOps, Platform, and AI teams.

  • Establish credibility as a trusted advisor through technical thought leadership, architectural guidance, and industry best practices.

  • Leverage champion relationships to influence broader buying groups, shape requirements, and uncover cross-sell and expansion opportunities.

  • Maintain engagement beyond the initial sale, ensuring outcomes are realized and leveraging insights to support future sales motions.

Customer and Internal Advocacy

  • Advocate for customer needs with Product and Engineering, providing clear, actionable feedback informed by field experience.

  • Coordinate with Post Sales and Support resources to ensure continuity across the customer lifecycle.

  • Develop reusable technical assets (workshops, demos, reference architectures, enablement content) to scale impact across accounts.

Competitive and Strategic Selling

  • Actively support competitive sales motions by identifying differentiation and influencing evaluation criteria throughout the sales cycle.

  • Partner with Sales to develop technical win strategies for strategic and competitive accounts.

_______________________________________________________________________

Qualifications

We know strong candidates come from a range of paths, and that confidence gaps keep some excellent candidates from applying to roles like this. If you meet most of what's below and are excited about the rest, please apply.

  • Experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Solutions Architect in complex enterprise sales.

  • Strong experience running competitive PoCs/PoVs with clearly defined success and exit criteria.

  • Ability to engage credibly with senior technical and business stakeholders, including security and platform leadership.

  • Solid understanding of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), containers, DevOps, and modern application architectures.

  • Development, agentic AI development, software development lifecycle, and/or software supply chain experience strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, secure software supply chain (SLSA, SBOMs), MCP or agentic tooling, and DevSecOps practices strongly preferred.

_______________________________________________________________________

What to Expect

  • You will be welcomed with a first-in-class onboarding experience that includes equipment setup, a sweet swag package, and a collaborative training program working with an onboarding peer.

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to help build and operate the cloud infrastructure platform behind our sovereign mission operations teams. You’ll make it safer and easier to deploy, upgrade, and run UFORCE services in on-premises environments, including sites with limited or no internet connectivity.

You’ll combine hands-on infrastructure engineering with practical operational ownership: automating deployments, strengthening reliability, and making sure customer IT and partner operations teams can run the platform with confidence. You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Security, and customer-facing teams, with a focus on solutions that are secure, supportable, and usable in the field.

What you’ll do

  • Build and improve deployment and maintenance automation for on-premises environments, including infrastructure as code, packaging, environment validation, and preflight checks.

  • Make releases and upgrades work reliably in offline or restricted-network settings: manage artifacts and versioning, define validation gates, and document staged rollout and rollback procedures.

  • Develop repeatable deployment patterns for VM-based, Kubernetes-based, and mixed environments, and document when and how to handle deviations.

  • Establish and maintain an observability baseline for constrained environments, including useful metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards. Make alerts actionable and link them to clear runbooks.

  • Define and operationalize service-level objectives and change-safety practices such as smoke tests, rollout checks, and rollback-first procedures.

  • Respond to incidents across deployed environments, coordinate diagnosis and communication, and turn lessons learned into improvements to automation, monitoring, and operations.

  • Create and maintain operational playbooks, troubleshooting guides, escalation paths, and maintenance workflows for customer IT and partner operations teams.

  • Partner with engineering and security teams to identify operational risks early and ensure new platform capabilities are ready to deploy and support.

  • Coach teammates on practical reliability habits, including debugging, alert quality, incident follow-through, and documentation.

Required Skills

  • Significant hands-on experience operating production infrastructure or services in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure engineering.

  • Experience building and maintaining infrastructure as code with Terraform or a comparable tool, including safe practices for testing and applying changes.

  • Practical experience with Kubernetes, virtual-machine platforms, or both; an understanding of deployment and upgrade challenges in constrained environments.

  • Experience designing or operating observability systems for metrics, logs, alerts, and dashboards, including environments that cannot rely on SaaS services.

  • Ability to design safe release, upgrade, and rollback workflows and to make them usable through clear operational documentation.

  • Strong incident-response skills: you can investigate ambiguous symptoms, prioritize checks, coordinate with stakeholders, and follow through on corrective actions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, especially when explaining technical risks, procedures, and trade-offs to engineering and operations partners.

  • A practical, ownership-oriented approach to reliability: you improve the system and close the loop from incident to prevention.

Nice to have

  • Experience with air-gapped, on-premises, or strongly segmented enterprise or defense environments.

  • Experience supporting deployments operated by customer IT teams, third-party operations teams, or managed service providers.

  • Familiarity with enterprise identity integrations such as Active Directory, LDAP, or SSO, as well as secrets management and auditability.

  • Experience defining service-level objectives and improving reliability through incident reviews and measurable follow-up.

  • Familiarity with security or compliance constraints and how to balance them with safe, supportable operations.

What success looks like

  • Standard environment setup and refresh becomes faster and more repeatable, with a path to completing common footprints in less than a day.

  • Upgrade and rollback procedures are validated, well documented, and executable by partner operations teams with limited SRE support.

  • New deployments have usable dashboards and actionable alerts quickly, supported by reusable configuration and runbooks.

  • Customer and partner operations teams resolve more routine issues independently, while recurring incidents lead to durable engineering improvements.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Staff Software Engineer, Infotainment HMI Systems
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

The Berlin team is looking for a Staff Software Engineer - Infotainment, to provide hands-on technical leadership for complex embedded software and hardware/software integration work. You will help shape architectures that connect vehicle hardware, embedded operating systems, platform services, communication paths, and user-facing behavior into reliable products.

This is a broad technical role for an engineer who can move comfortably between system-level design and implementation. You will work across current and next-generation vehicle platforms, helping teams take ideas from early architecture through development, integration, validation, and production readiness. You’ll be working in a high-performing forward-deployed team working closely with key OEM stakeholders. Examples include physical input, HMI systems and bespoke in-vehicle touchpoints.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, develop, and maintain embedded software across hardware interfaces, operating-system services, middleware, communication paths, and applications, using C/C++ and contributing to Rust adoption where it improves safety, reliability, maintainability, or service boundaries.

  • Lead technical design discussions and translate ambiguous requirements into clear interfaces, ownership boundaries, acceptance criteria, dependencies, delivery plans, reusable abstractions, and configuration contracts that scale across vehicle platforms, products, and variants.

  • Evaluate and optimize constrained systems for CPU, memory, storage, power, latency, startup, concurrency, and fault handling while ensuring predictable behavior, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Guide the integration of hardware-linked behavior—including physical controls, display interaction, vehicle signals, persistent state, device configuration, and other time-sensitive system behavior—across software and hardware components.

  • Lead complex software and hardware investigations and drive end-to-end validation using logs, traces, diagnostics, target hardware, laboratory equipment, simulators, emulators, software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and prototype vehicles.

  • Partner with hardware, firmware, platform, application, validation, product, and external teams to resolve dependencies and make timely technical decisions; establish practices for schemas, generated bindings, diagnostics, observability, versioning, compatibility, and maintainability; and mentor engineers while communicating architecture, risks, trade-offs, and decisions clearly.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, plus seven or more years developing or integrating embedded, platform, or hardware-linked software.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing, debugging, reviewing, and maintaining C and/or C++ software, with practical Rust experience or the ability and interest to learn Rust.

  • Experience with embedded operating systems, embedded Linux, real-time systems, board-support packages, device drivers, hypervisor-based systems, or comparable constrained computing environments.

  • Strong understanding of hardware/software interfaces, communication protocols, concurrency, timing, startup and reset behavior, resource constraints, fault handling, and system performance across CPU, power, memory, storage, latency, reliability, and degraded operation.

  • Experience leading architecture, integration, and system-level debugging across multiple software and hardware components, defining interface contracts, schemas, generated bindings, diagnostics, logging, versioning, compatibility practices, and end-to-end validation.

  • Experience with automotive, aerospace, mobile-device, consumer-electronics, robotics, industrial-control, defense, or similarly constrained embedded products, including HMI, physical controls, display systems, vehicle signals, gateways, input routing, or other real-time hardware-linked behavior.

  • Experience with ARM-based systems, high-performance system-on-chip platforms, board bring-up, hardware debugging tools, and interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet, USB, PCIe, SPI, or I2C; familiarity with reusable platform, middleware, SDK, or device-integration components, CI/CD, telemetry, diagnostic logging, command-line tooling, and laboratory-debugging workflows, plus excellent communication skills across distributed teams and external partners.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

descriptionHtml:
Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Doctolib Prévention, une équipe d'entrepreneur(euse)s qui construit une nouvelle activité depuis 2022 avec l'ambition de transformer le système de santé vers plus de prévention. En participant à des missions très diversifiées aux côtés du Prevention Strategy Associate, vous contribuerez directement à accompagner l'effort national de virage vers une médecine plus préventive et à donner aux patients les moyens de devenir acteurs de leur santé.

 

Vos missions

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

  • Réaliser des analyses quantitatives et améliorer les outils de mesure (enquêtes, analyses comparatives) pour évaluer l’impact des campagnes de prévention et formuler des recommandations.

  • Mener des études de marché pour soutenir le développement de Doctolib Prévention.

  • Contribuer à la priorisation de la roadmap produit et marketing.

  • Préparer les reportings internes et coordonner avec les équipes (communication, affaires publiques, autres équipes).

  • Optimiser les processus internes et produire des supports (scripts, pitchs, présentations) pour l’équipe sales.

 

Les qualités attendues 

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n'avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos besoins, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.

Vous pourrez être le prochain membre de notre équipe si vous :

  • Êtes étudiant.e en Master 1/2 en école de commerce ou d'ingénieur, avec une spécialisation en stratégie, santé publique, ou data

  • Êtes à l'aise avec la data, l'analyse de données quantitatives et faites preuve de rigueur et d'esprit de synthèse

  • Avez un esprit entrepreneurial, une envie d'apprendre et de vous impliquer dans un projet à impact

  • Faites preuve d'adaptabilité, de flexibilité et de qualités relationnelles

Ce serait fantastique si :

  • Vous portez un intérêt fort pour la santé et/ou l'innovation en santé

  • Vous souhaitez monter en compétences sur des sujets variés : stratégie, data, marketing, opérations

  • Vous possédez une appétence pour le domaine des médias

Notre offre

  • Un programme d’onboarding complet, avec la Doctolib Academy et de nombreuses sessions de formation au sein de votre équipe (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

  • Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux 

  • Une offre de sport : un abonnement Urban Sports Club, des cours de sport gratuits dans les bureaux ou à distance

  • Le remboursement des titres de transport à 50%

  • De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être 

  • Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride

Le processus de recrutement

  • Un call RH avec Flore, Talent Partner (15 minutes)

  • Un entretien opérationnel avec Aabir Elakili, Prevention Strategy Lead (1 heure)

Détails du poste

  • Stage conventionné à temps plein

  • Durée : 6 mois

  • Début souhaité : mars 2027

  • Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret

  • Rémunération : À définir selon profil

 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

Toutes les informations fournies sont traitées par Doctolib pour la gestion des candidatures. Pour plus de détails sur le traitement des données, cliquez ici. Veuillez contacter hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com pour toute question ou pour exercer vos droits.

title: Stageopdracht Video Content Creator
descriptionHtml:
Over Noldus

Bij Noldus ontwikkelen we innovatieve software en technologie waarmee onderzoekers

wereldwijd menselijk en dierlijk gedrag kunnen bestuderen en analyseren. Onze oplossingen

worden gebruikt in uiteenlopende onderzoeksomgevingen, van universiteiten en laboratoria tot

ziekenhuizen en bedrijven.

We hebben onlangs onze website volledig vernieuwd. Een mooie stap vooruit, maar ons

beeldmateriaal is nog niet overal meegegroeid. Daarom zoeken we een creatieve en zelfstandige

stagiair die ons helpt om onze producten, software en toepassingen op een moderne en

aantrekkelijke manier in beeld te brengen.

De stageopdracht

Hoe maken we onze innovatieve producten en software visueel aantrekkelijk, begrijpelijk en

overtuigend voor onze websitebezoekers?

Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met het ontwikkelen en produceren van nieuwe

videocontent voor onze website en andere digitale kanalen. Samen met het E-commerce team

bepaal je welke onderwerpen en producten we willen uitlichten en hoe we deze het beste

kunnen presenteren. Vervolgens vertaal je deze ideeën naar concrete videoconcepten en ga je

zelfstandig aan de slag met de uitvoering.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

• Productvideo’s: laat zien hoe onze producten in de praktijk worden gebruikt en welke

mogelijkheden ze bieden.

• Softwaredemo’s en screen recordings: maak korte, duidelijke video’s waarin je

functionaliteiten en toepassingen van onze software laat zien.

• Customer stories: breng in beeld hoe onderzoekers onze oplossingen gebruiken en welke

waarde ze toevoegen aan hun onderzoek.

• Animaties en motion graphics: gebruik animatie om complexe technologie, processen of

functionaliteiten eenvoudig uit te leggen.

• Combinaties van bestaand en nieuw beeldmateriaal: ontwikkel creatieve manieren om

bestaande content te vernieuwen en aan te vullen met nieuwe beelden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je krijgt de ruimte om het volledige creatieve proces te doorlopen, van eerste idee tot

eindproduct.

• Je inventariseert samen met het E-commerce team welke videocontent nodig is en waar de

grootste kansen liggen.

• Je ontwikkelt creatieve concepten, storyboards en een praktische contentplanning.

• Je organiseert en maakt nieuwe video-opnames, zowel van producten als van software in

gebruik.

• Je maakt screen recordings, animaties en motion graphics waar dit de boodschap versterkt.

• Je monteert en bewerkt het materiaal tot professionele video’s die passen bij onze nieuwe

huisstijl.

• Je zorgt ervoor dat de video’s geschikt zijn voor gebruik op onze website, productpagina’s en

andere digitale kanalen.

Wat willen we bereiken?

Aan het einde van de stage willen we beschikken over een vernieuwde collectie videocontent

die:

• Onze producten en software duidelijk en aantrekkelijk presenteert.

• Websitebezoekers helpt om sneller te begrijpen wat onze oplossingen doen en hoe ze worden

gebruikt.

• Een moderne, consistente uitstraling heeft die aansluit bij onze nieuwe website en huisstijl.

• Op verschillende plekken binnen onze digitale klantreis kan worden ingezet.

Naast concrete video’s werk je aan een herkenbare visuele stijl en aanpak, zodat we ook in de

toekomst op een consistente manier nieuwe videocontent kunnen ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden wij?

• Een creatieve stage met veel ruimte voor eigen ideeën en initiatief.

• De mogelijkheid om een project van concept tot eindproduct zelfstandig vorm te geven.

• Samenwerking met een enthousiast E-commerce team en verschillende productspecialisten.

• Een internationale en innovatieve werkomgeving.

• Concrete eindproducten die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt op onze website en digitale

kanalen.

• Een mooie kans om je portfolio uit te breiden met uiteenlopende videoproducties, animaties

en softwaredemo’s.

Het eindresultaat

Je levert niet alleen een aantal professionele video’s op, maar helpt Noldus ook om een nieuwe

standaard neer te zetten voor hoe we onze producten en technologie visueel presenteren.

Jouw creativiteit maakt onze innovaties zichtbaar!


Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een creatieve, enthousiaste student die het leuk vindt om ideeën om te zetten in

professioneel beeldmateriaal. Je volgt bijvoorbeeld een hbo-opleiding in de richting van Creative

Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Audiovisuele Media of een vergelijkbare

creatieve opleiding.

Je herkent jezelf in het volgende:

• Je hebt affiniteit met videoproductie, editing en visuele storytelling.

• Je kunt werken met tools zoals Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve of

vergelijkbare software.

• Je vindt het leuk om zowel te filmen als digitaal beeldmateriaal te creëren.

• Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op.

• Je bent creatief, neemt initiatief en denkt graag mee over hoe iets beter of aantrekkelijker

kan.

• Je vindt het interessant om complexe software of technologie op een toegankelijke manier uit

te leggen.

Ervaring met animatie of motion graphics is een pluspunt.

title: Stagiair
descriptionHtml:
Let op: stageplekken voor de functie van stagiair in de uitvoering zijn populair. Vanaf het nieuwe schooljaar verwachten wij meer duidelijkheid te hebben over de beschikbare stageplekken voor schooljaar 2026/2027. Leerlingen die in de tussentijd toch solliciteren, worden op de wachtlijst geplaatst. We willen hierbij wel aangeven dat we op dit moment geen stageplek kunnen garanderen.

Ben jij op zoek naar een stage in elektrotechniek waar je écht meedraait en iets leert? Bij ons Amsterdamse familiebedrijf werk je mee aan projecten in de bouw en installatietechniek en ontdek je waar jouw interesses en talenten liggen.

Geen onbelangrijke klusjes, maar werkzaamheden die passen bij jouw opleiding en niveau. Je krijgt een vaste begeleider die jou stap voor stap helpt en je laat zien hoe het vak in de praktijk werkt. Zo leer je snel en werk je meteen mee aan mooie projecten in en rondom Amsterdam, zoals utiliteitsgebouwen en hotels.

Wat wij je bieden

  • Een stage waarin je écht meedoet en leert

  • Werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij je opleiding en leerdoelen

  • Goede begeleiding van een ervaren mentor

  • Een veilige en prettige werkomgeving in een Amsterdams familiebedrijf

  • Een stagevergoeding

  • Kans op een BBL-plek of vaste baan na je stage

  • Een leuke en afwisselende ervaring in een energiek team met fijne collega’s (medewerkerstevredenheid: 8,1)

Wat ga je doen?

We stemmen je stage af op jouw opleiding, niveau en leerdoelen. Je werkt mee aan echte projecten en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen binnen de elektrotechniek.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Meewerken aan echte elektrotechnische projecten in en rondom Amsterdam

  • Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij je opleiding en stage-opdrachten

  • Kennis uit school toepassen in de praktijk

  • Samenwerken met ervaren collega’s en leren van hun ervaring

  • Begeleiding krijgen van een vaste stagebegeleider die jou helpt om te groeien

  • Naarmate je verder komt, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandig werk

Wat neem je mee?

  • Je volgt een opleiding in elektrotechniek (MBO 1, 2, 3 of 4)

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om het vak te leren

  • Je bent betrouwbaar en komt afspraken na

  • Je werkt graag samen en staat open voor nieuwe ervaringen

  • Je communiceert duidelijk met collega’s en spreekt goed Nederlands

Welkom in ons team

We zijn een gek bedrijf in een gekke wereld. Daar moet je wel tegen kunnen… Dat vraagt om ambitie, creativiteit, inzet en openheid.

We stellen hoge eisen aan kwaliteit en teamwork. Daar zijn we professionals voor. Specialisten. Natuurlijk maken we fouten. Maar we schuiven niets onder het tapijt. We lossen ze op. En we gaan niet naar huis voordat we met z’n allen de klus geklaard hebben.

Wat je daarvoor terugkrijgt? Een goed salaris en volop kansen om het vak te leren, je kennis te vergroten of je loopbaan een boost te geven. De sfeer op kantoor en bij de uitvoering is meer dan goed, je staat er nooit alleen voor.

En je krijgt de kans om te werken aan spannende projecten op bijzondere locaties. Bij SDR is het nooit saai!

title: Senior Product Manager Platform (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Berater:innen vereinen das Tax Know-How aus Industrie, Beratung, Finanzverwaltung und IT in ganz besonderer Weise. Auch deshalb verstehen wir die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Mandant:innen besser als andere und entwickeln maßgeschneiderte Produkte und Lösungen aus einer Hand. Durch den bewussten Verzicht auf Abschlussprüfungen sind wir zusätzlich ein unabhängiger und langfristiger Partner. Wir freuen uns schon auf Dich!

Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest Produktvision und Roadmap für eine unserer Produktlinie der WTS Platform
  • Du führst Product Discovery mit unseren Service Lines und Mandanten durch. Du untersuchst ihre Arbeitsabläufe und prüfst die wichtigsten Annahmen
  • Du baust mit AI-Unterstützung selbst klickbare oder funktionale Prototypen, damit Ideen früh erlebbar und testbar werden
  • Du testest unterschiedliche Ansätze mit echten Nutzer:innen und entwickelst nur die Lösungen weiter, die sich in der Praxis bewähren
  • Nach einer erfolgreichen Discovery führst du das Vorhaben auf Produktseite durch Umsetzung und Release. Danach prüfst du anhand von Nutzung, Rückmeldungen und Geschäftswert, ob die Lösung den erwarteten Nutzen bringt
  • Du entwickelst Business Cases für neue Initiativen und vertrittst sie vor der Geschäftsführung​
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Engineering, Design und den Steuerexpert:innen aus den Service Lines zusammen. Development verantwortet Architektur, produktiven Code und Betrieb

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Manager für B2B-SaaS-, Plattform- oder Enterprise-Produkte mit
  • Du hast Produktvorhaben von der Problemklärung über den Release bis zur Weiterentwicklung verantwortet
  • Du führst Nutzerinterviews selbst und kannst Beobachtungen einordnen, ohne vorschnell die falschen Schlüsse zu ziehen
  • Du baust selbst mit modernen AI-Tools. Wir wollen sehen, was du getestet, daraus gelernt und anschließend verändert oder verworfen hast
  • Du hast praktisch mit Modellen, Prompts, Kontext und Agenten gearbeitet. Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung setzen wir nicht voraus
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit

Benefits

Das „Wir“ ist wesentlicher Bestandteil unserer DNA. Denn unser Erfolg fußt maßgeblich auf unseren einzigartigen Teams. Diese besondere Kultur pflegen wir im Rahmen regelmäßiger Teamevents mit viel Raum für den persönlichen Austausch. Unsere Vielfalt zeigt sich auch in unserer Mandatsstruktur: Ob Start-Up- oder Dax-Unternehmen - bei uns kann jeder Ideen und Ansätze einbringen. title: Strategic Partnerships Lead - UK
descriptionHtml:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

Who We Need

Rillet is hiring its first partnerships leader in the UK. You will kickstart our partner motion in the market from day one: choosing where to start, signing the first partners, and building results and momentum so we can staff up a team around you.

This is a founding, high-agency role that will span all three of Rillet's partner channels in the UK:

  • Accounting & Advisory: CPA, chartered accountancy, and ERP consulting firms that recommend and implement Rillet for their clients

  • Private Equity & Venture Capital: investors who back finance-led high growth companies and want to tool them with the best available technology

  • Technology: the fintech and Office of the CFO software ecosystem that integrates with Rillet and co-sells with us

You will work with partner executives on vision and business-case creation, and with front-line leaders on execution. You will work closely with the US partnerships leads for each channel, who will share playbooks, frameworks, and introductions, and with Product, Sales, Marketing, Solutions, and Customer Success to make every partner relationship turn into pipeline and revenue. You will build on our existing partnerships in the US – with firms such as the Big 4 and top PE firms – and expand our presence in their ecosystems in the UK.

This is a highly visible role internally and externally. What you build in the UK becomes the template for how Rillet launches partner programs in new markets.

What You'll Do

  • Launch the UK partner motion: Create a market map of key partners and channel-specific motions, and execute relentlessly to get early wins

  • Generate revenue day 1: Partnerships is a critical go-to-market play for Rillet, and it’s important we are commercially oriented from the start

  • Develop Rillet’s value exchange: Our partnerships are built on trust and reciprocity; you will identify what major partners care about and align Rillet’s plans to bring them value

  • Expand core capabilities and capacity: Work with partners to deepen our product capabilities and our implementation capacity in the UK

  • Establish Rillet as the market leader: Build alliances with the top firms and technology companies, and notable individuals, to win mindshare among addressable clients. As we have done in the US – any trusted advisor or PE firm or OCFO tech company would recommend Rillet

  • Host and attend industry events: Build relationships and presence in the UK and become the face of partnerships for the market

  • Enable Rillet’s GTM functions to work seamlessly with partners: Co-sell, implementations, integrations, customizations – wherever a partner can help us win, Sales, Marketing, Solutions, and Product should know whom to go to and how

  • Provide critical product feedback from the front lines: Rillet’s partners are top notch. They understand customer needs, and our job is to bake their feedback into everything we do

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of relevant experience in strategic partnerships at a high-growth B2B software company, or at a top finance-focused private equity firm

  • Background in analytically rigorous professions – investing, management consulting, investment banking, or product strongly preferred

  • Track record of launching and scaling partner programs from scratch, ideally as a first or early hire in a new market

  • Demonstrated ability to turn partnerships into real commercial outcomes: partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, not just relationships

  • Experience with at least one of our channels (accounting and ERP consulting firms, PE / VC investors, or technology and integration partners), and the curiosity to learn the other two quickly

  • Established network in the UK finance, accounting, or software ecosystem is a strong plus

  • Ability to build trusted relationships with C-level and equivalent executives

  • Proven track record of thriving in ambiguity: creating structure, taking action, and driving measurable results

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration and impact

  • Strong internal drive and low ego, with a team-first, growth mindset. Some call this an "Athlete" mentality

  • Willingness to travel across the UK and Europe, and to the US as needed

Life at Rillet

  • Grow with us. Take meaningful ownership, expand your scope, and make an impact as Rillet scales.

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

title: System Engineer – MFT, EDI & Email Security 80%-100%
descriptionHtml:

Als IT-Reseller und Lösungsanbieter begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Lifecycle – von der technischen Beratung und Konzeption über die Implementierung und Integration bis hin zum Betrieb und Support.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen System Engineer, der unsere Kundenprojekte technisch begleitet und gemeinsam mit unserem Team anspruchsvolle Integrations- und Infrastrukturaufgaben umsetzt.

Als System Engineer bist du Teil unseres technischen Teams und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Implementierung, Integration und Betreuung unserer Lösungen.

Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und hast direkten Kontakt zu unseren Kunden. Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Applikationen, Infrastruktur, Netzwerken und Geschäftsprozessen.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
descriptionHtml:

title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.



What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

We're hiring a Tech Lead for our brand new Payments squad, part of Saldo, our Billing and Payments Service.

Payments at tem works today, but it's a basic service. We're growing fast, and it needs to be built for the scale we're moving towards. You'll be the first tech lead in a squad that already has a senior engineer and three junior engineers, and you'll own the outcome of the squad's delivery and the standards it works to.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write design docs, review code, solve the hardest problems alongside the team, and set the technical direction for payments. The number you'll move is the cost of processing every pound that flows through tem. Your job is to bring it down, and keep it low as we scale.

Must-Haves

Desirable

title: Technical Analyst
descriptionHtml:
• Location: Paris, France (Hybrid) 

  • Level: C2

  • Team: Client Delivery

  • Reporting To: Head of Migration Enablement and Architecture

This role is based in Paris and requires an existing right to work in the EU.

At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

Kaluza’s Technical Analysts are an important member of our Implementation teams. It’s a critical hybrid role that bridges the gap between the customer's business needs and the company's technical product. They act as a consultant and technical expert during the customer onboarding and implementation phase, ensuring that Kaluza’s SaaS platform is configured and deployed successfully to meet the client's specific energy-related challenges.

This role requires a unique combination of technical expertise, data analysis, problem solving skills, and a solid understanding of the energy industry.

As a Technical Analyst, you are the critical link between our clients' ambitions and Kaluza's cutting-edge SaaS platform. This is a hands-on, hybrid role where you'll act as both a technical consultant and a subject matter expert, guiding our enterprise clients through the entire implementation lifecycle. You won't just be configuring software; you'll be solving complex business problems and enabling the energy transition.

Your role will focus on taking a new client from the initial sale to a fully operational system. This includes:

  • Requirements Gathering and Analysis: You'll meet with clients to deeply understand their specific business needs, data sources, and operational processes. You'll translate these high-level requirements into detailed technical specifications for our engineering and delivery teams.

  • System Configuration and Design: You'll lead the technical configuration of the Kaluza platform, aligning it with the client's operational model and regulatory requirements. This involves customising parameters, dashboards, reports, and workflows to ensure a perfect fit.

  • Data Integration and Migration: A critical part of this role, you'll be responsible for integrating the client's existing data systems with our platform. You'll work with APIs and data pipelines, build and manage ETL processes, and ensure historical data is migrated accurately and securely.

  • Testing and Quality Assurance: In close collaboration with our Quality Assurance teams, you'll develop and execute test plans to ensure the implemented solution performs flawlessly. You will validate data accuracy, test system performance, and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

  • Client Training and Enablement: You'll empower client teams by providing comprehensive training and creating detailed user guides. You'll also serve as the primary technical point of contact, troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise during the implementation phase.

  • Project Management Support: You will work alongside our Programme Managers, providing the technical expertise needed to develop project timelines, manage key deliverables, and proactively identify and mitigate technical risks.

About You 

You are a hands-on, analytical problem-solver who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You have a passion for detail and a proven ability to translate complex client needs into practical, scalable solutions. You are comfortable working with large, diverse datasets and possess a strong understanding of how enterprise systems function.

Ideally, you'll have/be:

  • Proven Implementation Experience: Hands-on experience in a similar role, successfully implementing enterprise-level SaaS solutions for B2B clients.

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working with large datasets, APIs, and ETL processes, with a strong understanding of the core principles of data integration and migration.

  • Business Analysis & Requirements Management: Strong business analysis skills, with experience eliciting, analysing, documenting, validating and prioritising complex business and technical requirements. Confident using a range of requirements-gathering techniques, including stakeholder interviews, workshops, process mapping, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria. Able to translate business needs into clear functional and technical requirements, identify gaps and dependencies, manage requirements traceability, and support stakeholders through solution design, testing and implementation.

  • Stakeholder Management & Facilitation: Skilled at engaging business and technical stakeholders, facilitating requirements and solution workshops, challenging assumptions, resolving ambiguity and building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Process & Solution Analysis: Able to understand current-state business processes, define future-state requirements, perform gap and impact analysis, and work collaboratively with product and engineering teams to shape practical solutions.

  • A Problem-Solving Mindset: A natural curiosity and an enthusiastic drive for continuous improvement. Motivated by the challenge of breaking down complex problems and finding pragmatic, scalable solutions.

  • Business Acumen: Experience working with enterprise technology systems and a strong understanding of how technology, data and business processes interact to support operational and commercial outcomes.

  • Proficiency in French: Since this role is based in Paris and serves a European market, fluency in French is essential to engage effectively with our clients.

What will set you apart

  • Experience in the Energy Sector: While not essential, prior experience with energy-related data systems (e.g., MDMS, billing systems) or an understanding of the energy industry will be a significant advantage.

  • Client-Facing Excellence: You have a proven track record of acting as a trusted technical advisor to clients, building strong relationships, and managing expectations throughout a project.

  • The Big Picture Thinker: A deep curiosity about how a client’s business works, allowing you to develop solutions that don’t just fix a problem but fundamentally transform their operations.

  • A work ethic and style that brings people and teams together to achieve more than the sum of individual parts. 

Where you'll work

We offer flexible working, with an expectation of 3 days a week in the office. This gives us the best of both: real time together to collaborate and build relationships, with the flexibility to work in the way that suits you best the rest of the week.

Kaluza Values

Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:

Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together.

We want the best people

We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.

We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
